programme.sub-title: Luc Tangorre case, the strength of denial (1st part)
programme.desc: The Luc Tangorre cases were among the most publicized in France. In 1983, Luc Tangorre, nicknamed "the rapist of the southern districts of Marseilles", was sentenced to 15 years in prison for ten sexual assaults and rapes committed between 1979 and 1981. After partial pardon and release from prison, he was charged with rape of two American female students in 1988 and sentenced to 18 years of imprisonment by the Gard Assize Court.
programme.desc-more: Everyone presented him as a victim of miscarriage of justice, he was in fact a champion of recidivism. programme.title: The history of the Route du Rhum

And in a few years, the Route du Rhum has become a laboratory of the future where the sea becomes dematerialized and where the sailor becomes a pilot. The 2026 edition will be the meeting of flying boats: 70% of the boats registered at the start will be equipped with foils. Back to this spectacular metamorphosis of the time of the poets sailors to today's pilots, following the trace of those who have changed the legend.

programme.title: Family
programme.desc: When she was in Strasbourg, where she had been raped by her father for the first time, Christine Angot decided to visit her family.
programme.desc-more: Christine Angot, a renowned writer, embarks on an introspective journey after a major encounter at a book festival. Desiring to understand the roots of her trauma, she decided to return to Strasbourg to explore the family past linked to her father, Pierre, who had been her executioner during her teenage years. Her first stop leads her to Elizabeth, Peter's companion, with whom she engages in a tumultuous conversation, seeking to bring out buried truths. This meeting, full of emotions, reveals tensions and unsaid, updating the complexity of family relations. Christine then went to her mother, Claude, in the hope of finding answers and a form of reconciliation. However, confrontation is equally difficult, with each exchange filled with pain and resentment. Through these visits, Christine tries to heal her wounds and redefine her identity in the face of a past that haunts her.

programme.title: Fortune de France
programme.desc: The death of Isabelle leaves John inconsolable and Peter carrying a heavy secret. The plague is ravaging the region. Fontenac, the sworn enemy, begs Siorac to save his daughter Diane with the disease. John accepts it provided it is quarantined, and succeeds in curing it. François is delighted with Diane, while Pierre discovers love with Hélix...
programme.desc-more: In the Black Perigord in 1557, France was plunged into the wars of Religion, creating a climate of tension and violence. Jean de Siorac (Nicolas Duvauchelle), a respected knight and a fervent defender of Protestantism, finds himself trapped behind the walls of the castle of Mespech, isolated in a world where intolerance is law. As he struggles to protect his community, his dedicated Catholic wife Isabelle (Lucie Debay) struggles to find a place in a society dominated by men. Tensions within the family are felt, especially among their sons, Pierre (Simon Zampieri) and François, who are drawn between their respective beliefs. Through Pierre's eyes, the favourite son, this first season explores moral dilemmas and family conflicts exacerbated by historical circumstances. Between loyalty, faith and violence, the struggle for survival and identity is emerging in a troubled context where everyone must choose their own side.

programme.desc: Jean-Paul Leconte, nicknamed the "killer of the Somme", was sentenced to life imprisonment in 2005 for the murders of Patricia Leclercq and Christelle Dubuisson in 2002. Sentenced to 17 years in prison in 1991 for rape, he was released after 13 years, having received a remission of sentence. It was a DNA analysis that eventually confused him in the murder of the two young women, committed one month apart.

programme.title: At the end of the investigation, the end of the perfect crime?
programme.sub-title: Francis Leroy, the full moon killer
programme.desc: At the turn of the 1980s, a masked and armed man spreads panic in the Bergerac region. He enters houses and sequesters their occupants. Over the years, his attacks became more and more violent, until he committed crimes. It will take years of investigation to confuse him with the strange but brilliant intuition of a policeman.

programme.title: The Apprenticeship
programme.desc: In the early 1970s, in New York. Donald Trump joins his father's company, specializing in housing rental. The young man, who was set up by a discrimination investigation, offered himself the services of Roy Cohn, a formidable lawyer. This decision marks the beginning of his irresistible ascent...
programme.desc-more: In a setting that evokes the power struggles and the disproportionate ambitions of modern America, The Apprentice offers a fascinating look at the tumultuous beginnings of a young Donald Trump (Sebastian Stan). In the 1970s, as the country is in the midst of a transformation, Trump began to forge his destiny at the intersection of business and politics. In search of influence and success, he crossed Roy Cohn's (Jeremy Strong) route, a conservative lawyer with a flamboyant character and implacable strategy. The latter becomes his mentor, initiates Trump to the archanes of power, and this, through a pact that seems promising but carries within him the seeds of a devouring ambition. As Trump navigates a world of alliances and betrayals, he faces personal and professional challenges that will test his integrity and ambition. The stakes are constantly increasing as Trump proves to be willing to sacrifice everything to reach his dreams, while Cohn, the master of political manipulation, reveals a world where success has a price.

programme.title: Trump leaves or doubles
programme.desc: The Midterms, the US mid-term elections, which renew the entire House of Representatives, one third of the Senate and two thirds of the governors, take the form of a referendum this year for or against Donald Trump and could hinder the reforms desired by the US President. The outcome of the vote is indeed a condition for the continuation of American political life for the next two years. Focus on the forces in attendance and the atmosphere in which the election takes place.

programme.desc-more: Cherif, 10, Dimitri, 8, Jonathan, 6, and Dylan, 4 years old, the four boys of Myriam Badaoui and Thierry Delay are placed in foster care following multiple episodes of violence by their unemployed alcoholic father. programme.title: Outreau's case
programme.desc: Delay children and their mothers reveal the existence of a farm in Belgium, where repeated rapes would have occurred. The investigation is moving towards a network of paedophilia in connection with Belgium, but the on-site investigation does not bring back anything new. Despite the lack of evidence, new people are arrested. All claim their innocence, until Daniel Legrand son makes a declaration that will change everything.

programme.title: Samy and the angels of the Timone
programme.desc: L'animatrice Eglantine Éméyé lost her 17-year-old younger son, Samy, who was a polydisabled with severe autistic traits on 20 February 2023. A few days before, he had arrived in the neuropediatric department of Timone Hospital, following complications of back surgery. Eglantine today pays tribute to this team of voluntary, committed and supportive caregivers, by convening the memories of the moments shared with her son in this exceptional service to humanity, which welcomes children with often rare diseases.

programme.title: Typewriter and other sources of hassle
programme.desc: In a unique setting, the barge the Adamant and the Averroès and Rosa Parks pavilions of Esquirol Hospital, director Nicolas Philibert explores the daily lives of caregivers and patients. Through his objective, he highlights dedicated doctors who do not just care; They also engage in concrete actions to improve the daily lives of their patients. Among them, Walid Benzane and Goulven Cancouët are found in Patrice d'Hondt's apartment, a poet known for his touching verses recited on the Adamant. On that day, Patrice, overwhelmed, faced a crisis: his precious typewriter, his expression tool, broke down. This moment of intimacy not only reveals the personal challenges that patients face, but also the profound humanity of caregivers who, through their presence and help, transform moments of hassle into opportunities for sharing and comfort.

programme.title: Simon Coleman
programme.desc: Discover the summary of the episodes of season 4 of the Simon Coleman series, with Jean-Michel Tinivelli, Flavie Péan, Ted Etienne
programme.desc-more: Simon Coleman (Jean-Michel Tinivelli) is a policeman with a fearless character, a specialist in infiltration missions who does not hesitate to risk his life in the service of justice. Her contagious smile and relaxed attitude to the most perilous situations give her a charismatic and confusing aura. While he inspires confidence in some of his colleagues, others perceive him as an unconscious player in Russian roulette. Simon navigates a world where every choice can have dramatic consequences, skillfully juggling with external threats while keeping a keen sense of humour. As he immerse himself in criminal environments plunged into the meanderings of illegality, he must not only expose criminals, but also face his own demons and the growing pressure of his profession. As the episodes progress, the issues become more intense, forcing Simon to establish complex relationships with his colleagues, his superiors and even potential informants, while the danger is around every corner. In this dangerous game where the line between good and evil becomes blurred, Simon fights to protect the city he loves while wondering about the price to pay for his mission.

programme.title: Flo
programme.desc: The little fiancée of the Atlantic, Florence Arthaud (Stéphane Caillard), was a great navigator. His exceptional and unique record in this masculine universe reached its peak with his victory of the Route du Rhum in 1990. Beyond these exploits, "Flo" tells the incredible destiny of a fiercely free woman who, after a road accident that almost cost her her life, decides to reject her bourgeois milieu and the life she had been set for her to live her dreams fully.

programme.title: The history of the Route du Rhum
programme.desc: For some years, an invisible wing has raised the sea. The foil, an engineering blade, allows the boats to no longer float, but to fly over the waves. And in a few years, the Route du Rhum has become a laboratory of the future where the sea becomes dematerialized and where the sailor becomes a pilot. The 2026 edition will be the meeting of flying boats: 70% of the boats registered at the start will be equipped with foils. Back to this spectacular metamorphosis of the time of the poets sailors to today's pilots, following the trace of those who have changed the legend.

programme.title: Invisible wounds
programme.desc: Camille (Sarah Suco) is missing. Murder, suicide or run away? The testimonies of her entourage give an contradictory picture of this married woman and mother of two little girls. Camille's journey until her disappearance is replayed before our eyes, at the same time as advance the intimate investigation conducted by her best friend and sister of her husband and the police investigation conducted by Captain Larivière (Lubna Azabal), to find her. This dive into a woman's life describes the effects of psychological manipulation within the couple. An invisible but destructive violence that sometimes leads to the worst.

programme.title: Captives
programme.desc: In 1894, Fanni Devander voluntarily entered the hospital of the Salpêtrière. While Dr. Charcot died a few months earlier, the young woman, married and mother of family, entered a facility where women of all ages, often suffering from mental disorders, were confined in very harsh conditions. Welcomed by a supervisor, nicknamed La Douane, who takes some of her property, Fanni meets Marguerite Botard, the nurse in chief, and Flaviane, a resident, to whom she entrusts that she is looking for her mother, who has been incarcerated for many years in a Parisian psychiatric institution.

programme.title: Provencal Colorado: The world of ochres
programme.desc: Several million years ago, what was to become Provence was under the sea. The sea retreated behind it from clay-rich sands and from the ocreous and white shores. The landscape of this corner of Provence, enhanced by its quarries, is the result of nature, erosion and the work of men. Without them, the ochre would have remained secret, hidden under vegetation. With Sophie Seigneur, Nicolas Raymond, Richard Mégret, Christophe Allemand, Nicolas Brandel, Gilles Camus.

Case concluded, everyone has something to sell
The art of crime
programme.desc: In the catacombs of Paris, a young woman, disguised as a vampire, is found murdered, spread in a coffin, a stake deep in her heart. Near the body, a reproduction of the painting "Vampire" d'Edvard Munch. Police captain Antoine Verlay and art historian Florence Chassagne are investigating the theatre troupe in which the victim, Sarah Angeli, a 24-year-old actress, was playing. Two days earlier, the deceased and Cécile Monclar, the actress who replaced her when she was on rest, fought violently.
programme.desc-more: Captain Antoine Verlay (Nicolas Gob), a seasoned investigator with impulsive character, is assigned to the OCBC, the Central Office for Combating Trafficking in Cultural Property. This new position is proving to be a real challenge for him, because he must deal with a serious handicap: his total ignorance of art and art history. In charge of investigating cases of theft and forgery, Antoine must quickly plunge into a world he does not control, while facing the pressure surrounding him to solve thorny cases. With the help of the talented art expert Florence Chassating (Eléonore Bernheim), who brings her knowledge and expertise, he tries to explore the mysteries of precious works that have disappeared. Together, they plunge into the secret world of collectors, artists and traffickers, where the stakes go far beyond mere paintings. Through each investigation, Antoine must learn to navigate in this complex environment, while fighting against his impulses and developing a keen sense of deduction, to discover that art hides many secrets.

programme.title: The art of crime
programme.desc: In a photo studio, Emma Wurtz's lifeless body (Eléonore Bernheim), a 25-year-old legal secretary, is discovered, immerse the art world in deep dismay. This mysterious murder is amplified by a selfie erased two hours after her death, where Emma poses alongside an iconic painting by Edward Manet, "At Tortoni", a masterpiece that has been missing for more than thirty years during the famous flight of the Gardner Museum in Boston. Faced with this enigma, Florence (Nicolas Gob), an art lover and experienced investigator, turns to Jean-Louis Marquet (Philippe Duclos), a renowned detective in the field of stolen works, to assist him in this complex affair. However, Marquet's arrival did not please Antoine (Benjamin Egner), who was fighting against his own growing feelings for Florence, fuelling palpable tension between the protagonists. As the investigation progresses, buried secrets threaten to burst, revealing a criminal network in the heart of the art world.

programme.title: Anatole Latile
programme.desc: The director's mother forced him to play Startruc with Anatole and Jason for an hour of unfair glue, in order to make him find his child's soul.
programme.desc-more: Anatole Latile is a schoolboy with imagination and energy, but his adventurous spirit often pushes him to find himself in delicate situations. With his gang of comrades, there is never a lack of opportunity to embark on farfelus projects that lead him to multiply misadventures. Whether it's creating a faulty robot for the science class or organizing a surprise birthday party for his best friend, Anatole is a surprising ingenuity, although often misdirected. His carelessness and daring sometimes win him reproof from his teachers, but he also knows how to charm his friends with his contagious enthusiasm. Through his adventures, Anatole learns to juggle his aspirations with the consequences of his actions, thus discovering the value of friendship and responsibility. His tumultuous journey to school will lead him to unexpected life lessons, while keeping a lightness that makes his adventures charming.

programme.sub-title: Murders on the island of Yeu
programme.desc: A famous navigator decides to do everything she can to catch up with her family. As she sails with her son, they discover a corpse.
programme.desc-more: In this captivating second season of "Moutres à...", France is the scene of intriguing mysteries, mainly located on its western facade. Viewers are transported to emblematic places such as Guérande, the island of Yeu and Etretat, where a series of enigmatic murders shake local communities. History begins with the fall of a notable cliff in Etretat, an event that raises disturbing questions: was it alone when it fell? The investigation is conducted by detective duos, whose varied skills and group dynamics are tested. Among them, Claire Borotra is an intriguing investigator, while Antoine Dulery and Bruno Madinier are contributing their expertise to business resolution. In parallel, the presence of Adriana Karembeu adds an unexpected touch to the plot, promising a season full of twists and revelations.

In 1917, two young British soldiers were required to cross enemy lines to prevent a division from an imminent attack by the Germans.
programme.desc-more: On April 6, 1917, in the First World War, tension was at its peak on the Western front. William Schofield and Tom Blake, two corporals of the British army, were suddenly summoned by General Erinmore, who entrusted them with a crucial mission. They must travel to Croisille Wood, near the town of Ecoust, to provide an urgent warning to the 2nd Devonshire Battalion, led by Colonel Mackenzie. Military intelligence indicates that German forces have set a deadly trap for British troops, and an imminent offensive could lead to a real disaster. It was then that William and Tom, despite the dangers that were before them, set off in a devastated and bruised landscape, where every step could cost their lives. The crossing confronts them not only with external dangers, but also with their own fears, their courage and the fragility of human existence in times of war. They must act quickly to save lives and avoid an inevitable massacre.

programme.title: Rescuers at Sea: Call and Sacrifice
programme.desc: On the night of August 7, 1986, five rescuers died trying to rescue a pleasure boat. This tragedy makes the French aware of the dangers of their profession.
programme.desc-more: On the night of August 7, 1986, five volunteer rescuers from the Aber Wrac'h SNSM station were on their way to rescue a pleasure craft in distress near Bec Island. The operation turned into a disaster when their canoe broke into the Kerguen rocks, leaving no survivors among the crew. This tragedy reveals the daily perils of marine rescue and constitutes an electroshock. The surrounding emoi causes the change of the organization of rescue at sea, allowing the improvement of equipment, professionalisation and the establishment of protections for rescuers.

programme.title: Mayotte, the escapes from the street
programme.desc: In Tsoundzou 2, a district south of Mamoudzou, young people live in gangs on the street. Some people call themselves "H2Rs," the heirs of the street. Flights, rackets, small business: they try to survive thanks to the scramble. In the absence of alternatives, they have sometimes had to navigate between poverty and delinquency. Bohousse, Commissioner, Ali, Popeye and Faadi aspire to a better life. But how can we extract from an environment that seems to condemn any projection towards the future? Despite the difficulties, each one is gradually trying to find his way.

programme.title: Operation Hao
programme.desc: Emmanuelle and Tehau, two young Polynesians from the Tuamotu, are engaged in a one-year training within the regiment of adapted military service recently installed on the Hao atoll. Emmanuelle, from the island, and Tehau, from a neighbouring atoll, learn about tropical agriculture and restoration, with the hope of getting a job and, perhaps, discovering a military vocation. Their journey takes place on an island marked by history: former rear base of the army during the nuclear tests, prosperous and then deserted at its stop, Hao is now seeking to retain his youth.

programme.title: History secrets
programme.desc: Fascinating, sulfurous and controversial, who was really Empress Messalin? To trace its history is to make an exciting journey into the heart of the Roman Empire, the most powerful of the time. It's also for the best and the worst Caligula, Nero, Agrippine and Narcisse.
programme.desc-more: Fascinating, scandalous, calculator and cruel, who was really Empress Messalin, born in the year 20 and murdered in 48? To trace its history is to make an exciting journey into the heart of the Roman Empire, the most powerful of the time. It's also for the best and the worst Caligula, Nero, Agrippine and Narcisse. It is to admire the new discoveries of the frescoes of the buried villas of Pompeii, which, almost 2000 years after the eruption of Vesuvius, reveal the intimacy of the great History. Stéphane Bern proposes to follow the steps of the one who, with conspiracy, murder and manipulation, will succeed in imposing himself alongside her husband Claude and thus play a crucial role in the Roman Empire.

programme.title: Murders to...
programme.desc: On a captivating journey through France, "Mothers to..." plunges spectators into the heart of regions rich in history and culture, where every murder revealed is intimately linked to a local legend or a landmark event. Each episode highlights a duo of investigators, often composed of a man and a woman, whose skills are not always limited to those of the law enforcement agencies. These characters, sometimes from a variety of backgrounds, mix their talents and perspectives to solve complex puzzles that shake local communities. As investigations, tensions and affinities develop, adding a romantic and human dimension to their investigations. Between police intrigues and cultural discoveries, this series will seduce polar lovers while immersing them in the French heritage, making each murder a mystery to be deciphered, and a story to tell.
programme.desc-more: Murders to... is a captivating police series that plunges viewers into the enigmatic universe of criminal investigations in the heart of French regions. Each episode takes us to a distinct place, rich in history and local legends, where the past resurfaces in a often tragic and bloody way. In every investigation, horrific crimes seem to resonate with historical events, legends or myths rooted in the collective memory of the inhabitants. The series examines how these ancient narratives can influence the present, while buried secrets resurface, leading the protagonists into a real nightmare. The series follows a group of determined investigators, ready to elucidate these dark mysteries. Their expertise, accompanied by an analytical and human approach, prompts them to interview not only suspects, but also witnesses and residents, always in search of hidden truths. In addition to their investigative skills, they must navigate through tense interpersonal dynamics and the emotional impact of crimes on the community. Investigators also face moral dilemmas, wondering how far they are prepared to go to unearth the truth.

programme.title: Audrey's refuge
programme.desc: In a small village animated by nature, Audrey, a 7-year-old girl full of life, is dedicated to the protection and well-being of the animals around her. With a heart overflowing with tenderness and empathy, she interacts with a multitude of species, from loving dogs to singing birds, to wild animals that cross her path. Every day, she strives to prove that harmony between humans and animals is possible, using gentle and respectful methods. Through his adventures, Audrey meets various characters, such as his best friend who helps him in his missions, and a local veterinarian who teaches him the basics of animal care. Together, they overcome challenges, discover moving stories and learn the importance of compassion. By cultivating these values, Audrey inspires its people to change their gaze on wildlife and embrace a more environmentally friendly way of life.

programme.title: Anatole Latile
programme.desc: Anatole burys her health book in the garden to avoid the vaccine in school, but Princess brings him back. He must hide it without being vaccinated.
programme.desc-more: Anatole Latile is a schoolboy with imagination and energy, but his adventurous spirit often pushes him to find himself in delicate situations. With his gang of comrades, there is never a lack of opportunity to embark on farfelus projects that lead him to multiply misadventures. Whether it's creating a faulty robot for the science class or organizing a surprise birthday party for his best friend, Anatole is a surprising ingenuity, although often misdirected. His carelessness and daring sometimes win him reproof from his teachers, but he also knows how to charm his friends with his contagious enthusiasm. Through his adventures, Anatole learns to juggle his aspirations with the consequences of his actions, thus discovering the value of friendship and responsibility. His tumultuous journey to school will lead him to unexpected life lessons, while keeping a lightness that makes his adventures charming.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: Teen Titans are not teenagers like the others. Thanks to their superpowers, they intervene when the world is in serious danger. With humour and relaxation, they save the universe from all perils. At their head, Robin, who grew up in a circus with his parents. He was adopted by Batman, who trained him well. He now flies his own wings, leaving Gotham City for Jump City. Next to him, the figure Starfire, an alien princess born on the planet Tamaran, but also Raven, daughter of a Terrin and a distant conqueror. A series of animated rhythmic, adventure-filled and humorous.
programme.desc-more: In a world where teenage superheroes fight for justice, the Teen Titans stand out for their offbeat humour and carefree spirit. Lead by former Batman protégé Robin (Scott Menville), they left Gotham City to settle in Jump City, where they dedicated themselves to protecting citizens while juggling the challenges of adolescence. Next to Robin are Starfire (Hynden Walch), an extraterrestrial princess with extraordinary powers, and Raven (Tara Strong), a young woman with mystical abilities inherited from an evil father. Together, they face various threats, ranging from super-villains to interdimensional monsters, while cultivating solid friendships and living hilarious adventures. With epic fighting and nasty situations, this series of animation takes the spectators into a whirlwind of action and laughter, proving that even heroes need moments of lightness.

He now flies his own wings, leaving Gotham City for Jump City. Next to him, the figure Starfire, an alien princess born on the planet Tamaran, but also Raven, daughter of a Terrin and a distant conqueror. A series of animated rhythmic, adventure-filled and humorous.
programme.desc-more: In a world where teenage superheroes fight for justice, the Teen Titans stand out for their offbeat humour and carefree spirit. Lead by former Batman protégé Robin (Scott Menville), they left Gotham City to settle in Jump City, where they dedicated themselves to protecting citizens while juggling the challenges of adolescence. Next to Robin are Starfire (Hynden Walch), an extraterrestrial princess with extraordinary powers, and Raven (Tara Strong), a young woman with mystical abilities inherited from an evil father. Together, they face various threats, ranging from super-villains to interdimensional monsters, while cultivating solid friendships and living hilarious adventures. With epic fighting and nasty situations, this series of animation takes the spectators into a whirlwind of action and laughter, proving that even heroes need moments of lightness.

programme.desc-more: When Thomas Bareski arrived in a hamlet in the Vosges, where he was killed six years ago, he found himself facing a deserted village. The Schal family murder case, including parents and their children, remains unanswered. Bareski chose to resume the investigation to understand what happened to the parents and their two children, so that the village could finally regain its serenity. He has limited support from a few indomitables determined to elucidate this tragedy.

programme.title: History secrets
programme.sub-title: Charles X, the last king of France
programme.desc: Born in 1757, Charles-Philippe of France, Count of Artois and younger brother of Louis XVI and Louis XVIII, spent the first years of his life enjoying the pleasures of the court of Versailles, openly and with excesses, playing money and love. To accompany her in this frivolity royal, Marie-Antoinette, her favorite sister-in-law, is not lacking in imagination. On 29 May 1825 he became King Charles X on the occasion of a sumptuous sacre, but in the heart of a France still bruised by the stigma of the Revolution. The sovereign wanted to restore the absolute monarchy, censor the press and deprive the French of all constitutional freedom.

programme.title: Anatole Latile
programme.desc: The director's mother forced him to play Startruc with Anatole and Jason for an hour of unfair glue, in order to make him find his child's soul.
programme.desc-more: Anatole Latile is a schoolboy with imagination and energy, but his adventurous spirit often pushes him to find himself in delicate situations. With his gang of comrades, there is never a lack of opportunity to embark on farfelus projects that lead him to multiply misadventures. Whether it's creating a faulty robot for the science class or organizing a surprise birthday party for his best friend, Anatole is a surprising ingenuity, although often misdirected. His carelessness and daring sometimes win him reproof from his teachers, but he also knows how to charm his friends with his contagious enthusiasm. Through his adventures, Anatole learns to juggle his aspirations with the consequences of his actions, thus discovering the value of friendship and responsibility. His tumultuous journey to school will lead him to unexpected life lessons, while keeping a lightness that makes his adventures charming.

programme.title: Murders to...
programme.sub-title: Murders on the island of Yeu
programme.desc: In this captivating second season of "Moutres à...", France is the scene of intriguing mysteries, mainly located on its western facade. Viewers are transported to emblematic places such as Guérande, the island of Yeu and Etretat, where a series of enigmatic murders shake local communities. History begins with the fall of a notable cliff in Etretat, an event that raises disturbing questions: was it alone when it fell? The investigation is conducted by detective duos, whose varied skills and group dynamics are tested. Among them, Claire Borotra is an intriguing investigator, while Antoine Dulery and Bruno Madinier are contributing their expertise to business resolution. In parallel, the presence of Adriana Karembeu adds an unexpected touch to the plot, promising a season full of twists and revelations.
programme.desc-more: Murders to... is a captivating police series that plunges viewers into the enigmatic universe of criminal investigations in the heart of French regions. Each episode takes us to a distinct place, rich in history and local legends, where the past resurfaces in a often tragic and bloody way. In every investigation, horrific crimes seem to resonate with historical events, legends or myths rooted in the collective memory of the inhabitants. The series examines how these ancient narratives can influence the present, while buried secrets resurface, leading the protagonists into a real nightmare. The series follows a group of determined investigators, ready to elucidate these dark mysteries. Their expertise, accompanied by an analytical and human approach, prompts them to interview not only suspects, but also witnesses and residents, always in search of hidden truths. In addition to their investigative skills, they must navigate through tense interpersonal dynamics and the emotional impact of crimes on the community. Investigators also face moral dilemmas, wondering how far they are prepared to go to unearth the truth.

programme.title: Vera's investigations
programme.desc: Trapped in the countryside during a violent night storm, Vera discovers an abandoned car, with a baby inside. Without access to the GPS network and facing blocked roads, caught in the dark, she is forced to find refuge with the infant inside Brockburn House, her former alderman's residence, in the middle of a reception. The family's reception leaves something to be desired, especially since later, the corpse of a young woman is found on the way to the property. To investigate correctly, Vera must overcome grudges.
programme.desc-more: In the wild moors of Northumberland, swept by icy winds and bathed in raw light, crimes never remain buried for long. It is here that Vera Stanhope (Brenda Blethyn), chief inspector with a rough temperament as the surrounding landscapes, conducts her investigations with a relentless intuition and caustic humour that destabilizes her colleagues as well as the suspects. Dressed in her eternal worn coat, with a headband in shape, she embodies a force of nature, indifferent to conventions, obsessed with one thing: the truth. With him, Joe Ashworth (David Leon), his dedicated assistant, acts as a spiritual son – a delicate balance between his ideal youth and the experienced cynicism of his mentor. Everything changes when a 15-year-old, Luke Armstrong, is found dead in his bathtub, his face frozen in an expression of terror, strangled by a lace. But what should look like an ordinary family drama turns into a macabre riddle: the assassin has laid fresh flowers on the surface of the water, such as a funeral offer or a sinister signature. For Vera, this too much theatrical detail feels the calculation. Who could have done such a cold and methodical act? A relative? A stranger? Or worse, someone who's just getting started? As the investigation sinks into the unfavorable secrets of the small community, Vera and Joe discover that Luke, apparently a high school student without history, hid troubled bonds – family lies, school tensions, perhaps even dangerous relationships. Each testimony raises new questions, each alibi cracks. Then a second murder occurs, even more meticulously staged. The doubt is no longer allowed: a serial killer is walking around the county, and his ritual seems to obey a logic that only a twisted mind could understand. Between the heavy silences of suspects, the unsaid of a region where everyone knows each other and the false-likes of well-organized respectability, Vera must unravel the skewer of a case where nothing seems to be the same. But the more it digs, the closer the danger gets. Because this killer isn't just hitting – He watches, he anticipates, and he likes to play with those who track him. How far will Vera have to go to get rid of her game before a new victim falls? And what does this series of murders reveal about the buried demons in this lost corner of England, where appearances are often the best of camouflages?

Shortly thereafter, the victim's husband was interested in the investigators, as well as an old friend of the family, and then the victim's younger daughter's boyfriend.
programme.desc-more: In the wild moors of Northumberland, swept by icy winds and bathed in raw light, crimes never remain buried for long. It is here that Vera Stanhope (Brenda Blethyn), chief inspector with a rough temperament as the surrounding landscapes, conducts her investigations with a relentless intuition and caustic humour that destabilizes her colleagues as well as the suspects. Dressed in her eternal worn coat, with a headband in shape, she embodies a force of nature, indifferent to conventions, obsessed with one thing: the truth. With him, Joe Ashworth (David Leon), his dedicated assistant, acts as a spiritual son – a delicate balance between his ideal youth and the experienced cynicism of his mentor. Everything changes when a 15-year-old, Luke Armstrong, is found dead in his bathtub, his face frozen in an expression of terror, strangled by a lace. But what should look like an ordinary family drama turns into a macabre riddle: the assassin has laid fresh flowers on the surface of the water, such as a funeral offer or a sinister signature. For Vera, this too much theatrical detail feels the calculation. Who could have done such a cold and methodical act? A relative? A stranger? Or worse, someone who's just getting started? As the investigation sinks into the unfavorable secrets of the small community, Vera and Joe discover that Luke, apparently a high school student without history, hid troubled bonds – family lies, school tensions, perhaps even dangerous relationships. Each testimony raises new questions, each alibi cracks. Then a second murder occurs, even more meticulously staged. The doubt is no longer allowed: a serial killer is walking around the county, and his ritual seems to obey a logic that only a twisted mind could understand. Between the heavy silences of suspects, the unsaid of a region where everyone knows each other and the false-likes of well-organized respectability, Vera must unravel the skewer of a case where nothing seems to be the same. But the more it digs, the closer the danger gets. Because this killer isn't just hitting – He watches, he anticipates, and he likes to play with those who track him. How far will Vera have to go to get rid of her game before a new victim falls? And what does this series of murders reveal about the buried demons in this lost corner of England, where appearances are often the best of camouflages?

programme.title: Jade's armor
programme.desc: It's Ban Tang's party day. The Yes are planning to go together to the festival and Lan Jun hopes to meet Kai. Which is not Liam's taste.
programme.desc-more: In a world where legends come to life, Lan Jun, a young woman apparently ordinary, finds herself confronted with an extraordinary destiny. A heir to a legendary super heroine named Jade, she must wear the iconic armor that once protected the kingdom from evil. At first, Lan Jun doubted his ability to bear such a burden and honour Jade's legacy. However, as dark forces begin to emerge, threatening peace and harmony, she understands that the time has come to fight. With the help of his friends and unexpected allies, Lan Jun is embarking on a perilous quest to master his new skills and discover the hidden secrets of armor. Between personal challenges and epic confrontations, she must learn to believe in herself and embrace her role as a protector. The adventure that awaits her will lead her to explore unknown territories, both external and internal, as she prepares to face the evil that is looming on the horizon.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: A very long-glawed feline with a speckled coat, wearing a carved mask, bursts into the Queen's room in the middle of the night and disappears with her.
programme.desc-more: In a mysterious London, a disturbing event shakes the royal court when, in the middle of the night, a feline with a spotted coat and surprisingly long claws bursts into the Queen's room (Barbara Scaff). This serval, wearing a carved mask that gives it a enigmatic look, attacks the peace of the monarchy by disappearing with the sovereign. The alert is quickly given and a complex investigation is under way, involving members of the Royal Guard and city detectives. Andy Chase is a clever detective, determined to break the mystery behind this intriguing creature and find the Queen before it's too late. As the investigation proceeds, hidden secrets, unexpected alliances and surprising revelations emerge, plunging the spectator into an atmosphere of tension and intrigue where each clue could be the key to the resolution of this bold flight.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: When Detective McFlare meets his agent, Pigeon Paxton, who is about to reveal important information to him, they are both attacked.
programme.desc-more: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, Clever, a pig from India with a keen mind and remarkable observational capacity, and his brother Bro, a little more impulsive and bold, are embarking on police investigations that defy understanding. While Scotland Yard struggles to solve thorny business, the two fur brothers take charge, proving that even the smallest can have a great impact. Their first case plunges them into an intriguing mystery: a series of inexplicable disappearances of precious toys in the neighbourhood. With their sense of deference, Clever and Bro question unlikely witnesses, explore dark alleys and use clever schemes to dislodge the culprits. As they investigate, they discover an unsuspecting criminal network, testing their intelligence and courage. Each investigation brings them a little closer to the truth, but also to the dangers that lie ahead.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: Oscar and Malika discover that their neighborhood is being painted in grey by a necropix, a creature from space that abhors colors. Our heroes must then help a young superhero chromapix stop it, and, thanks to their magical brushes, return to their city all its colors.
programme.desc-more: In a series of hilarious and moving adventures, Oscar (Jillian O'Dowd) and Malika, two inseparable friends, are constantly late for school. Their daily lives are punctuated by rock-capped situations, where every day is a new opportunity to find yourself in unexpected perpetencies. Whether it's a school bus that's broken down, a wandering animal that blocks their way or their own mishaps, their over-imagining imagination is driving them into scenarios that are all more crazy than each other. Despite the obstacles, their unwavering friendship and team spirit enable them to overcome challenges while learning valuable life lessons. Through these fifty-two episodes, Oscar and Malika remind us that even when we are late, the essential thing is to enjoy the journey and adventure that awaits us, while cultivating unforgettable memories.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: In the colorful and sparkling world of Bluey, a young blue bitch, the daily adventure takes a playful and imaginative turn. Accompanied by her little sister Bingo, Bluey transforms everyday situations into captivating games. When Bluey receives an invitation to a birthday party, the excitement is at its peak. However, Bingo, with his magical pen, complicates the preparations by introducing unexpected and fanciful elements that test the patience of the whole family. At the same time, their father, Bandit (David McCormack), is confronted with the challenges of daily life when he has to drive his daughters to school. The two little bitches, with their overly creativeness, will not fail to imagine hilarious and surprising scenarios, making each moment memorable. Through games that reflect their daily lives, Bluey and Bingo learn valuable lessons about friendship, family and imagination, while bringing joy and laughter to those around them.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. programme.title: Shaun the sheep
programme.desc: A balloon is landing in the field. The sheep, intrigued, approach the boat and, involuntarily, find themselves carried away in the air...
programme.desc-more: In a peaceful corner of the English countryside, Shaun, a malicious and resourceful sheep, bores himself from the monotonous routine of the farm where he lives with his sheep companions. Always looking for a new adventure, Shaun decides to take charge and escape from the daily monotony. With the help of his friends, a much less clever group of sheep, he concocts a bold plan to spend an unforgettable day. However, their escape quickly turns into a series of hilarious mishaps when animals find themselves confronted with unforeseen situations, ranging from a trip to a city trip to unexpected encounters with humans. While Shaun must show creativity and courage to get his flock embarrassed, he realizes that friendship and solidarity are essential to overcoming obstacles. In this animated comedy, Shaun's adventurous spirit and his faces promise to captivate spectators of all ages.

programme.title: Idefixes and Indomitables
programme.desc: Persuaded that Vitamin prefers him a more slender dog, Padgachix has set himself in the lead of regaining shape using an exercise wheel invented by Angleigus.
programme.desc-more: In this captivating episode of season 2, Padgachix (Benjamin Bollen), the famous dog of the undeserved, is convinced that his mistress, Vitamin (Kelly Marot), prefers more slender animals. Desiring to prove to him that he can be a worthy companion, he embarks on a desperate quest to regain his form. His solution? A revolutionary exercise wheel, designed by the farfelu inventor Anglaigus (Jean-Claude Donda) for the General. However, things are turning unexpectedly when the wheel, with an uncontrollable mechanism, starts to turn at full speed in the streets of Lutece. Pungachix is trapped inside, causing a real disorder in the city, causing panic among the inhabitants. His friends, including the cunning Obélix (Stéphane Bern) and the wise Asterix (Edwige Lemoine), must join forces to save their companion while trying to restore calm before the situation degenerates completely.

programme.title: Idefixes and Indomitables
programme.desc: Because of a potion, Turbine starts spitting diamonds, which arranges Labienus and Plendastus, who take advantage of it to remove the bitch. Fortunately, Idéfix is watching.
programme.desc-more: In this captivating episode of the series "Idefix and the Indomitable", a mysterious potion makes unexpected wonders. Turbine, the bitch with a well tempered character, begins to spit diamonds, causing the greed of Labienus and Plendastus, two unscrupulous crooks. Seeing a golden opportunity, they do not hesitate to kidnap the bitch to exploit this incredible phenomenon to their advantage. As the two malefrats draw up a Machiavellical plan to take advantage of this unexpected situation, Idéfix (Benjamin Bollen), the faithful companion, is launching a race against the clock to save his four-legged friend. With courage and determination, he uses his irresistible instincts to thwart the plans of the kidnappers. This journey rich in twists and adventures will test the friendship and loyalty of the characters, while revealing unexpected facets of their personality.

programme.title: Idefixes and Indomitables
programme.desc: Voldenuix wishes to offer Sonelematine a necklace that belongs to Monalisa. The owl embarks Turbine in the recovery of the jewel, which he will copy with the help of a potion.
programme.desc-more: In this captivating episode of the series "Idefix and the Indomitable", Voldenuix, the clever owl, decided to make a romantic gesture by offering Sonelematine a precious necklace that once belonged to Monalisa. This iconic jewel is more than just an accessory; It is full of history and mystery. To achieve his plan, Voldenuix joins Turbine, a character with a lively mind and always ready for adventure. Together, they embark on a bold quest to recover the necklace, but the task will not be easy. Using a magic potion, Turbine hopes to copy the jewel, but this manipulation could have unexpected consequences. As they travel, they will have to navigate through comical obstacles and surprising puzzles, while learning lessons about friendship, love and the value of precious objects. The episode promises to be rich in twists and humour, faithful to the spirit of Idéfix's adventures.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: Tonight, in the castle park, there is a fireworks in honor of the king. Curious as anything, Artus and Marcus will go see the preparations.
programme.desc-more: Tonight, the castle park is preparing to host a spectacular fireworks fire in honor of the king, attracting the curiosity of the city's inhabitants. Artus (Alexandre Nguyen) and Marcus (Hugo Brunswick), two inseparable friends, decided to attend the preparations for this festive event. As they explore the behind the scenes of the organization, they discover a vibrant world of colours and secrets. The two young men find themselves immersed in an electric atmosphere, where the pyrotechnicians work to create heavenly wonders. However, as they conduct their playful investigation, they dig up underlying tensions and unexpected rivalries between the members of the preparation team. As the long-awaited moment approaches, Artus and Marcus realize that this fireworks could reveal more than mere bright flashes, and that much more important issues are hidden behind this royal celebration.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: At the Château, Charles Perrault tells the story of Little Red Chaperon, when a wolf is lost in the groves. The Guard is after him.
programme.desc-more: At the heart of a Castle where tales come to life, Charles Perrault evokes the history of the Little Red Chaperon. However, a mysterious wolf, lost in the surrounding groves, draws the attention of the Guard, who is pursuing it. Belfort (Alexandre Nguyen), initially paralyzed by fear, saw his apprehension turn into determination thanks to Lupin (Hugo Brunswick), who persuaded him to help this animal in distress. For Lupin, this encounter with a wolf of his kind, named Remus, is of particular importance. As the two companions engage in a mission of exfiltration, Remus gradually settles in Lupin's heart, appearing as a fascinating father figure. But Lupin needs a crucial question: should he abandon Belfort to join a pack and live among his fellow men? The fear of losing his friend and the threat to their quest exacerbate Belfort's concern.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: Benny, the nicest and most popular dog in the neighborhood, suddenly changes his personality. He starts biting after seeing a symbol engraved on a tree in the park.
programme.desc-more: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, two brothers, Clever, a lively-minded Indian pig, and Bro, his impulsive brother, are launching investigations that even defy Scotland Yard's abilities. Clever, with an acute sense of observation and an extraordinary intelligence, is often the brain behind their investigations, while Bro, always ready to act without thinking, brings a touch of energy and audacity to their adventures. Together, they are attacking mysterious and complex cases that have left the police perplexed for years. Each episode plunges them into captivating puzzles, where they have to decipher clues, question witnesses and navigate a world of intrigues. As their reputation grows, they attract the attention of enigmatic characters who seek to defeat them. Clever and Bro will have to unite their strengths and talents to solve mysteries that may well change their lives forever.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: On the way to school, Oscar and Malika fall into a tunnel where they meet a group of kobolds, dwarves who dig tunnels under the city...
programme.desc-more: In a series of hilarious and moving adventures, Oscar (Jillian O'Dowd) and Malika, two inseparable friends, are constantly late for school. Their daily lives are punctuated by rock-capped situations, where every day is a new opportunity to find yourself in unexpected perpetencies. Whether it's a school bus that's broken down, a wandering animal that blocks their way or their own mishaps, their over-imagining imagination is driving them into scenarios that are all more crazy than each other. Despite the obstacles, their unwavering friendship and team spirit enable them to overcome challenges while learning valuable life lessons. Through these fifty-two episodes, Oscar and Malika remind us that even when we are late, the essential thing is to enjoy the journey and adventure that awaits us, while cultivating unforgettable memories.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey keeps missing his word! But seeing how much Bingo trusts their mom, she grasps the scope of promises and the importance of keeping her word.
programme.desc-more: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!

programme.title: The aces of the jungle to the rescue
programme.desc: The happy gang of jungle Aces continues to want to bring peace and justice to the nature around them, despite some enemies.
programme.desc-more: In a vibrant jungle full of surprises, the tranquillity of animals is often put to the test by perilous situations. Maurice, a tig-shaped manchot with a well-dipped character, joined a heteroclite team composed of Batricia, a cunning bat, Miguel, an impressively strong gorilla, and Gilbert, an astute tarsier. Together, they form the "Ace of the jungle", a group of brave animals dedicated to the protection of their friends and their habitat. When a danger threatens their peaceful community, a simple alarm signal, manifested by clouds of smoke rising from a volcano, is enough to mobilize them. Once they have gathered together, they develop bold plans to counter the threats to their world. This captivating cartoon, produced by a Toulouse society, invites young spectators to dive into a world of thrilling adventures where friendship and courage triumph over obstacles.

programme.desc: Mr Loyal du Cirque d的Hiver for more than 10 years, Michel Palmer has seen it in all its colours with this new show concocted by the Bouglione family. On the track are some of the most amazing numbers, offered by the cream of the circus cream of the contemporary: the juggler Glenn Folco, the rider Régina Bouglione, the clown Matute, the acrobats of the Trio Three G, but also the German wheel, magic, dogs and d'équilibreistes d'vertigineux. programme.title: Secret archives
programme.desc: To win over the public, to reach the top of the poster and to return even after terrible crossing of the desert, is the destiny of some artists, phoenix of the scene. Charles Aznavour pierced very late after contrary winds. He never let go and ended up winning. Fragilized by extreme melancholy, singer Renaud has dived several times and has risen every time. While she was a popular actress, Annie Girardot abandoned the cinema to succeed in the theatre. Finally, singer Claude Nougaro was thanked by his record company for lack of sales before returning in a frantic way with his tube "Nougayork". These revenges on life were filmed, photographed by relatives who agreed to share their treasures.

programme.title: TIF in Olympia
programme.desc: A male revelation of the year 2024 at the Flames Awards, Toufik Bouhraoua, alias TIF, presents himself on the Olympia scene to perform his most famous songs, and in particular those from his latest album, entitled 1.6 in tribute to a version of a famous video game that marked his childhood. A fan of themes that evoke the exile, identity or nostalgia of his own, the artist from Algiers hypnotizes the audience with his airs that mix rap, Andalusian music and Algerian chaabi. He is a music rapper, and here he delivers a concert as lively as it is upsetting.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: A series of abductions among cats in Marylebone neighborhood worries the sovereign of London animals. A rescuer tells him about the event.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant Lexington neighbourhood of London, two inseparable companions, Clever, a pig from India in the sense of sharp observation, and Bro, his impulsive and daring brother, are embarking on police investigations that even defy Scotland Yard's abilities. While the city is immersed in a series of troubling mysteries, the two animals find themselves confronted with complex cases, ranging from mysterious disappearances to puzzles that seem to be rooted in local folklore. Clever, with his analytical mind, deciphers clues that no one else notices, while Bro, with his overflowing energy, does not hesitate to engage in perilous situations to get answers. Together, they navigate through captivating intrigues and colorful characters, proving that even the smallest detectives can make a big difference in solving mysteries that haunt their community.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: On Jack's first day at Bluey's school, Calypso suggested that he play soldiers outside with Rusty in the bush.
programme.desc-more: In the colorful and sparkling world of Bluey, a young blue bitch, the daily adventure takes a playful and imaginative turn. Accompanied by her little sister Bingo, Bluey transforms everyday situations into captivating games. When Bluey receives an invitation to a birthday party, the excitement is at its peak. However, Bingo, with his magical pen, complicates the preparations by introducing unexpected and fanciful elements that test the patience of the whole family. At the same time, their father, Bandit (David McCormack), is confronted with the challenges of daily life when he has to drive his daughters to school. The two little bitches, with their overly creativeness, will not fail to imagine hilarious and surprising scenarios, making each moment memorable. Through games that reflect their daily lives, Bluey and Bingo learn valuable lessons about friendship, family and imagination, while bringing joy and laughter to those around them.

programme.title: Idefixes and Indomitables
programme.desc: After the incursions of Halowine, Arctix and Antarcticix into Lutèce, Labienus decided to capture the wolves that inhabit the surrounding forest. Turbine wants to warn Chevrotine.
programme.desc-more: In the captivating episode of the series "Idefix and the Indomitable", Lutèce is in a state of discord after the recent incidents caused by Halowine, Arctix and Antarctix, invaders who sow discord in the city. Faced with this growing threat, Labienus, the Roman strategist, made the bold decision to capture wolves wandering around the surrounding forest, convinced that these creatures could be used as a weapon against the Gaulish irredentists. Meanwhile, Turbine, Idéfix's faithful companion, realizes that this initiative could have disastrous consequences for the balance of nature and the tranquillity of Lutece. Determined to prevent Labienus from harming wolves, Turbine launched a race against the clock to warn Chevrotine, the wise and cunning inhabitant of the village. In this thrilling adventure, the characters will have to navigate between loyalty and bravery, while facing complex moral choices.

programme.desc-more: In the episode "Miche o ma miche" of season 2 of "Idéfix et les Indomitables", Idéfix (Benjamin Bollen), Asterix's faithful companion, finds himself in a delicate situation when he is captured and locked in the kennel of the Louve. During his imprisonment, he was confronted with Monalisa (Kelly Marot), a clever investigator who did not hesitate to use schemes to discover the secret den of the Indomitable. Monalisa, determined to defeat the plans of the indomitable Gauls, uses his intelligence and trick to question Idefix, hoping that he will reveal crucial information. Meanwhile, Idéfix, faithful to his team, must use his ingenuity to resist pressure and protect his friends. As tensions rise, the episode explores the themes of loyalty, bravery and resistance to adversity, while offering a mix of humour and adventure unique to the universe of Asterix.

programme.title: Idefixes and Indomitables
programme.desc: While Idéfix and Turbine are looking for crumbs for Asmatix, Chevrotine arrives at the den to use an underground passage to cause the Louve Palace to collapse.
programme.desc-more: While Idéfix (Benjamin Bollen) and his accomplice Turbine (Kelly Marot) are searching the surrounding area for crumbs for the Asmatix glutton (Jean-Claude Donda), their quest is taking an unexpected turn. Chevrotine (Edwige Lemoine), a bold and farceous figure, landed in the den with a bold idea: to use an underground passage to make the Louve Palace collapse, a formidable enemy. Together, they are building a clever plan, but this mission may well prove more complex than it seems. Tensions rise as they have to navigate between the luve traps and the hidden dangers of the underground. In this adventure, friendship and solidarity will be tested, while Idéfix and his friends face difficult choices. Will they succeed in accomplishing their mission without being overwhelmed by the obstacles that stand in their way?

programme.title: Idefixes and Indomitables
programme.desc: Padgachix found a cursed mirror that makes him softly invisible. To be rid of this curse, he must lay the mirror before the statue of Hohis.
programme.desc-more: In this captivating episode of the series "Idefix and the Indomitable", Padgachix, a bold and often unpredictable character, makes a discovery that will upset his life: a cursed mirror capable of making his user progressively invisible. As he explores the mysteries of this ancient artifact, he quickly realizes that this invisibility is not without consequences, taking him away from his friends and plunged him into a state of growing loneliness. To lift the curse that eats him, Padgachix must undertake a perilous quest to lay the mirror before the statue of Hohis, an ancient god whose legend is marked by magic and wisdom. Accompanied by his faithful companions, he will have to overcome unexpected obstacles and confusing puzzles, while discovering the true value of friendship and courage in the face of adversity. This adventure promises to be rich in twists and life lessons.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: Richard de Rastignasse, the magnificent lion of the household, makes a sensation with his entourage, so much so that many animals imitate him.
programme.desc-more: In the captivating world of the household, Richard de Rastignasse, a charismatic lion, is distinguished by its beauty and majestic appearance. Surrounded by a plethora of fascinated animals, it quickly becomes the pertussis of its entourage, attracting the attention of all in its elegant manners and undeniable charisma. His growing popularity encourages many companions to copy him, seeking to imitate his behavior and style. Within this dynamic, other animals, each with their unique personality, begin to compete to attract attention, resulting in a series of comical and touching situations. However, behind this facade of glory, Richard has to face his own doubts and the growing expectations of his entourage. As the household moves around, Richard will have to navigate between the quest for his identity and the pressure to stay at the top, while discovering what it really means to be a leader in this vibrant ecosystem.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: Ariane accidentally laced Louis XIV's billiard mat. Belfort and Lupin will help him hide this awful nonsense before the game party starts.
programme.desc-more: In a context of fascist and mystery at the court of Louis XIV, an unfortunate incident occurred when young Ariane (Nathalie Homs) found herself to lace the royal billiard carpet, a masterpiece of craftsmanship. She panicked about the consequences of her act, and turned to her two accomplices, Belfort (Alexandre Nguyen) and Lupin (Hugo Brunswick), masters in the art of trickery and concealment. Together, they must develop a clever plan to mask this blunder before the game begins, where nobles and courtiers expect a demonstration of talent. Between daring ploys and nasty situations, the trio is launching a race against the clock, juggling the intrigues of the court and the expectations of the guests. As tensions rise, loyalty and ingenuity will be tested in a universe where every false step could have fatal repercussions.

programme.title: Grizzy and lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy ran out of food and went to pick fruit. He brings back a basket when he finds out the Lemmings have got their hands on Yummy's last dowel.
programme.desc-more: In Canada's vast nature, Grizzy, an imposing bear, enjoys the tranquillity of its territory, a cottage isolated in the middle of the forest. His peaceful life was quickly disrupted by a mischievous group of lemmings, determined to challenge his authority and to appropriate the resources he considered his. These little creatures, always in search of adventures, do not retreat in front of anything to thwart Grizzy's plans, transforming every day into a battle of trick and trick. Their hilarious and often chaotic attempts put to the test the patience of the bear, who must use all his strength and intelligence to try to keep control of his territory. Between comical misunderstandings and fierce rivalries, Grizzy must navigate a world where survival is not only a matter of strength, but also of strategy and resourcefulness in the face of these unexpected opponents.

programme.desc: From Dakar. For this fourth edition of the Summer Youth Olympic Games, France is represented by a delegation of 69 athletes registered in 22 sports, on the proposal of the various national federations. There is also Lucie Schoonheere on skateboarding. She had participated in Paris 2024 and became the first French athlete to participate in the Olympics after having had a participation in the Olympics. In total, about 2,700 athletes aged up to 17 are expected in Dakar 2026, with a total parity. The opportunity to participate in the upcoming JOJs is available to the territories of the 206 NOCs and, for the first time, to an Olympic team of young refugees.

programme.title: The real family
programme.desc: A couple who raise a young boy entrusted by social assistance cannot overcome their sentence after his return to their father.
programme.desc-more: In the idyllic setting of a beachside campsite, where the children's laughter mix with the sound of the waves, Anna (Mélanie Thierry) and Driss (Lyes Salem) enjoy the last moments of family holidays. Around them, they gravitate their two sons, Jules and Adrien, as well as Simon, a six-year-old boy with a malicious smile, whom they have raised with love since he was barely eighteen months old. For Anna, Driss and the children, Simon is an integral part of their home, a solid family balance, built day after day in tenderness and complicity. But this harmony is about to be shaken by a phone call that will change everything. Eddie (Félix Moati), Simon's biological father, resurfaces after months of absence and instability. This time, he's determined: he wants his son's custody back. Anna's news is a shock. How can we accept the idea of seeing this child who she loved, raised and protected as her own? Between the legal procedures, Eddie's expectations and Simon's rights, she finds herself caught in an emotional vice, torn between her mother's instinct and the implacable reality of a system that leaves little room for the nuances of the heart.

programme.title: Usual Suspects
programme.desc: A customs officer is trying to get from a con man, who survived a massacre, information that could help him arrest a mythical gangster.
programme.desc-more: After serving a long prison sentence, Dean Keaton (Gabriel Byrne) aspires to redemption, wishing to leave behind his criminal past. However, his old lifestyle resurfaces when he is suspected of being involved in a bloody robbery alongside his accomplices: McManus (Stephen Baldwin), Fenster (Benicio del Toro), Hockney (Kevin Pollak) and Verbal (Kevin Spacey). Although they are temporarily released, tension rises when, at the heart of their reflections, an unforeseen opportunity arises. A mysterious criminal, Keyser Söze, makes a tempting offer: to eliminate a powerful drug dealer in exchange for a huge amount of money. The ubiquitous threat of Söze, a man with a terrifying and elusive reputation, creates a climate of distrust among the members of the group. The situation takes a tragic turn when one of them refuses to participate in the plan, being brutally eliminated, plunged the group into a spiral of paranoia, betrayal and deadly danger.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: In the vibrant Lexington neighbourhood of London, two inseparable companions, Clever, a pig from India in the sense of sharp observation, and Bro, his impulsive and daring brother, are embarking on police investigations that even defy Scotland Yard's abilities. While the city is immersed in a series of troubling mysteries, the two animals find themselves confronted with complex cases, ranging from mysterious disappearances to puzzles that seem to be rooted in local folklore. Clever, with his analytical mind, deciphers clues that no one else notices, while Bro, with his overflowing energy, does not hesitate to engage in perilous situations to get answers. Together, they navigate through captivating intrigues and colorful characters, proving that even the smallest detectives can make a big difference in solving mysteries that haunt their community.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: In a series of hilarious and moving adventures, Oscar (Jillian O'Dowd) and Malika, two inseparable friends, are constantly late for school. Their daily lives are punctuated by rock-capped situations, where every day is a new opportunity to find yourself in unexpected perpetencies. Whether it's a school bus that's broken down, a wandering animal that blocks their way or their own mishaps, their over-imagining imagination is driving them into scenarios that are all more crazy than each other. Despite the obstacles, their unwavering friendship and team spirit enable them to overcome challenges while learning valuable life lessons. Through these fifty-two episodes, Oscar and Malika remind us that even when we are late, the essential thing is to enjoy the journey and adventure that awaits us, while cultivating unforgettable memories.
programme.desc-more: Oscar and Malika, two young inseparable neighbours, live rock adventures each morning by going to school. Despite their geographical proximity and friendship, each journey turns into a series of unexpected journeys that prevent them from arriving on time. Whether it's by crossing a mischievous dog that takes them into a treasure hunt, meeting colorful characters or meeting up with some crazy situations, each episode is a new opportunity for them to discover the world around them. Their insatiable curiosity and sense of humour push them to explore unanticipated paths, while strengthening their bond of friendship. Through this series full of freshness and imagination, young spectators are invited to follow these two heroes of everyday life in a world where adventure and camaraderie are always at the meeting, transforming the simple journey to school into an unforgettable epic.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey refuses to go to bed and prefers to stay awake like a bat. She finds her dad asleep on the floor, dreaming of playing rugby. His mom says his dad dreams of playing because he doesn't have time. Bluey decides to dream of being a bat to stay awake longer...
programme.desc-more: In the colorful and sparkling world of Bluey, a young blue bitch, the daily adventure takes a playful and imaginative turn. Accompanied by her little sister Bingo, Bluey transforms everyday situations into captivating games. When Bluey receives an invitation to a birthday party, the excitement is at its peak. However, Bingo, with his magical pen, complicates the preparations by introducing unexpected and fanciful elements that test the patience of the whole family. At the same time, their father, Bandit (David McCormack), is confronted with the challenges of daily life when he has to drive his daughters to school. The two little bitches, with their overly creativeness, will not fail to imagine hilarious and surprising scenarios, making each moment memorable. Through games that reflect their daily lives, Bluey and Bingo learn valuable lessons about friendship, family and imagination, while bringing joy and laughter to those around them.

programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.title: Idefixes and Indomitables
programme.desc: In the captivating episode of the series "Idefix and the Indomitable", Lutèce is in a state of discord after the recent incidents caused by Halowine, Arctix and Antarctix, invaders who sow discord in the city. Faced with this growing threat, Labienus, the Roman strategist, made the bold decision to capture wolves wandering around the surrounding forest, convinced that these creatures could be used as a weapon against the Gaulish irredentists. Meanwhile, Turbine, Idéfix's faithful companion, realizes that this initiative could have disastrous consequences for the balance of nature and the tranquillity of Lutece. Determined to prevent Labienus from harming wolves, Turbine launched a race against the clock to warn Chevrotine, the wise and cunning inhabitant of the village. In this thrilling adventure, the characters will have to navigate between loyalty and bravery, while facing complex moral choices.

programme.title: Idefixes and Indomitables
programme.desc: In order to get rid of the pigeons that again Monalisa and Labienus, Anglaigus proposes to put birch chalk on the old dovecote.
programme.desc-more: In the episode "Miche o ma miche" of season 2 of "Idéfix et les Indomitables", Idéfix (Benjamin Bollen), Asterix's faithful companion, finds himself in a delicate situation when he is captured and locked in the kennel of the Louve. During his imprisonment, he was confronted with Monalisa (Kelly Marot), a clever investigator who did not hesitate to use schemes to discover the secret den of the Indomitable. Monalisa, determined to defeat the plans of the indomitable Gauls, uses his intelligence and trick to question Idefix, hoping that he will reveal crucial information. Meanwhile, Idéfix, faithful to his team, must use his ingenuity to resist pressure and protect his friends. As tensions rise, the episode explores the themes of loyalty, bravery and resistance to adversity, while offering a mix of humour and adventure unique to the universe of Asterix.

programme.title: Idefixes and Indomitables
programme.desc: While Idéfix (Benjamin Bollen) and his accomplice Turbine (Kelly Marot) are searching the surrounding area for crumbs for the Asmatix glutton (Jean-Claude Donda), their quest is taking an unexpected turn. Chevrotine (Edwige Lemoine), a bold and farceous figure, landed in the den with a bold idea: to use an underground passage to make the Louve Palace collapse, a formidable enemy. Together, they are building a clever plan, but this mission may well prove more complex than it seems. Tensions rise as they have to navigate between the luve traps and the hidden dangers of the underground. In this adventure, friendship and solidarity will be tested, while Idéfix and his friends face difficult choices. Will they succeed in accomplishing their mission without being overwhelmed by the obstacles that stand in their way?

programme.title: Idefixes and Indomitables
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of the series "Idefix and the Indomitable", Padgachix, a bold and often unpredictable character, makes a discovery that will upset his life: a cursed mirror capable of making his user progressively invisible. As he explores the mysteries of this ancient artifact, he quickly realizes that this invisibility is not without consequences, taking him away from his friends and plunged him into a state of growing loneliness. To lift the curse that eats him, Padgachix must undertake a perilous quest to lay the mirror before the statue of Hohis, an ancient god whose legend is marked by magic and wisdom. Accompanied by his faithful companions, he will have to overcome unexpected obstacles and confusing puzzles, while discovering the true value of friendship and courage in the face of adversity. This adventure promises to be rich in twists and life lessons.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: In the captivating world of the household, Richard de Rastignasse, a charismatic lion, is distinguished by its beauty and majestic appearance. Surrounded by a plethora of fascinated animals, it quickly becomes the pertussis of its entourage, attracting the attention of all in its elegant manners and undeniable charisma. His growing popularity encourages many companions to copy him, seeking to imitate his behavior and style. Within this dynamic, other animals, each with their unique personality, begin to compete to attract attention, resulting in a series of comical and touching situations. However, behind this facade of glory, Richard has to face his own doubts and the growing expectations of his entourage. As the household moves around, Richard will have to navigate between the quest for his identity and the pressure to stay at the top, while discovering what it really means to be a leader in this vibrant ecosystem.
