programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: In a context of fascist and mystery at the court of Louis XIV, an unfortunate incident occurred when young Ariane (Nathalie Homs) found herself to lace the royal billiard carpet, a masterpiece of craftsmanship. She panicked about the consequences of her act, and turned to her two accomplices, Belfort (Alexandre Nguyen) and Lupin (Hugo Brunswick), masters in the art of trickery and concealment. Together, they must develop a clever plan to mask this blunder before the game begins, where nobles and courtiers expect a demonstration of talent. Between daring ploys and nasty situations, the trio is launching a race against the clock, juggling the intrigues of the court and the expectations of the guests. As tensions rise, loyalty and ingenuity will be tested in a universe where every false step could have fatal repercussions.

programme.title: Grizzy and lemmings
programme.desc: In Canada's vast nature, Grizzy, an imposing bear, enjoys the tranquillity of its territory, a cottage isolated in the middle of the forest. His peaceful life was quickly disrupted by a mischievous group of lemmings, determined to challenge his authority and to appropriate the resources he considered his. These little creatures, always in search of adventures, do not retreat in front of anything to thwart Grizzy's plans, transforming every day into a battle of trick and trick. Their hilarious and often chaotic attempts put to the test the patience of the bear, who must use all his strength and intelligence to try to keep control of his territory. Between comical misunderstandings and fierce rivalries, Grizzy must navigate a world where survival is not only a matter of strength, but also of strategy and resourcefulness in the face of these unexpected opponents.
programme.desc-more: In the vast and wild Canadian forest, Grizzy, an imposing and cunning brown bear, enjoys a comfortable existence in the forest guard cabin, which he considers his kingdom. When he appropriates the delights of this isolated retreat, he encounters a horde of mischievous and fearless lemmings, small mammals who, although often clumsy, do not retreat in front of anything to counteract Grizzy's plans. These lemmings, with their limited intelligence but their unwavering determination, engage in a series of hilarious confrontations with the bear, competing for the domination of the hut and the treasures it contains. Misadventures are going on as Grizzy faces unexpected challenges, clever traps and nasty situations, while trying to preserve his quiet lifestyle. The struggle between the bear and the lemmings gives rise to moments of burlesque comedy, making each episode a unique and entertaining adventure.

programme.title: The real family
programme.desc: In the idyllic setting of a beachside campsite, where the children's laughter mix with the sound of the waves, Anna (Mélanie Thierry) and Driss (Lyes Salem) enjoy the last moments of family holidays. Around them, they gravitate their two sons, Jules and Adrien, as well as Simon, a six-year-old boy with a malicious smile, whom they have raised with love since he was barely eighteen months old. For Anna, Driss and the children, Simon is an integral part of their home, a solid family balance, built day after day in tenderness and complicity. But this harmony is about to be shaken by a phone call that will change everything. Eddie (Félix Moati), Simon's biological father, resurfaces after months of absence and instability. This time, he's determined: he wants his son's custody back. Anna's news is a shock. How can we accept the idea of seeing this child who she loved, raised and protected as her own? Between the legal procedures, Eddie's expectations and Simon's rights, she finds herself caught in an emotional vice, torn between her mother's instinct and the implacable reality of a system that leaves little room for the nuances of the heart.

programme.title: Usual Suspects
programme.desc: After serving a long prison sentence, Dean Keaton (Gabriel Byrne) aspires to redemption, wishing to leave behind his criminal past. However, his old lifestyle resurfaces when he is suspected of being involved in a bloody robbery alongside his accomplices: McManus (Stephen Baldwin), Fenster (Benicio del Toro), Hockney (Kevin Pollak) and Verbal (Kevin Spacey). Although they are temporarily released, tension rises when, at the heart of their reflections, an unforeseen opportunity arises. A mysterious criminal, Keyser Söze, makes a tempting offer: to eliminate a powerful drug dealer in exchange for a huge amount of money. The ubiquitous threat of Söze, a man with a terrifying and elusive reputation, creates a climate of distrust among the members of the group. The situation takes a tragic turn when one of them refuses to participate in the plan, being brutally eliminated, plunged the group into a spiral of paranoia, betrayal and deadly danger.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: According to Alfred the pigeon, the former aviary of Buckingham Palace is haunted, for a living gargoyle keeps all the birds that approach it.
programme.desc-more: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, Clever, a pig from India with extraordinary intelligence, and his brother Bro, an impulsive and intrepid companion, embark on captivating police investigations. While the city is immersed in mysteries that even Scotland Yard struggles to solve, the two brothers turn out to be unexpected detectives. Their keen sense of observation and their ability to decipher clues lead them into increasingly complex cases, ranging from mysterious disappearances to daring robberies. Each investigation confronts them with intriguing characters, enigmatic witnesses and suspects with obscure motivations. As they investigate, Clever and Bro discover that truth can sometimes hide in the most unexpected places. Their complicity and determination will lead them to surprising revelations, proving that even the smallest can make a great difference in the quest for justice.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: In a series of hilarious and moving adventures, Oscar (Jillian O'Dowd) and Malika, two inseparable friends, are constantly late for school. Their daily lives are punctuated by rock-capped situations, where every day is a new opportunity to find yourself in unexpected perpetencies. Whether it's a school bus that's broken down, a wandering animal that blocks their way or their own mishaps, their over-imagining imagination is driving them into scenarios that are all more crazy than each other. Despite the obstacles, their unwavering friendship and team spirit enable them to overcome challenges while learning valuable life lessons. Through these fifty-two episodes, Oscar and Malika remind us that even when we are late, the essential thing is to enjoy the journey and adventure that awaits us, while cultivating unforgettable memories.
programme.desc-more: Oscar and Malika, two young inseparable neighbours, live rock adventures each morning by going to school. Whether it's by crossing a mischievous dog that takes them into a treasure hunt, meeting colorful characters or meeting up with some crazy situations, each episode is a new opportunity for them to discover the world around them. Their insatiable curiosity and sense of humour push them to explore unanticipated paths, while strengthening their bond of friendship. Through this series full of freshness and imagination, young spectators are invited to follow these two heroes of everyday life in a world where adventure and camaraderie are always at the meeting, transforming the simple journey to school into an unforgettable epic.

programme.title: Anatole Latile
programme.desc: Anatole Latuile, a schoolgirl with a effervescent temperament, is known for her wild ideas and bold plans that often lead him to find himself in delicate situations. In this captivating episode, Anatole decides to conduct her own investigation into a series of mysterious disappearances of objects in her school. Armed with his insatiable curiosity and sense of observation, he embarks on an improvised spinning, hoping to expose the culprit and restore order in his school environment. However, his impulsivity and his inclination for disorder continue to complicate his efforts. As he interrogates his classmates and observes the suspicious behaviors of teachers, Anatole discovers a world of unexpected intrigues and well-kept secrets. With the help of his faithful friends, he will have to navigate through a series of unforeseen events that test his ingenuity and ability to solve puzzles, while learning that sometimes truth can be more complex than it appears.
programme.desc-more: Anatole Latile is a schoolboy with imagination and energy, but his adventurous spirit often pushes him to find himself in delicate situations. With his gang of comrades, there is never a lack of opportunity to embark on farfelus projects that lead him to multiply misadventures. Whether it's creating a faulty robot for the science class or organizing a surprise birthday party for his best friend, Anatole is a surprising ingenuity, although often misdirected. His carelessness and daring sometimes win him reproof from his teachers, but he also knows how to charm his friends with his contagious enthusiasm. Through his adventures, Anatole learns to juggle his aspirations with the consequences of his actions, thus discovering the value of friendship and responsibility. His tumultuous journey to school will lead him to unexpected life lessons, while keeping a lightness that makes his adventures charming.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: Belfort & Lupin discover that a young marmot arrived with a load of ice ordered by the King. They must help him get back to his own people.
programme.desc-more: In the sumptuous setting of the Palace of Versailles in the seventeenth century, two unexpected companions, Belfort, a young boy with a valiant heart, and Lupin, Louis XIV's beloved dog, embark on fascinating adventures. While the royal residence gardens are dotted with secrets and mysteries, Belfort and Lupin dedicate themselves to the protection of the animals that inhabit the Royal Household and surrounding areas. Their unwavering friendship leads them to face a variety of challenges, ranging from the search for a rare bird in danger to the defense of a young fawn threatened by predators. Each episode leads them into thrilling quests where courage and trickery are of the essence. Between the carelessness of childhood and the majesty of the court, Belfort and Lupin learn valuable life lessons while establishing ties with their feathered and hairy companions, enriching their world of friendship and adventure.

programme.title: Scooby-Doo! The Sammys' clash
programme.desc: Scooby and his friends visit a ranch that has a reputation for being haunted by a disturbing cowboy. The spectre would also be an ancestor of Sammy.
programme.desc-more: Scooby-Doo and his gang of amateur detectives go to an isolated ranch to visit Tawny Rogers, Sammy's cousin (Matthew Lillard). This picturesque place, yet full of charm, hides a dark legend: it would be haunted by the spectre of a worrying cowboy. By exploring the ranch, Scooby (Frank Welker), Shaggy (Matthew Lillard), Velma (Kate Micucci), Daphne (Amanda Seyfried) and Sammy discover that this ghost would actually be Dapper Jack, an ancestor of Sammy, whose appearance is disturbing, because it looks like a trait to his descendant. Former notorious bandit, Dapper Jack left an indelible mark on the area, sowing terror among the inhabitants. As the band tries to penetrate the mystery surrounding this spectrum, they must navigate through enigmatic clues and unexpected encounters, while thwarting the traps of a tumultuous past that threatens to catch them.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: Moluso accidentally bumps into Axelle, an older student. While she wants to break her face, a electric current runs through them both.
programme.desc-more: In the tumultuous world of adolescence, Moluso, a young high school student, accidentally finds himself facing Axelle, an older student, passionate about Heavy Metal and the temperament of fire. This moment of collision, far from being annoyed, triggers a strange phenomenon: an electric current seems to travel through them, raising questions about the nature of their encounter. While Axelle, initially ready to teach her a lesson, finds herself intrigued by this clumsy boy, Moluso must navigate in the meanderings of his own emotions. This unexpected lightning strike leads them to wonder about their differences and aspirations. While Moluso discovers a world he does not know, Axelle, for her part, has to face his own demons and the pressure of his entourage. Together, they will learn to know each other, to accept each other and to embrace the unforeseeable that love can bring, transforming their daily lives into an unforgettable adventure.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: Molusco accompanies Coco for a visit to the museum. But back home, Molusco discovers that Coco stole a painting depicting a shell Saint Jaques: he fell in love...
programme.desc-more: During a museum trip, Molusco accompanies his friend Coco, whose enthusiasm for art is palpable. In exploring the various works, Coco is particularly captivated by a painting depicting a Saint-Jacques shell, symbol of beauty and delicacy that deeply affect him. However, their visit takes an unexpected turn when, back home, Molusco discovers with astonishment that Coco has stolen this work of art. This impulsive flight is not only an act of malice, but the sign of an emerging and obsessive love for this unique piece. As Molusco tries to understand his friend's motivations, he finds himself drawn into a whirlwind of moral emotions and dilemmas. The situation prompts them to reflect on the value of art, friendship and the consequences of their actions, while revealing the depth of their connection.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: Molusco spends his time at Bruno's, new in the neighborhood, and Rafik feels left out. Molusco's gonna find out Bruno's not an ordinary boy.
programme.desc-more: In this captivating episode of the series "Mousco", Molusco, a young curious and endearing character, discovers a new friend in the person of Bruno, a little boy recently arrived in the neighborhood. In search of adventures and camaraderie, Molusco spent all his time with Bruno, gradually neglecting his former friend Rafik, who felt increasingly isolated. While Molusco is excited about this new friendship, he does not know that Bruno hides an amazing secret: in reality, he is a gastronomic chef passionate about oysters, having taken the appearance of a child to explore the world of children. At the same time, Molusco, eager to appear as muscular as Ozzy, is embarking on a weight building program, but his efforts seem to be in vain. This episode illustrates with humour and tenderness the dynamics of friendship, jealousy and misunderstandings that may arise in the quest for acceptance and recognition.

programme.desc-more: In this episode of the series "Mousco", Molusco, a clumsy but endearing character, finds himself in a delicate situation after accidentally breaking Coco's television. In an attempt to repair his mistake, he replaces the defective screen with a goldfish, thinking that this pet will bring a little joy to his friend. However, he soon realized that this gesture had unexpected consequences. The fish, named Poissonou, seems to quickly win Coco's heart, causing Molusco to feel jealous and anxious. As he observes with despair the growing complicity between Coco and his new aquatic friend, Molusco must reflect on his own feelings and the value of their friendship. This emotional conflict leads to questions about his place in Coco's life and what it really means to be a friend.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: A prestigious diamond exhibited at the British Museum has just been stolen and the flight bears the signature of Warragul, the famous diamond gnome.
programme.desc-more: In the lively Lexington district of London, the unusual duo formed by Clever, an exceptional-flavoured Indian pig, and his brother Bro, an impulsive but loyal companion, embarks on captivating investigations. Although their appearance may seem ordinary, their insatiable curiosity and lively intelligence propel them to the heart of mysteries that even Scotland Yard struggles to solve. In this episode, they find themselves facing a complex affair involving mysterious disappearances and misleading clues, which lead them through the dark alleys and the well-kept secrets of the city. Clever, with his keen sense of observation, deciphers the smallest details, while Bro, with his fervent temperament, does not hesitate to put himself in danger to discover the truth. Together, they must navigate a world where appearances are often misleading, while learning to trust their instincts to thwart the plans of an elusive criminal.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: In a series of hilarious and moving adventures, Oscar (Jillian O'Dowd) and Malika, two inseparable friends, are constantly late for school. Their daily lives are punctuated by rock-capped situations, where every day is a new opportunity to find yourself in unexpected perpetencies. Whether it's a school bus that's broken down, a wandering animal that blocks their way or their own mishaps, their over-imagining imagination is driving them into scenarios that are all more crazy than each other. Despite the obstacles, their unwavering friendship and team spirit enable them to overcome challenges while learning valuable life lessons. Through these fifty-two episodes, Oscar and Malika remind us that even when we are late, the essential thing is to enjoy the journey and adventure that awaits us, while cultivating unforgettable memories.
programme.desc-more: Oscar and Malika, two young inseparable neighbours, live rock adventures each morning by going to school. Despite their geographical proximity and friendship, each journey turns into a series of unexpected journeys that prevent them from arriving on time. Whether it's by crossing a mischievous dog that takes them into a treasure hunt, meeting colorful characters or meeting up with some crazy situations, each episode is a new opportunity for them to discover the world around them. Their insatiable curiosity and sense of humour push them to explore unanticipated paths, while strengthening their bond of friendship. Through this series full of freshness and imagination, young spectators are invited to follow these two heroes of everyday life in a world where adventure and camaraderie are always at the meeting, transforming the simple journey to school into an unforgettable epic.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Dad agrees to play shepherd dog with Bluey and Bingo to stop them from disturbing Mom. But keeping a sheep is a difficult task.
programme.desc-more: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!

programme.title: Facing History: Lady Liberty's epic
programme.desc: The Statue of Liberty was born out of the desire of a small group of French intellectuals to offer America a sign of recognition for its struggle for freedom.
programme.desc-more: The Statue of Liberty was born out of the desire of a small group of French intellectuals to offer the American Republic a sign of recognition for its fight against slavery and for freedom. The sculptor Auguste Bartholdi takes on this ambition and imagines a monumental work: Freedom enlightening the world. Funded on both sides of the Atlantic with spectacular exhibitions and popular subscriptions, it was completed in Paris in 1884 and inaugurated in New York two years later. Dressed at the entrance to the bay, it became America's first face for millions of immigrants seeking a better life.

programme.title: Facing History: Lady Liberty's epic
programme.desc: From the 1930s to the 1970s, the Statue of Liberty embodied all the contradictions of America and went through the profound transformations of society.
programme.desc-more: Throughout the 20th century, the Statue of Liberty has many roles. Restored in 1936 for its 50th anniversary, she embodied in Franklin Roosevelt's eyes a promise of peace and the symbol of an America that had been built thanks to immigrants. The Second World War made her a hero in the fight against totalitarianism, and then an icon of the free world. In the 1960s, she became a witness to the struggles for equal rights and opposition to the Vietnam War. Richard Nixon tries to get his image back by addressing the "silent majority," before sinking into the Watergate scandal. At the end of the 1970s, America doubted for itself. Lady liberty seems to be a mess too.

programme.title: Facing History: Lady Liberty's epic
programme.sub-title: In the shadow of the old lady
programme.desc: From Ronald Reagan to Donald Trump, US presidents have consistently used the Statue of Liberty to embody a political message.
programme.desc-more: In the early 1980s, the Statue of Liberty was in poor condition. Its restoration became a political issue for Ronald Reagan, who saw it as the mark of American renewal. In 1986, in the midst of the cold war, the spectacular celebration of its centennial was the ideal occasion to bring Western freedom to a triumph. In the 1990s, Lady Liberty embodied a prosperous and self-confident America, until the shock of September 11, 2001. As a figure of the country's resilience, it also becomes the standard of the war on terrorism. In 2025, the Trompian counter-revolution built it into an idol MAGA, a bulwark against all elements that could defile or destroy America.

programme.desc: Yvan Cassar was the master of the "Johnny Hallyday Symphony" tour, the first of which took place at the Acropolis of Nice in 2022. In this large-scale project, Johnny Hallyday's historic artistic director was aiming to revive the singer's artistic world on stage by making his voice heard accompanied by 100 musicians. A "foul" idea, which now allows you to rediscover your greatest titles in a new symphonic version. Yvan Cassar does not derogate from any rule of the past: fidelity to the tastes of the artist, musical rigor, splendour of the set.

programme.title: Surfing, the sacred fire
programme.desc: The surf competition of the Paris 2024 Olympic Games is held in Tahiti, French Polynesia, where it all started. This documentary tells how surfing, an ancestral Polynesian tradition fought by the Westerners, has become a worldwide activity, an object of emancipation throughout the eras. Following the soubrasauts of history and embodied by legendary characters, this documentary creates a political and cultural history of surfing.

programme.title: From "Matrix" to "Sense8", the Wachowski revolution
programme.desc: From "Bound" to the queer series "Work in Progress", an exploration and decryption of Lana and Lilly Wachowski's revolutionary work and career. "Matrix" is the soil where all the seeds of the filmmakers' struggle are sown. Feminism, anticapitalism, transidentity or racial justice are encoded in action scenes in trench-coat or metaphors loaded with symbols.

programme.title: Shaun the sheep
programme.desc: In a peaceful corner of the English countryside, Shaun, a malicious and resourceful sheep, bores himself from the monotonous routine of the farm where he lives with his sheep companions. Always looking for a new adventure, Shaun decides to take charge and escape from the daily monotony. With the help of his friends, a much less clever group of sheep, he concocts a bold plan to spend an unforgettable day. However, their escape quickly turns into a series of hilarious mishaps when animals find themselves confronted with unforeseen situations, ranging from a trip to a city trip to unexpected encounters with humans. While Shaun must show creativity and courage to get his flock embarrassed, he realizes that friendship and solidarity are essential to overcoming obstacles. In this animated comedy, Shaun's adventurous spirit and his faces promise to captivate spectators of all ages.
programme.desc-more: In a rural world where routines are settled, Shaun (Justin Fletcher), a sheep with a lively and malicious mind, is distinguished by his insatiable curiosity and his sense of adventure. He lives peacefully on a farm with his companions, a group of naive and somewhat clumsy ovine people, who follow him in all his frascs. When daily life becomes too monotonous, Shaun decides to take charge and escape from the farm to live a thrilling day. However, his plans take an unexpected turn when the farmer, distracted by events, finds himself in nasty and unforeseen situations. Accompanied by his faithful friend, the dog Bitzer (John Sparkes), Shaun will have to be ingenuity and team spirit to overcome the obstacles. Together, they will navigate through hilarious and unexpected adventures, proving that even the smallest can achieve great things when they are united.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: In the sumptuous gardens of the Palace of Versailles in the seventeenth century, two unlikely companions, Belfort, a faithful dog of King Louis XIV, and Lupin, a daring wolf, formed an inseparable team. Their friendship leads them to extraordinary adventures, where their courage and ingenuity are tested. Together, they travel the green alleys of the royal residence, launching rescue missions to rescue animals in distress, whether they are from the Royal Household or from the surrounding forests. Their quest leads them through intriguing mysteries and unexpected encounters, while highlighting the richness of animal life at that time. In a fascinating historical setting, Belfort and Lupin discover not only the importance of friendship and loyalty, but also the challenges of protecting those who have no voice. Each episode brings them a little closer to the soul of Versailles and its secrets.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: In the lively city of Belfort, the atmosphere warms up when the rosary of the King, an eccentric artist, begins to create a flamboyant hat decorated with ostrich feathers. This capricious ambition arouses the concern of two ladies of the high society, Madame Du Bec (Nathalie Homs) and Madame De Buc (Barbara Tissier), who see this as a danger to their status and reputation. Fearing that this new trend would destabilize the classical elegance of their circle, they decided to do everything possible to sabotage the chapelier's project. In a frantic race against the clock, the two women develop schemes to counter the designer's plans, leading them to a parade of colourful characters, including the faithful assistant of the chapelier (Guillaume Beaujolais) and a young apprentice (Hugo Brunswick) who wanted to prove his worth. Tensions rise as each one confronts each other in a ballet of intrigues and quiproquos, revealing the hidden undersides of the high society.

programme.title: Scooby-Doo and the colony of fear
programme.desc: Scooby-Doo and his acolytes are going to recharge in the middle of the nature at Camp Little More. Chills and thrills are on the game despite friendly animators and diverse activities. Little More is also a place where legends are perennial and sometimes even alive...
programme.desc-more: At the Little Moose vacation colony, Scooby-Doo (voice of Frank Welker) and his group of friends, Fred (voice of Matthew Lillard), Daphné (voice of Kate Micucci), Vera (voice of Grey DeLisle) and Sammy (voice of Casey Kasem), hope to spend days of relaxation and fun. Surrounded by friendly animators and fun activities, they are quickly seduced by the festive atmosphere. However, the ghost stories told by campers take a disturbing turn when disturbing creatures, such as the Woodsman, Fishman and Black Canyon Banshee, begin to haunt the camp. Band members realize that these appearances are more than just legends. Determined to solve these mysteries, they join forces to discover the origin of these disturbing phenomena. Between chills and laughter, they will have to show courage and ingenuity to unmask the real culprits behind these supernatural events.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: To look as muscular as Ozzy, Molusco starts to muscle up, in vain. He finally has an idea of genius: he has pearls in his entire body.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fantastic universe, Musculo, a half-hust, half-human boy, dreams of living an ordinary life as an eleven-year-old. Despite his physical characteristics that distinguish him from other children, Musculo aspires to integrate and enjoy the simple pleasures of childhood, such as playing football or spending time with his friends. However, his singular appearance attracts the sometimes mocking attention of his comrades, which makes him feel excluded and misunderstood. As the episodes progress, Musculo faces various challenges that test his courage and determination. He discovers the importance of friendship and self-acceptance, while sailing through the trials of preadolescence. Accompanied by his friends, he will live a life of loufrosque and touching adventures that will allow him to get closer to his dream of a normal life, while celebrating his difference and learning to accept himself as he is.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: Molusco's falling off at school and sent him to the hospital to do radios. Disaster, he doesn't have a skeleton! He finds one in a doctor's office and swallows it, reassured. Except it's a monkey skeleton and we think it's the missing link...
programme.desc-more: In a fun and offbeat world, Molusco and his friend Rafik decide to put their comrade Coco on a television game that highlights his exceptional talents. Convinced that Coco (Matthew Forbes) has every chance of shining, they are putting in place a bold scheme to participate in the program. Molusco (Marc Bretonnière) is indeed turning into a kind of disguise, taking the role of the body, while Coco, as a thinking head, is preparing to meet the challenges of the game. However, their enthusiasm is quickly tempered by the discovery that not all other competitors are in good faith. Indeed, devious rivalries and cheatings are beginning to emerge, testing the team spirit and determination of Molusco and Coco. In this competition full of twists, they will have to navigate between cunning and creativity to hope to emerge victorious and prove that honesty and talent can triumph over maneuvers.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: Molusco and Rafik have Coco on a television game to which he is particularly gifted. Molusco's body is the way to go, and Coco's head is the way to go. But the other competitors aren't very honest...
programme.desc-more: In this colourful episode of the "Mousco" series, Molusco, a charming mollusc with a curious mind, realizes that he does not share the same sense of humor as his human friends. This finding plunges him into an identity crisis, prompting him to believe that he is devoid of comic talent. Determined to remedy this situation, he undertook a hilarious and chaotic journey to develop his skills in jokes and shows. With a series of comical attempts, Molusco embarks on a series of sketches and bland performances, seeking to conquer the heart of his audience. On the way, he meets colorful characters, each bringing his own style of humour. As he explores the various facets of comedy, Molusco discovers that the essence of laughter lies in authenticity and self-acceptance, even if it implies being a little different.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: Clever announces to Bro and McFlare that she has finally gathered enough clues to know where the next meeting of The Cause, the secret organization of the evil Knight, will take place.
programme.desc-more: In the lively Lexington district of London, a pig named Clever from India, with a keen sense of observation, and her brother Bro, a little too impulsive, are embarking on investigations that defy understanding. While Scotland Yard struggles to solve old and complex cases, the two hairy compera are attacking mysteries that have long escaped human investigators. Their first case leads them into the world of mysterious disappearances of pets, where they discover a clandestine network of traffickers. With their ingenuity and sense of camaraderie, Clever and Bro immerse themselves in a thrilling investigation, questioning the inhabitants of the neighborhood and deciphering clues left behind. Their boldness and determination will lead them to surprising revelations that may well change the perception that humans have of these small creatures, while proving to them that team spirit can overcome the greatest obstacles.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: With only five minutes to play "By car", Bluey and Mom start a race against the clock to buy the milk required by a grinchy guest and try to escape an angry trader.
programme.desc-more: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!

programme.title: We need to make a world
programme.desc: Karl Sanchez, better known as Drag queen Nicky Doll, is going to meet those who live their differences with pride. Skin colour, morphology, disability, gender identity: the series focuses on diversity in all its forms. In Brazil, Nicky is going to meet those who are turning their difference into power. From samba to Aboriginal rap, from Paralympic sport to drag, a vibrant journey where diversity becomes an art of living.

programme.title: We need to make a world
programme.desc: In South Africa, Karl Sanchez, better known as Drag Queen Nicky Doll, explores a country that transforms his wounds into collective power. From art to activism, from nature to drag, diversity is an act of resistance and reconciliation.
programme.desc-more: Between stories of resilience, unknown traditions and struggles for equality, Karl Sanchez, better known as Drag queen Nicky Doll, explores the human and cultural richness of each country. As the meetings progressed, he was welcomed by the locals, shared their daily lives, tasted local specialities, discovered singular practices and tried out new experiences. Light and deeply human, the series looks at the world in a quirky and positive way and carries a message of hope and tolerance. In South Africa, Nicky Doll explores a country that turns its wounds into collective power. From art to activism, from nature to drag, diversity is an act of resistance and reconciliation.

programme.title: Route 66, an American legend
programme.desc: Drive 66 runs nearly four thousand kilometres from the Midwest to the Pacific, through the Oklahoma Plains and Arizona deserts, and runs between Chicago and Los Angeles. But this film is neither a travel guide nor a historical documentary in the classical sense, it tells how an asphalt ribbon has become a real American fiction. The road was removed from federal records in 1985, and became a heritage with Historic Route 66, but it was mainly through images that it survived. A century after its creation, it remains a collective fiction, powerful enough to continue to tell America, its dreams of freedom as its contradictions.

programme.title: Between duel and duo: André Manoukian and Jean-François Zygel - Concert at the Théâtre des Taillades
programme.desc: Jean-François Zygel, composer and virtuoso pianist, and André Manoukian, pianist-jazzman with oriental influences, have once again made an appointment for their now inescapable "Between duel and duo". This year, the tandem benefits from the natural acoustics of the Théâtre des Carrières des Taillades.
programme.desc-more: Jean-François Zygel and André Manoukian have once again made an appointment for their now inescapable "Between duel and duo". This year, the tandem benefits from the natural acoustics and mineral beauty of the Taillades Careers Theatre. For this edition, André Manoukian, pianist-jazzman with oriental influences, meets the iron with Jean-François Zygel, composer and virtuoso pianist, internationally distinguished. Two artists, two paths, two musicalities that promise a creative tension, a source of brilliant improvisations.

programme.title: Schönbrunn's Summer Night Concert 2026
programme.desc: The concert of a summer night is a visual dazzling as much as an opportunity to hear the best of classical, symphonic and lyrical music, thanks to the participation of renowned soloists and conductors. This year, Lorenzo Viotti made her debut at the console of this event, as did the Welsh bass baritone Sir Bryn Terfel, who has been working closely with the orchestra for several decades, both in opera and in concert.

programme.title: Charles Dutoit and David Fray at the Princely Palace of Monaco
programme.desc: A concert captured on Thursday 31 July 2025 at the Cour d'honneur of the Princely Palace of Monaco. The Monte Carlo Philharmonic Orchestra is under the direction of Charles Dutoit. With pianist David Fray.

programme.title: The meetings of the Papotin
programme.desc: L'actrice Marion Cotillard, who was consecrated in 2008 by Olivier Dahan's "La Môme", answers questions from the editor of Le Papotin, a newspaper composed of autistic spectrum disorders. On this occasion, she revisits her career, her aspirations and improvises a choreography on a Madonna remix.

programme.title: Great detectives!
programme.desc: Netflix merges two episodes into one. (26/09/19)
programme.desc-more: In a small Australian city, a group of four pre-teens with a keen sense of justice and insatiable curiosity unite to found their own detective agency. Composed of the intelligent and determined Abby (Abby Bergman), the brilliant Aston (Aston Droomer), the russy Jamil (Jamil Smyth-Secka) and the creative Anna (Anna Cooke), this group of friends embarks on a series of captivating investigations that lead them to solve mysteries around their school and neighbourhood. Each episode confronts them with various puzzles, ranging from the disappearance of personal objects to disturbing rumours that disturb the peace of their establishment. As they strive to thwart clever ploys and discover the truth, young detectives must also navigate the challenges of friendship, loyalty and school rivalries. With an unwavering team spirit, they face unexpected obstacles, testing their investigative skills and their ability to remain united against adversity. "Super detectives!" plunges spectators into a thrilling universe where every investigation is a full-fledged adventure, filled with suspense and humour. Young heroes learn that solving mysteries is not only a matter of intelligence, but also of courage and solidarity.

programme.title: The aces of the jungle to the rescue
programme.desc: The jungle Aces are a bunch of friends, animals, all more or less booby, who will live rock adventures in the forest.
programme.desc-more: In a vibrant jungle full of surprises, the tranquillity of animals is often put to the test by perilous situations. Maurice, a tig-shaped manchot with a well-dipped character, joined a heteroclite team composed of Batricia, a cunning bat, Miguel, an impressively strong gorilla, and Gilbert, an astute tarsier. Together, they form the "Ace of the jungle", a group of brave animals dedicated to the protection of their friends and their habitat. When a danger threatens their peaceful community, a simple alarm signal, manifested by clouds of smoke rising from a volcano, is enough to mobilize them. Once they have gathered together, they develop bold plans to counter the threats to their world. This captivating cartoon, produced by a Toulouse society, invites young spectators to dive into a world of thrilling adventures where friendship and courage triumph over obstacles.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, Clever, a pig from India with a keen sense of observation, and Bro's somewhat impulsive brother, are engaged in captivating police investigations. Their insatiable curiosity has led them to solve mysteries that even Scotland Yard has been struggling to clear for years. In this thrilling episode, the two animals discover a series of strange disappearances that seem to be linked to a disturbing urban legend: the Gorgon of Regent's Park, a mythical creature that, according to rumours, is hidden in the shadows of London's gardens. As they navigate through the secrets of their neighbourhood, Clever uses his intelligence and his sense of analysis, while Bro uses his audacity to interrogate the inhabitants and decipher clues. Together, they will have to overcome unexpected obstacles and prove that even the smallest can dig up great truths in a city where appearances are often misleading.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: Every morning, Oscar and Malika, two young neighbours, go to school together. Every morning, their plan to arrive on time is upset by an event as extraordinary as it is improbable. This obliges them to justify themselves to the school principal, Ms. Prudence, who, of course, never believes them. Adventure, humor and surprise are on the programme of this French animation series for children.
programme.desc-more: Oscar and Malika, two young inseparable neighbours, live rock adventures each morning by going to school. Despite their geographical proximity and friendship, each journey turns into a series of unexpected journeys that prevent them from arriving on time. Whether it's by crossing a mischievous dog that takes them into a treasure hunt, meeting colorful characters or meeting up with some crazy situations, each episode is a new opportunity for them to discover the world around them. Their insatiable curiosity and sense of humour push them to explore unanticipated paths, while strengthening their bond of friendship. Through this series full of freshness and imagination, young spectators are invited to follow these two heroes of everyday life in a world where adventure and camaraderie are always at the meeting, transforming the simple journey to school into an unforgettable epic.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: In the sumptuous gardens of the Palace of Versailles in the 17th century, a unique bond was established between Belfort, Louis XIV's favorite dog, and Lupin, a daring wolf. Together, they form an unexpected duo, uniting their forces to protect their fellow animals, whether they are from the Royal Household or from the vast surrounding areas. Their friendship leads them into thrilling adventures, oscillating between humour and emotion. While the kingdom is plagued by political intrigues and conspiracy, Belfort and Lupin often find themselves at the heart of delicate situations. They must overcome the traps set by the jealous courtiers and solve mysteries surrounding the disappearance of animals. Through fascinating discoveries and bold rescues, this heteroclite couple learns to overcome their differences, proving that friendship transcends the barriers between species. Their achievements are a celebration of loyalty and courage in a world full of greatness and danger.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: As a great equestrian show prepares for the Grand Ecuries of Versailles, the noble Bucephale horse, well known for its presence, is facing a personal crisis: a mysterious legache that threatens not only his health, but also his future in the prestigious stables. Convinced that he will be driven out and relegated to oblivion in a meadow, Bucephalus is invaded by anguish and despair. Faced with this delicate situation, the two protagonists, Belfort (Alexandre Nguyen) and Lupin (Hugo Brunswick), are committed to a determined mission to save their equine friend. With the complicity of an empathic veterinarian (Nathalie Homs) and other unexpected allies, they explore unusual remedies and unconventional methods to give Bucephale hope. As the carousel date approaches, friendship and solidarity will be tested, but Belfort and Lupin's determination could make all the difference.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.title: Great detectives!
programme.sub-title: The case of the incredible fortune-telling woman
programme.desc: Netflix merges two episodes into one. (26/09/19)
programme.desc-more: In a small Australian city, a group of four pre-teens with a keen sense of justice and insatiable curiosity unite to found their own detective agency. Composed of the intelligent and determined Abby (Abby Bergman), the brilliant Aston (Aston Droomer), the russy Jamil (Jamil Smyth-Secka) and the creative Anna (Anna Cooke), this group of friends embarks on a series of captivating investigations that lead them to solve mysteries around their school and neighbourhood. Each episode confronts them with various puzzles, ranging from the disappearance of personal objects to disturbing rumours that disturb the peace of their establishment. As they strive to thwart clever ploys and discover the truth, young detectives must also navigate the challenges of friendship, loyalty and school rivalries. With an unwavering team spirit, they face unexpected obstacles, testing their investigative skills and their ability to remain united against adversity. "Super detectives!" plunges spectators into a thrilling universe where every investigation is a full-fledged adventure, filled with suspense and humour. Young heroes learn that solving mysteries is not only a matter of intelligence, but also of courage and solidarity.

Composed of the intelligent and determined Abby (Abby Bergman), the brilliant Aston (Aston Droomer), the russy Jamil (Jamil Smyth-Secka) and the creative Anna (Anna Cooke), this group of friends embarks on a series of captivating investigations that lead them to solve mysteries around their school and neighbourhood. Each episode confronts them with various puzzles, ranging from the disappearance of personal objects to disturbing rumours that disturb the peace of their establishment. As they strive to thwart clever ploys and discover the truth, young detectives must also navigate the challenges of friendship, loyalty and school rivalries. With an unwavering team spirit, they face unexpected obstacles, testing their investigative skills and their ability to remain united against adversity. "Super detectives!" plunges spectators into a thrilling universe where every investigation is a full-fledged adventure, filled with suspense and humour. Young heroes learn that solving mysteries is not only a matter of intelligence, but also of courage and solidarity.

programme.desc-more: In a vibrant jungle full of surprises, the tranquillity of animals is often put to the test by perilous situations. Maurice, a tig-shaped manchot with a well-dipped character, joined a heteroclite team composed of Batricia, a cunning bat, Miguel, an impressively strong gorilla, and Gilbert, an astute tarsier. Together, they form the "Ace of the jungle", a group of brave animals dedicated to the protection of their friends and their habitat. When a danger threatens their peaceful community, a simple alarm signal, manifested by clouds of smoke rising from a volcano, is enough to mobilize them. Once they have gathered together, they develop bold plans to counter the threats to their world. This captivating cartoon, produced by a Toulouse society, invites young spectators to dive into a world of thrilling adventures where friendship and courage triumph over obstacles.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: Mystery Lane - Season 1 - Season 1
programme.desc-more: In a world where mystery and danger are mixed, Clever (Kaycie Chase), a clever investigator, announces to her colleagues Bro (Andy Chase) and McFlare (Doug Rand) that she has finally got a set of crucial clues. These revelations lead her to the location of the next meeting of The Cause, a secret organization led by an evil Knight whose intentions are obscure and threatening. As Clever and his friends are about to infiltrate this clandestine meeting, they realize that the stakes are much higher than they imagined. Each clue brings them closer to a plot that could have devastating repercussions on their city. In parallel, tensions are mounting between the team members, each facing their own demons. As time is running out, Clever must deploy all his ingenuity to thwart the Machiavellical plans of The Cause before it is too late.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: Mystery Lane - Season 1 - Season 1
programme.desc-more: In the foggy streets of London, Clever, a pig of remarkable intelligence, is dedicated to an unusual mission: to solve the mysteries that affect pets and their owners. With a sharp mind and an unparalleled sense of observation, Clever joins a diverse team of accomplices, including four-legged friends and people passionate about justice. Each investigation plunges him into a secret world where treason, riddles and surprising revelations are mixed. From the disappearance of a precious cat to the strange behavior of a watchdog, each case puts to the test its ingenuity and determination. By sailing through mysterious London, Clever discovers that the truth is often more complex than it seems. With a touch of humour and a great sensitivity, this episode takes us into a thrilling adventure where friendship and loyalty are essential to triumph over dark forces that threaten the welfare of animals.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: Mystery Lane - Season 1 - Season 1
programme.desc-more: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, Clever, a pig from India with a keen sense of observation, and Bro's impulsive and adventurous brother, are engaged in investigations that go beyond imagination. Together, they start a series of mysterious cases that even Scotland Yard struggles to solve. Their first challenge is to bring them into a complex enigma involving a daring art flight, where invaluable works have disappeared without leaving any trace. Thanks to their lively mind and ability to sneak into unexpected places, the two brothers discovered a well-organized criminal network, using clever techniques to escape justice. While they are thwarting the plans of their opponents, Clever and Bro will also have to overcome their own differences to make the truth come out. Their friendship and determination will be tested in this thrilling adventure, where each clue counts and where danger is around every corner.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.sub-title: The case of the thief of his
programme.desc: Every morning, Oscar and Malika, two young neighbours, go to school together. Every morning, their plan to arrive on time is upset by an event as extraordinary as it is improbable. This obliges them to justify themselves to the school principal, Ms. Prudence, who, of course, never believes them. Adventure, humor and surprise are on the programme of this French animation series for children.
programme.desc-more: Oscar and Malika, two young inseparable neighbours, live rock adventures each morning by going to school. Despite their geographical proximity and friendship, each journey turns into a series of unexpected journeys that prevent them from arriving on time. Whether it's by crossing a mischievous dog that takes them into a treasure hunt, meeting colorful characters or meeting up with some crazy situations, each episode is a new opportunity for them to discover the world around them. Their insatiable curiosity and sense of humour push them to explore unanticipated paths, while strengthening their bond of friendship. Through this series full of freshness and imagination, young spectators are invited to follow these two heroes of everyday life in a world where adventure and camaraderie are always at the meeting, transforming the simple journey to school into an unforgettable epic.

programme.title: Anatole Latile
programme.desc: Anatole, a young hero with a heart, realizes with despair that he has completely forgotten the anniversary of his dear friend, the Princess. This neglect leads to a morose atmosphere, the Princess being in a bad mood and disappointed by this oversight. To try to catch up and give his friend a smile, Anatole starts organizing a memorable surprise party. He makes every effort to create an event worthy of this name, gathering a joyful group of animals, each bringing his personal touch to the celebration. Between chaotic preparations, hilarious proquos and moments of tenderness, Anatole will have to overcome many challenges to make this celebration a success. Anatole's friends, each with their own character and peculiarities, join him in this adventure, creating a festive atmosphere where friendship and solidarity shine. Their interactions and efforts to give the Princess a smile highlight the values of friendship and compassion.
programme.desc-more: Anatole Latile is a schoolboy with imagination and energy, but his adventurous spirit often pushes him to find himself in delicate situations. With his gang of comrades, there is never a lack of opportunity to embark on farfelus projects that lead him to multiply misadventures. Whether it's creating a faulty robot for the science class or organizing a surprise birthday party for his best friend, Anatole is a surprising ingenuity, although often misdirected. His carelessness and daring sometimes win him reproof from his teachers, but he also knows how to charm his friends with his contagious enthusiasm. Through his adventures, Anatole learns to juggle his aspirations with the consequences of his actions, thus discovering the value of friendship and responsibility. His tumultuous journey to school will lead him to unexpected life lessons, while keeping a lightness that makes his adventures charming.

programme.title: Shaun the sheep
programme.desc: In a peaceful corner of the English countryside, Shaun, a malicious and resourceful sheep, bores himself from the monotonous routine of the farm where he lives with his sheep companions. Always looking for a new adventure, Shaun decides to take charge and escape from the daily monotony. With the help of his friends, a much less clever group of sheep, he concocts a bold plan to spend an unforgettable day. However, their escape quickly turns into a series of hilarious mishaps when animals find themselves confronted with unforeseen situations, ranging from a trip to a city trip to unexpected encounters with humans. While Shaun must show creativity and courage to get his flock embarrassed, he realizes that friendship and solidarity are essential to overcoming obstacles. In this animated comedy, Shaun's adventurous spirit and his faces promise to captivate spectators of all ages.
programme.desc-more: In a rural world where routines are settled, Shaun (Justin Fletcher), a sheep with a lively and malicious mind, is distinguished by his insatiable curiosity and his sense of adventure. He lives peacefully on a farm with his companions, a group of naive and somewhat clumsy ovine people, who follow him in all his frascs. When daily life becomes too monotonous, Shaun decides to take charge and escape from the farm to live a thrilling day. However, his plans take an unexpected turn when the farmer, distracted by events, finds himself in nasty and unforeseen situations. Accompanied by his faithful friend, the dog Bitzer (John Sparkes), Shaun will have to be ingenuity and team spirit to overcome the obstacles. Together, they will navigate through hilarious and unexpected adventures, proving that even the smallest can achieve great things when they are united.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: In the heart of the enchanting gardens of the Palace of Versailles, in the seventeenth century, there is an unusual friendship between Belfort, a noble loyal dog, and Lupin, a bold wolf with a tender heart. Together, these two intrepid companions form an inseparable duo, ready to do anything to protect their friends with hairs and feathers. Whether it is by helping the residents of the Royal Household or by helping wild animals, their courage and ingenuity are boundless. In this thrilling episode, they find themselves confronted with a series of mysteries and perils, testing their unwavering link. Between unbridled races through the green alleys and unexpected encounters with other residents of the court, Belfort and Lupin demonstrate that love and friendship transcend all barriers. Every new adventure they discover the true value of courage and loyalty in a world where danger is around every corner.
programme.desc-more: Belfort & Lupin (2023)
programme.desc: Belfort & Lupin (2023)

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: Today, Mr. Binet (Antoine Schoumsky), the royal wig, is plunged into a real turmoil. The Queen's favorite wig, a key piece of her elegance and symbol of her authority, has mysteriously disappeared, sowing panic in the kingdom. Gazette, the little mouse (Barbara Tissier), is particularly affected by this situation, because this wig is not only an accessory: it is his home. Determined to find her shelter and help Mr.Binet, she embarks on a quest full of adventures. Together, they must navigate through the royal palace, interrogate the members of the court, and thwart the rumours that are circulating about this disappearance. As disturbing clues begin to emerge, the unlikely duo discovers a much larger plot that threatens to plunge the kingdom into chaos. Between mystery, humour and friendship, this adventure will lead them to unexpected revelations about power and loyalty.
programme.desc-more: Belfort & Lupin (2023)
programme.desc: Belfort & Lupin (2023)

programme.title: It's still not a witch.
programme.sub-title: The secret of fruits and vegetables
programme.desc: Cecile eats an apple, Mathieu chews a carrot. For one thing, there is no doubt: fruits are our best allies, while for the other they are vegetables. Max and SAMI suggest that they investigate who fruit or vegetables are the most beneficial to humans.

programme.title: Scooby-Doo and the curse of the 13th Ghost
programme.desc: Occultist Vincent Van Ghoul calls on Scooby-Doo's iconic team to solve a long-suffering riddle. Years earlier, Daphne (Kate Micucci), Shaggy (Matthew Lillard) and Scooby-Doo (Frank Welker) had managed to capture twelve of the thirteen ghosts escaped from the Devil's Box. However, the thirteenth and final ghost, Asmodeus, a formidable winged demon, remains at large and represents an imminent danger. In this thrilling adventure, our amateur detectives must revisit their childhood memories and face their fears to track down this evil spectrum. The reunion with their ancient knowledge and revelations about past events add a nostalgic dimension to their quest. As the team finds itself confronted with mysteries and trials, it will have to show courage and ingenuity to thwart Asmodeus' plans, while reaffirming the bonds of friendship that unite them.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: In a world where the human-fantastic boundary is blurred, Musculo, a half-hust, half-human boy, struggles with his unique identity and the ardent desire to lead a normal existence at the age of eleven. In search of acceptance, he navigates between his daily adventures, his relations with his classmates and the challenges posed by his hybrid nature. Musculo is surrounded by loyal friends who help him overcome the obstacles of child life, while discovering the joys and sorrows of adolescence. His parents, although understanding, also struggle to provide him with a stable environment, which further complicates his quest for balance. Through the grim and touching situations, Musculo learns that true normality lies in the acceptance of oneself and others, and that every difference can become a force in its journey towards personal fulfilment.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: Coco, a pragmatic young woman, is reluctant to participate in a scientific party, convinced that the event will only be an opportunity for boring debates. However, his brother Molusco, eager to please him and break his routine, took charge of things. He decided to organize a surprise by inviting his scientific friends to their home, thinking that this party might change Coco's opinion about the world of science. Unfortunately, scientists, often eccentric and unpredictable, quickly turn the evening into a real chaos. Between farfetched experiences and unpredictable behaviors, the festival degenerates, testing Molusco's patience and Coco's anguish. The events take an unexpected turn, and the evening is transformed into a hilarious and disastrous adventure that challenges family relations and the acceptance of others' passions.

programme.desc: Molusco (0)

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: In a colorful and baffled universe, Molusco, an endearing and clumsy character, finds himself facing an unexpected danger that threatens his existence. To save him, a third arm appears from his head, a phenomenon as surprising as it is surprising. Initially, Molusco was delighted with this new ability, thinking that it would give him unprecedented strength and agility. However, he quickly realizes that this extra arm has a clean will and starts overprotecting it excessively. This arm, with a strong and intrusive personality, makes decisions in its place, disrupting the balance of its daily life and social interactions. While Molusco tries to regain his autonomy and manage this unusual situation, he also faces unexpected challenges, thus revealing truths about himself and the sense of friendship and freedom.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: In a world where imagination and reality are at the same time together, Musculo, a young boy with a double nature, half-hust, half-human, dreams of living an ordinary existence at the age of eleven. He was removed from the simple pleasures of childhood because of his unique condition, and struggled to integrate among his comrades. Through his adventures, Musculo faces unexpected challenges, whether to enrol in school, participate in children's games or simply make friends. His quest for acceptance led him to explore his identity, while discovering the joys and sorrows of childhood. As the episodes progress, he meets with colorful characters who help him navigate the complexities of his atypical life. Between humour and tenderness, Musculo learns that true normality lies in the acceptance of oneself and the celebration of its differences.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: In the vibrant Lexington neighbourhood of London, two fearless brothers, Clever, a sharp-minded Indian pig, and Bro, his impulsive brother, are embarking on police investigations that challenge imagination. With insatiable curiosity and remarkable intelligence, they find themselves resolving cases that even Scotland Yard has not been able to solve for years. While Clever uses his sense of observation to decipher the clues, Bro does not hesitate to plunge his head first into action, which leads them into situations as comic as well as proving. Their first case led them to investigate the mysterious disappearance of a precious jewel, a theft that left the community in a state of dismay. While traveling through the alleys of Lexington, the two brothers will discover a world of intrigues, secrets and unexpected characters, while learning to master their own talents and strengthen their brotherly bond.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: Every morning, Oscar and Malika, two young neighbours, go to school together. Every morning, their plan to arrive on time is upset by an event as extraordinary as it is improbable. This obliges them to justify themselves to the school principal, Ms. Prudence, who, of course, never believes them. Adventure, humor and surprise are on the programme of this French animation series for children.
programme.desc-more: Oscar and Malika, two young inseparable neighbours, live rock adventures each morning by going to school. Despite their geographical proximity and friendship, each journey turns into a series of unexpected journeys that prevent them from arriving on time. Whether it's by crossing a mischievous dog that takes them into a treasure hunt, meeting colorful characters or meeting up with some crazy situations, each episode is a new opportunity for them to discover the world around them. Their insatiable curiosity and sense of humour push them to explore unanticipated paths, while strengthening their bond of friendship. Through this series full of freshness and imagination, young spectators are invited to follow these two heroes of everyday life in a world where adventure and camaraderie are always at the meeting, transforming the simple journey to school into an unforgettable epic.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.title: Misery
programme.desc: Paul Sheldon (James Caan), a successful novelist, finally savors his creative freedom. After completing the last volume of his Misery saga, he made the radical decision to kill his heroine, thus releasing his imagination for new projects. As he left his writing shelter to join New York, a snowstorm of unprecedented violence struck the area. His car, blinded by the bluffs, leaves the road and crashes into a buried ravine. Injured, unconscious and at the mercy of the elements, Paul seems condemned... until a shadow leans on him. Annie Wilkes (Kathi Bates), a retired nurse who is re-entering an isolated cottage, finds out by chance and takes her home. While his gesture seems to be dictated by compassion, Paul still ignores that Annie is much more than just a Samaritan. Misery's unconditional fan of her, she devotes an obsessional cult to the heroine of her novels – and the author's decision to end her story plunges her into a silent but growing fury. While Paul, who was bedridden and dependent on his care, tried to keep calm, he gradually realized that his savior was hiding a much darker face.

programme.title: Tales and Legends
programme.desc: In a slightly futuristic world, two teenagers dock a young woman. Very quickly, the altercation turns into a dispute and young people exchange hard and raw words, full of violence and questions about the nature of the adolescent. A little later, a mature woman presents "the robot-companion", intended to accompany children in their daily lives, for example at their evenings. Young people give their testimony about the developed relationships with their robot, which they do not want to call this any more.

programme.title: Jade's armor
programme.desc: Lan Jun wonders if she should tell Kai that she's Jade, but is afraid he'll take it badly. At the same time, an Eclat strikes with amnesia all the inhabitants of Ban Tang.
programme.desc-more: In a world where legends come to life, Lan Jun, a young woman apparently ordinary, finds herself confronted with an extraordinary destiny. A heir to a legendary super heroine named Jade, she must wear the iconic armor that once protected the kingdom from evil. At first, Lan Jun doubted his ability to bear such a burden and honour Jade's legacy. However, as dark forces begin to emerge, threatening peace and harmony, she understands that the time has come to fight. With the help of his friends and unexpected allies, Lan Jun is embarking on a perilous quest to master his new skills and discover the hidden secrets of armor. Between personal challenges and epic confrontations, she must learn to believe in herself and embrace her role as a protector. The adventure that awaits her will lead her to explore unknown territories, both external and internal, as she prepares to face the evil that is looming on the horizon.

programme.desc-more: In a vibrant jungle full of surprises, the tranquillity of animals is often put to the test by perilous situations. Maurice, a tig-shaped manchot with a well-dipped character, joined a heteroclite team composed of Batricia, a cunning bat, Miguel, an impressively strong gorilla, and Gilbert, an astute tarsier. Together, they form the "Ace of the jungle", a group of brave animals dedicated to the protection of their friends and their habitat. When a danger threatens their peaceful community, a simple alarm signal, manifested by clouds of smoke rising from a volcano, is enough to mobilize them. Once they have gathered together, they develop bold plans to counter the threats to their world. This captivating cartoon, produced by a Toulouse society, invites young spectators to dive into a world of thrilling adventures where friendship and courage triumph over obstacles.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: In a mysterious London, a disturbing event shakes the royal court when, in the middle of the night, a feline with a spotted coat and surprisingly long claws bursts into the Queen's room (Barbara Scaff). This serval, wearing a carved mask that gives it a enigmatic look, attacks the peace of the monarchy by disappearing with the sovereign. The alert is quickly given and a complex investigation is under way, involving members of the Royal Guard and city detectives. Andy Chase is a clever detective, determined to break the mystery behind this intriguing creature and find the Queen before it's too late. As the investigation proceeds, hidden secrets, unexpected alliances and surprising revelations emerge, plunging the spectator into an atmosphere of tension and intrigue where each clue could be the key to the resolution of this bold flight.

programme.desc: Mystery Lane (2021)

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, Clever, a pig from India with a keen mind and remarkable observational capacity, and his brother Bro, a little more impulsive and bold, are embarking on police investigations that defy understanding. While Scotland Yard struggles to solve thorny business, the two fur brothers take charge, proving that even the smallest can have a great impact. Their first case plunges them into an intriguing mystery: a series of inexplicable disappearances of precious toys in the neighbourhood. With their sense of deference, Clever and Bro question unlikely witnesses, explore dark alleys and use clever schemes to dislodge the culprits. As they investigate, they discover an unsuspecting criminal network, testing their intelligence and courage. Each investigation brings them a little closer to the truth, but also to the dangers that lie ahead.
programme.desc-more: Mystery Lane (2021)

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, Clever, a pig from India with a sharp observation, and Bro's somewhat impulsive brother, are embarking on captivating police investigations. Despite their small size, both animals manage to decipher mysteries that even Scotland Yard struggles to solve. Their first case takes them into a series of jewelry robberies that left the police perplexed. Clever uses his lively mind to observe the details that no one else notices, while Bro, with his fervoury temperament, does not hesitate to enter into risky situations to get clues. In parallel, they are confronted with formidable opponents, cunning criminals who are determined to protect their secrets. As they investigate, the two brothers discover a complex criminal network that threatens to plunge all Lexington into chaos. Their friendship and ingenuity will be tested as they engage in this thrilling quest to restore justice.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: In a series of hilarious and moving adventures, Oscar (Jillian O'Dowd) and Malika, two inseparable friends, are constantly late for school. Their daily lives are punctuated by rock-capped situations, where every day is a new opportunity to find yourself in unexpected perpetencies. Whether it's a school bus that's broken down, a wandering animal that blocks their way or their own mishaps, their over-imagining imagination is driving them into scenarios that are all more crazy than each other. Despite the obstacles, their unwavering friendship and team spirit enable them to overcome challenges while learning valuable life lessons. Through these fifty-two episodes, Oscar and Malika remind us that even when we are late, the essential thing is to enjoy the journey and adventure that awaits us, while cultivating unforgettable memories.
programme.desc-more: Oscar and Malika, two young inseparable neighbours, live rock adventures each morning by going to school. Despite their geographical proximity and friendship, each journey turns into a series of unexpected journeys that prevent them from arriving on time. Whether it's by crossing a mischievous dog that takes them into a treasure hunt, meeting colorful characters or meeting up with some crazy situations, each episode is a new opportunity for them to discover the world around them. Their insatiable curiosity and sense of humour push them to explore unanticipated paths, while strengthening their bond of friendship. Through this series full of freshness and imagination, young spectators are invited to follow these two heroes of everyday life in a world where adventure and camaraderie are always at the meeting, transforming the simple journey to school into an unforgettable epic.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: In the colorful and sparkling world of Bluey, a young blue bitch, the daily adventure takes a playful and imaginative turn. Accompanied by her little sister Bingo, Bluey transforms everyday situations into captivating games. When Bluey receives an invitation to a birthday party, the excitement is at its peak. However, Bingo, with his magical pen, complicates the preparations by introducing unexpected and fanciful elements that test the patience of the whole family. At the same time, their father, Bandit (David McCormack), is confronted with the challenges of daily life when he has to drive his daughters to school. The two little bitches, with their overly creativeness, will not fail to imagine hilarious and surprising scenarios, making each moment memorable. Through games that reflect their daily lives, Bluey and Bingo learn valuable lessons about friendship, family and imagination, while bringing joy and laughter to those around them.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.
