programme.title: Shaun the sheep
programme.desc: In a peaceful corner of the English countryside, Shaun, a malicious and resourceful sheep, bores himself from the monotonous routine of the farm where he lives with his sheep companions. Always looking for a new adventure, Shaun decides to take charge and escape from the daily monotony. With the help of his friends, a much less clever group of sheep, he concocts a bold plan to spend an unforgettable day. However, their escape quickly turns into a series of hilarious mishaps when animals find themselves confronted with unforeseen situations, ranging from a trip to a city trip to unexpected encounters with humans. While Shaun must show creativity and courage to get his flock embarrassed, he realizes that friendship and solidarity are essential to overcoming obstacles. In this animated comedy, Shaun's adventurous spirit and his faces promise to captivate spectators of all ages.
programme.desc-more: In a rural world where routines are settled, Shaun (Justin Fletcher), a sheep with a lively and malicious mind, is distinguished by his insatiable curiosity and his sense of adventure. He lives peacefully on a farm with his companions, a group of naive and somewhat clumsy ovine people, who follow him in all his frascs. When daily life becomes too monotonous, Shaun decides to take charge and escape from the farm to live a thrilling day. However, his plans take an unexpected turn when the farmer, distracted by events, finds himself in nasty and unforeseen situations. Accompanied by his faithful friend, the dog Bitzer (John Sparkes), Shaun will have to be ingenuity and team spirit to overcome the obstacles. Together, they will navigate through hilarious and unexpected adventures, proving that even the smallest can achieve great things when they are united.

programme.title: Idefixes and Indomitables
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of season 2, Padgachix (Benjamin Bollen), the famous dog of the undeserved, is convinced that his mistress, Vitamin (Kelly Marot), prefers more slender animals. Desiring to prove to him that he can be a worthy companion, he embarks on a desperate quest to regain his form. His solution? A revolutionary exercise wheel, designed by the farfelu inventor Anglaigus (Jean-Claude Donda) for the General. However, things are turning unexpectedly when the wheel, with an uncontrollable mechanism, starts to turn at full speed in the streets of Lutece. Pungachix is trapped inside, causing a real disorder in the city, causing panic among the inhabitants. His friends, including the cunning Obélix (Stéphane Bern) and the wise Asterix (Edwige Lemoine), must join forces to save their companion while trying to restore calm before the situation degenerates completely.

programme.title: Idefixes and Indomitables
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of the series "Idefix and the Indomitable", a mysterious potion makes unexpected wonders. Turbine, the bitch with a well tempered character, begins to spit diamonds, causing the greed of Labienus and Plendastus, two unscrupulous crooks. Seeing a golden opportunity, they do not hesitate to kidnap the bitch to exploit this incredible phenomenon to their advantage. As the two malefrats draw up a Machiavellical plan to take advantage of this unexpected situation, Idéfix (Benjamin Bollen), the faithful companion, is launching a race against the clock to save his four-legged friend. With courage and determination, he uses his irresistible instincts to thwart the plans of the kidnappers. This journey rich in twists and adventures will test the friendship and loyalty of the characters, while revealing unexpected facets of their personality.

programme.title: Idefixes and Indomitables
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of the series "Idefix and the Indomitable", Voldenuix, the clever owl, decided to make a romantic gesture by offering Sonelematine a precious necklace that once belonged to Monalisa. This iconic jewel is more than just an accessory; It is full of history and mystery. To achieve his plan, Voldenuix joins Turbine, a character with a lively mind and always ready for adventure. Together, they embark on a bold quest to recover the necklace, but the task will not be easy. Using a magic potion, Turbine hopes to copy the jewel, but this manipulation could have unexpected consequences. As they travel, they will have to navigate through comical obstacles and surprising puzzles, while learning lessons about friendship, love and the value of precious objects. The episode promises to be rich in twists and humour, faithful to the spirit of Idéfix's adventures.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: Tonight, the castle park is preparing to host a spectacular fireworks fire in honor of the king, attracting the curiosity of the city's inhabitants. Artus (Alexandre Nguyen) and Marcus (Hugo Brunswick), two inseparable friends, decided to attend the preparations for this festive event. As they explore the behind the scenes of the organization, they discover a vibrant world of colours and secrets. The two young men find themselves immersed in an electric atmosphere, where the pyrotechnicians work to create heavenly wonders. However, as they conduct their playful investigation, they dig up underlying tensions and unexpected rivalries between the members of the preparation team. As the long-awaited moment approaches, Artus and Marcus realize that this fireworks could reveal more than mere bright flashes, and that much more important issues are hidden behind this royal celebration.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: At the heart of a Castle where tales come to life, Charles Perrault evokes the history of the Little Red Chaperon. However, a mysterious wolf, lost in the surrounding groves, draws the attention of the Guard, who is pursuing it. Belfort (Alexandre Nguyen), initially paralyzed by fear, saw his apprehension turn into determination thanks to Lupin (Hugo Brunswick), who persuaded him to help this animal in distress. For Lupin, this encounter with a wolf of his kind, named Remus, is of particular importance. As the two companions engage in a mission of exfiltration, Remus gradually settles in Lupin's heart, appearing as a fascinating father figure. But Lupin needs a crucial question: should he abandon Belfort to join a pack and live among his fellow men? The fear of losing his friend and the threat to their quest exacerbate Belfort's concern.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, two brothers, Clever, a lively-minded Indian pig, and Bro, his impulsive brother, are launching investigations that even defy Scotland Yard's abilities. Clever, with an acute sense of observation and an extraordinary intelligence, is often the brain behind their investigations, while Bro, always ready to act without thinking, brings a touch of energy and audacity to their adventures. Together, they are attacking mysterious and complex cases that have left the police perplexed for years. Each episode plunges them into captivating puzzles, where they have to decipher clues, question witnesses and navigate a world of intrigues. As their reputation grows, they attract the attention of enigmatic characters who seek to defeat them. Clever and Bro will have to unite their strengths and talents to solve mysteries that may well change their lives forever.

programme.title: Mystery Lane

While the city is immersed in a series of troubling mysteries, the two animals find themselves confronted with complex cases, ranging from mysterious disappearances to puzzles that seem to be rooted in local folklore. Clever, with his analytical mind, deciphers clues that no one else notices, while Bro, with his overflowing energy, does not hesitate to engage in perilous situations to get answers. programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: In a series of hilarious and moving adventures, Oscar (Jillian O'Dowd) and Malika, two inseparable friends, are constantly late for school. Their daily lives are punctuated by rock-capped situations, where every day is a new opportunity to find yourself in unexpected perpetencies. Whether it's a school bus that's broken down, a wandering animal that blocks their way or their own mishaps, their over-imagining imagination is driving them into scenarios that are all more crazy than each other. Despite the obstacles, their unwavering friendship and team spirit enable them to overcome challenges while learning valuable life lessons. Through these fifty-two episodes, Oscar and Malika remind us that even when we are late, the essential thing is to enjoy the journey and adventure that awaits us, while cultivating unforgettable memories.
programme.desc-more: Oscar and Malika, two young inseparable neighbours, live rock adventures each morning by going to school. Despite their geographical proximity and friendship, each journey turns into a series of unexpected journeys that prevent them from arriving on time. Whether it's by crossing a mischievous dog that takes them into a treasure hunt, meeting colorful characters or meeting up with some crazy situations, each episode is a new opportunity for them to discover the world around them. Their insatiable curiosity and sense of humour push them to explore unanticipated paths, while strengthening their bond of friendship. Through this series full of freshness and imagination, young spectators are invited to follow these two heroes of everyday life in a world where adventure and camaraderie are always at the meeting, transforming the simple journey to school into an unforgettable epic.

programme.title: Okoo-koo
programme.desc: Okoo-koo - Season 5: even closer to children, even more inspiring! For his fifth season, Okoo-koo continues his mission: to awaken curiosity, encourage creativity and accompany children in their discovery of the world through fun, positive and inspiring content. This year, the show is getting even closer to its audience with \" Okoo, it's at home \", a new weekly sequence that gives the children the floor. Karim will meet them all over France to discover their passions, talents and initiatives, or will host them directly on the stage to share their universes. A section that places children at the heart of the program and values their creativity, personality and commitment.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: "The girls of the forest"Bluey, a 6-year-old bouvier, makes every day epic with her imagination and energy, transforming family life into adventures.
programme.desc-more: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!

programme.title: The aces of the jungle to the rescue
programme.desc: The happy gang of jungle Aces continues to want to bring peace and justice to the nature around them, despite some enemies.
programme.desc-more: In a vibrant jungle full of surprises, the tranquillity of animals is often put to the test by perilous situations. Maurice, a tig-shaped manchot with a well-dipped character, joined a heteroclite team composed of Batricia, a cunning bat, Miguel, an impressively strong gorilla, and Gilbert, an astute tarsier. Together, they form the "Ace of the jungle", a group of brave animals dedicated to the protection of their friends and their habitat. When a danger threatens their peaceful community, a simple alarm signal, manifested by clouds of smoke rising from a volcano, is enough to mobilize them. Once they have gathered together, they develop bold plans to counter the threats to their world. This captivating cartoon, produced by a Toulouse society, invites young spectators to dive into a world of thrilling adventures where friendship and courage triumph over obstacles.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: "The Treasure of the Catacombs"Champollion, the famous archaeologist Sir Arthur Bones parrot, came to ask for help from Clever, because his master was abducted by a humanoid robot.
programme.desc-more: In a world where adventure and mystery are interspersed, Clever, a young amateur detective, finds himself confronted with an unexpected situation when he receives a visit from Champollion, the parrot of Sir Arthur Bones, a renowned archaeologist. Champollion, a panicked man, reveals that his master was abducted by a humanoid robot, an event that seems to have come out of a science fiction story. Intrigued and determined to help, Clever is engaged in an investigation that will lead him to explore ancient catacombs and long-sought secrets. As he investigates, he will discover mysterious clues and forgotten artifacts, while facing unexpected dangers. With the help of his friends, Clever will have to be a cunning and courageous man to thwart the kidnapper's plans and save Sir Arthur. The stakes are high, and each discovery brings it closer to a truth that could change the course of history.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: "The trap of the octopus"A poodle that participates continuously in canine beauty competitions is attacked at night in its home by a tentacular creature.
programme.desc-more: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, Clever, a pig from India with a sharp sense of observation, and his brother Bro, a little impulsive, are embarking on bold police investigations. Their insatiable curiosity and their natural instinct to solve mysteries push them to explore business that even Scotland Yard struggles to elucidate. Together, they decipher complex puzzles and face perilous situations, while using their trickery and team spirit. Clever, with his intelligence and attention to detail, contrasts with Bro's fervour temperament, creating a captivating dynamic between the two characters. As they go through their adventures, they discover a network of intrigues that drags them into theft, deceit and secrets that are well guarded. Their quest for truth leads them to rub themselves with mysterious characters and unexpected situations, proving that even the smallest can have a great impact on the world around them.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: «The Serval of the Thames»A very long-glawed feline with a speckled coat, wearing a carved mask, bursts into the Queen's room in the middle of the night and disappears with it.
programme.desc-more: In a mysterious London, a disturbing event shakes the royal court when, in the middle of the night, a feline with a spotted coat and surprisingly long claws bursts into the Queen's room (Barbara Scaff). This serval, wearing a carved mask that gives it a enigmatic look, attacks the peace of the monarchy by disappearing with the sovereign. The alert is quickly given and a complex investigation is under way, involving members of the Royal Guard and city detectives. Andy Chase is a clever detective, determined to break the mystery behind this intriguing creature and find the Queen before it's too late. As the investigation proceeds, hidden secrets, unexpected alliances and surprising revelations emerge, plunging the spectator into an atmosphere of tension and intrigue where each clue could be the key to the resolution of this bold flight.

programme.title: Idefixes and Indomitables
programme.desc: "The Phaler of Fear"After absorbing a potion of Voldenuix, Asmatix thought he was back at the battle of Lutece. Chevrotine will try to take advantage of it to get revenge for Labienus.
programme.desc-more: In this captivating episode of "Idefix and the Indomitable", Asmatix, the famous Druid, finds himself in a situation to say the least unexpected after ingesting a potion concocted by the sorcerer Voldenuix. This potion carried him mentally to the tumultuous period of the battle of Lutèce, where he believed himself in the midst of the clashes between the Gauls and the Romans. As Asmatix tries to navigate this past world, Chevrotine, his accomplice, both unpredictable and cunning, sees an opportunity to settle his accounts with Labienus, the Roman centurion. Driven by a desire for revenge, Chevrotine embarked on a bold plan to destabilize Labienus, but things did not go as planned. Tensions are rising, and quiproquos are accumulating, testing Asmatix's ingenuity and Chevrotin's determination in an adventure full of twists and humour.

programme.title: Idefixes and Indomitables
programme.desc: "The pomdofin of discord"In order to compete with the Gaulish kitchen cart of Pomdofine, Labienus, Plendastus and Anglaigus create a canteen cart of Roman cuisine.
programme.desc-more: In a small Gallic village where gastronomy is queen, Pomdofine, the famous cook, is at the head of a popular Gaulish kitchen cart. To counter this culinary success, Labienus, a clever Roman strategist, decides to put in place a bold plan with the help of his accomplices, Plendastus and Anglaigus. Together, they concoct a canteen cart of Roman cuisine, hoping to seduce the villagers with exotic and tasty dishes, while imposing themselves as the new masters of gastronomy. The tensions between the Gauls and the Romans intensified as the two sides competed to attract the greedy. The inhabitants of the village, caught between two fires, face culinary choices that may well influence the harmony of their community. In this tasty duel, unexpected alliances that suggest promise to spice up the plot, while celebrating the passion for good cooking.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: Chico, a pink flamingo, crashes at the feet of Belfort and Lupin, thinking he has arrived in Africa. The two heroes will try to help him find his way back.
programme.desc-more: In this captivating episode of the "Belfort & Lupin" series, the story begins unexpectedly when a pink flamingo named Chico, disoriented and exhausted, crashes at the feet of our two heroes, Belfort and Lupin. Convinced of having arrived in Africa, Chico quickly realized that he was far from his destination. The two protagonists, always ready to help those in need, decide to embark on a rock adventure to help the flamboyant bird find its way back. As they travel, they meet a gallery of colorful characters and find themselves confronted with comedic and unexpected situations. Challenges are accumulating, testing their ingenuity and friendship. As the tracks multiply, Belfort and Lupin will have to navigate through misunderstandings and misunderstandings, proving that mutual aid and solidarity are essential, even in the most disconcerting moments.

programme.sub-title: From the menagerie to the rififi
programme.desc: "From the Rififi to the menagerie"The change of the enclosures of the lama Serge creates a real tsunami at the Household because Madame Rosa does not support her new neighbour.
programme.desc-more: At La Ménagerie, a local zoo, the change of the enclosures of the lama Serge (Alexandre Nguyen) provokes a real agitation. Indeed, Madame Rosa (Barbara Tissier), a passionate and devoted careful woman, cannot bear the presence of this new neighbour with an unpredictable character. Serge, with his mischievous temperament and his tendency to sow disorder, disturbs the well-ordered daily life of the household, where every animal and every employee has their place. The tension between Rosa and Serge, exacerbated by the mockery of other animals, is rising, while the zoo director, Mr. Bouvier (Hugo Brunswick), is trying to find a solution to calm the situation. Over the days, conflicts are increasing, leading to nasty and unforeseen situations. Between rivalries, emerging friendships and the challenge of living together, this episode promises a humorous exploration of inter-animal and human relations, where everyone will have to learn to accept differences.

programme.title: Dodin Buffant's passion
programme.desc: In the mid 1880s, in France. A famous astronomer is developing a scheme to conquer the heart of his faithful and complicit cook.
programme.desc-more: At the end of the 19th century in France, Eugénie (Juliette Binoche) dedicated her life to chef Dodin Bouffant (Benoît Magimel), whose cook she has been faithful for two decades. Renowned for its refined dishes that seduce the greatest personalities of the time, Dodin finds in the presence of Eugénie an indispensable support, both in the vegetable garden and in the kitchens of his prestigious establishment. Their relationship, much more than just professional collaboration, flourishes in a profound complicity that flirts with love, although they have never formalized their union, despite Dodin's repeated proposals. While their daily lives are punctuated by sumptuous dinners for notables, an underlying tension is emerging, revealing the true feelings that unite them. In the face of the demands of high gastronomy and their own desires, Eugene and Dodin must navigate between passion and tradition, questioning the norms of their time.

programme.title: The aces of the jungle to the rescue
programme.desc: The happy gang of jungle Aces continues to want to bring peace and justice to the nature around them, despite some enemies.
programme.desc-more: In a vibrant jungle full of surprises, the tranquillity of animals is often put to the test by perilous situations. Maurice, a tig-shaped manchot with a well-dipped character, joined a heteroclite team composed of Batricia, a cunning bat, Miguel, an impressively strong gorilla, and Gilbert, an astute tarsier. Together, they form the "Ace of the jungle", a group of brave animals dedicated to the protection of their friends and their habitat. When a danger threatens their peaceful community, a simple alarm signal, manifested by clouds of smoke rising from a volcano, is enough to mobilize them. Once they have gathered together, they develop bold plans to counter the threats to their world. This captivating cartoon, produced by a Toulouse society, invites young spectators to dive into a world of thrilling adventures where friendship and courage triumph over obstacles.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, Clever, a pig from India with a keen mind and remarkable observational capacity, and his brother Bro, a little more impulsive and bold, are embarking on police investigations that defy understanding. While Scotland Yard struggles to solve thorny business, the two fur brothers take charge, proving that even the smallest can have a great impact. Their first case plunges them into an intriguing mystery: a series of inexplicable disappearances of precious toys in the neighbourhood. With their sense of deference, Clever and Bro question unlikely witnesses, explore dark alleys and use clever schemes to dislodge the culprits. As they investigate, they discover an unsuspecting criminal network, testing their intelligence and courage. Each investigation brings them a little closer to the truth, but also to the dangers that lie ahead.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: Every morning, Oscar and Malika, two young neighbours, go to school together. Every morning, their plan to arrive on time is upset by an event as extraordinary as it is improbable. This obliges them to justify themselves to the school principal, Ms. Prudence, who, of course, never believes them. Adventure, humor and surprise are on the programme of this French animation series for children.
programme.desc-more: Oscar and Malika, two young inseparable neighbours, live rock adventures each morning by going to school. Despite their geographical proximity and friendship, each journey turns into a series of unexpected journeys that prevent them from arriving on time. Whether it's by crossing a mischievous dog that takes them into a treasure hunt, meeting colorful characters or meeting up with some crazy situations, each episode is a new opportunity for them to discover the world around them. Their insatiable curiosity and sense of humour push them to explore unanticipated paths, while strengthening their bond of friendship. Through this series full of freshness and imagination, young spectators are invited to follow these two heroes of everyday life in a world where adventure and camaraderie are always at the meeting, transforming the simple journey to school into an unforgettable epic.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: As an Australian young bouvier, Bluey transforms every day into a playground of games and adventures thanks to her lively imagination and inexhaustible energy.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.title: Idefixes and Indomitables
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of "Idefix and the Indomitable", Idéfix (Benjamin Bollen), the faithful companion of Asterix and Obelix, finds himself in a perilous situation. Locked in the kennel of the fearsome Louve, he faces the interrogation of Monalisa (Kelly Marot), a clever and determined figure, who seeks to discover the location of the secret den of the Indomitable. As tensions rise and time is running out, Muffine (Edwige Lemoine), Idéfix's courageous and fearless friend, is undertaking a bold mission to save him. Aware of the dangers ahead, she was developing an ingenious plan to infiltrate the territory of the Louve and to thwart her actions. Meanwhile, the story is enriched with moments of humour and friendship, as the characters fight to defend their values and protect their community. The stakes are high and every decision counts in this thrilling adventure.

programme.title: Idefixes and Indomitables
programme.desc: The arrival of Gracchus Plendastus, a flamboyant and ambitious figure, at the Louve causes palpable agitation among the inhabitants. Monalisa, a clever, clever young mouse, does not see with a good eye this intrusion that threatens her daily life. She then decided to take advantage of the gourmet taste of the nearby mice to concoct a Machiavellic plan. By orchestrating a series of misunderstandings and tricks, Monalisa hopes to defeat Gracchus' intentions and regain control of his territory. The mice, seduced by the promise of tempting feasts, are drawn into his ploy, ignoring the consequences of their actions. In this tumultuous context, friendship and loyalty will be tested, while Monalisa will have to navigate between his personal ambitions and the well-being of his community. This captivating narrative plunges us into a universe where intrigues and alliances weave around the quest for power and survival.

programme.title: Idefixes and Indomitables
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of the animated series "Idefix and the Indomitable", Baratine, a little heroine with a big heart, finds herself in a delicate situation when she clings the paw between the roots of a majestic tree. This tree, coveted by Anglaigus, a character determined to transform it into toothpicks, becomes the symbol of the struggle for nature's preservation. As Anglaigus' plans threaten the balance of their environment, Baratine, with his indomitable spirit and sense of justice, becomes a leader of a resistance movement. She joins her friends in defending their precious tree and mobilizes the inhabitants of the village to oppose the invader. Through thrilling adventures, Baratine discovers the strength of union and the importance of protecting their natural heritage. This touching and humorous narrative addresses themes of solidarity and ecology, captivating both young and old.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: In the majestic setting of the Palace of Versailles in the 17th century, the intrepid duo of Belfort, a faithful dog of Louis XIV, and Lupin, a daring wolf, was illustrated by his heroic actions. In the lush gardens of the royal residence, these two unlikely friends devote themselves to protecting their fur-and-fine companions, whether they are from the Royal Household or the surrounding wilderness. Each episode leads them into thrilling adventures, where their friendship and courage are tested. Whether it's to rescue an injured bird or to find a lost cat, Belfort and Lupin are showing remarkable team spirit. Through unexpected challenges, they discover not only the joys of mutual aid, but also the dangers that lie ahead in this enchanting and perilous world. Their incessant quest to save the most vulnerable leads them to experience moments rich in emotions, thus forging an unwavering link between these two creatures, emblematic of loyalty and bravery.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: While the Court of Humans left the fascist of Versailles to take refuge in the soothing setting of Fontainebleau, Belfort (Alexandre Nguyen) found himself immersed in an ocean of despair. In the King's room, he mourns his forgetfulness, feeling abandoned and invisible in a courtyard where prestige and power reign as masters. As the festivities were full at Fontainebleau, he wondered about his role and place in this world where appearances predominate. Meanwhile, political intrigues and court rivalries threaten to upset the fragile balance between the nobles. In this tumultuous context, Belfort will have to navigate through conspiracy and manipulation, seeking to regain the King's attention and prove his worth. His quest will lead him to meet with colorful characters, each with his own ambitions, and rediscover the true sense of friendship and loyalty.

programme.title: Grizzy and lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy, a smart, strong bear, reigns over a corner of the Canadian forest where a lovely family of mischievous lemmings give him a twist.
programme.desc-more: In the vast and wild Canadian forest, Grizzy, an imposing and cunning brown bear, enjoys a comfortable existence in the forest guard cabin, which he considers his kingdom. When he appropriates the delights of this isolated retreat, he encounters a horde of mischievous and fearless lemmings, small mammals who, although often clumsy, do not retreat in front of anything to counteract Grizzy's plans. These lemmings, with their limited intelligence but their unwavering determination, engage in a series of hilarious confrontations with the bear, competing for the domination of the hut and the treasures it contains. Misadventures are going on as Grizzy faces unexpected challenges, clever traps and nasty situations, while trying to preserve his quiet lifestyle. The struggle between the bear and the lemmings gives rise to moments of burlesque comedy, making each episode a unique and entertaining adventure.

programme.desc: Grizzy, a smart, strong bear, reigns over a corner of the Canadian forest where a lovely family of mischievous lemmings give him a twist.
programme.desc-more: In the vast and wild Canadian forest, Grizzy, an imposing and cunning brown bear, enjoys a comfortable existence in the forest guard cabin, which he considers his kingdom. When he appropriates the delights of this isolated retreat, he encounters a horde of mischievous and fearless lemmings, small mammals who, although often clumsy, do not retreat in front of anything to counteract Grizzy's plans. These lemmings, with their limited intelligence but their unwavering determination, engage in a series of hilarious confrontations with the bear, competing for the domination of the hut and the treasures it contains. Misadventures are going on as Grizzy faces unexpected challenges, clever traps and nasty situations, while trying to preserve his quiet lifestyle. The struggle between the bear and the lemmings gives rise to moments of burlesque comedy, making each episode a unique and entertaining adventure.

programme.title: Shaun the sheep, the movie
programme.desc: In a picturesque farm, Shaun (voice of Justin Fletcher), a young, mischievous and fearless sheep, aspires to escape the daily routine. With the help of his animal comrades, he developed a bold plan to take a vacation for the myopic farmer, whose benevolence is often put to the test. To distract Blitzer (voice of John Sparkes), the vigilant shepherd dog, Shaun and his friends are implementing a series of hilarious tricks. However, when their scheme takes an unexpected turn, the farmer finds himself trapped in a caravan that starts to de-calm the hill. As Blitzer pursues him, Shaun and the other sheep quickly realize that they need the help of their master to navigate this chaotic situation. Determined to find the farmer and restore balance on the farm, Shaun embarks on an adventure full of twists and lessons on friendship and responsibility.

programme.title: Fort Boyard
programme.desc: Under the benevolent gaze of Olivier Minne, still in charge of the show, Philippe Etchebest, Ragnar Le Breton, Fabien Olicard, Carla Lazzari, Jeck and Isabelle Vitari set off to assault the famous Charente-Maritime fort, protected by Father Fouras and his numerous acolytes. Tonight, the six candidates will try to seize the treasure for the benefit of the association Firefighters Solidaires, a humanitarian organization whose purpose is to act both locally and internationally in order to prepare the population for risks and crises.

programme.title: Kina & Yuk: ice foxes
programme.desc: In an increasingly threatened Arctic landscape, Kina (Véronique Boileau) and Yuk (Joe Bishop), a pair of polar foxes, are preparing to welcome their range. Since their childhood, they have shared precious moments in this glacial region, but Kina's pregnancy has brought about changes in their daily lives. A skilled hunter, Yuk, takes on him to ensure the livelihood of his companion, who becomes less able to hunt. On one of his expeditions, he started chasing a bear, hoping that he would let him eat some seals. However, hunting is complicated by the devastating effects of climate, which is transforming their habitat. While Yuk is isolated on a piece of drifting ice, he faces unforeseen challenges. His family's survival depends on it, and he will have to navigate in a hostile environment to find his way back to Kina.

programme.title: Gaming X Symphony: Legends & Quests in Concert
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra, under the direction of James Sherlock, takes over the greatest video game music in Copenhagen, such as "The Legend of Zelda" and "League of Legends", "God of War", "Halo", "World of Warcraft", "Diablo" and many other tracks that have remained in the gamers' memories.

programme.title: A step aside
programme.desc: In the early days of spring, Catherine and Vincent met with him by having lunch on the same public bench. Both are married but they are used to meeting, talking, laughing, confiding in each other. For these two quinquagenaires, these encounters are a breath of freshness and charm. But how long will the charm go to operate? And when you're settled in your life, how far are you able to venture? Will this bench be a turning point or a simple parenthesis?

programme.title: Jo
programme.desc: Successful comic writer Antoine Brisebard is the victim of master singer Jo who threatens to reveal the sulphurous past of his wife Sylvie. Determined to get rid of the importun, Antoine claims the writing of a police play as a pretext to collect information to commit the perfect crime. But when Antoine takes action, he dares not shoot. Yet, the blow is leaving. A corpse is indeed in the living room. Detective Ducros is responsible for the investigation.

programme.title: Bilal Hassani, fight like a daughter, my son.
programme.desc: The general public discovered Bilal Hassani during Eurovision 2019 and his song "King", a real hymn to the difference that triggered waves of love but also of hatred on the networks. Very quickly, the young boy took with courage the question of gender identity, in a personal and artistic exploration, not hesitant to share with us his doubts, his wounds but also his own evolution. This documentary proposes to embrace several themes that resonate strongly: homosexuality, homophobia, cyberharassment and justice, racism but also Moroccan roots, love and choice of a mother who is freed from the cultural weight for the development of her son, celebrity and of course identity and gender.

programme.title: The great pyramid concert with Fatma Said
programme.desc: Egyptian soprano Fatma Said gives a concert at the foot of the pyramids of Giza. She plays a program that crosses cultures, mixing the classical repertoire with songs from Egyptian and Middle Eastern traditions. In front of the pyramids, each note takes on a new dimension, as if the desert became a silent partner. In this majestic and almost magical setting, music writes its own legend. The orchestra accompanying Fatma Said is the Parisian Frivolités, led by chef Sammy El Ghadab for this event.

programme.desc: Oumar meets Chilla. On the agenda of their exchanges: turning his first professional disappointments into strength, breaking into rap without holding his femininity, and succeeding in being worthy of making his parents proud.

programme.title: The aces of the jungle to the rescue
programme.desc: The happy gang of jungle Aces continues to want to bring peace and justice to the nature around them, despite some enemies.
programme.desc-more: In a vibrant jungle full of surprises, the tranquillity of animals is often put to the test by perilous situations. Maurice, a tig-shaped manchot with a well-dipped character, joined a heteroclite team composed of Batricia, a cunning bat, Miguel, an impressively strong gorilla, and Gilbert, an astute tarsier. Together, they form the "Ace of the jungle", a group of brave animals dedicated to the protection of their friends and their habitat. When a danger threatens their peaceful community, a simple alarm signal, manifested by clouds of smoke rising from a volcano, is enough to mobilize them. Once they have gathered together, they develop bold plans to counter the threats to their world. This captivating cartoon, produced by a Toulouse society, invites young spectators to dive into a world of thrilling adventures where friendship and courage triumph over obstacles.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: In the lively Lexington district of London, the unusual duo formed by Clever, an exceptional-flavoured Indian pig, and his brother Bro, an impulsive but loyal companion, embarks on captivating investigations. Although their appearance may seem ordinary, their insatiable curiosity and lively intelligence propel them to the heart of mysteries that even Scotland Yard struggles to solve. In this episode, they find themselves facing a complex affair involving mysterious disappearances and misleading clues, which lead them through the dark alleys and the well-kept secrets of the city. Clever, with his keen sense of observation, deciphers the smallest details, while Bro, with his fervent temperament, does not hesitate to put himself in danger to discover the truth. Together, they must navigate a world where appearances are often misleading, while learning to trust their instincts to thwart the plans of an elusive criminal.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, the intrepid Clever, a pig from India with a keen sense of observation, and his brother Bro, a little too impulsive, are embarking on captivating police investigations. While the city is immersed in a series of mysteries that even Scotland Yard struggles to solve, the two hair-brothers find themselves at the heart of both confusing and enigmatic business. Their team spirit, although sometimes chaotic, allows them to address complex cases, ranging from inexplicable disappearances to daring thefts. Thanks to Clever's ingenuity and Bro's courage, they decode clues that others have neglected. Each episode leads them into thrilling adventures where they have to thwart the plans of clever criminals and solve mysteries that defy logic. Through their investigations, they discover not only buried secrets, but also the unwavering strength of their brotherly bond.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: Every morning, Oscar and Malika, two young neighbours, go to school together. Every morning, their plan to arrive on time is upset by an event as extraordinary as it is improbable. This obliges them to justify themselves to the school principal, Ms. Prudence, who, of course, never believes them. Adventure, humor and surprise are on the programme of this French animation series for children.
programme.desc-more: Oscar and Malika, two young inseparable neighbours, live rock adventures each morning by going to school. Despite their geographical proximity and friendship, each journey turns into a series of unexpected journeys that prevent them from arriving on time. Whether it's by crossing a mischievous dog that takes them into a treasure hunt, meeting colorful characters or meeting up with some crazy situations, each episode is a new opportunity for them to discover the world around them. Their insatiable curiosity and sense of humour push them to explore unanticipated paths, while strengthening their bond of friendship. Through this series full of freshness and imagination, young spectators are invited to follow these two heroes of everyday life in a world where adventure and camaraderie are always at the meeting, transforming the simple journey to school into an unforgettable epic.

programme.title: Anatole Latile
programme.desc: Anatole Latile, a schoolboy full of energy and imagination, is known for his pranks and his rock adventures. Always looking for new ideas to entertain themselves, there is never a lack of opportunity to get into nasty situations that attract him the lightnings of his teachers and the agitation of his comrades. With his group of friends, Anatole is embarking on ambitious projects, whether it is to organize a treasure hunt in the school or to design wild inventions that do not always happen as planned. However, his inventive mind and determination to create chaos hide a real ingenuity. As he juggles his nonsense with his school responsibilities, Anatole discovers that lessons learned outside books can sometimes be just as valuable. His quest for fun leads him into unexpected adventures, where friendship, creativity and perseverance are tested.

programme.title: Shaun the sheep
programme.desc: In a peaceful corner of the English countryside, Shaun, a malicious and resourceful sheep, bores himself from the monotonous routine of the farm where he lives with his sheep companions. Always looking for a new adventure, Shaun decides to take charge and escape from the daily monotony. With the help of his friends, a much less clever group of sheep, he concocts a bold plan to spend an unforgettable day. However, their escape quickly turns into a series of hilarious mishaps when animals find themselves confronted with unforeseen situations, ranging from a trip to a city trip to unexpected encounters with humans. While Shaun must show creativity and courage to get his flock embarrassed, he realizes that friendship and solidarity are essential to overcoming obstacles. In this animated comedy, Shaun's adventurous spirit and his faces promise to captivate spectators of all ages.
programme.desc-more: In a rural world where routines are settled, Shaun (Justin Fletcher), a sheep with a lively and malicious mind, is distinguished by his insatiable curiosity and his sense of adventure. He lives peacefully on a farm with his companions, a group of naive and somewhat clumsy ovine people, who follow him in all his frascs. When daily life becomes too monotonous, Shaun decides to take charge and escape from the farm to live a thrilling day. However, his plans take an unexpected turn when the farmer, distracted by events, finds himself in nasty and unforeseen situations. Accompanied by his faithful friend, the dog Bitzer (John Sparkes), Shaun will have to be ingenuity and team spirit to overcome the obstacles. Together, they will navigate through hilarious and unexpected adventures, proving that even the smallest can achieve great things when they are united.

programme.title: Idefixes and Indomitables
programme.desc: In a climate of growing tension in Lutèce, Monalisa (Edwige Lemoine), the incarnate trick, develops a bold plan to manipulate local wildlife against Idefix (Benjamin Bollen). In her quest for power, she sows insidious rumours, making him look like a Roman spy, which causes a wave of mistrust and hostility among the animals of the forest. While the situation is beyond his control, Idefix, a faithful companion of Asterix, finds himself at the heart of a torment that threatens the harmony of his world. Tensions are rising as Idéfix's allies, including the famous Gaulish indomitables, face unfounded accusations. Meanwhile, Stéphane Bern, as a narrator, guides spectators through this captivating intrigue where loyalty, betrayal and community spirit are competing. Events are taking an unexpected turn, highlighting the power of rumours and the dangers of misinformation in an already fragile society.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: In the heart of the majestic gardens of the Palace of Versailles, in the seventeenth century, a singular friendship was established between Belfort, a loyal and affectionate dog, and Lupin, a daring and curious wolf. Together, these two heteroclites embark on thrilling adventures that test their courage and ingenuity. Each episode sees them facing unforeseen challenges, whether it is to rescue a bird trapped in the meshes of a net or to protect the animals of the Royal Household from the dangers of the outside world. Their quest for justice and protection leads them through the lush alleys and hidden secrets of the gardens, where they meet other fascinating characters. With a good dose of humour and emotion, Belfort and Lupin remind us that friendship transcends barriers, and that even the most unlikely allies can make a difference in desperate situations.

programme.title: Scooby-Doo: The Curse of the Ghost Pilot
programme.desc: In a remote mountainous region, Scooby-Doo and his band of fearless investigators, composed of Fred (Frank Welker), Daphne (Grey DeLisle), Velma (Mindy Kaling) and Shaggy (Matthew Lillard), are going to an oversized vehicle race that promises to be full of thrills. However, the festive event takes on a disturbing turn when the competition is disrupted by the appearance of a mysterious creature named Inferno. This ghostly entity is causing panic among the participants and threatens to defeat the race. Determined to restore order and protect competitors, Scooby and his friends, with the help of famous wrestling stars, are launching a thrilling investigation. They will have to show courage, intelligence and teamwork to discover Inferno's identity and solve this mystery. Friends will have to navigate through confusing clues and unexpected challenges, while keeping their sense of humour and adventure.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: In a world where absurd and magic are associated, Musculo, a half-hustler, half-human boy, dreams of leading an ordinary existence like all children of his age. At only eleven years old, he struggles with the challenges of an atypical adolescence, navigating between his extraordinary abilities and his desire for integration. As he tries to integrate with his entourage, Musculo has to face some nasty and often confusing situations, exacerbated by his unique condition. His friends, who accept him as he is, encourage him to embrace his differences, but Musculo still aspires to a life without labels. This inner conflict leads him into a series of adventures where he will have to learn to balance his extraordinary origins with his common aspirations. On the way, he discovers the value of friendship, self-acceptance and the strength of identity, while facing the challenges that his status imposes on him.

programme.title: Molusco

At only eleven years old, he dreams of living an ordinary existence, like all children of his age, far from curious eyes and judgments. His days are filled with friends, games and adventures, but he constantly faces the challenges of his unique nature. In search of acceptance and normality, Musculo tries to integrate into his school and community, while sailing through the difficulties that his atypical appearance imposes on him. His interactions with colourful characters, such as his faithful friend Rasmus (Rasmus Hardiker) and his inspiring mentor Caroline (Caroline Mozzone), prompt him to discover that self-acceptance is the key to transforming his difference into strength. In this touching narrative, Musculo learns that friendship and courage can help him embrace his true identity.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, two inseparable companions, Clever, a pig from India with exceptional insight, and his brother Bro, a little more impulsive, are embarking on fascinating police investigations. Their insatiable curiosity pushes them to attack cases that even Scotland Yard detectives struggle to solve. In this episode, they find themselves facing a complex mystery involving a series of unexplained disappearances and clues lost in the alleys of the city. While Clever uses his keen sense of observation to decipher the puzzles, Bro often gets carried away by his enthusiasm, which leads them into unforeseen and sometimes perilous situations. Together, they must navigate through a world of intrigues and secrets, while cultivating their brotherly bond and their love for adventure. The two brothers will discover that the key to solving this mystery may be their ability to combine their unique talents.

programme.title: Mystery Lane

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: Every morning, Oscar and Malika, two young neighbours, go to school together. Every morning, their plan to arrive on time is upset by an event as extraordinary as it is improbable. This obliges them to justify themselves to the school principal, Ms. Prudence, who, of course, never believes them. Adventure, humor and surprise are on the programme of this French animation series for children.
programme.desc-more: Oscar and Malika, two young inseparable neighbours, live rock adventures each morning by going to school. Despite their geographical proximity and friendship, each journey turns into a series of unexpected journeys that prevent them from arriving on time. Whether it's by crossing a mischievous dog that takes them into a treasure hunt, meeting colorful characters or meeting up with some crazy situations, each episode is a new opportunity for them to discover the world around them. Their insatiable curiosity and sense of humour push them to explore unanticipated paths, while strengthening their bond of friendship. Through this series full of freshness and imagination, young spectators are invited to follow these two heroes of everyday life in a world where adventure and camaraderie are always at the meeting, transforming the simple journey to school into an unforgettable epic.

programme.desc: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.title: It's still not a witch.
programme.desc: CTPS takes you into the secrets of the kingdom of Egypt and eternal life. According to the Egyptians, for a soul to gain access to eternal life, it was necessary to keep its body. In the cabin, Max "undresses" a model of mummy to understand the techniques used and also tells us about the "naturally" mummified animals. Surprised, some mummies came from South America, others from China... the Egyptians were not the only ones to have this practice. Mathieu discovers the mummies of the Museum of Fine Art and Archaeology in Besançon and accesses a place forbidden to the public: reserves. Kimi goes to the Museum of Man to participate in an exceptional operation to restore an Egyptian mummy.

programme.title: Family
programme.desc: Christine Angot, a renowned writer, embarks on an introspective journey after a major encounter at a book festival. Desiring to understand the roots of her trauma, she decided to return to Strasbourg to explore the family past linked to her father, Pierre, who had been her executioner during her teenage years. Her first stop leads her to Elizabeth, Peter's companion, with whom she engages in a tumultuous conversation, seeking to bring out buried truths. This meeting, full of emotions, reveals tensions and unsaid, updating the complexity of family relations. Christine then went to her mother, Claude, in the hope of finding answers and a form of reconciliation. However, confrontation is equally difficult, with each exchange filled with pain and resentment. Through these visits, Christine tries to heal her wounds and redefine her identity in the face of a past that haunts her.

programme.title: Lio
programme.desc: Both nymphette, sex symbol and French pop icon, Lio remains the figure of the 1980s, a decade as electric as eccentric. But behind the chammered outfits, beyond the pop world and the acidulated colors, the singer is also a victim of domestic violence. As a result of the attacks on women, it has become the liberation of their word over the years. While she records her new album, Lio, unsuspecting and fighting, tells what it is like to be a woman in a world that prefers to silence them.

programme.title: The great BaZH.art
programme.desc: Brigitte Fontaine was born in Morlaix, she grew up in the Finistère before "mounting" in Paris once the bac in her pocket. For 60 years she's been shaking all the conventions and that's why we love her. With 20 albums and as many books on the counter, Brigitte Fontaine has developed an absolutely inimitable style with her friend Areski Belkacem.

programme.title: Secret archives
programme.desc: To win over the public, to reach the top of the poster and to return even after terrible crossing of the desert, is the destiny of some artists, phoenix of the scene. Charles Aznavour pierced very late after contrary winds. He never let go and ended up winning. Fragilized by extreme melancholy, singer Renaud has dived several times and has risen every time. While she was a popular actress, Annie Girardot abandoned the cinema to succeed in the theatre. Finally, singer Claude Nougaro was thanked by his record company for lack of sales before returning in a frantic way with his tube "Nougayork". These revenges on life were filmed, photographed by relatives who agreed to share their treasures.

programme.title: Become Lucky Love
programme.desc: Luc Bruyère never imagined himself dying old. Question of destiny and personal history, no doubt. Born with one less arm, he has been subjected from his early age to violence in the eyes of others, even turning his life into hell. So why not consume it and burn it as quickly as possible, this life, even if it destabilizes its loved ones, its mother especially. Luc chose to take on himself, to transform himself, to become what he always dreamed of: singer. With his angel face, nothing resists him and he has fun, like a kid never satisfied. But the story would be too good for him at least. To live his incandescent love, he became a little more damaged and, today, at the dawn of his 30 years, he looks at the road he has travelled and is doing without taboos.

programme.title: The aces of the jungle to the rescue
programme.desc: The happy gang of jungle Aces continues to want to bring peace and justice to the nature around them, despite some enemies.
programme.desc-more: In a vibrant jungle full of surprises, the tranquillity of animals is often put to the test by perilous situations. Maurice, a tig-shaped manchot with a well-dipped character, joined a heteroclite team composed of Batricia, a cunning bat, Miguel, an impressively strong gorilla, and Gilbert, an astute tarsier. Together, they form the "Ace of the jungle", a group of brave animals dedicated to the protection of their friends and their habitat. When a danger threatens their peaceful community, a simple alarm signal, manifested by clouds of smoke rising from a volcano, is enough to mobilize them. Once they have gathered together, they develop bold plans to counter the threats to their world. This captivating cartoon, produced by a Toulouse society, invites young spectators to dive into a world of thrilling adventures where friendship and courage triumph over obstacles.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, two brothers, Clever, a lively-minded Indian pig, and Bro, his impulsive brother, are launching investigations that even defy Scotland Yard's abilities. Clever, with an acute sense of observation and an extraordinary intelligence, is often the brain behind their investigations, while Bro, always ready to act without thinking, brings a touch of energy and audacity to their adventures. Together, they are attacking mysterious and complex cases that have left the police perplexed for years. Each episode plunges them into captivating puzzles, where they have to decipher clues, question witnesses and navigate a world of intrigues. As their reputation grows, they attract the attention of enigmatic characters who seek to defeat them. Clever and Bro will have to unite their strengths and talents to solve mysteries that may well change their lives forever.
programme.desc-more: Mystery Lane (2021)
programme.desc: Mystery Lane (2021)

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: In the lively Lexington district of London, two fearsome investigators, Clever, a pig from India with an exceptional flair for observation, and his brother Bro, impulsive and reckless, are attacking mysteries that escape even the experts of Scotland Yard. While the city has been in the grip of unresolved cases for years, Clever uses his intelligence and his sense of deduction to decipher clues that no one else sees, while Bro does not hesitate to plunge head first into action, bringing a touch of unpredictability to their investigations. Together, they explore cases as varied as mysterious disappearances, bold robberies and buried secrets, while encountering formidable opponents. As they journey, the two brothers discover not only the complexity of the crimes they try to solve, but also the strength of their brotherly bond in a world where danger is at every corner of the street.

programme.title: Mystery Lane

While the city is immersed in mysteries that even Scotland Yard struggles to solve, the two brothers turn out to be unexpected detectives. Their keen sense of observation and their ability to decipher clues lead them into increasingly complex cases, ranging from mysterious disappearances to daring robberies. Each investigation confronts them with intriguing characters, enigmatic witnesses and suspects with obscure motivations. As they investigate, Clever and Bro discover that truth can sometimes hide in the most unexpected places. Their complicity and determination will lead them to surprising revelations, proving that even the smallest can make a great difference in the quest for justice.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: Every morning, Oscar and Malika, two young neighbours, go to school together. Every morning, their plan to arrive on time is upset by an event as extraordinary as it is improbable. This obliges them to justify themselves to the school principal, Ms. Prudence, who, of course, never believes them. Adventure, humor and surprise are on the programme of this French animation series for children.
programme.desc-more: Oscar and Malika, two young inseparable neighbours, live rock adventures each morning by going to school. Despite their geographical proximity and friendship, each journey turns into a series of unexpected journeys that prevent them from arriving on time. Whether it's by crossing a mischievous dog that takes them into a treasure hunt, meeting colorful characters or meeting up with some crazy situations, each episode is a new opportunity for them to discover the world around them. Their insatiable curiosity and sense of humour push them to explore unanticipated paths, while strengthening their bond of friendship. Through this series full of freshness and imagination, young spectators are invited to follow these two heroes of everyday life in a world where adventure and camaraderie are always at the meeting, transforming the simple journey to school into an unforgettable epic.

programme.title: Anatole Latile
programme.desc: In this episode of the series "Anatole Latile", Mr.Auzaguet, a passionate and enthusiastic teacher, decides to create a vegetable garden at school with the aim of reconciling his students with vegetables. He hopes to awaken their curiosity and encourage them to adopt a healthier diet. However, children, initially intrigued by this initiative, are quickly getting tired of the gardening and the routine involved. Laughters and games leave room for boredom, and cultivated vegetables gradually become objects of disinterest. In view of this, Mr Auzaguet must redouble his imagination and creativity to bring his project back to life. It offers fun activities and challenges that could revive the enthusiasm of children for the vegetable garden. This episode explores the themes of engagement, food education and perseverance in the face of adversity, while highlighting the relationships between students and their teachers.
programme.desc-more: Anatole Latile is a schoolboy with imagination and energy, but his adventurous spirit often pushes him to find himself in delicate situations. With his gang of comrades, there is never a lack of opportunity to embark on farfelus projects that lead him to multiply misadventures. Whether it's creating a faulty robot for the science class or organizing a surprise birthday party for his best friend, Anatole is a surprising ingenuity, although often misdirected. His carelessness and daring sometimes win him reproof from his teachers, but he also knows how to charm his friends with his contagious enthusiasm. Through his adventures, Anatole learns to juggle his aspirations with the consequences of his actions, thus discovering the value of friendship and responsibility. His tumultuous journey to school will lead him to unexpected life lessons, while keeping a lightness that makes his adventures charming.

programme.title: Shaun the sheep
programme.desc: In a peaceful corner of the English countryside, Shaun, a malicious and resourceful sheep, bores himself from the monotonous routine of the farm where he lives with his sheep companions. Always looking for a new adventure, Shaun decides to take charge and escape from the daily monotony. With the help of his friends, a much less clever group of sheep, he concocts a bold plan to spend an unforgettable day. However, their escape quickly turns into a series of hilarious mishaps when animals find themselves confronted with unforeseen situations, ranging from a trip to a city trip to unexpected encounters with humans. While Shaun must show creativity and courage to get his flock embarrassed, he realizes that friendship and solidarity are essential to overcoming obstacles. In this animated comedy, Shaun's adventurous spirit and his faces promise to captivate spectators of all ages.
programme.desc-more: In a rural world where routines are settled, Shaun (Justin Fletcher), a sheep with a lively and malicious mind, is distinguished by his insatiable curiosity and his sense of adventure. He lives peacefully on a farm with his companions, a group of naive and somewhat clumsy ovine people, who follow him in all his frascs. When daily life becomes too monotonous, Shaun decides to take charge and escape from the farm to live a thrilling day. However, his plans take an unexpected turn when the farmer, distracted by events, finds himself in nasty and unforeseen situations. Accompanied by his faithful friend, the dog Bitzer (John Sparkes), Shaun will have to be ingenuity and team spirit to overcome the obstacles. Together, they will navigate through hilarious and unexpected adventures, proving that even the smallest can achieve great things when they are united.

programme.title: Idefixes and Indomitables
programme.desc: In the "Eaux troubles à Lutèce" episode of the series "Idéfix et les Indomitables", the harmony of the city of Lutèce is threatened by an increasing pollution of the Seine, orchestrated by the Romans. Padgachix (Benjamin Bollen), eager to seduce the beautiful Vitamin (Kelly Marot), decided to redo a beauty. After a reinvigorating bath, he found himself clean as a new penny, but this metamorphosis made him reluctant to help his friend Idéfix (Jean-Claude Donda) in his fight against the Romans. Idefix, faithful and determined, knows that he must act to preserve the environment and quality of life of the inhabitants of Lutece. Faced with Padgachix's indifference, Idefix decided to take charge of the matter. As he embarks on a journey full of twists, he will have to find allies and strategies to counter the plans of the invaders and restore the cleanliness of the Seine waters.
programme.desc-more: Idefix and the Indomitable (2020)
programme.desc: Idefix and the Indomitable (2020)

programme.title: Idefixes and Indomitables
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of the series "Idefix and the Indomitable", the plot focuses on the unexpected return of Lovendpis the Egyptian (Benjamin Bollen), a character with a mysterious past and dark motivations. The latter's mission is to recover a magical amulet, precious relic stolen from his master by Labienus (Jean-Claude Donda), a former opponent who does not retreat in front of anything to preserve his power. In parallel, Lovendpis is a person who is very talented and who can help him find Turbine (Kelly Marot). As the characters embark on an adventure sown with pitfalls through the mysteries of ancient Egypt, they will have to face enigmas, traps and formidable opponents. In this unbridled race, unexpected alliances and betrayals risk changing the course of events, while the magic amulet holds secrets that could upset their destiny to all.

programme.title: Idefixes and Indomitables
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of the series "Idefix and the Indomitable", Idéfix (Benjamin Bollen), the faithful companion of Asterix, finds himself deported to a remote forest, where he faces a perilous situation. In this new hostile environment, he meets other animals from Lutèce, all victims of an unjust system. Together, they have to overcome their differences to survive. However, the calm was quickly broken by the appearance of Chevrotine (Jean-Claude Donda), an extremist with disproportionate ambitions, who saw in this assembly a golden opportunity to form his own armed group. Chevrotine, charismatic but dangerous, seeks to manipulate animals by exploiting their despair. Idefix, aware of the stakes, must bring his comrades together and find a way to resist this growing threat. This fight for freedom and solidarity will test their determination and team spirit, while they try to escape the claws of Chevrotine.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: In the heart of the sumptuous gardens of the Palace of Versailles in the 17th century, two unexpected companions, Belfort and Lupin, are engaged in a series of thrilling adventures. Belfort, a faithful Louis XIV dog, and Lupin, a bold wolf, form an inseparable duo, joining forces to protect the hair and feather residents of the Royal Household and the surrounding wildlife. Each episode leads them into perilous situations where their friendship and ingenuity are tested. Meetings with colourful characters, spectacular rescues and unexpected discoveries will mark their journey. Together, they will face challenges, overcome traps and navigate through the intrigues of the royal court, while learning to overcome their differences. In this series, friendship and loyalty intertwine with moments of humour and emotion, offering a unique look at animal life at the Sun King's court.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: After an unexpected slide in the corridors of the majestic Versailles castle, Lupin (Alexandre Nguyen) finds himself trapped in the mysterious clock cabinet. This cabinet, both fascinating and terrifying, is subjected to a complex mechanism that the royal watchmaker dates back every day at nightfall. Alarmed by this situation, Belfort, Lupin's faithful friend, is concerned about the disastrous consequences if humans discover the presence of his companion in the castle. To save Lupin before the watchmaker's arrival, Belfort drew up a bold plan. Knowing by heart the workings of the daily life of Versailles, he formed a team of intrepid animals: Ariane, Gazette, Artus, Marcus, and even Madame Rosa. Together, they engage in a perilous mission, while avoiding crossing Bazire, the royal dog, who continues to pursue Belfort to remind him of his obligations. The adventure is full of twists and dangers.

programme.title: It's still not a witch.
programme.sub-title: The oyster, the pearl of the seas
programme.desc: Oysters are both intriguing and fascinating. They often get disgusted: "Eating an oyster, no, but what's wrong?" At the same time they have a magical power: to make pearls, treasures of pirates and luxury jewelry. But beyond their brilliance, these molluscs have many surprises. Did you know that in some cities, they are used to clean up water, like in New York or Brest? Kimi will learn all the secrets of pearls, while Mathieu goes to sea with an ostrian farmer. Max, on the other hand, reveals the superpowers of this amazing creature.

programme.title: Scooby Doo and cyber tracking
programme.desc: Scooby-Doo, Sammy (Shaggy Rogers), Fred, Daphne and Vera meet again to solve an intriguing puzzle involving a ghost virus that threatens to capture the digital world. As they plunge into the meanderings of this case, the group finds themselves trapped in a video game that transports them through their own past adventures. This immersive experience propels them into different eras, ranging from cave age to futuristic worlds in space. Each time is punctuated by unexpected twists and quiproquos, as they encounter alternative versions of themselves, which further complicates their mission. Faced with unprecedented challenges and puzzles to solve, our heroes will not only have to foil the plans of the ghost virus, but also navigate the potential consequences of their interactions with their doubles, endangering the course of history.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: In a world where imagination and reality mix together, Musculo, a young half-hust, half-human boy, dreams of an ordinary life at the age of eleven. Every day, he confronts the challenges of a singular existence, desperately seeking to integrate among the children of his age. Although its hybrid nature gives it unique features, such as the ability to camouflage in the water, it aspires to live classic childhood adventures, such as playing football or participating in birthday parties. His interactions with his friends, who oscillate between curiosity and misunderstanding, highlight the themes of acceptance and identity. Musculo navigates through the joys and sorrows of childhood while discovering the limits of his condition. Through comical and moving situations, this series explores the quest for belonging and the small victories that accompany the path to self-acceptance.

Accompanied by his friends, he explores the joys and sorrows of daily life, learning to accept his difference. This initiatory journey highlights the themes of identity, acceptance and resilience, while offering a tender and humorous look at the transition to adulthood.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, two unlikely brothers are embarking on investigations that defy understanding. Clever, a pig from India with a keen sense of observation, and Bro, his somewhat impulsive brother, find themselves involved in mysterious things that even Scotland Yard struggles to elucidate. Their first investigation plunges them into an unexplained network of disappearances that shakes the local community. By looking at every detail, Clever uses his intelligence and ability to notice clues that humans might neglect, while Bro, with his fervoury temperament, does not hesitate to engage physically in defending their quest for truth. Together, they must navigate a complex world where appearances are deceptive and where each character hides a secret. As they sink into these mysteries, their brotherly bond will be tested, revealing unexpected truths about their own past.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: As an Australian young bouvier, Bluey transforms every day into a playground of games and adventures thanks to her lively imagination and inexhaustible energy.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.title: It's still not a witch.
programme.desc: Maritime traffic is about 60,000 commercial vessels on the water every day, plus more than 40,000 recreational vessels. To allow the loading and unloading of goods and passengers between land and sea, humans have created ports! Today, these are places where tomorrow's innovations are born! In Bordeaux, Kimi discovers that the ports are centres of technological innovation with connected oysters and bathymetry and dredging systems to ensure access to the port. Mathieu brings us to discover the port of Le Havre, which focuses on protecting the environment by integrating sustainable solutions to reduce its ecological footprint.

programme.title: Reporters
programme.desc: Paris, October 1980. Day after day, Raymond Depardon followed the press photographers of Gamma, of which he was one of the founders. Between two planes, two trains, they cover, among other things, Jacques Chirac's visit to the merchants of Paris, Giscard d'Estaing's trip to China, and Georges Marchais' campaign, candidate for the presidency of the Republic. Some, more specialized, are ready for anything for a scoop that will sell all over the planet, others prefer to work on a subject in depth.

programme.title: Your Turn (C à vous)
programme.desc: Meet Anne-Elisabeth Lemoine and her group of columnists with a florileg of the best moments of "C à vous" of the week.
programme.desc-more: Culture, politics, economy... In a Parisian loft, Anne-Elisabeth Lemoine and her group of columnists discuss and exchange around the most diverse news, live. The presenter is surrounded by Patrick Cohen, Pierre Lescure, Aurélie Casse alternately with Emilie Tran Nguyen, Mohamed Bouhafsi, Lorrain Sénéchal and Bertrand Chameroy. During the first part of the program, a chef cooks a dish that they then taste in C to you, the continuation, the second part of the program.

programme.title: Jamy's World
programme.sub-title: Car, plane, climate: can we still travel?
programme.desc: The private sector is in the midst of a revolution. In France and Austria, Jamy Gourmaud tests these more environmentally friendly modes of travel.
programme.desc-more: Jamy explores the transportation problem, the main contributors to global warming, and options for moving in the near future. Originally presented as the vehicle of the future, the electric car is now very controversial. For longer journeys, the train seeks to credibly become a serious alternative to the aircraft. For daily trips, bikes and carpooling are the obvious solutions for the planet and the congestion of our cities but still have work to convince as many people as possible.
