programme.desc: Jérémie Pastor, a young man from Toulouse, travels to the picturesque village of Saint-Martial to attend the funeral of Jean-Pierre Rigal, his former baker's boss. Upon his arrival, he was warmly welcomed by Martine, the widow of the deceased, who offered to settle in his son Vincent's room. However, Jeremiah's return was not unanimous: Vincent, jealous and distrustful, saw with a bad eye the presence of the one whom he considered an intruder. Tensions are rising rapidly between the two men, exacerbated by Jeremiah's suspicion of Vincent's interest in his mother. Moreover, the friendship between Vincent and Walter Bonchamp, a common friend, stirs up Jeremiah's jealousy, which gradually feels marginalized. In this emotionally charged context, buried secrets and family rivalries resurface, leading Jeremiah into a spiral of intrigues and unexpected revelations.

programme.title: Frosia, a free woman in the gulag
programme.desc: In 1919, the family of Euphrosinia Kersnovskaya, known as Frosia, fled the Bolshevik revolution to settle in Bessarabia, a territory between Ukraine and Romania, which corresponds to the present Moldova. In 1940, the USSR invaded the region and seized the property of all landowners. Frosia and her mother were driven from their house, and the young woman was arrested and sentenced to relegation in Siberia. It is the beginning of twelve years of wandering in the heart of the Goulag, from which it will escape to be arrested again and then repeatedly transferred, to the terrible camp of Norilsk north of the polar circle. At the request of his mother, Euphrosinia Kersnovskaya reported this journey in an illustrated newspaper.

programme.title: Giorgia Meloni and the Gull clan
programme.desc: The rise of Georgia Meloni, from her commitment to Mussolini's young heirs to the security policy she has put in place.
programme.desc-more: In the early 1990s, the Italian Social Movement (MSI), Mussolini's heir party, made available to one of its youth sections a meagre local in the catacombs of Colle Oppio, one of the seven hills of Rome. In this ideal place, Giorgia Meloni, then a minor, and her comrades, re-establish the world from the eye and, inspired by Tolkien's "Lord of the Rings", their cult book, live in community. If they claim to be of the tradition and the sense of honor of the Hobbits, they call their group the "Gowland Clan" (Gabbiani) - reference to Jonathan Livingston, the solitary bird breaking rules of Richard Bach's bestseller. These influences allow them to smooth their neofascism, whose imagination is associated with cumbersome figures.

programme.sub-title: RN, on the way to victory?
programme.desc: Marine Le Pen, a favourite of the polls, is embarking on the conquest of the Elysée. Citizens are talking about their daily concerns while following the presidential campaign.
programme.desc-more: On 7 July 2026, the presidential campaign was launched. On that day, Marine Le Pen saw his electoral horizon clear. The favourite of the polls can finally embark on the conquest of the Elysée. In Hayange, a town of Moselle, formerly a fief of the left, the RN is now raising great hope. At the other end of the country, in the Gard, the RN elected representatives are mobilizing to defend the taurine traditions, which is worth them some popularity. In Saumur, in the West, a business owner of SMEs is concerned. In Alfortville, a French teacher regrets that a class at the school has been closed again. For many citizens, politics is a daily reality, far from slogans and intrigues of power. This does not prevent them from following the presidential campaign and from having an opinion on the candidates and their programmes.

programme.title: Madam Prefect
programme.desc: The cameras followed Valérie Michel-Moreaux during her last year in the Vosges, a prefect who is not like the others who is going through crises with a style of her own.
programme.desc-more: They are the link between Paris and the territories. The 130 prefects have a delicate task of implementing national policy in the regions and departments. Many men, but also a few women. The cameras followed one of them during his last year in the Vosges, a department that is in a state of waiting, between factory closures and population decline. Born from a modest background, Valérie Michel-Moreaux has risen to this position thanks to his will alone. Pollution to PFAS, suicide of farmers, cities in ruins: this not like the others is going through crises with a style of its own. Its challenge is to defend the Republic and also to reconcile rural territories with decisions taken in a distant capital.

programme.title: Trump against the law
programme.desc: Massive dismissals, instrumentalization of justice: one year after Donald Trump's re-election, decrypting a strategy led by the MAGA camp against the rule of law.
programme.desc-more: Under the influence of several judicial procedures, notably for his role in the Capitol assault, Donald Trump left the White House in January 2021 for what was then like four years of exile. Re-elected and now surrounded by a fully acquired close guard, the billionaire has tried to re-design the framework of the presidential power and test the limits of American law one by one, with decrees and offensives. Improper use of independent federal agencies, massive dismissals within the ministries and the FBI, instrumentalization of justice and the Supreme Court, intimidation of counter-powers.

programme.title: Giorgia Meloni and the Gull clan
programme.desc: In September 2022, Giorgia Meloni came to the top of the general elections. It implements the Conservative programme promised to Italians.
programme.desc-more: In September 2022, Brothers of Italy, Giorgia Meloni's party, came to the top of the general election with 26% of the vote. Invested as President of the Council in October, she implemented a conservative program promised to Italians during her campaign and very impregnated by an identity project. It is increasing punitive measures against humanitarian NGOs, migrants, LGBTQIA+ couples, ravers or protesters. This strategist, stubbornly refusing to declare himself "antifascist", is at the same time trying to reassure its European partners. With her long friendship with Donald Trump, the first woman president of the Italian History Council received a new impetus when the American magnate was re-elected in 2024, which openly named her her privileged interlocutor in Europe.

The Lcp editorial has addressed one of the problems facing many cities, from Paris to Saint Malo, to Nice, Biarritz and Annecy: overtourism. It must be said that this is a bit of a ransom for success, since France is the most visited country in the world with more than 100 million foreign tourists a year, So how does tourism endanger our cities? How to reconcile local life and tourism? And above all, give the city back to its inhabitants? Marion Becker and Pierre-Yves Deheunynck went to Chamonix, capital of mountaineering, nestled at the foot of Mont Blanc. The city-mountain resort, very frequented summer as winter, tries to solve this difficult equation.

programme.title: Marius and the sound of the waves
programme.desc: Emilie just had her first child, Marius. But very soon, something surprises him: Marius does not react to the sounds. Diagnosis falls: it is deaf deep.
programme.desc-more: Emilie just had her first child. Like all mothers, she filmed her son Marius' first moments. But very soon, something surprises him: Marius does not react to the sounds of his father's trombone. Diagnosis falls: it is deaf deep. Marius wouldn't hear a Boeing take off next to him. Then begins a forced immersion into an unknown world, made of medical appointments, expectations, hopes and doubts. The couple must reinvent their daily lives, learn sign language and rethink their future. From intimate images filmed over three years, the film tells from inside the shock of diagnosis, denial, and then the slow path to acceptance. Until that day when the couple discovers that a complex operation could give Marius the hearing.

programme.title: Cultural exception, the battle that saved French cinema
programme.desc: Are creative works mere merchandise? France and the United States were at stake in the intense economic and diplomatic battle during the GATT negotiations in 1993. In the name of free trade, the Americans are weighing their weight to dismantle the financing system for French cinema and to deliver it to the great winds of Yankee competition. But France, helped by Europe, resists and manages to make the United States fold. Thus the concept of "cultural exception" was born. This story is told through the look of lobbyist Jack Valenti, who will work to defend Hollywood's interests against European diplomats and politicians.

programme.sub-title: Correctional appeal hearing at the Rennes Court of Appeal
programme.desc: At the Rennes Court of Appeal, two men appeared in the accused's box. One is prosecuted for four offences, the other for six. At the heart of the audience: drug trafficking and possession of weapons. How can we plead the case of an accused whose defence system is not credible? How can we demand the fair penalty when the defendant has been convicted many times for similar acts? Yet, despite the seriousness of the accusations, the two men defend themselves in a casual manner and sometimes deny the evidence. In addition to the question of whether the defendants are guilty, the force of a public hearing is to be the privileged witness of the contradictory debate between lawyers and magistrates. The power of a hearing is also to witness the fight that lawyers are leading for their client.

programme.title: Giorgia Meloni and the Gull clan
programme.desc: In September 2022, Brothers of Italy, Giorgia Meloni's party, came to the top of the general election with 26% of the vote. Invested as President of the Council in October, she implemented a conservative program promised to Italians during her campaign and very impregnated by an identity project. It is increasing punitive measures against humanitarian NGOs, migrants, LGBTQIA+ couples, ravers or protesters. This strategist, stubbornly refusing to declare himself "antifascist", is at the same time trying to reassure its European partners. With her long friendship with Donald Trump, the first woman president of the Italian History Council received a new impetus when the American magnate was re-elected in 2024, which openly named her her privileged interlocutor in Europe.

programme.title: J.D. Vance: The revenge of an America
programme.desc: From his chaotic childhood to the White House, J.D. Vance embodied the revenge of MAGA (Make America Great Again). To tell the story of the U.S. Vice President Thomas Snegaroff and David Thomson met with about ten people who have been with him throughout his life. These tell who J.D. Vance really is: how man has evolved ideologically and how he has transformed politically. Meetings and interviews with his closest friends, including his mother Beverly, and his mentor, David Frum, who shares the secrets of his ambitions and plans to transform America and Europe.

programme.title: Head for the Elysée
programme.sub-title: RN, on the way to victory?
programme.desc: On 7 July 2026, the presidential campaign was launched. On that day, Marine Le Pen saw his electoral horizon clear. The favourite of the polls can finally embark on the conquest of the Elysée. In Hayange, a town of Moselle, formerly a fief of the left, the RN is now raising great hope. At the other end of the country, in the Gard, the RN elected representatives are mobilizing to defend the taurine traditions, which is worth them some popularity. In Saumur, in the West, a business owner of SMEs is concerned. In Alfortville, a French teacher regrets that a class at the school has been closed again. For many citizens, politics is a daily reality, far from slogans and intrigues of power. This does not prevent them from following the presidential campaign and from having an opinion on the candidates and their programmes.

programme.title: Georges Pompidou, the cruelty of power
programme.desc: What a singular destiny that Georges Pompidou, the son of teachers, became the right-hand man of General de Gaulle, before succeeding him in 1969. An unusual and unpremeditated journey, because unlike many others, Pompidou never ardently seeks power. From stage to stage, he has the highest responsibilities, such as a fatality. As wonderful as it is, this destiny is revealed by a nameless cruelty to this man who is fond of life and happiness. Taking over from the colossus of Gaulle is a challenge that is almost impossible to meet.

programme.title: Action Investigation
programme.sub-title: Roissy, Orly, motorways: customs officers leave nothing (1/2)
programme.desc: The French customs had never hit so hard: in 2025, 108 tons of narcotics seized, 31 tons of which were cocaine. An explosion of +49% in a year! And the battlefield is 32 km2: Paris-Charles-de-Gaulle, the country's first gateway, where 70 million travellers travel each year.

programme.title: Action Investigation
programme.sub-title: Roissy, Orly, motorways: customs officers leave nothing (2/2)
programme.desc: While Parisian airports are the preferred areas of action for customs officers, the track also overflows on the roads: the DOD, the shock unit, is a common family car driven by an unsuspecting family father. In the lining of a bag: cocaine. At his home: money and jewelry. At the postal sorting centre, customs officer Ludovic opens the parcels from all over the world. Counterfeiting, false drugs, drugs ordered online: everything goes through.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: A scaphandrier was murdered. The victim's body must remain in a decompression box for four days: the NCIS investigates.
programme.desc-more: NCIS' thirteenth season opens with palpable tension, while Special Agent Leroy Jethro Gibbs (Mark Harmon), who was left for death at the end of the previous season, recovers from his injuries. Meanwhile, Tony DiNozzo (Michael Weatherly) is on the front line against La Vocation, a fearful terrorist group operating in China. In an episode crossover, Gibbs' team collaborates with their Louisiana colleagues, bringing a new dynamic to the investigation. As DiNozzo navigates a complex international investigation, he must juggle the implications of collaboration between NCIS, the FBI and the British intelligence services. The situation is very strong when Ziva David (Pa Pablo's Cote) is directly threatened, exacerbating tensions between team members, including with Tony. This season will also mark the departure of Michael Weatherly, one of the pillars of the series, while Gibbs, for the first time in thirteen years, changes haircuts, symbolizing a new era in the team.

programme.title: The little history of France
programme.desc: In a humorous and offbeat approach, this series highlights characters close to major historical figures of France, such as Vercingetorix, Jeanne d'Arc and Napoleon. Through a series of sketches in various historical contexts, the writers offer an unprecedented look at the landmarks of the past. Each episode plunges the spectator with humour into the daily lives of these iconic figures and their loved ones, often contrasted with the weight of history.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: NCIS is looking for a potential bone marrow donor for a seafarer with leukemia. Bishop goes home to Oklahoma for Thanksgiving.
programme.desc-more: NCIS' thirteenth season opens with palpable tension, while Special Agent Leroy Jethro Gibbs (Mark Harmon), who was left for death at the end of the previous season, recovers from his injuries. Meanwhile, Tony DiNozzo (Michael Weatherly) is on the front line against La Vocation, a fearful terrorist group operating in China. In an episode crossover, Gibbs' team collaborates with their Louisiana colleagues, bringing a new dynamic to the investigation. As DiNozzo navigates a complex international investigation, he must juggle the implications of collaboration between NCIS, the FBI and the British intelligence services. The situation is very strong when Ziva David (Pa Pablo's Cote) is directly threatened, exacerbating tensions between team members, including with Tony. This season will also mark the departure of Michael Weatherly, one of the pillars of the series, while Gibbs, for the first time in thirteen years, changes haircuts, symbolizing a new era in the team.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: NCIS is investigating the murder of an officer suspected of selling military secrets. There's a clue that the investigators are heading to Ducky's old address.
programme.desc-more: In this exciting new season of NCIS, the team of specialized agents, led by the intrepid Leroy Jethro Gibbs (Mark Harmon), finds itself confronted with a series of complex and intriguing cases involving Navy personnel. Their investigation begins with the mysterious disappearance of a man, which occurred six months earlier, and which seems to be a crucial clue to a recent car explosion. As they explore this case, a new mystery arises: the tragic death of a woman whose body was found after a fall of a building. The victim's doctor, reluctant to share information about his or her background, becomes an issue for Gibbs, who must convince him or her to collaborate. Barely this resolved case, Gibbs, accompanied by Palmer (Brian Dietzen) and Quinn (Emily Wickersham), set out at sea to elucidate the murder of a marine, testing their ingenuity and determination. This 14th season promises to be rich in suspense and rebound.

programme.title: Hit Man
programme.desc: In New Orleans, a man on a police mission decides to ignore protocol by helping a woman who was abused by her husband.
programme.desc-more: Gary Johnson (Glen Powell), a professor of philosophy at the University of New Orleans, has a seemingly ordinary existence. An electronics enthusiast, he put his talents at the service of the local police, participating in listening operations to thwart potential criminal plans. His life is changing when he is forced to replace a colleague on a mission, pretending to be a hit man. This unexpected role allows him to discover a dark world where morality is tested. As a false killer, Gary quickly finds himself immersed in perilous situations, charged with unmasking citizens ready to commit the irreparable. As he juggles his identity as a professor and as a criminal, Gary must navigate into complex ethical dilemmas, confronting his personal values while trying to protect innocent lives. This double game will lead him to redefine what it really means to be a hero.

programme.title: Kaamelott
programme.desc: In the fifth century, King Arthur and his prious knights tried to raise up the divine mission entrusted to them: to go in search of the Holy Grail.
programme.desc-more: The island of Brittany, in the fifth century. His legends, battles, the fantastic and respectable adventures of the Knights of the Round Table, gathered around their powerful and magnanimous King Arthur. But looking closer, Arthur is not always as wise as he would like to think, and his dear wife Guinevere is not the erudite nymph related by history, but rather a naive woman who keeps exasperating her husband. Guinevere's father, Leodagan, king of Carmellia, is a warmaniac who only thinks of fighting the other peoples, while his mother, Séli, is an ambitious acariquist always quick to share her bad mood with the kingdom. As for the famous Knights of the Round Table, they are not so brave and philanthropic that we are told that they want to believe it. Perceval and Karadoc are poltrons who are better at making the tavern of the village go bad than in fulfilling the missions entrusted to them by King Arthur. Yvain and Gauvain are two teenagers seeking glory but unable to prove their courage. Bohort is more interested in fashion than in fighting, and Merlin is an enchanter whose spells usually turn against him. King Arthur is embodied by talented Alexandre Astier, who is one of the three creators of the series with Alain Kappauf (Camera Café) and Jean-Yves Robin. He knows how to work with the family, since he shares the screen with Lionnel Astier (Leodagan of Carmelide) and Simon Astier (Yvain), who is the main hero of Hero Corp.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: NCIS agents have been preparing Operation Willoughby for several months. It is about arresting a rich businessman suspected of committing attacks with the aim of influencing the stock market. Infiltrated as a pilot of the target, Clayton Reeves is unmasked, revealing the existence of a mole...
programme.desc-more: In this exciting new season of NCIS, the team of specialized agents, led by the intrepid Leroy Jethro Gibbs (Mark Harmon), finds itself confronted with a series of complex and intriguing cases involving Navy personnel. Their investigation begins with the mysterious disappearance of a man, which occurred six months earlier, and which seems to be a crucial clue to a recent car explosion. As they explore this case, a new mystery arises: the tragic death of a woman whose body was found after a fall of a building. The victim's doctor, reluctant to share information about his or her background, becomes an issue for Gibbs, who must convince him or her to collaborate. Barely this resolved case, Gibbs, accompanied by Palmer (Brian Dietzen) and Quinn (Emily Wickersham), set out at sea to elucidate the murder of a marine, testing their ingenuity and determination. This 14th season promises to be rich in suspense and rebound.

programme.title: Mylène Farmer : Nevermore
programme.desc: An immersive experience at the heart of Mylène Farmer's concert, a monumental spectacle. With fourteen stadiums on the programme and more than 550,000 spectators in total, Nevermore is the largest tour of the stages of the history of music proposed in France by an artist. Revealed in 1984 with the title Mom is wrong, aduned to all corners of the globe, Mylène Farmer, who reserves a prominent place in his relationship with the public, takes advantage of this opportunity to celebrate as it should for nearly four decades of presence on the music scene.
programme.desc-more: It is one of the largest tours of the history of music proposed by an artist. Nice, Bordeaux, Paris... Between July 2023 and September 2024, the discreet Mylène Farmer went around the stadiums of France, even in Belgium and Switzerland. Fourteen dates quickly displayed full that recorded more than 600,000 spectators. From "Without counterfeiting", to "Libertine", passing through "Yes but... No" at "Unenchanted", the singer took back her greatest hits during a spectacular show with impressive scenery and iconic choreography.

programme.title: Kaamelott
programme.desc: In the fifth century, King Arthur and his prious knights tried to raise up the divine mission entrusted to them: to go in search of the Holy Grail.
programme.desc-more: The island of Brittany, in the fifth century. His legends, battles, the fantastic and respectable adventures of the Knights of the Round Table, gathered around their powerful and magnanimous King Arthur. But looking closer, Arthur is not always as wise as he would like to think, and his dear wife Guinevere is not the erudite nymph related by history, but rather a naive woman who keeps exasperating her husband. Guinevere's father, Leodagan, king of Carmellia, is a warmaniac who only thinks of fighting the other peoples, while his mother, Séli, is an ambitious acariquist always quick to share her bad mood with the kingdom. As for the famous Knights of the Round Table, they are not so brave and philanthropic that we are told that they want to believe it. Perceval and Karadoc are poltrons who are better at making the tavern of the village go bad than in fulfilling the missions entrusted to them by King Arthur. Yvain and Gauvain are two teenagers seeking glory but unable to prove their courage. Bohort is more interested in fashion than in fighting, and Merlin is an enchanter whose spells usually turn against him. King Arthur is embodied by talented Alexandre Astier, who is one of the three creators of the series with Alain Kappauf (Camera Café) and Jean-Yves Robin. He knows how to work with the family, since he shares the screen with Lionnel Astier (Leodagan of Carmelide) and Simon Astier (Yvain), who is the main hero of Hero Corp.

programme.title: Criminal investigations
programme.sub-title: Who killed the in-laws of influencer Magali Berdah? (1/2)
programme.desc: A double bloody crime, a suspect that any one overburdens and a trial that may never take place. This seems inconceivable, yet this is the possibility that Melissa, Kim and Julie, Karine Teboul's three daughters, are preparing for. This 50-year-old solo mom and her companion, Frédéric Ruberto, 46 years old, were brutally murdered on the night of October 9-10, 2021 at the latter's home in Allauch, a small town in the vicinity of Marseille.

programme.title: Criminal investigations
programme.sub-title: Who killed the in-laws of influencer Magali Berdah? (2/2)
programme.desc: In the second part of the show, Criminal Investigations is interested in the murder of Sophie Lionnet. On Wednesday, September 20, 2017, in London, a Frenchman was arrested burning in his garden the remains of a human body. Ouissem Medouni lives with his companion Sabrina and her two children. The autopsy reveals that the calcined body is that of Sophie Lionnet, their nanny.

programme.title: Criminal investigations
programme.sub-title: Marc Demeulemeester: Would the stepfather also be the murderer? (1/2)
programme.desc: On January 28, 2015, Marc Demeulemeester reported the disappearance of his son-in-law Antoine Dupont, a 15-year-old from Gonnehem, Pas-de-Calais. For over a year, Sabine, Antoine's mother, thought she would see her son again. But her husband will confess the murder.

programme.title: Kaamelott
programme.desc: The island of Brittany, in the fifth century. His legends, battles, the fantastic and respectable adventures of the Knights of the Round Table, gathered around their powerful and magnanimous King Arthur. But looking closer, Arthur is not always as wise as he would like to think, and his dear wife Guinevere is not the erudite nymph related by history, but rather a naive woman who keeps exasperating her husband. Guinevere's father, Leodagan, king of Carmellia, is a warmaniac who only thinks of fighting the other peoples, while his mother, Séli, is an ambitious acariquist always quick to share her bad mood with the kingdom. As for the famous Knights of the Round Table, they are not so brave and philanthropic that we are told that they want to believe it. Perceval and Karadoc are poltrons who are better at making the tavern of the village go bad than in fulfilling the missions entrusted to them by King Arthur. Yvain and Gauvain are two teenagers seeking glory but unable to prove their courage. Bohort is more interested in fashion than in fighting, and Merlin is an enchanter whose spells usually turn against him. King Arthur is embodied by talented Alexandre Astier, who is one of the three creators of the series with Alain Kappauf (Camera Café) and Jean-Yves Robin. He knows how to work with the family, since he shares the screen with Lionnel Astier (Leodagan of Carmelide) and Simon Astier (Yvain), who is the main hero of Hero Corp.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: In this exciting new season of NCIS, the team of specialized agents, led by the intrepid Leroy Jethro Gibbs (Mark Harmon), finds itself confronted with a series of complex and intriguing cases involving Navy personnel. Their investigation begins with the mysterious disappearance of a man, which occurred six months earlier, and which seems to be a crucial clue to a recent car explosion. As they explore this case, a new mystery arises: the tragic death of a woman whose body was found after a fall of a building. The victim's doctor, reluctant to share information about his or her background, becomes an issue for Gibbs, who must convince him or her to collaborate. Barely this resolved case, Gibbs, accompanied by Palmer (Brian Dietzen) and Quinn (Emily Wickersham), set out at sea to elucidate the murder of a marine, testing their ingenuity and determination. This 14th season promises to be rich in suspense and rebound.

programme.title: Apprentice adventurers
programme.sub-title: The secret of the black pearl
programme.desc: On an island in the Philippines, isolated on a hostile beach, in the heart of a wild nature, reality TV candidates, more accustomed to luxury and comfort, will have to survive with almost nothing. In teams of two, they will have to learn how to manage daily life on the beach, where hunger, lack of sleep and stories, but also the different events. Indeed, to keep their place on the island the Apprentices-Aventurers will have to surpass themselves. If the adventure is too difficult, they will have only one alternative: ring the bell to give up.

programme.title: It's only the truth that matters
programme.desc: The iconic duo Pascal Bataille and Laurent Fontaine offer participants a rare space where words are freed. On the program: true stories, reunions, confessions, second chances... And always this inimitable concept: a curtain, a revelation, a decision. Faced with what their loved ones have never dared to tell them, will the guests agree to join them on the other side of the curtain or will they go on their side?

Their investigation begins with the mysterious disappearance of a man, which occurred six months earlier, and which seems to be a crucial clue to a recent car explosion. As they explore this case, a new mystery arises: the tragic death of a woman whose body was found after a fall of a building. The victim's doctor, reluctant to share information about his or her background, becomes an issue for Gibbs, who must convince him or her to collaborate. programme.desc-more: Within the Naval Criminal Investigative Service, an elite unit specializing in crimes related to the Marines, terrorists or spy networks, a team with a variety of profiles and complementary work in the shadows to unravel intrigues where betrayals, lies and loyalty are met. Led by Leroy Jethro Gibbs (Mark Harmon), a former Marine sniper with a turbulent past and legendary reputation, the agents combine surgical intuition with unconventional methods. With him, Timothy McGee (Sean Murray), a brilliant but sometimes too methodical analyst, and Nick Torres (Willer Valderrama), a former agent infiltrated with explosive charisma, form a duo as effective as unpredictable. Completing the Ellie Bishop team (Emily Wickersham), a specialist in criminal psychology with formidable instincts, Jimmy Palmer (Brian Dietzen), a medical examiner with a heart, and Kasie Hines (Diona Reasonover), an expert in forensics whose analytical intelligence often saves the bet. Not to mention Leon Vance (Rocky Carroll), director of NCIS, whose strategic decisions weigh heavily in the course of investigations, and Alden Parker (Gary Cole), a former FBI profile whose arrival is changing the established dynamics.

With him, Timothy McGee (Sean Murray), a brilliant but sometimes too methodical analyst, and Nick Torres (Willer Valderrama), a former agent infiltrated with explosive charisma, form a duo as effective as unpredictable. Completing the Ellie Bishop team (Emily Wickersham), a specialist in criminal psychology with formidable instincts, Jimmy Palmer (Brian Dietzen), a medical examiner with a heart, and Kasie Hines (Diona Reasonover), an expert in forensics whose analytical intelligence often saves the bet. Not to mention Leon Vance (Rocky Carroll), director of NCIS, whose strategic decisions weigh heavily in the course of investigations, and Alden Parker (Gary Cole), a former FBI profile whose arrival is changing the established dynamics.

programme.title: The little history of France
programme.desc: In a humorous and offbeat approach, this series highlights characters close to major historical figures of France, such as Vercingetorix, Jeanne d'Arc and Napoleon. Through a series of sketches in various historical contexts, the writers offer an unprecedented look at the landmarks of the past. Each episode plunges the spectator with humour into the daily lives of these iconic figures and their loved ones, often contrasted with the weight of history.

programme.title: Under the sun
programme.desc: Juliette and Manuel are about to get married, but Tina, Manuel's former girlfriend, is back and does not hesitate to sow zizania in the couple.
programme.desc-more: Caroline (Tonya Kinzinger) made her big comeback, leaving behind her the tensions that had passed with Bertrand, who finally decided to turn the page on her adventure with Tony. However, a new obstacle is emerging on their way: Louis (Frédéric Deban) is in prison, wrongly accused of the murder of Julia. While Jessica (Adeline Blondieau) holds a valuable video surveillance tape from the clinic that could exonerate Louis, she also reveals compromising evidence against Paolo (Luis Marquès). In another part of the city, Iannis (Romeo Sarfati) makes an unexpected connection with a tramp, who turns out to be David, his son's father. At the same time, the clinic faces a major challenge when a sick inmate, entrusted by Lieutenant Peretti, takes Laure (Bénédicte Delmas) as a hostage. This twelfth season promises its lot of intrigues, surprises and haletant twists.

programme.desc: A young woman must take over the acting leadership of a new hotel in her hometown, whose inhabitants stubbornly refuse to open.

programme.title: A Christmas gift
programme.desc: A top-of-the-range store manager is not well at the end of the year. His niece wishes that his aunt's loneliness be finally broken.
programme.desc-more: In a position of high importance in the management of a shopping mall, Heather Nash, a single, is very close to her sister, Courtney, and her niece, Molly. At the request of her boss, she has to terminate the lease of a declining turnover toy shop. She doesn't know that her manager is Patty, Ryan's aunt, a young man she just met and whose charm she fell.

programme.desc: During Christmas parties, a young New Yorker, returning to her hometown to help her father retire, falls in love with a solo dad.
programme.desc-more: Anne returns to North Bay to help her father close her store. For forty years, he has been selling wooden toys made by him. During her stay, Anne participates in the organization of the Christmas party and meets Keith and her 10-year-old daughter.

programme.title: Boarding for Christmas
programme.desc: As the parties approached, a journalist went to a Navy ball, accompanied by her sister. On the spot, she meets a pilot.
programme.desc-more: Maddie, a journalist for a Norfolk newspaper, is on a Tiger cruise during the Christmas season. She met a beautiful naval officer and discovered a mystery in the ship's archive room.

programme.title: Mentalist
programme.desc: Jane finds out a major clue after meeting four suspects. His team is investigating the death of an IT engineer, killed by a drone.
programme.desc-more: After gradually reducing his list of suspects concerning Red John, the serial killer who upset his life, Patrick Jane (Simon Baker) finds himself facing an increasingly complex dilemma. The closer he approaches the identity of the murderer, the more he intensifyes his acts of violence, sowing terror around him. Despite the traps set by Red John, Jane is perceptive and manages to expose the criminal. However, their explosive confrontation forces Jane to flee the country to escape the threat she faces. Two years later, Teresa Lisbon's team (Robin Tunney) was dissolved, and Van Pelt (Amanda Righetti) and Rigsby (Owain Yeoman) began a new life together. As Jane lives under a false identity, a new opportunity presents itself to him, marking the beginning of a season full of tensions and revelations, with the arrival of new characters, including Kim Fischer (Emily Swallow) and the FBI agent, who bring an unexpected dynamic to the plot.

programme.title: The big bulk
programme.desc: The Grand Vrac is a short entertainment program incarnated by Camille Lellouche. In the form of a humorous, off-the-shelf TV game, it makes bulk practice a popular, fun and accessible subject for all. Through a large print run, viewers have the opportunity to get their shopping reimbursed, while (re)discovering this simple way of consumption to integrate into everyday life.

programme.title: Harry Potter and the Fire Cup
programme.desc: Harry Potter, who was nominated for the general surprise of the Fire Cup, will join the students in the competition for the Three Witchers' Tournament, held in Poudlard.
programme.desc-more: While the mortuary leaves of Poudlard Park are stained red by the early autumn frimas, an unusual excitement is shaking the corridors of the school of witchcraft. This year, the legendary Three Witchers' Tournament is re-appearing, a magical competition as perilous as it is prestigious, opposing the champions of the three largest European schools: Poudlard, Beauxbâtons and Durmstrang. Around the Fire Cup, an ancient artifact with blue flames, students and teachers gather, eager to discover the names of the happy elected ones. Yet, no one expects the magic fire to simmer to spit out a fourth name, that of a participant who should never have been in the run: Harry Potter (Daniel Radcliffe). programme.title: Super Mario Bros, the movie
programme.desc: As they try to repair an underground pipe, Mario and his brother Luigi, both plumbers, find themselves immersed in a new fairy world through a mysterious conduit. But when the two brothers are separated, Mario is engaged in a very exciting adventure to find Luigi. In his quest, he can count on the help of the fungus Toad, resident of the Mushroom Kingdom, and the wise advice, in combat techniques, of Princess Peach, a determined warrior at the head of the Kingdom. Thus Mario managed to mobilize his own forces to complete his mission.

programme.title: Superheroes in spite of him
programme.desc: Cédric Dugimont (Philippe Lacheau), an apprentice actor in the galley, finally took his first role in a superhero film. One night, while he was using the shooting car, he was the victim of an accident that made him lose his memory. When he woke up, dressed in his costume as a vigilante and in the middle of the accessories of the film, he was persuaded to become the character of the film with a perilous mission to be accomplished. But isn't heroes and even less superheroes who wants to... And less Cedric!

programme.title: 90' Investigations
programme.sub-title: Municipal police officers: the guardian angels of the suburbs
programme.desc: In recent months, the suburban police have been regularly on the front page, suspected of slipping or at the time victims of violent acts by young offenders. In Viry-Châtillon and Wissous, a team followed about 20 agents during their daily missions, between muscular arrests and neighbourhood conflicts.
programme.desc-more: For months, the suburban police have been regularly on the news. They are suspected of slipping or, on the contrary, they are victims of violent acts by young offenders. So, what's their daily life? To find out, the magazine team followed the men of two municipal police in l'Essonne, 30 km south of the capital. First of all, in Viry-Châtillon, a city of 30,000 inhabitants divided between pavilion areas and large ensembles. And in Wissous, a short walk from the airport of Orly, where the municipal police are also under constant tension.

programme.desc-more: Caroline (Tonya Kinzinger) made her big comeback, leaving behind her the tensions that had passed with Bertrand, who finally decided to turn the page on her adventure with Tony. However, a new obstacle is emerging on their way: Louis (Frédéric Deban) is in prison, wrongly accused of the murder of Julia. While Jessica (Adeline Blondieau) holds a valuable video surveillance tape from the clinic that could exonerate Louis, she also reveals compromising evidence against Paolo (Luis Marquès). In another part of the city, Iannis (Romeo Sarfati) makes an unexpected connection with a tramp, who turns out to be David, his son's father. At the same time, the clinic faces a major challenge when a sick inmate, entrusted by Lieutenant Peretti, takes Laure (Bénédicte Delmas) as a hostage. This twelfth season promises its lot of intrigues, surprises and haletant twists.

Near Lille, a couple is forced to complete the work started by a builder who deserted the site. Finally, in the Dawn, twelve families fight against unscrupulous entrepreneurs to obtain justice.

In another part of the city, Iannis (Romeo Sarfati) makes an unexpected connection with a tramp, who turns out to be David, his son's father. At the same time, the clinic faces a major challenge when a sick inmate, entrusted by Lieutenant Peretti, takes Laure (Bénédicte Delmas) as a hostage. This twelfth season promises its lot of intrigues, surprises and haletant twists.

programme.title: A fairytale Christmas
programme.desc: Caitlyn, assistant to the editor of a prestigious fashion magazine, aspires to establish herself as a designer. His world was stumbling when Prince Jeffrey and his friend, Lady Isabelle, came to town to give a big New Year's charity ball. Jeffrey is going to propose to Isabelle at this reception. The Beautiful charge Caitlyn to make her a dress. A request that could start Caitlyn's career. But Abigail, her boss, hopes that Lady Isabelle will wear a creation of her daughter, Leighton, and will do everything she can to make Caitlyn not finish the outfit, entrusting him with all the preparations for the evening. Caitlyn spends a lot of time with Jeffrey. They fall in love with each other.

programme.title: Balanced Meals
programme.desc: Laurent Mariotte gives all the tricks to make good dishes, like a real chef, with fresh and seasonal ingredients.

programme.title: Hercules Poirot
programme.desc: After the failure of a case that resulted in the death of a young girl, Hercule Poirot decided not to investigate any more. He retired for a while but gradually became darker in depression. On the advice of his doctor, he returns to work by starting to pursue a thief of masters' paintings...
programme.desc-more: Poirot must make clear on more intriguing things than the others: the corpse of an unknown man camouflaged behind an old lady's couch, early clocks, a Halloween party that turns into a nightmare, and even a businessman stabbed to death in the compartment of a train, in the midst of a snow storm. While the Belgian private man operates his small grey cells, the novelist Ariadne Oliver, she finds herself stuck in rock-like situations. Who else than his old friend Poirot to come and get her out of those bad steps?

programme.title: Hercules Poirot
programme.desc: Marie Marvelle, a great Belgian film star, informed Hercule Poirot that she had received three letters demanding the restitution of her diamond, the Western Star, so that he would find his place on the statue of a Chinese god. Some time later, the famous detective learns that the jewel was stolen...
programme.desc-more: Poirot faces a series of particularly complex puzzles. A young heiress proposes to accompany him to the Côte d'Azur, but dies in strange circumstances during the journey on the train. The Belgian private "small grey cells" are invited at a dinner at one of the country's richest men, who invite four criminals and four fine limiers to his table. In an oppressive atmosphere, Poirot plunges into dark affairs of morals and family scandals. We attach ourselves to Ariadne Oliver, a fanciful and passionate novelist whose overflowing imagination brings a new breath to the series.

programme.desc-more: Hercule Poirot, a famous figure created by Agatha Christie, is a Belgian detective whose apparent phlegm does not in any way detract from his ability to deduce or his talents as an investigator. However, Hercule Poirot is tired of the search for the culprits, preferring to take care of his legendary mustache. Captain Arthur Hastings, aware that the skills of his detective friend are indispensable to his criminal affairs, obliged him to read the newspaper daily in Poirot in order to share the most sordid news. Hercule Poirot's curiosity is quickly piqued, and each time he takes him on complex investigations with his friend James Japp.

programme.title: Charlie and the chocolate factory
programme.desc: At the heart of this adventure is Charlie Bucket (Freddie Highmore), a boy with a big heart from a modest family, close to him in a small house with cracked walls. Despite the deprivations, Charlie keeps his passion for chocolate intact, a rare luxury he savors with delights. When Willy Wonka (Johnny Depp), the mysterious and eccentric owner of the famous Wonka chocolate shop, announces a contest as unexpected as it is exceptional, hope is invited into Charlie's life. Five gold tickets, hidden in chocolate tablets around the world, will offer their happy holders an exclusive tour of the factory – and a lifetime store of sweets. For Charlie, whose every play counts, this quest is an impossible challenge... But the impossible never stopped the dreamers. While tickets are discovered one by one by spoiled, capricious or simply lucky children, Charlie finds himself in a competition as exciting as it is perilous. Each candidate embodies a trait of character pushed to the extreme, and Wonka's factory, with its technological wonders and enigmatic Oompa-Loompas, seems designed to test much more than their resistance to sugar. But behind the laughter and the cascades of candy, there is a deeper question: what does Willy Wonka really want by opening the doors of his sweet kingdom? And why does Charlie, among all the children, seem to draw his attention?

programme.title: 90' Investigations
programme.sub-title: Truffle, turkey and gambas: true or fake exceptional products?
programme.desc: Close-up on the work of the gendarmerie's shock units, in total immersion in the heart of the brigades of Aubagne, Roquevaire, Carnoux-en-Provence and Cassis. Names that smell good on holidays and the Mediterranean, but for these Southern gendarmes, daily life is far from restless.
programme.desc-more: Among the most popular products by French for the holidays is the unbeatable turkey. If you need an average of over 100 euros for high quality poultry, you can find them for a much cheaper price on a large area. Where do they come from and what are their breeding conditions? The truffle exceeds 1 000 euros per kilo and is not easily accessible. Recently, manufacturers have been offering cheap flavoured products to this fungus. How do they do it? Finally, the magazine team investigated the surprising production methods of the gamba industry.

Once upon a time Christmas in Castle Creek
programme.desc: Amelia, who dreams of running a Christmas decoration shop, finds herself competing with Vic, who dreams of opening a chocolate shop. Both want to buy the same shop, but forced to team up, they start to tie one to the other.

programme.title: Royal Christmas getaway
programme.desc: As a young single nurse in Boston, Anna is going to spend the end of the year in her hometown, Kentsbury, where her father has a hostel. On the way, she fell on the Royal Family of Galwick, who could no longer leave her home due to a snowstorm. She then suggested that she accompany him until the weather calms down. She gradually approached Prince James during Christmas activities.

programme.title: Mentalist
programme.desc: "Meeting Point"With a new clue, Jane thinks she can identify Red John. He's bringing the five suspects together in his Malibu house to expose the killer.
programme.desc-more: After gradually reducing his list of suspects concerning Red John, the serial killer who upset his life, Patrick Jane (Simon Baker) finds himself facing an increasingly complex dilemma. The closer he approaches the identity of the murderer, the more he intensifyes his acts of violence, sowing terror around him. Despite the traps set by Red John, Jane is perceptive and manages to expose the criminal. However, their explosive confrontation forces Jane to flee the country to escape the threat she faces. Two years later, Teresa Lisbon's team (Robin Tunney) was dissolved, and Van Pelt (Amanda Righetti) and Rigsby (Owain Yeoman) began a new life together. As Jane lives under a false identity, a new opportunity presents itself to him, marking the beginning of a season full of tensions and revelations, with the arrival of new characters, including Kim Fischer (Emily Swallow) and the FBI agent, who bring an unexpected dynamic to the plot.

programme.desc-more: Patrick Jane (Simon Baker), a talented mentalist who reads people and analyzes their behaviour, uses his skills to help the California Bureau of Investigation (CBI) solve complex criminal cases. With a sense of caustic humour and a sometimes controversial approach, he worked closely with Agent Teresa Lisbon (Robin Tunney), whose rigor and professionalism contrasted with Patrick's more disdainful nature. Together, they make up a dynamic team that navigates through thrilling investigations while trying to solve personal mysteries. In the background, Patrick is also obsessed with his quest for revenge against Red John, a serial killer who tragically took the life of his wife and daughter. This hunt led him to juggle his role as an investigator with his inner demons, revealing the depths of his psyche while unifying the sons of criminal plotters.

programme.title: Supercondriaque
programme.desc: Romain Faubert (Dany Boon), a 39-year-old man, is a hypochondriac convinced that every small evil is a sign of a serious illness. His life is a true journey of the fighter, rhythmic by his incessant medical consultations and his maladic anxieties. His friend Dimitri Zvenka (Kad Merad), a professional doctor, is overwhelmed by Roman's often unfounded warnings. Despite his friendship and dedication, Dimitri is convinced that the key to Roman's well-being lies in the meeting of a companion who could ease his fears. The situation becomes more complicated when Dimitri's sister Anna (Alice Pol), who is distinguished by her altruism in welcoming Cherkistan refugees, confuses Romain with Anton Miroslav, the charismatic leader of the Cherkist revolution. This contempt leads Romain into a series of hilarious quiproquos, while he tries to navigate between his own anxieties and the expectations of others. As tensions intensify and the rock-capped situations accumulate, Romain will have to face his inner demons while adapting to a world that is foreign to him. The stakes then become crucial, and more than ever he will have to overcome his fears to find his place. This film, mixing humour and tenderness, explores the themes of friendship, love and the quest for identity, in a whirlwind of nasty and touching situations.

programme.title: 90' Investigations
programme.sub-title: Extreme cleaners, derailers, sewerers: they do not step back in front of anything
programme.desc: The city of Douai, in the North of France, fights against poverty and delinquency. This agglomeration of 150 000 inhabitants, located near the Belgian and Luxembourg borders, is plagued by tobacco trafficking, but not only. Between spectacular fires, road accidents and neighbourhood wars, the daily life of the 420 police officers in Douai is very busy. A team followed them in the field during their many missions.
programme.desc-more: It's the French nightmare: cockroaches, rats, bugs or fleas. To get rid of them, every day men and women put their hands where no one would want to set foot. In insect-infested apartments, in people with Diogene syndrome, in areas invaded by rats and even in sewers. They are derailers, sewerers, hunters of pests, or even cleaners of the extreme.

programme.desc: The Grand Vrac is a short entertainment program incarnated by Camille Lellouche. In the form of a humorous, off-the-shelf TV game, it makes bulk practice a popular, fun and accessible subject for all. Through a large print run, viewers have the opportunity to get their shopping reimbursed, while (re)discovering this simple way of consumption to integrate into everyday life.

programme.title: 90' Investigations S17
programme.desc: RAID, the Elite Police Unit, is celebrating its 40th anniversary. From the selection of these experienced men to the most tense missions, a team followed the daily lives of these exceptional police officers. A group, created by Commissioner Broussard, has brought an end to Jacques Mesrine's actions. Each year, hundreds of them try to integrate RAID, but few resist the multiple trials, which push them to exhaustion, both physical and mental. And those who are admitted still have to undergo a long training in combat, where everything can stop if they are not up to the level. This is a necessary preparation because once on the ground, young recruits will be plunged into a risk tension.

programme.title: 90' Investigations S15
programme.desc: Martinique and Guadeloupe, known for their dream beaches, have become hubs of international drug trafficking. Located a few kilometres away from drug-producing countries such as Colombia and Venezuela, these French islands are the gateway to narcotics in Europe. Tens of tons of cocaine and cannabis are smuggled in each year. To combat this scourge, the French army is fighting a daily battle against traffickers in the Caribbean Sea. The Ventôse and Germinal, two frigates of the National Navy, conduct patrols at sea to intercept the boats of the traffickers. For several months a team followed the missions of the sailors mobilized to intercept the "go fast" from Latin America.

programme.title: Animals to adopt: new family for a new life (The exceptional rescue of about 60 cats) S8 (n°13)
programme.desc: "The exceptional rescue of some 60 cats"This series follows the daily lives of SPA shelters, due to the growing abandonments. Employees and volunteers work to care for and find a new animal home.

programme.title: Animals to adopt: new family for a new life (Mao, Lulu and Fanou) S6 (No 4)
programme.desc: "Mao, Lulu and Fanou"Dive into emotion with this series of real that looks poignantly at the backstage of SPA shelters and reveals how employees and volunteers save, care for and try to get their residents adopted as quickly as possible! All are animated by the same passion and one credo: finding the best home for each of them. Cats, dogs, puppies, kittens... Each episode takes you to the heart of the upsetting stories of these animals collected, abused, abandoned... that wait only for the love of a new family. From their arrival at the shelter to their adoption, the series of reals traces their journey, between care, hope, joy and doubts. A sincere and emotional immersion in a universe where each adoption is a victory, each story a source of hope and inspiration.

programme.title: 90' Investigations S18
programme.desc: 9 French in 10 fear the aggressive behaviour of motorists and 6 in 10 admit insulting other road users. The city centres have become battlefields where you sometimes have to sneak in to save your skin. In October 2024, the death of cyclist Paul Vary, crushed by a SUV, shocked the entire country. This horrific tragedy has become the sad symbol of violence on the road. From Paris to Marseilles and Bordeaux, the danger is at its peak. Between cars, bikes, scooters and other unbridled equipment, vigilance is necessary.

programme.title: 90' Investigations S17
programme.desc: Who ever shook his neighbor on the road or pissed off a car that didn't drive the way we would like it? This aggressive driving, two in three Frenchmen admit to being customary. Sometimes, simple words of birds turn into a fight, or even a hallucinating war scene on the road. For anodizing reasons, these altercations may even end in a fatal account settlement. The cause: motorists unable to keep their calm on the road. This madness that is looking at the wheel, some have made it a business: surveillance cameras sold at gold prices, driving simulators, or training courses to learn how to keep your cool, what are the solutions to manage stress while driving?

programme.title: Rugby: Championship of Nations
programme.desc: After a difficult summer tour, marked by a heavy defeat against South Africa (43-0), Wales has to recover at home against Japan. But be careful of these, able to surprise Dewi Lake and his family in Cardiff.

programme.title: A golden family
programme.desc: Venus confronted himself with the questions posed by the inimitable Camille Combal, Arnaud Ducret and Tom Villa, who had come with their real family. On the one hand, Arnaud Ducret, captain, accompanied by his wife Claire, his mother Maryvonne and his sister Mélanie. Facing them, a family 100% couple with his captain Tom Villa, his wife Marion, and Cartman accompanied by his wife Aurelia. They all have one thing in common: they want to win the place in the final that will allow them to win perhaps 100,000 euros in favour of the association "Autistes sans frontières" of which Arnaud Ducret is the sponsor.

programme.title: Under the sun
programme.desc: Caroline (Tonya Kinzinger) made her big comeback, leaving behind her the tensions that had passed with Bertrand, who finally decided to turn the page on her adventure with Tony. However, a new obstacle is emerging on their way: Louis (Frédéric Deban) is in prison, wrongly accused of the murder of Julia. While Jessica (Adeline Blondieau) holds a valuable video surveillance tape from the clinic that could exonerate Louis, she also reveals compromising evidence against Paolo (Luis Marquès). In another part of the city, Iannis (Romeo Sarfati) makes an unexpected connection with a tramp, who turns out to be David, his son's father. At the same time, the clinic faces a major challenge when a sick inmate, entrusted by Lieutenant Peretti, takes Laure (Bénédicte Delmas) as a hostage. This twelfth season promises its lot of intrigues, surprises and haletant twists.
programme.desc-more: In Saint-Tropez, Laure (Tonya Kinzinger), a medical student, is preparing to marry Alain. However, on the day of her marriage, she felt an irrepressible impulse to find Grégory (Stéphane Slima), her youthful love, and decided to flee the altar. At the same time, Louis (Romeo Sarfati), the brother of Grégory, was dismissed from high school and crossed the road to Caroline (Adeline Blondieau), an attractive singer but engaged with the artist Samuel. Louis was immediately charmed and engaged in a quest to conquer his heart, even if it brought him into conflict with Samuel. As each person's life crosses, Jessica (Marie-Christine Adam), an American woman met by Gregory on a trip, arrives at Saint-Tropez. Laure, wary of this new coming, ends up being friends with her, which further complicates the relationships between the characters. Tearing choices and complex feelings emerge in this canvas of life full of passion and twists.

programme.title: The key to a successful Christmas
programme.desc: Lisa, a specialist in shop design and decoration, and Oliver, her partner, make many professional trips abroad. But both dream of opening their own shop. One day, the young woman went to Evergreen, her hometown, where she found the atmosphere of Christmas her childhood. Lisa meets Kevin, a businessman, who is also from the village. Little by little, between the two young people who are used to moving constantly, the charm acts.

programme.title: Mentalist
programme.desc: After gradually reducing his list of suspects concerning Red John, the serial killer who upset his life, Patrick Jane (Simon Baker) finds himself facing an increasingly complex dilemma. The closer he approaches the identity of the murderer, the more he intensifyes his acts of violence, sowing terror around him. Despite the traps set by Red John, Jane is perceptive and manages to expose the criminal. However, their explosive confrontation forces Jane to flee the country to escape the threat she faces. Two years later, Teresa Lisbon's team (Robin Tunney) was dissolved, and Van Pelt (Amanda Righetti) and Rigsby (Owain Yeoman) began a new life together. As Jane lives under a false identity, a new opportunity presents itself to him, marking the beginning of a season full of tensions and revelations, with the arrival of new characters, including Kim Fischer (Emily Swallow) and the FBI agent, who bring an unexpected dynamic to the plot.
programme.desc-more: Patrick Jane (Simon Baker), a talented mentalist who reads people and analyzes their behaviour, uses his skills to help the California Bureau of Investigation (CBI) solve complex criminal cases. With a sense of caustic humour and a sometimes controversial approach, he worked closely with Agent Teresa Lisbon (Robin Tunney), whose rigor and professionalism contrasted with Patrick's more disdainful nature. Together, they make up a dynamic team that navigates through thrilling investigations while trying to solve personal mysteries. In the background, Patrick is also obsessed with his quest for revenge against Red John, a serial killer who tragically took the life of his wife and daughter. This hunt led him to juggle his role as an investigator with his inner demons, revealing the depths of his psyche while unifying the sons of criminal plotters.

programme.title: The Lord of the Rings: the two towers
programme.desc: In Middle Earth, where the shadows of Sauron spread more and more daily, the struggle for the survival of free peoples reached a decisive turning point. Frodo Sacquet (Elijah Wood), carrying the Unique Ring, and his tireless companion Sam Gamegie (Sean Astin) continue their exhausting march towards the Mordor, a cursed territory where every step brings them closer to their destiny. Their route, sown with tangles and despair, is now guided by a disturbing presence: Gollum (Andy Serkis), a creature torn between his visceral hatred for the Hobbits and his sickly obsession with the Ring. Sometimes ambiguous allies, sometimes creeping threats, Gollum leads them through mortal marshes and hostile mountains, where every decision could seal their fate. Meanwhile, the Ring Community, dispersed but not defeated, faced its own trials. Aragorn (Viggo Mortensen), heir to a throne he still refuses to assume, Legolas (Orlando Bloom), the mortally shot elf, and Gimli (John Rhys-Davies), the dwarf in the heat of fire, are pursuing the monstrous Uruk-hai creatures of Saraumane, who have taken away their young companions Merry (Dominic Monaghan) and Pippin (Billy Boyd). Their quest leads them to Rohan, a kingdom where legendary riders see their strength slashed under the corrupt influence of Sarumane. There they discovered Theoden (Bernard Hill), a broken king, manipulated by the fates of the enemy, whose people were on the brink of annihilation.

programme.title: Signed Cat's Eyes

programme.title: Cleaners the household experts
programme.sub-title: Angele and Sylvain facing Olivia head at home
programme.desc: Since an ordinary accident, Sylvain, 53, Angèle's father, has lost his foot. Forced to stay at home, he discovered a passion for graffiti on the walls of his apartment and for the accumulation of useless objects. Sylvain finally decided to take over. After a long and complicated divorce, and then a difficult return to France, Olivia, former restorer, is now a "celiftant" self-entrepreneur at the RSA. Catering and creating culinary events, she had to adapt her daily life to her home and work from home. But Olivia neglected the organization and storage in her apartment. If her activity develops well, she can no longer work calmly under the current conditions.

programme.title: Cleaners the household experts
programme.sub-title: Floriane and Natacha facing Marion the winemaker
programme.desc: Floriane and Natacha, two sisters, successively lost their mother five years ago, then their father a few weeks ago. Never really recovered from his wife's disappearance, their father had let himself go to the house that saw her daughters grow up. Today, the two sisters who are deprived of the situation have no choice but to ask for help from the Cleaners. Not far from the castle of the Varenne lives Marion, who has the vine in the blood. This young single woman has made the choice of living in a mobile home next to her work, as the passion for grape variety is devouring for the farm worker. If despite the heavy hardships of life, like the death of her sister two years ago, she gives the change in appearance, inside her 30 m2 housing, is the absolute disorder.

programme.title: Cleaners the household experts
programme.desc: Alexandre, Leslie, Zak and Laura, four experts in cleanliness, arrive at private homes whose interior has been left to the fore. Due to lack of time and/or motivation, these people live in disorder and dirt. Chef, specialist in food hygiene, Alexandre shares his tips for eliminating microbes and bacteria. Zak, meanwhile, is a pro for storage and optimization of spaces. Leslie and Laura, for their part, excellent in the household. Together, they transform the interiors of individuals.

programme.title: Cleaners the household experts
programme.desc: Alexandre, Leslie, Zak and Laura, four household experts, help individuals who are not as much on the line of hygiene as they are. Cleaners only have three days to clean everything from floor to ceiling! In this first issue, the pros of the feather fly to the aid of 44-year-old Sylvie, who lives in Ardèche. This woman works seven days a week and she doesn't have much time to take care of her home. As for Olivier, 28, he's a single person who hasn't cleaned up or stored anything in his apartment for a year!

programme.desc-more: The show "Star Academy" – which saw the birth of many successful singers such as Nolwenn Leroy, Olivai Ruiz or Jenifer – appeared in 2001 – has made a big return to TF1 in 2022 after fourteen years of absence. Their days are thus littered with classes, rehearsals, but also moments of relaxation and complicity in the heart of an exceptional experience that will mark them forever.

programme.title: Cleaners the household experts
programme.desc: "Corinne, 49, Brussels, single". It was when Corinne saw the immense distress of his former Francis that he decided to take charge of the matter. After his sister died, Francis and Corinne went to recover her personal affairs. When they open the door, they realize that the housing is in an indescribable state. "Amber, 23, saleswoman, Nancy." It's a scourge everyone fears: bed bugs! This is the tragedy that Amber is experiencing.
programme.desc-more: In their daily lives, they are bloggers, cooks or business leaders, but they lead a double life as household experts. These four agents are ready to intervene! Alexandre, chef, is as demanding on cleanliness as on cooking. Leslie, energetic and inventive, makes her obsession with household a profession. Claude, a sports coach, advocates a healthy spirit in a healthy home. Laura, the professional, aims for perfection. Together, Cleaners have three days to transform an interior and teach tricks.

programme.desc-more: Montauban is a town with 250,000 inhabitants, located not far from Toulouse, in the Occitanie region. It is a sunny city that smells good in the Southwest. A team followed the PMO gendarmes, the motorised platoon of Montauban. These 20 specialists are on the front line to intercept the drivers. Overspeed, drivers without a licence or drunkenness, the patrol does not tolerate any deviations to carry out its mission.

programme.title: Ducobu goes green
programme.desc: It's the beginning of the year. Ducobu wants to make his loved ones think that he started working, while still cheating. Unfortunately, Latouche is unwitting all of his plans. When he hears of Rita Greenberg, Ducobu decides to become an environmental activist in order to take, like her, a sabbatical year...
programme.desc-more: As the school's school year approaches, Ducobu (Damien Pauwels), the famous student cheating at the Saint-Potache school, goes to Mr.Kitrish to acquire the most clever gadgets in order to deceive the vigilance of his teachers. Meanwhile, Gustave Latouche (Élie Semoun), her teacher, has to face a delicate mission: to announce to his mother that he has decided to marry his colleague, Madame Rateau (Frédérique Bel). Once this complicated task has been accomplished, Latouche resumes her role as an intransigent teacher, stepping up efforts to counter the schemes of Ducobu. The situation takes an unexpected turn when Ducobu attends a captivating presentation by his comrade Léonie (Louise Riguidel Huon) on ecology. Intrigued by this theme, he sees it as an opportunity to avoid classes while plunged into an unexpected adventure that could change his vision of the world and of school.

programme.title: Holy witches
programme.desc: In 1967 Bruno, an orphan, moved to his grandmother's home in the small town of Demopolis, Alabama. She recommends that she pay attention to evil witches. She takes Bruno to a beautiful seaside resort. But the great witch decided to gather all her friends...
programme.desc-more: The winter of 1968 moved to Chicago when the life of an eight-year-old boy turned tragically: his parents disappeared in a car accident, leaving him orphaned and desperate. Collected by his maternal grandmother (Octavia Spencer), a woman with a well-dimmed character but with a huge heart, he is taken to Demopolis, a small peaceful town in Alabama where time seems to have stopped. To soften his pain and help him adapt to this new environment, his grandmother is deploying treasures of invention. Between home-made cakes that embalm the kitchen of comforting fragrances and the arrival of Daisy, a small white mouse that became his inseparable companion, the boy gradually began to find his smile. But this new tranquillity is short-lived. One day, as he explores the surroundings of his new home, his gaze crosses that of a neighbour with a smile too perfect, in too polite ways. Behind this facade of respectability is a terrifying truth: this woman is nothing but a witch, a member of a secret coven that blows in the shadows, determined to eliminate all the children of the county. While the boy discovers the extent of this macabre plot, he understands that the danger is much closer than he thought. The witches, led by the Great Witch (Anne Hathaway) – a creature as elegant as it is formidable – have infiltrated the smallest corners of society, hiding under the traits of ordinary women, teachers or even figures of authority. Their goal? Transform every child into a monstrous creature through a diabolical potion, all under the nose of perilous adults.

programme.title: Super Nanny
programme.sub-title: Mom says yes, Dad says no: our children enjoy it
programme.desc: In Plouzané, near Brest, live Emelyne and David, parents of two very moving boys. Maxence, four, is taking her little brother into all his nonsense. David, often absent, no longer knows how to be obeyed. Emelyne, herself very busy with her business, tries to face up, but the arguments and cries have become permanent at home.
programme.desc-more: In Plouzané, Brittany, Emelyne, 32, and David, 35, are the parents of Maxence, 4, and Juliann, 2 years old. Often absent for his work, the father lost all authority over his boys who took advantage of it to multiply the nonsense. As a result, the arguments and the screams are almost permanent. Super Nanny will quickly understand that the couple can't agree on how to educate the children. She has ten days to help this family at the edge of the breakup.

programme.title: Super Nanny
programme.sub-title: 45 m2 and co-do : welcome to Paris, Super Nanny!
programme.desc: In Paris, Anne and Thibaut are the parents of Joshua, 4, and Joachim, 2 years old. The young couple are akin to the cododo, because they sleep four in the same bed. And the least we can say is that bedtime and nights are not a rest. Anne and Thibaut are exhausted and lack patience.
programme.desc-more: Anne and Thibaut are the parents of two little boys. The couple is akin to the co-dodo, they all sleep in the same bed. And nights are necessarily agitated. Because of lack of sleep, Anne and Thibaut are often exhausted and sometimes they lack patience with the children. Besides, being a real "mommy chicken", Anne is constantly anxious when her boys play outside. To reduce risk, it limits exits. So many challenges for Super Nanny who intends to end the co-dodo and restore confidence to parents, especially Anne.

programme.title: Super Nanny
programme.sub-title: The screens have taken control! Super Nanny to the rescue
programme.desc: Amandine and Jonathan raise their two daughters, Liliou, 8, and Myla, 3. From morning to evening, the television receives all the attention of the children. Jonathan, a video game enthusiast, is isolated. In this fragile organization, tensions are mounting. Yet, at the granny's, the girls, far from the screens, are soothed. Super Nanny has to face a major challenge in helping this family.
programme.desc-more: In a daily newspaper where screens occupy a central place, Amandine, home helper, and Jonathan, a façadier, raise their two daughters Liliou, 8, and Myla, 3. From morning to evening, the TV remains lit and receives all the attention of the children. Jonathan, for his part, is passionate about video games and is isolated every night, leaving Amandine alone to manage the end of the day. In this fragile organization, tensions are mounting. Myla, from her three-year-old age, monopolizes attention. She does not hesitate to violently oppose her sister, while Liliou gradually disappears. Yet, at "Mami Coconut", the girls are calmed down, accomplices and far from the screens. In the face of this striking contrast, Super Nanny faces a major challenge to help this family reconnect.

programme.title: Baby boom
programme.desc: Women's expectations for childbirth are high. Some want to control everything, others hope that this moment is as short as possible or that everything will take place according to their convictions, even if it is suffering. For almost a month, the series followed the daily maternity day of the inter-municipal hospital in Poissy-Saint-Germain. Midwives, doctors, caregivers, childcare workers are mobilized every day to help mothers live in the best conditions this unforgettable moment.

programme.title: Baby boom
programme.desc: Being a mother is not necessarily innate... maternity often causes a metamorphosis that sometimes creates many doubts, questions and upsets a woman's life. No woman becomes a mother in the same way, whether in tears or in laughter. These mothers, with a very different course, sincerely evoke their stories. Some have learned about motherhood in pain, others have never given up on the desire to become mothers, despite trials or after long years of waiting.

programme.title: The Scott Brothers
programme.desc: After Lucas (Chad Michael Murray) and Peyton (Hilarie Burton) left Tree Hill, the city was in a state of rapid growth. Haley (Bethany Joy Lenz) takes over the musical label, determined to make the talents she supports shine. Meanwhile, Brooke (Sophia Bush) is preparing to launch a new collection for her brand, settling in with Julian (Austin Nichols), who is working on an ambitious film production. The dynamics of their relationship evolve as they together face the challenges of the entertainment world. Millicent (Lisa Goldstein), influenced by Clothes Over Bros' new agry, Alex (Jana Kramer), is beginning to change behaviour, creating tensions. At the same time, Nathan (James Lafferty) is plunged into a scandal that threatens his marriage to Haley, and Clay (Robert Buckley), his sports agent, is trying to keep the family at bay. This season, marked by twists and the arrival of new memorable characters, explores the challenges of friendship, love and professional ambitions.
programme.desc-more: While Julian (Austin Nichols) finally made the decision to move to Brooke (Sophia Bush), she was preparing to welcome Alex Dupre (Jana Kramer), a famous actress who would become the face of her new clothing collection. Millicent (Lisa Goldstein), Brooke's best friend, goes to the airport to get Alex back, but the meeting is not going as planned, as Alex proves to be unbearable and capricious. Meanwhile, Nathan (James Lafferty) was under pressure because of the blackmail exerted by Renee (Kate Voegele), which prompted him to worry about his career as a basketball player. Although he tries to reassure Clay (Robert Buckley) by saying that he did not have an affair with Renee, tensions are rising and secrets are beginning to emerge. The relationships between the characters become more complex as they navigate between ambitions, betrayals and desires, each seeking to find its place in this tumultuous world.
