programme.title: Visitors: The Revolution
programme.desc: Locked in the corridors of time, Godefroy de Montmirail (Jean Reno) and his faithful servant Jacquouille (Christian Keyboarder) are projected in an era of profound political and social upheavals: the French Revolution... More specifically, La Téreur, a period of great dangers during which the descendants of Jacquouille La Fripouille, the convinced revolutionaries, confiscate the castle and all the property of the descendants of Godefroy de Montmirail, arrogant aristocrats on the run whose life is only held by a thread.

programme.title: Tattoo Cover : Tattoo Saviours
programme.desc: On vacation in Mauritius with his son, Delphine succumbs to the desire to get tattooed the portrait of Michael Jackson, above the ankle. But the tattooer decided to add his personal touch. Coming especially from Switzerland, Claire wants to cover a tattoo cut in half by a scar on the bottom of her belly. Its objective: to regain a harmonious skin. Ludovic, a Flemish with a well-dimmed sense of humor, stops at the shop for a staggered tattoo. A typical case that promises nice surprises and good laughter. In Cagnes-sur-Mer, Vincent pays tribute to his father through a symbolic tattoo. This humble and discreet man raised his children with strength and courage. To sublimate it, Maya and Charly unite their talent around a cover full of emotion.

programme.title: Tattoo Cover : Tattoo Saviours
programme.desc: Marty's team welcomes Pascal who hopes that his tattoo dedicated to his favourite rock band will find a second breath to meet his expectations. Aurore no longer supports his tattoo, which was to commemorate a period of his life and would like to trade it for a more floral imaging. At the age of 18, Gaëtan was tattooed with a strong idea in mind but the result proved to be a real disappointment. Finally, Jean-Pierre comes to make cover an enigmatic tattoo whose real meaning bothers him a lot and which he would rather replace with something more elegant.

programme.title: Baby boom
programme.desc: The adventure of pregnancy and childbirth is full of emotions. Joy is mixed with a certain apprehension, a feeling that is quite natural, because this event can prove tragic. Within maternity services, a red code means that a caesarean must be performed urgently. No future parent wants to live that. Elina and Ahmed are waiting for twins. The medical team is doing everything possible to delay the birth of the child, which should be premature. Denise is pregnant with her first child. Finally, Alima's birth is expected to be difficult.

programme.title: Baby boom
programme.desc: Having a child born can become a real obsession, especially for women who have difficulty getting pregnant. At present, 10% of women face such difficulties. Medical conditions, stress, hormonal problems or poor consumption habits, the causes can be multiple. A real tragedy for some women, who will have to overcome major obstacles with determination to become a parent. Then begin a real journey of the fighter in order to be a mother.

programme.title: The Scott Brothers
programme.desc: After Lucas (Chad Michael Murray) and Peyton (Hilarie Burton) left Tree Hill, the city was in a state of rapid growth. Haley (Bethany Joy Lenz) takes over the musical label, determined to make the talents she supports shine. Meanwhile, Brooke (Sophia Bush) is preparing to launch a new collection for her brand, settling in with Julian (Austin Nichols), who is working on an ambitious film production. The dynamics of their relationship evolve as they together face the challenges of the entertainment world. Millicent (Lisa Goldstein), influenced by Clothes Over Bros' new agry, Alex (Jana Kramer), is beginning to change behaviour, creating tensions. At the same time, Nathan (James Lafferty) is plunged into a scandal that threatens his marriage to Haley, and Clay (Robert Buckley), his sports agent, is trying to keep the family at bay. This season, marked by twists and the arrival of new memorable characters, explores the challenges of friendship, love and professional ambitions.
programme.desc-more: While Julian (Austin Nichols) finally made the decision to move to Brooke (Sophia Bush), she was preparing to welcome Alex Dupre (Jana Kramer), a famous actress who would become the face of her new clothing collection. Millicent (Lisa Goldstein), Brooke's best friend, goes to the airport to get Alex back, but the meeting is not going as planned, as Alex proves to be unbearable and capricious. Meanwhile, Nathan (James Lafferty) was under pressure because of the blackmail exerted by Renee (Kate Voegele), which prompted him to worry about his career as a basketball player. Although he tries to reassure Clay (Robert Buckley) by saying that he did not have an affair with Renee, tensions are rising and secrets are beginning to emerge. The relationships between the characters become more complex as they navigate between ambitions, betrayals and desires, each seeking to find its place in this tumultuous world.

Their days are thus littered with classes, rehearsals, but also moments of relaxation and complicity in the heart of an exceptional experience that will mark them forever.

programme.title: The Villa of Broken Hearts
programme.desc: A group of anonymous men and women or who have already participated in reality TV shows in the past is housed in a superb villa with the aim of solving their problems related to their love life. To help them, the seduction coach Lucie Mariotti offers them a galant appointment with suitors from outside. The expert is also present at individual coaching sessions to try to learn more about the failures of their sentimental past and help them identify the nature of the brakes to their love happiness.

programme.title: Crime Chronicles
programme.desc: In February 2021, in Montauban-de-Bretagne, a small village 30 km from Rennes, Magali Blandin, a storyless mother of family, disappeared mysteriously. Immediately, the gendarmerie put in place the great means to try to find it, in vain. While the whole of France, upset, is following the twists of the affair, Jérôme Gaillard, the husband of the disappeared woman, finds herself at the heart of the investigations. The investigators will reveal a evil scenario that combines family plot, hit-and-learn killers and repeated lies. *Death scenario for family murder * *Cartel revenge or love rivalry? *

programme.title: Cleaners the household experts
programme.sub-title: Angele and Sylvain facing Olivia head at home
programme.desc: Since an ordinary accident, Sylvain, 53, Angèle's father, has lost his foot. Forced to stay at home, he discovered a passion for graffiti on the walls of his apartment and for the accumulation of useless objects. Sylvain finally decided to take over. After a long and complicated divorce, and then a difficult return to France, Olivia, former restorer, is now a "celiftant" self-entrepreneur at the RSA. Catering and creating culinary events, she had to adapt her daily life to her home and work from home. But Olivia neglected the organization and storage in her apartment. If her activity develops well, she can no longer work calmly under the current conditions.

programme.title: Cleaners the household experts
programme.sub-title: Floriane and Natacha facing Marion the winemaker
programme.desc: Floriane and Natacha, two sisters, successively lost their mother five years ago, then their father a few weeks ago. Never really recovered from his wife's disappearance, their father had let himself go to the house that saw her daughters grow up. Today, the two sisters who are deprived of the situation have no choice but to ask for help from the Cleaners. Not far from the castle of the Varenne lives Marion, who has the vine in the blood. This young single woman has made the choice of living in a mobile home next to her work, as the passion for grape variety is devouring for the farm worker. If despite the heavy hardships of life, like the death of her sister two years ago, she gives the change in appearance, inside her 30 m2 housing, is the absolute disorder.

programme.title: Cleaners the household experts
programme.desc: Alexandre, Leslie, Zak and Laura, four experts in cleanliness, arrive at private homes whose interior has been left to the fore. Due to lack of time and/or motivation, these people live in disorder and dirt. Chef, specialist in food hygiene, Alexandre shares his tips for eliminating microbes and bacteria. Zak, meanwhile, is a pro for storage and optimization of spaces. Leslie and Laura, for their part, excellent in the household. Together, they transform the interiors of individuals.

programme.title: Cleaners the household experts
programme.desc: Alexandre, Leslie, Zak and Laura, four household experts, help individuals who are not as much on the line of hygiene as they are. Cleaners only have three days to clean everything from floor to ceiling! In this first issue, the pros of the feather fly to the aid of 44-year-old Sylvie, who lives in Ardèche. This woman works seven days a week and she doesn't have much time to take care of her home. As for Olivier, 28, he's a single person who hasn't cleaned up or stored anything in his apartment for a year!

programme.title: Cleaners the household experts
programme.desc: Four household experts are stealing from individuals who need advice to clean and store their homes. Zak, for his part, a blogger specializing in storage, is the king to optimize small spaces. Finally, Laura and Leslie are household professionals who don't let anything go. programme.title: Crime Chronicles
programme.sub-title: Serial killer special: In the head of the greatest serial killers
programme.desc: Back to the out-of-standard investigation that has made it possible to arrest one of the most prolific serial killers in the history of American crime. Sentenced in 2012 for the savage murder of three women, Samuel Little confessed to having committed more than 90 murders, spread over nearly four decades without ever being worried. How could he have been so under radar for so long? This former boxer and amateur painter mainly targeted isolated and minority women. An unusually deadly journey told by investigative journalist Jacques Pradel.

programme.title: Crime Chronicles
programme.sub-title: Special "Houses of Horror" The Turpin Case: The Horror in California
programme.desc: Jordan Turpin is a 17-year-old girl. She was found in panic in Perris, a small town in the state of California, right in the middle of the street. She contacted the authorities to tell them that she had managed to escape from the claws of her father and mother, David and Louise Turpin, who had been sequestering her for very long years. She was not alone, because she was locked up with her twelve brothers and sisters. Unfortunately, it was the only one who managed to escape and begin seeking help from the authorities.

programme.title: Large families: life in XXL
programme.desc: In large families, the smallest problem is very large. How do we get out of here with the family when we have eight kids? How can we deal with the arrival of triplets when we have their brothers and sisters to manage? Hard blows and small or great joys, discover their incredible daily life through the lives of several of them, who agreed to surrender themselves to the whole of France.

Super Nanny will quickly understand that the couple can't agree on how to educate the children. She has ten days to help this family at the edge of the breakup.

programme.title: Super Nanny
programme.sub-title: 45 m2 and co-do : welcome to Paris, Super Nanny!
programme.desc: Anne and Thibaut are the parents of two little boys. The couple is akin to the co-dodo, they all sleep in the same bed. And nights are necessarily agitated. Because of lack of sleep, Anne and Thibaut are often exhausted and sometimes they lack patience with the children. Besides, being a real "mommy chicken", Anne is constantly anxious when her boys play outside. To reduce risk, it limits exits. So many challenges for Super Nanny who intends to end the co-dodo and restore confidence to parents, especially Anne.

programme.title: Friends
programme.sub-title: The one who bluffed the social worker
programme.desc: While the iconic group of friends is at a decisive turning point in their lives, Ross Geller (David Schwimmer) must navigate in a new emotional balance. He is divided between his feelings for Charlie, Joey Tribbiani's girlfriend (Matt LeBlanc), who also questions his own relationship with Rachel Green (Jennifer Aniston). Rachel, for her part, is considering a professional opportunity in Paris, which further complicates the dynamics between the characters. Meanwhile, Monica Geller (Courteney Cox) and Chandler Bing (Matthew Perry) are taking steps to start a family, dreaming of a peaceful life in the suburbs. Unexpected reunions with Janice (Maggie Wheeler) add a dose of comedy and nostalgia, while Phoebe Buffay (Lisa Kudrow) receives a wedding proposal from Mike Hannigan (Paul Rudd). This explosive and emotional finale celebrates friendship, love and choices that define life.
programme.desc-more: "Friends", cult series, follows the adventures of six young New York singles. Monica, who lives in Manhattan, finds Rachel, a childhood friend who fled her marriage. They move in together and Rachel joins the circle of friends: Phoebe, Monica's ex-coloc, Chandler and Joey, their neighbors, and Ross, Monica's brother, who has been in love with Rachel since high school. The band often finds themselves at Central Perk. For ten seasons, spectators follow their careers and love stories.

programme.title: Beetlejuice
programme.desc: In a charming Connecticut home, Adam (Alec Baldwin) and Barbara Maitland (Geena Davis), a young, life-filled couple, see their existence rock after a tragic car accident that leaves them trapped in their own home as ghosts. Their peaceful afterlife is quickly disrupted by the arrival of the Deetz, a family of new owners with a snobish and invasive attitude, which turns their haven of peace into a real nightmare. Faced with this unbearable intrusion, Adam and Barbara decide to appeal to Beetlejuice (Michael Keaton), an eccentric and unpredictable spirit, in the hope of driving the intruders out of their home. However, the situation is quickly beyond control, Beetlejuice spreading chaos with its farfelus plans and disastrous actions. As the couple struggle to regain the tranquillity of their home, they realize that the solutions of a spectral world can have unexpected and often disastrous consequences.

programme.title: Beetlejuice
programme.desc: A couple, who died in a car accident, came back to haunt their old home and, at the same time, their new owners, vain and petty beings.
programme.desc-more: In a charming Connecticut home, Adam (Alec Baldwin) and Barbara Maitland (Geena Davis), a young, life-filled couple, see their existence rock after a tragic car accident that leaves them trapped in their own home as ghosts. Their peaceful afterlife is quickly disrupted by the arrival of the Deetz, a family of new owners with a snobish and invasive attitude, which turns their haven of peace into a real nightmare. Faced with this unbearable intrusion, Adam and Barbara decide to appeal to Beetlejuice (Michael Keaton), an eccentric and unpredictable spirit, in the hope of driving the intruders out of their home. However, the situation is quickly beyond control, Beetlejuice spreading chaos with its farfelus plans and disastrous actions. As the couple struggle to regain the tranquillity of their home, they realize that the solutions of a spectral world can have unexpected and often disastrous consequences.

programme.title: Asterix and the Menhir's Hit
programme.desc: Unable to control his strength, Obélix inadvertently sends a menhir to Panoramix which, assommé, loses his memory and at the same time the formula of the magic potion. While Asterix and Obelix are trying to heal Panoramix, the inhabitants of the village are seduced by a diviner, who is the pay of the Romans...
programme.desc-more: In 52 BC, the balance of the village of Asterix (Roger Carel) and Obélix (Gérard Depardieu) is threatened when their beloved Druid, Panoramix (Pierre Tornado), is hit with menhir, which causes sudden amnesia. This painful shock deprives him of his memories and, more crucially, of the formula of the magic potion that allows the resistance of their village to the Roman invaders. Taking advantage of this precarious situation, a cunning charlatan, Prolix (Michel Galabru) – a diviner at the service of the Roman Empire – settles nearby, manipulating the villagers and exploiting their naivety for his own benefit. Faced with this threat and the loss of their power, Asterix and Obelix decide to take charge. Their quest leads them through unexpected trials in order to restore Panoramix's memory. With courage and determination, our heroes fight to thwart Prolix's plans and protect their village from Roman intrusion, while desperately seeking the key to finding the famous magic potion.

programme.title: The Unicorn School
programme.desc: Ava is throwing a party for a foal who's doing some stupid things on campus. Sophia investigates the connection her father has with the Constellation of the Unicorn.
programme.desc-more: In this captivating episode of season 2 of "L'École des unicornes", Ava (Sara Garcia) is about to organize a memorable party to celebrate the anniversary of a mischievous foal who sows zizany on campus. Between the preparations, she must juggle with the nonsense of the young equine who is constantly creating nasty and unforeseen situations, attracting the attention of other students. Meanwhile, Sophia (Sadie Laflamme-Snow) is embarking on an intriguing investigation into the mysterious link between her father and the Constellation of the Unicorn, a mythical legend surrounded by secrets. As the festivities are breaking full, Sophia discovers elements that might well change her perception of her family and her legacy. Tensions rise as the two stories cross, revealing unexpected truths and tested friendships. Between laughter and revelation, this episode explores the themes of friendship, loyalty and self-discovery.

programme.title: The Unicorn School
programme.desc: Taking advantage of one night at the stables, the Sapphires go out in hiding to search for the Crown Stars, but they are not the only ones on their track.
programme.desc-more: Taking advantage of a peaceful night at the stables, the members of the Sapphires group, made up of young and fearless riders, decided to venture in secret for a thrilling quest: to find the Stars of the Crown, legendary artifacts that could change the destiny of their school. Guided by their curiosity and their sense of adventure, they equip themselves with flashlights and slip quietly out of their neighbourhoods. However, their night getaway is not going as planned. On their way, they discover that they are not the only ones looking for these precious Stars. A rival group, the Stars, is also on the track, ready to do anything to get them back. In an atmosphere full of mystery and competition, the Sapphires will have to show courage, cunning and solidarity to overcome the obstacles that stand in their way, while discovering the true meaning of friendship and loyalty.

programme.title: Armors
programme.desc: The dinosaurs are back. TJ, Paloma, Joon, Prisca and Liam, five teenagers, discover that they are the only ones who can create a connection with them.
programme.desc-more: In a world where dinosaurs, long gone, are reborn with incredible strength, a new generation of heroes rises to defend the Earth. Five teenagers, with a unique connection to these prehistoric creatures, discover that they are the only ones able to communicate and to ally with these imposing reptiles. Each of them wears a special armor that allows them to pilot their dinosaur and deploy extraordinary capabilities. At the heart of this thrilling adventure, our young protagonists, faced with an ancient evil that threatens the balance of their world, must overcome their doubts and learn to work together. In parallel, they face formidable enemies who seek to exploit the powers of dinosaurs for their own ends. The epic fighting between armor and dark forces is intensifying, testing not only their skills as warriors, but also their friendship and loyalty. As they explore wild landscapes and mysterious ruins, each teenager will have to discover his own inner strength and the true sense of heroism. "Armorsaurs" promises to be a series of captivating actions, where friendship and courage are the keys to saving a world at risk, while revealing secrets that even the bravest of them would never have imagined.

programme.title: Beethoven saves Christmas
programme.desc: A few hours from Christmas Eve, as the stars glitter over the snow-covered roofs and the children of the world are preparing to drop their shoes in front of the fireplace, an unexpected will upset the magic of the night. In Santa's secret workshop, where the elves are working for the last preparations, a mischievous and a little too bold young leprechaun does not resist the desire to offer a forbidden getaway. Without permission, he took the legendary sled, pulled by the fastest reindeer in the world. But what was supposed to be a simple touristic ride over the clouds turns into a nightmare: losing control of the team, the elf crashes in disaster in a peaceful American town, dispersing in its fall the precious toy bag – a magical object without which no gift distribution can take place. The gurney is panicked and found alone in the middle of a sleeping city, with an impossible mission: to find the bag before Santa Claus sees his disappearance. Without it, millions of children risk waking up without the slightest presence at the foot of the tree. Fortunately, his path crosses Beethoven, a dog as imposing as it is courageous, whose legendary flair and generous heart make it ideal ally. Together, they race against the clock through the snowy streets, following a sluggish track. Their quest leads them to a den of unrecommended criminals, who have recovered the bag without doubt of its priceless value. Between a cunning gang leader and crooked and dangerous accomplices, the task is dangerous. As the hours unfold and midnight approaches, the elf and Beethoven will have to be ingenuity and tricky to thwart the plans of the thieves, avoid the traps tensed in the city, and above all, bring the bag back in time to save Christmas. But between the quiproquos, the unbridled pursuits and unexpected encounters with eccentric and benevolent inhabitants, their mission is transformed into a hectic adventure where friendship, trust and a little canine magic will make all the difference. One thing is certain: this night, perhaps the greatest gift will not be the one that is found under the tree, but the one that is shared on the way.

programme.title: Ruby, the teen Kraken
programme.desc: Ruby Gillman, a 16-year-old girl, lives in the charming seaside town of Oceanside, where she shares her daily life with her family, all with distinctive blue skin. In reality, Ruby and his family are Krakens, marine creatures who have chosen to live incognito among humans. As the school year draws to a close, his friends encourage him to participate in the final ball, a much-anticipated event that will take place on a boat. However, Ruby's protective mother Agatha strongly opposes this idea, fearing that her daughter will be exposed to water, which could reveal their true nature and lead to catastrophic consequences. As Ruby struggles between her teenage desires and her mother's restrictions, she gradually discovers the mysteries of her legacy, thus confronting her identity and her family's expectations.

programme.title: Beetlejuice
programme.desc: In a charming Connecticut home, Adam (Alec Baldwin) and Barbara Maitland (Geena Davis), a young, life-filled couple, see their existence rock after a tragic car accident that leaves them trapped in their own home as ghosts. Their peaceful afterlife is quickly disrupted by the arrival of the Deetz, a family of new owners with a snobish and invasive attitude, which turns their haven of peace into a real nightmare. Faced with this unbearable intrusion, Adam and Barbara decide to appeal to Beetlejuice (Michael Keaton), an eccentric and unpredictable spirit, in the hope of driving the intruders out of their home. However, the situation is quickly beyond control, Beetlejuice spreading chaos with its farfelus plans and disastrous actions. As the couple struggle to regain the tranquillity of their home, they realize that the solutions of a spectral world can have unexpected and often disastrous consequences.

programme.title: Rambo II: the mission
programme.desc: John Rambo (Sylvester Stallone), a former Special Forces soldier and traumatized veteran, was found in an American prison after being convicted for resisting authority. But his fate changed when a former superior, Colonel Samuel Trautman (Richard Crenna), proposed an unofficial mission: to infiltrate Vietnam, now under communist control, to locate and photograph prisoner camps where American soldiers, who had disappeared since the end of the war, were still detained. What was supposed to be a discreet reconnaissance operation quickly turns into a nightmare. Rambo, equipped with his survival knife and legendary bow, discovers more than just evidence: broken compatriots, surviving in inhuman conditions under the ruthless femule of ruthless jailers. Faced with the horror of these camps, where torture and dehumanization reign as masters, his sense of honor and loyalty to his brothers and sisters in arms are awakened with unheard of violence. But the orders are clear: no intervention, only clichés to prove their existence.

programme.title: Rambo
programme.desc: John Rambo (Sylvester Stallone), a former member of the Special Forces, bears the invisible and visible stigma of a conflict that broke him. A medal of war in the pocket, but soul in tatters, this lonely giant drags his imposing silhouette from city to city, seeking only a little peace in a world that rejected him. His gaze betraying a contained violence, he embodies the abandoned soldier, the one that the homeland used before turning the page. His wandering leads him to a small mountain village, where a simple meal in a dinner will trigger a spiral of brutality. Sheriff Will Teasle (Brian Dennehy), an authoritarian and contemptuous lawman, saw Rambo as an undesirable wanderer whose presence was a disorderly order. For no good reason, he evicts manu militari, then, when Rambo returns – simply to eat – he stops. In the sordid police station, humiliations and beatings rain, awakening to the former soldier of demons he believed buried. But Teasle ignores the man he provokes: Rambo is not an ordinary tramp, it is a human weapon, forged by war and capable of a resistance out of standard.

programme.title: A wedding at Christmas
programme.desc: As Christmas approaches, a woman who has been badly overcame from a break-up visits her father in her inn. On the spot, she meets a seductive man to do everything.
programme.desc-more: A Christmas wedding takes us to a fairytale winter setting, where the sparkling lights and pristine snow hide hearts in search of comfort. Cait (Jessy Holtermann), a young woman on the verge of discouragement after a painful breakup, fled from the rest of the holidays to take refuge in the family hostel, a haven of peace nestled in the mountains. But when she arrived, she discovered a desolate establishment, far from the warm atmosphere she hoped for. Drew (James Liddell), a man who is a lénigmatic and attractive to do everything, tells him a devastating news: his father, overwhelmed by costly repairs, might well be forced to sell the hostel, thus ending a family tradition dear to his heart. Determined to save this place full of memories, Cait refuses to give up. With Drew's unexpected help, whose charm and resourcefulness do not leave her indifferent, she develops a bold plan: turning the hostel into an idyllic setting to host a last-minute wedding. The couple looking for a place to celebrate their union at Christmas could be the miracle solution to bring the establishment back to life and save family finances. But between the logistical unforeseen, family tensions and the doubts that arise again, Cait and Drew will have to show boundless creativity and growing complicity. As preparations accelerate and decorations illuminate the inn with a new glow, a question persists: will this crazy project succeed in restoring hope to Cait, while reviving the flame of unexpected love?

programme.title: Christmas à la carte
programme.desc: A famous cook who returned to spend Christmas with his family, finds a gastronomic critic who had torpedoed his old establishment.
programme.desc-more: As the glittering lights and festive decorations turn the streets into a true Christmas tale, Josie, a talented and recognized cook, returns to her hometown to spend the holidays. After a busy year, she aspires to regain the warmth of the family home and share precious moments with her loved ones. But this holiday will not only be an opportunity to rest: Josie decides to put her culinary know-how at the service of a project that is very close to her heart. She is launching a special menu for her mother's new restaurant, hoping to offer her an unforgettable gift and attract enthusiastic clientele. However, his return home is a surprise. While she is in the kitchen, she crosses the path of Tanner, a gastronomic critic as charismatic as he demands. Their meeting is not annoyed: Tanner is none other than the man who, years earlier, had issued a devastating critique of his bakery, a hard blow which Josie hardly recovered. Despite this tumultuous past, an unexpected spark seems to arise between them, and the initial tensions gradually give way to growing complicity. As the menu preparations progress and the parties approach, Josie and Tanner find themselves immersed in a delicate dance between distrust and attraction.

programme.title: A wedding at Christmas
programme.desc: A Christmas wedding takes us to a fairytale winter setting, where the sparkling lights and pristine snow hide hearts in search of comfort. Cait (Jessy Holtermann), a young woman on the verge of discouragement after a painful breakup, fled from the rest of the holidays to take refuge in the family hostel, a haven of peace nestled in the mountains. But when she arrived, she discovered a desolate establishment, far from the warm atmosphere she hoped for. Drew (James Liddell), a man who is a lénigmatic and attractive to do everything, tells him a devastating news: his father, overwhelmed by costly repairs, might well be forced to sell the hostel, thus ending a family tradition dear to his heart. Determined to save this place full of memories, Cait refuses to give up. With Drew's unexpected help, whose charm and resourcefulness do not leave her indifferent, she develops a bold plan: turning the hostel into an idyllic setting to host a last-minute wedding. The couple looking for a place to celebrate their union at Christmas could be the miracle solution to bring the establishment back to life and save family finances. But between the logistical unforeseen, family tensions and the doubts that arise again, Cait and Drew will have to show boundless creativity and growing complicity. As preparations accelerate and decorations illuminate the inn with a new glow, a question persists: will this crazy project succeed in restoring hope to Cait, while reviving the flame of unexpected love?

programme.title: Christmas à la carte
programme.desc: As the glittering lights and festive decorations turn the streets into a true Christmas tale, Josie, a talented and recognized cook, returns to her hometown to spend the holidays. After a busy year, she aspires to regain the warmth of the family home and share precious moments with her loved ones. But this holiday will not only be an opportunity to rest: Josie decides to put her culinary know-how at the service of a project that is very close to her heart. She is launching a special menu for her mother's new restaurant, hoping to offer her an unforgettable gift and attract enthusiastic clientele. However, his return home is a surprise. While she is in the kitchen, she crosses the path of Tanner, a gastronomic critic as charismatic as he demands. Their meeting is not annoyed: Tanner is none other than the man who, years earlier, had issued a devastating critique of his bakery, a hard blow which Josie hardly recovered. Despite this tumultuous past, an unexpected spark seems to arise between them, and the initial tensions gradually give way to growing complicity. As the menu preparations progress and the parties approach, Josie and Tanner find themselves immersed in a delicate dance between distrust and attraction.

programme.title: French prisons: the reality behind bars
programme.desc: What really happens behind the walls of French prisons? For several weeks, a team has obtained access to two very different prisons: the Towers prison, which is faced with overcrowding, and the Châteaudun detention centre, which is preparing for the reintegration of prisoners sentenced to long sentences. Close to the supervisors, prison staff and inmates, this novel documentary plunges into the daily life of a largely unknown universe of the general public. Overpopulation management, security, detention work, activities, exit preparation, family connections: cameras followed those who live and work behind bars.

programme.title: Rambo III
programme.desc: John Rambo is back from his last mission to Vietnam. Discreetly withdrawn from Thailand, he lives quietly with Buddhist monks. He hopes to stay away from the long-standing world of violence. One day, he receives a visit from Colonel Trautman, his instructor...
programme.desc-more: After Vietnam's indelible scars, John Rambo (Sylvester Stallone), the former soldier hunted by his demons, found a precarious refuge among Buddhist monks in Thailand. Peaceful temples and meditative rituals have become its ultimate bulwark against a past haunted by blood and the cries of the battlefields. But fate, relentless, strikes again at his door under the traits of Colonel Samuel Trautman (Richard Crenna), his mentor and father figure, whose grave voice resonates as a distant echo of unfinished duty. This time, the mission is not played in the wet jungle, but in the burning deserts of Afghanistan, where Soviet forces are crushing a desperate Afghan resistance under their boot. Trautman, sent as an scout to assess the extent of American aid to the mujahedin, finds himself trapped behind the enemy lines after a murderous ambush. The military authorities, powerless, turn to the only man able to challenge the impossible: Rambo. But the warrior worn out by the fighting categorically refuses to sink back into hell. How can we convince a man broken by war to save the one who was his guide, while every fiber of his being screams to stay away from chaos?

programme.title: Rambo II: the mission
programme.desc: Former Vietnam fighter, John Rambo is serving a five-year prison sentence. His former colonel offered him a chance to redeem himself: he would have to return to Vietnam and locate the camps holding American prisoners since the end of the war. Rambo takes his job very seriously...
programme.desc-more: John Rambo (Sylvester Stallone), a former Special Forces soldier and traumatized veteran, was found in an American prison after being convicted for resisting authority. But his fate changed when a former superior, Colonel Samuel Trautman (Richard Crenna), proposed an unofficial mission: to infiltrate Vietnam, now under communist control, to locate and photograph prisoner camps where American soldiers, who had disappeared since the end of the war, were still detained. What was supposed to be a discreet reconnaissance operation quickly turns into a nightmare. Rambo, equipped with his survival knife and legendary bow, discovers more than just evidence: broken compatriots, surviving in inhuman conditions under the ruthless femule of ruthless jailers. Faced with the horror of these camps, where torture and dehumanization reign as masters, his sense of honor and loyalty to his brothers and sisters in arms are awakened with unheard of violence. But the orders are clear: no intervention, only clichés to prove their existence.

programme.title: Christmas with a heart
programme.desc: Christmas in Crawleigh has never been so emotionally charged. After years of climbing the ranks of a prestigious and exhausting New York career, Sam returned to his small hometown, with a heavy heart and a slender soul. Her existence, which she thought was perfectly controlled, has just collapsed like a castle of cards, leaving her destabilized and in search of comfort. Between the glittering garlands and the snowy streets of this village, where everything seems unchanged, she hopes to find some of the family warmth she has so missed. His mother, who is always as welcoming, opens her arms, but it is another meeting that will upset his stay: Noah's, his youthful love, remained anchored in this picturesque setting as a living memory. Noah never left Crawleigh. He is always as generous and committed as he is, and he devotes his time to helping the poorest in the community, organizing collections, hot meals and events to give the smile back to those who have been abused by life. When Sam saw him at work, she rediscovered this part of herself that she had buried under the records and meetings: this desire to make a difference, this simple joy of sharing and giving. Gradually, she gets dragged into her projects, regaining the pleasure of small things – a shared laugh, an accomplice look, the happiness of seeing eyes light up through a thoughtful gesture. While they work side by side to organize the village's great Christmas party, the old sparks between them are reviving, brighter than ever. Snow walks, conversations in front of a hot chocolate, memories that go back to the surface... Everything seems to bring them back to what they once were, and to what they might have become. Yet Sam cannot help but wonder whether this enchanted parenthesis is just a sweet lure, or whether Crawleigh – and Noah – might well be the port of attachment that she has never stopped looking for.

programme.title: A wedding at Christmas
programme.desc: A Christmas wedding takes us to a fairytale winter setting, where the sparkling lights and pristine snow hide hearts in search of comfort. Cait (Jessy Holtermann), a young woman on the verge of discouragement after a painful breakup, fled from the rest of the holidays to take refuge in the family hostel, a haven of peace nestled in the mountains. But when she arrived, she discovered a desolate establishment, far from the warm atmosphere she hoped for. Drew (James Liddell), a man who is a lénigmatic and attractive to do everything, tells him a devastating news: his father, overwhelmed by costly repairs, might well be forced to sell the hostel, thus ending a family tradition dear to his heart. Determined to save this place full of memories, Cait refuses to give up. With Drew's unexpected help, whose charm and resourcefulness do not leave her indifferent, she develops a bold plan: turning the hostel into an idyllic setting to host a last-minute wedding. The couple looking for a place to celebrate their union at Christmas could be the miracle solution to bring the establishment back to life and save family finances. But between the logistical unforeseen, family tensions and the doubts that arise again, Cait and Drew will have to show boundless creativity and growing complicity. As preparations accelerate and decorations illuminate the inn with a new glow, a question persists: will this crazy project succeed in restoring hope to Cait, while reviving the flame of unexpected love?

programme.title: The secrets of pyramid builders
programme.desc: The construction of the Kheops pyramids lasted nearly twenty years and required the work of 20,000 workers, who lived in a nearby city.
programme.desc-more: Built 4,500 years ago on the Giza plateau, next to Cairo, the Kheops pyramid is the only wonder of the ancient world still standing today. It is also the largest pyramid in history, composed of more than two million blocks of stone and culminating at 146 meters high. Before this achievement, the Egyptian builders erected other pyramidal monuments. The first pyramid in history is the degree building that dominates the funeral complex of King Jeser (2691–2625 B.C.), in Saqqarah.

programme.title: The secrets of pyramid builders
programme.sub-title: The Pharaoh with the three pyramids
programme.desc: The famous sphinx erected on the Giza plateau, which represents a lion with a human head, was built during the Fourth Dynasty, around 2,600 BC.
programme.desc-more: King Snefrou, who was the founder of the Fourth Dynasty of the Ancient Empire of Egypt, was a great builder around 2,500 B.C.E., but his name was known only to specialists. Three pyramids were erected during the twenty-five years of his reign: one in Meidoum and two in Dahchour, about ten kilometres south of Cairo: the northern pyramid and the colossal rhomboidal pyramid, which was to be about 180 metres in length at the base, and 100 metres in height. The latter is one of Egypt's best preserved thanks to its limestone coating.

programme.title: 1492: Christopher Columbus
programme.desc: In 1491, Christopher Columbus dreamed of opening a road to the Indies via the West. With some support, he obtained an interview with Queen Isabelle de Castille. Conquised, it gives him the means to undertake the crossing. On August 3, 1492, the caravelles Santa Maria, Pinta and Nina left the port of Palos. The trip is much longer than expected and does not end in India as planned.

programme.title: To tell you the truth
programme.desc: Find the best of To Say All: animated debates, expertise, humour and convictions, with Matthieu Croissandeau and his guests who come back to the great moments of the news in a free and passionate atmosphere.

programme.title: Eva Braun, in Hitler's privacy
programme.desc: Richard Berry commented on the amateur films that Eva Braun made at the time when she was Adolf Hitler's mistress: a new look at the Third Reich.
programme.desc-more: Daughter of an interior architect professor Eva Braun was first the mistress and then the wife of Adolf Hitler until their common suicide in 1945. They met for the first time in 1929 while working as an assistant to Henrich Hoffman, the official photographer of the Nazi party. From 1937 to 1944, she made several amateur films at the Hitler chalet, the Berghof, located in Bavaria near the town of Berchtesgaden. For the first time, these images were gathered in a documentary and show the intimacy of the German dictator behind the scenes of the Third Reich.

programme.desc: After 18 years in prison, André returned home, an electronic bracelet with an ankle. His return is not enthusiastically welcomed. His wife can't stand his presence, his mother-in-law is invading, and his 20-year-old daughter, whom he didn't see growing up, refuses to call him Dad. Did André deserve these years of imprisonment? programme.title: The discovery of Egypt's last tombs
programme.desc: From the beginning of the mission to Saqqarah, Zahi Hawass and his team of Egyptian scientists feel that their area of search will be extremely rich. After digging some 40 wells, they finally discovered the Grail: dozens of coffins from the New Empire and the Lower Age, which will have to be scanned, and perhaps opened. Inside, individuals were buried with their secrets, sometimes unexpected... Thanks to modern techniques the team will go back in time, to make talk about the fates of these people who lived in Ancient Egypt 3000 years ago.

programme.title: The discovery of Egypt's last tombs
programme.desc: Dozens of coffins were found, but Zahi Hawass finds a stone sarcophagus, which allegedly belonged to a vizier of the New Empire.

programme.title: Julie's travels
programme.sub-title: Milan, elegance and art of savoring
programme.desc: On foot, by bike, along the Navigli, in the Sempione park or from the heights of the Torre Branca, Julie travels Milan from length to broad to discover the specialities. She shares a breakfast "al banco", savors panettone, risotto with saffron and the famous Milanese rib.
programme.desc-more: Julie is going to discover Milan, a city where elegance, history and traditions blend together. On foot or by bike, along the Navigli, in the Sempione park or from the heights of the Torre Branca, it travels through the various districts of the Lombard capital to reveal all the facets of it. Between Italian art of living, artisanal know-how and artistic heritage, Julie meets those who make the city live on a daily basis. On the gastronomy side, it savors some great local specialities, from panettone to risotto to saffron, not to mention the famous Milanese rib.

programme.title: At the scene of the crime
programme.sub-title: The canal drowns - The Koskinas case
programme.desc: 19 July 2004. The body tied up by a young woman is recovered from the bottom of a canal near Fresnes. The Paris gendarmerie is opening an investigation. The next day, a second body, naked and tied, was found near the first. The business seems to be connected.

programme.title: At the scene of the crime
programme.desc: Back to the Gaston Moysset case, an old man brutally murdered by a boxing champion who almost committed the perfect crime.
programme.desc-more: On June 3, 1994, a carer who was responsible for providing care to an old couple living in Bezons, Val-d'Oise, discovered a horror spectacle when she arrived at their home. Gaston Moysset, 89, lies in a pool of blood, with his skull broken. He died four days later at the hospital. His wife, witness to the tragedy, was never able to help the police with Alzheimer's disease. After a long investigation, the PJ still hasn't solved the murder. The victim's grandson is suspected and then cleared. But the automated fingerprint file, which was only in its early stages, finally revealed that the fingerprint found in the victim's home was Pierre Lorcy, a boxing champion who almost committed the perfect crime.

programme.title: The secrets of pyramid builders
programme.desc: The famous sphinx erected on the Giza plateau, which represents a lion with a human head, was built during the Fourth Dynasty, around 2,600 BC.
programme.desc-more: The famous great Sphinx of Giza, which represents a lion with a human head, was built during the Fourth Dynasty, around - 2600. As high as a six-storey building, this gigantic statue – 73 metres long by 14 metres wide and 20 metres high – came out of a single block of limestone, except for the forelegs, probably shaped whole in masonry. Egyptians long thought that Pharaoh Khéphren would have ordered his construction. The great Sphinx could also be the work of Jedefre, the other son of Kheops and brother of Khéphren, who preceded him on the throne.

programme.title: The secrets of pyramid builders
programme.sub-title: The end of the giant pyramids
programme.desc: Mykerinos, a grandson of Kheops, built the third and smallest pyramid on the Giza plateau. He died before the construction was over.
programme.desc-more: King of the Fourth Dynasty of the Old Empire and grandson of Kheops, Mykerinos built the third and smallest pyramid on the Giza plateau: it rises to 63 meters high, representing only one tenth of the volume of the largest, the Kheops pyramid, and dominates a complex composed of two temples. Many signs of incompletion show that the sovereign died before the construction was completed. His successor, Chepseskaf, will be building a gigantic mastaba-shaped grave in Saqqarah. The pyramid tradition ends.

programme.title: Pyramids: The Mysteries Revealed
programme.sub-title: Kheops and the tomb of secrets
programme.desc: The Kheops pyramid has led to a colossal construction project that lasted for at least 25 years. How did the builders of the time manage to realize this feat?
programme.desc-more: Among the Seven Wonders of the World, the pyramid of Kheops, in Egypt, is the only one still visible in its original state. The building is 146.5 metres high, 230-wide and consists of more than 2 million blocks - some weighing up to 63 tons - and is now in full swing. Egyptologists and archaeologists have a new tool using aerial images and satellites to analyze soil anomalies and invisible parts. They hope to elucidate the puzzles that remain on this titanium site.

programme.title: Pyramids: The Mysteries Revealed
programme.desc: In the heart of Saqqarah is the pyramid of Pharaoh Djézer. Below Djézer, there are miles of secret galleries, a real technical feat.
programme.desc-more: The pyramid of Pharaoh Djéser, in the heart of Saqqarah, an ancient necropolis on the west bank of the Nile, houses several kilometres of secret galleries. Their construction was a real technical feat. In addition, this pyramid is surrounded by walls of walls covered with hieroglyphs, representing the greatest corpus of texts of humanity. Almost two hundred years later, Egyptologists managed to reconstruct these underground mazes thanks to new technologies.

programme.title: Unsolved
programme.sub-title: The Jean Moritz case: A death in the flames
programme.desc: On June 1, 2011, firefighters intervened to extinguish a fire in a store in Louuvril, in the North. They discover Jean Moritz's calcined body at the bottom of the room. The autopsy revealed that the victim had died before the fire started. The investigations are struggling to break the truth. But the children of John Moritz stir up heaven and earth so that justice does not close the file.
programme.desc-more: On June 1, 2011, firefighters intervened to extinguish a fire in a farce and catch shop in Louuvril in the North. They discover Jean Moritz's calcined body at the bottom of the room. The autopsy revealed that the victim had died before the fire started: Jean Moritz was beaten. His killer then set fire to the store in the hope of destroying the evidence of his crime. The investigations are struggling to break the truth. But the children of John Moritz stir up heaven and earth so that justice does not close the file. Their hard work will pay off.

programme.title: Unsolved
programme.desc: On 25 September 2003, Clément Roussenq, a 55-year-old father, principal of Virebelle College in La Ciotat, was fatally stabbed in the school parking lot, which was clearly a victim of a trap. Today, investigations are continuing. For the first time, the daughters of Clement Roussenq evoke the murder of their father.
programme.desc-more: On the evening of September 25, 2003, Clément Roussenq, 55, principal of Virebelle College in La Ciotat, received a telephone call pointing out a problem on his boat. He leaves his office in emergency and is fatally stabbed upon his return. The day after his death, a 14-year-old student was arrested and heard by the police before being released. The investigation later revealed that Clement Roussenq had been feeling threatened for a few months and wanted to leave La Ciotat. Students are placed in custody, teachers are questioned, but there is no evidence to confuse the culprit.

programme.title: Unsolved
programme.desc: In 2003, garbage bags containing pieces of human body were collected at the edge of the Scheldt Canal in Pas-de-Calais. It is Janine Sopka, 59, resident in Saint-Hilaire-sur-Helpe. What if the victim crossed the road of Mons's de specter, a Belgian serial killer never identified?
programme.desc-more: On 26 February 2003, garbage bags containing pieces of human body were collected in the Pas-de-Calais on the edge of the Scheldt Canal. The victim, Janine Sopka, 59 years old and resident in Saint-Hilaire-sur-Helpe, was cut by saw. By investigating the neighbourhood, the gendarmes learn that the victim was multiplying the love affair without a future. They're looking for the men she had a relationship with and interested in the one who had dinner with her on the night of her disappearance, without being able to link him to the murder. They wonder if Janine Sopka would not have crossed the road of Mons's de specter, a Belgian serial killer never identified.

programme.title: Missing MH370: What if we were lied to?
programme.desc: A review of the official investigation into the disappearance in March 2014 of a Malaysian Airlines Boeing 777 and the inconsistencies surrounding the case.
programme.desc-more: On 8 March 2014, the Malaysian Airlines Boeing 777, connecting Kuala Lumpur to Beijing, suddenly disappeared from control systems as it flew over the China Sea. Five years after the disappearance of flight MH370, no one knows what happened that day, no one knows the fate of 239 passengers and crew members on board. In order to better understand and understand the different assumptions, from the most serious to the most speculative, back to the official investigation and highlight the many inconsistencies that surround the case from the beginning.

programme.title: Return to Chernobyl
programme.desc: British presenter Ben Fogle explores the Chernobyl site, 35 years after the disaster, and presents striking images of the exclusion zone.
programme.desc-more: Thirty-five years after the nuclear disaster, Ben Fogle, a former Navy reservist who became a journalist, plunged into the Chernobyl exclusion zone. He was able to access the control room of tank number 4 and the very heart of the sarcophagus, where the drama took place. He also went to meet the inhabitants who refused to leave the area after the evacuation, and squatters who since illegally returned to ghost towns and camped in the abandoned buildings of the area. And that, despite the risks still high.

programme.title: Unsolved
programme.desc: A young Belgian tourist, Xavier Baligant, was found killed by several shots on the A31 motorway not far from Nancy, in July 2011, on a rest area. His assassination was like a real execution, and several questions arose. Did he have any enemies who might have been mad at him? Did he stop by any chance?
programme.desc-more: On the night of 18-19 July 2011, Xavier Baligant, a Belgian tourist returning from vacation, stops at a rest area of the A31 near Nancy (Meurthe-et-Moselle). His two young sons, Dylan and Jordan, are sleeping with their fists closed on the rear seat of the vehicle. At 2:00 in the morning, a patrol boat discovers Xavier's lifeless body in front of the toilet. He was shot at close range with several large-calibre bullets. The kids didn't see anything. programme.title: The secret life of the Pharaohs
programme.desc: Hatchepsout was the daughter of King Thutmôsis I and Queen Ahmes, who ruled Egypt in 1504 BC. When his father dies, a man must succeed him. programme.desc-more: In a parking lot, a woman, Aurélie Chataignier, gets raped. The next day, she filed a complaint with the police station. At the time, the case was tried and acquitted. However, according to the law, "No person legally acquitted can be charged for the same acts, even under a different description. »

programme.title: At the scene of the crime
programme.desc: On October 9, 2001, Gabrielle Labrell, 64, was given severe vomiting. A few hours later, her husband, Pierre, 66, suddenly developed the same symptoms. Firefighters and the doctor called to help are helpless. Present on the scene, the victim's son designates the rest of a white cheese dish to the emergency workers. Both parents died in the following days. The gendarmes have no clue why these deaths leave the doctors perplexed. Suicide? Accidental poisoning? Poisoning?

programme.title: Cleopatra, looking for the dead tomb
programme.sub-title: The fall of Cleopatra and Marc Antoine
programme.desc: After centuries of research, the tomb of the last queen of Egypt is about to be found. Thanks to excavations, 3D modelling and reconstructions, this documentary series traces the life of Cleopatra through ancient Egypt.
programme.desc-more: For centuries archaeologists from all over the world have been searching for the tomb of Egypt's greatest queen, Cleopatra. We followed their quest for clues in the desert as underwater off the coast of Alexandria. Between archaeological excavations and docu fiction, this series tells the last moments of Cleopatra, its alliances with Roman generals Julius Caesar and Marc Antoine, and its crazy ambition to lead her to suicide.

programme.title: The secrets of pyramid builders
programme.desc: Built 4,500 years ago on the Giza plateau, next to Cairo, the Kheops pyramid is the only wonder of the ancient world still standing today. It is also the largest pyramid in history, composed of more than two million blocks of stone and culminating at 146 meters high. Before this achievement, the Egyptian builders erected other pyramidal monuments. The first pyramid in history is the degree building that dominates the funeral complex of King Jeser (2691–2625 B.C.), in Saqqarah.

programme.title: The secrets of pyramid builders
programme.sub-title: The Pharaoh with the three pyramids
programme.desc: King Snefrou, who was the founder of the Fourth Dynasty of the Ancient Empire of Egypt, was a great builder around 2,500 B.C.E., but his name was known only to specialists. Three pyramids were erected during the twenty-five years of his reign: one in Meidoum and two in Dahchour, about ten kilometres south of Cairo: the northern pyramid and the colossal rhomboidal pyramid, which was to be about 180 metres in length at the base, and 100 metres in height. The latter is one of Egypt's best preserved thanks to its limestone coating.

programme.title: Unsolved
programme.desc: On November 17, 2008, Jacques Heusèle, a 59-year-old insurer residing in Arras, Pas-de-Calais, did not return home. A few days later, his car was found under a bridge at the Belgian border. On 25 January 2009, his body was recovered in the Sambre, Belgium. But the causes of the death of the notable remain mysterious. His wife Nicole eventually discovered secret notebooks in which he mentioned journeys and many first names, suggesting encounters with women or young girls. The reporters on the show are going back to this mysterious affair.

programme.title: Unsolved
programme.desc: On January 29, 2001, Christian Poucet, National Secretary of the Trades and Craftsmen's Defence Committee (CDCA) and a controversial 44-year-old businessman, arrived at his consulting company's premises in Baillargues, Herault. Two hooded men burst into the air and shoot him. A look at the mysterious murder of this local figure with hidden financial activities, through the multiple tracks followed by the investigation.

programme.title: Unsolved
programme.desc: On the night of 18-19 July 2011, Xavier Baligant, a Belgian tourist returning from vacation, stops at a rest area of the A31 near Nancy (Meurthe-et-Moselle). His two young sons, Dylan and Jordan, are sleeping with their fists closed on the rear seat of the vehicle. At 2:00 in the morning, a patrol boat discovers Xavier's lifeless body in front of the toilet. He was shot at close range with several large-calibre bullets. The kids didn't see anything. No effects were stolen. Nancy's Public Prosecutor's Office opens a court investigation against X for intentional homicide.

programme.desc-more: In a sunny afternoon in Los Angeles, a brutal execution shakes the city: three members of the East Side Catorces, a feared gang, are shot dead in a park. Inspector Brenda Leigh Johnson (Kyra Sedgwick) and her team from the Priority Investigations Unit are called to the scene of the drama in an emergency. Faced with this widely publicized murder, Brenda must navigate between public pressure and the complexities of a case that reveals broader issues than expected. As she begins her investigation, Brenda notes the disturbing presence of a man at the crime scene: Colonel Walter (Robert Gossett), a former military instructor who claims to know the identity of the shooter. Although his knowledge seems valuable, there is growing mistrust at Brenda's. She wondered about the colonel's real intentions, as tensions, secrets and gang rivalries resurfaced, complicating an already delicate investigation.

programme.desc: 11 November 1999, Christian Manteau and his wife Daniela returned from a dinner in person. The couple parked in the underground parking lot of their accommodation in Boulogne-Billancourt in the Paris region. At about 1.50 a.m., a security officer was making his night shift, and he discovered Daniela's bloody body. Christian Manteau says his wife was back in the parking lot to pick up a CD in the car and smoke a cigarette. There are few clues but reconstitution reveals inconsistencies in the widower's discourse.

Gradually the personality of the latter intrigues investigators. Six months after her husband's disappearance, Jeannine, pressed by the police, confesses to the murder of her husband.

programme.title: The secrets of pyramid builders
programme.desc: The Kheops pyramid, built around 2,650 B.C. on the Giza plateau, a few kilometres south of Cairo, peaks at 146 meters high. Its structure is the result of the assembly of more than 2 million limestone blocks! Archaeologists have not yet pierced all its secrets, but their latest findings suggest that Egyptians have used ramps, one on each side of the pyramid. Built by the vizier Hemiounou, it is the presumed tomb of Kheops, Pharaoh of the Fourth Dynasty and son of Snefrou.

programme.title: The secrets of pyramid builders
programme.desc: The famous great Sphinx of Giza, which represents a lion with a human head, was built during the Fourth Dynasty, around - 2600. As high as a six-storey building, this gigantic statue – 73 metres long by 14 metres wide and 20 metres high – came out of a single block of limestone, except for the forelegs, probably shaped whole in masonry. Egyptians long thought that Pharaoh Khéphren would have ordered his construction. The great Sphinx could also be the work of Jedefre, the other son of Kheops and brother of Khéphren, who preceded him on the throne.

programme.title: The secrets of pyramid builders
programme.sub-title: The end of the giant pyramids
programme.desc: King of the Fourth Dynasty of the Old Empire and grandson of Kheops, Mykerinos built the third and smallest pyramid on the Giza plateau: it rises to 63 meters high, representing only one tenth of the volume of the largest, the Kheops pyramid, and dominates a complex composed of two temples. Many signs of incompletion show that the sovereign died before the construction was completed. His successor, Chepseskaf, will be building a gigantic mastaba-shaped grave in Saqqarah. The pyramid tradition ends.

programme.title: Unsolved
programme.desc: On July 14, 2013, in Perpignan, Marie-Josée Benitez, 53, and her daughter Allison, 19, candidate for Miss Roussillon's election, mysteriously disappear. Eight days later, Francisco Benitez warned the police that he had no further news of his wife and child. The Perpignan Public Prosecutor ' s Office is opening up judicial information. On 5 August in the early morning, the legionnaire was found hanging in the toilets of his barracks. Francisco Benitez claims his innocence in a letter found there. The investigators are raiding the Benitez's home. Several elements burden the father of the family.

programme.title: Unsolved
programme.sub-title: The Broken Destiny of Gaëlle Fosset
programme.desc: On 27 April 2007, Gaëlle Fosset was found dead and half naked at her home at the residence of the Park, in Saint-Germain-la-Campagne, a peaceful village in the Eure. The beautiful blonde received 66 stab wounds. Investigators feel that the young woman knew her attacker. His companion, friends and neighbour are heard. But there is no evidence to advance the investigation. Analyses allow us to isolate a male DNA on the jogging pants that Gaëlle wore on the evening of the drama.

programme.title: Unsolved

programme.desc: On 4 August 1997, Christian Jambert, a retired police officer who had investigated the case of the missing Yonne, was found dead in the garage of his house near Auxerre. A farewell letter is found on the spot. The general practitioner, in charge of the body examination, concludes that a suicide by gun was committed. No autopsy is performed. In 2004, seven years after the facts, the daughter of the former Warrant Officer requested forensic expertise. The experts then lean for the crime thesis.

programme.title: The Fall of the Reich
programme.desc: In June 1944, optimism reigned in the Allied camp. In the West, the landing in Normandy is a success. In the east, the Red Army began an attack on 22 June. With Operation Bagration, it is breaking into Belarus and forcing the Wehrmacht to a terrible retreat. The time is at trust; And yet, the war, which was to be over before Christmas, is going on. There will be another eleven months of fighting, punctuated by terrible battles and war crimes. In 1935 Hitler said, "Give me ten years and you will not recognize Germany." On 30 April 1945, the dictator committed suicide and Nazi Germany capitulated.

programme.title: Eva Braun, in Hitler's privacy
programme.desc: Eva Braun was Adolf Hitler's mistress from 1932 until their common suicide in April 1945, in a bunker in the heart of Berlin. From 1937 to 1944, she made amateur films at the Hitler chalet, the Berghof, in the Bavarian Alps, a true decision-making centre of Nazism, where the Führer loved to receive his entourage. Coloured images that allow Hitler to enter the privacy of the third Reich and the backstage. These historical images were gathered in a documentary that looks at the privacy and crimes of the German dictator: the woman who shared her life.

programme.title: The secrets of pyramid builders
programme.sub-title: S1 The Great Pyramid of Kheops
programme.desc: Built 4,600 years ago, the largest of the three pyramids of Giza, with its 230-metre square base at 146-metre height, is the presumed tomb of Pharaoh Kheops. The construction of this masterpiece of the Fourth Dynasty lasted almost twenty years and required the work of 20,000 workers, who lived in a nearby city.

programme.title: Teen and criminal: how did they turn?
programme.sub-title: Manipulated by his mother, Benjamin, 16, kills his father
programme.desc: On December 6, 2012, in La Roquebrussanne in the Var, Jean, a 48-year-old winemaker was discovered inanimate, in the trunk of his car parked in the courtyard of his wine hangar. His wife Nadine is the one who alerts. A few weeks later, the victim's own son came to the gendarmerie to declare that he and his mother would actually be the murderers. The 16-year-old states that he helped his mother remove his father, as he would be a violent husband. But the investigation will update a machination orchestrated by the mother of the family.

programme.title: The faces of crime in the region
programme.desc: In summary, "A murder without a body." In January 2014, Josiane, a 57-year-old mother of a city-level employee, disappeared after having dropped her son off at the station. - "Rixe fatale au waulon." While he spent the evening of New Year's Eve with friends in Tignes, a teenager, Yohan, was the victim of a violent assault and died a few days later. - "Love Tragedy." Jean-Luc, carpenter, lives in Haute-Savoie. On 8 June 2014, his ex-wife, accompanied by his son Vincent, reported his disappearance.

programme.title: Your objects are worth gold
programme.desc: In Torcy, behind the walls of an amazing family condo, lies a veritable cavern of Ali Baba. Didier, a locksmith-chaudronnier passionate about urban furniture, has been accumulating benches, antique plates, Parisian fountains and unusual objects for over 30 years. In the absence of room, his children Aurélie, Benedict and Thierry today agree to separate themselves from them. With Adeline and the auctioneer Céline Béral, these forgotten treasures could reserve them some very nice surprises. Auctions may well exceed expectations.

programme.title: Your objects are worth gold
programme.sub-title: Brittany: treasures from the cellar to the attic
programme.desc: In Paris, Catherine fully savors her retirement in her 80 m2 apartment, filled with treasures that are chineed with brocante. Passionate about antiques, vintage decor and furniture makeover, she has accumulated a host of historical objects. Adeline and Céline Béral, auctioneer, helped her sort out, estimate her findings and reveal their true value. Perhaps funding new chine adventures;
programme.desc-more: In Liffré, near Rennes, 77-year-old Louis, a passionate actor, lives in a duplex where each object tells a story. Family heritages, sales hall finds, theatre accessories: its interior is filled with unsuspected curiosities and treasures. Along with Adeline and Breton expert Pierre-Guillaume Klein, he will have to make a choice: to keep the memories he has so much to remember and to let go those who might arouse beautiful surprises at auction.

programme.title: Your objects are worth gold
programme.sub-title: Rambouillet: vintage pearls from an exceptional field
programme.desc: In the Yvelines, Véronique and Xavier have raised a crazy bet: creating an extraordinary event venue. In 20 years, they have accumulated furniture, rare objects and unusual collections, making the estate a veritable cabinet of curiosities. Today, the time for retirement has come. Before heading south of France, they are taking a final challenge: to raise at least €15,000 by selling some of their treasures.

programme.title: The faces of crime in the region
programme.desc: In summary, "Typhaine Taton's Calvary." On 18 June 2009, in Aulnoye-Aymeries, in northern France, the mother of Typhaine Taton, five years old, reported her disappearance. She confesses to the murder of the child five months later. - "Slaughter in disco." On 1 July 2012, Fayçal Mokhtari violent delinquent repressed at the entrance of the discotheque "Théatro" returned to machine-gun the building. - "The perfect victim." On November 9, 2011, Marie-Antoinette Calarese 44 years old mentally deficient under strengthened curate is killed stabbing by André Crivello.

programme.title: The faces of crime in the region
programme.desc: In summary, "Ronzon's double murder." On August 12, 2016, a young Ronzon couple was found dead by friends. Their 20-month-old son was abandoned by the murderer. - "Hunty barbarism in Huy." On 29 March 2017, Valentin, 18, was declared missing by his father. There's a rumor that he was killed and thrown into the Meuse. - "Meet with death." On May 31, 2016, Chantal, a pedicure without a story from Lens-Saint-Rémy, was found dead at her house by her own daughter.

programme.title: The faces of crime in the region
programme.desc: In the summary: "Fatality to Arthes". On 8 July 2003, David, a 21-year-old brilliant student living in Arthes, was found dead in his car. He went camping on vacation with his friends. The body is sifted with shotguns, and its face is not recognizable. Asks the question of circumstances, but also of where his friends are? - "Tragic crew in Lavaur." On 14 December 2009, Jonathan's 17-year-old body was found dead in a vandalized bar-tobacco days earlier. What is the reason for this tragedy in such a quiet city?

programme.title: The faces of crime in the region
programme.desc: In the summary, "Trap-up". Laura, 28, accuses a magnetizer of having sexually touched her. Over the next two years, 12 other complaints were filed by former patients. - "The murder of the broker." Jean-Pierre is a brocantor. In 2013, his body was discovered lifeless in the middle of his room. - "The axe killer." Mohamed is a former bar manager based in Sochaux. He is married and father of two boys. But this peaceful life is turning into a nightmare.

programme.title: FBI: Missing Persons
programme.desc: In this intense season of "FBI: missing", the team of the Missing Persons Brigade is confronted with the tragic consequences of a hunt that has left deep scars. Danny (Enrique Murciano), haunted by post-traumatic stress, struggles to regain his balance, while Martin (Eric Close), seriously shot wounded, has to fight against a painkillers addiction that threatens his career. To strengthen the team, Jack (Anthony LaPaglia) welcomes Elena Delgado (Roselyn Sanchez), a former New York policeman with methods often considered aggressive, which brings a new dynamic but also tensions within the group. At the same time, Jack began an affair with Anne Cassidy (Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio), the widow of one of her mentors, adding a personal touch to her professional commitment. This season is marked by unusual investigations, including the one aimed at discovering the identity of an amnesia, thus breaking with the usual routine of disappearances.
programme.desc-more: The team of Jack Malone (Anthony LaPaglia), an experienced FBI agent, finds herself facing a delicate investigation when she receives a call about the disappearance of Barry Rosen, a man who recently won a chili eater contest with a $5,000 prize. While Barry seemed to be in good shape, his doctor had advised him to avoid this type of risk activity, fearing for his health. Far from being a mere case of disappearance, this case raises questions about the reasons and circumstances surrounding Barry's victory. Poppy Montgomery, in the role of Samantha Spade, and Enrique Murciano, incarnation of Danny Taylor, join Jack in this investigation that led them to explore the world of food competitions. As the investigation progresses, the team will discover hidden secrets and unexpected rivalries, while sailing through the stress and pressure of a race against the clock to find Barry before it is too late.

programme.title: The 10 most stunning castles
programme.desc: How did the castles become the most stunning fortresses of the Middle Ages? Through ten emblematic sites, from Haut-Kœnigsburg, fortress of the Vosges peaks, to Castelnaud, citadel of the Hundred Years War, passing through Fougères, one of the largest medieval fortresses in Europe, or Beaufort, lock of the Alps, this documentary tells the incredible ingenuity of the builders who have pushed ever further the limits of defence. Designed to monitor territories, protect people and resist the most formidable sieges, these castles have constantly evolved to cope with the progress of the art of war.

programme.title: The 10 most daring bridges
programme.desc: From Roman arches from the bridge of the Gard to the vertiginous haubans of the Millau viaduct, from the rising bridge Jacques-Chaban-Delmas, the largest in Europe, to the 3,800 tons of steel of the Viaduct du Viaur, this documentary explores ten bridges that have brought the French territories closer together. These non-standard works bear witness to the same ambition throughout the centuries: to cross the impossible. By crossing rivers, gorges or valleys, they tell more than 2,000 years of innovation, technical challenges and human exploits.

programme.title: The 10 most ingenious Roman buildings
programme.desc: The Romans not only conquered territories, they imposed a way of life, whose traces continue to shape French landscapes. From Pont du Gard to Maison Carrée de Nîmes, through the Arles arenas or the Orange Theatre, ten masterpieces of Roman architecture that shaped the French territory. Through these spectacular vestiges, the deep imprint left by the Roman Empire is revealed. A journey into the heart of an exceptional heritage, a testimony of the genius and power of Rome.

programme.title: France of Mysteries
programme.desc: From Carnac and Gavrinis, in Brittany, to Filitosa, on the island of Beauty, and through Rochemaure, in the department of Ardèche, France is full of mysterious sites that have fed legends. Thus, some archaeological elements such as carved menhirs, a pyramid or an enigmatic amphitheater have still not delivered all their secrets, defying the knowledge of researchers and sometimes throwing trouble on the foundations of humanity. This documentary reveals these places as fascinating as they are mysterious.

programme.title: FBI: Missing Persons
programme.desc: In this intense season of "FBI: missing", the team of the Missing Persons Brigade is confronted with the tragic consequences of a hunt that has left deep scars. Danny (Enrique Murciano), haunted by post-traumatic stress, struggles to regain his balance, while Martin (Eric Close), seriously shot wounded, has to fight against a painkillers addiction that threatens his career. To strengthen the team, Jack (Anthony LaPaglia) welcomes Elena Delgado (Roselyn Sanchez), a former New York policeman with methods often considered aggressive, which brings a new dynamic but also tensions within the group. At the same time, Jack began an affair with Anne Cassidy (Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio), the widow of one of her mentors, adding a personal touch to her professional commitment. This season is marked by unusual investigations, including the one aimed at discovering the identity of an amnesia, thus breaking with the usual routine of disappearances.
programme.desc-more: The team of Jack Malone (Anthony LaPaglia), an experienced FBI agent, finds herself facing a delicate investigation when she receives a call about the disappearance of Barry Rosen, a man who recently won a chili eater contest with a $5,000 prize. While Barry seemed to be in good shape, his doctor had advised him to avoid this type of risk activity, fearing for his health. Far from being a mere case of disappearance, this case raises questions about the reasons and circumstances surrounding Barry's victory. Poppy Montgomery, in the role of Samantha Spade, and Enrique Murciano, incarnation of Danny Taylor, join Jack in this investigation that led them to explore the world of food competitions. As the investigation progresses, the team will discover hidden secrets and unexpected rivalries, while sailing through the stress and pressure of a race against the clock to find Barry before it is too late.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible 2
programme.desc: Agent Ethan Hunt (Tom Cruise) is to recover and destroy a deadly virus, called "The Chimera," which was stolen by his former colleague Sean Ambrose (Dougray Scott). The latter holds the antidote and is buried in a laboratory in Sydney. Hunt and his assistant Luther Stickell (Ving Rhames) are trying to get close to Nyah Hall (Thandiwe Newton), Sean's former girlfriend, to infiltrate his highly secure headquarters.

programme.title: A plan of hell
programme.desc: As they quietly approach retirement, Roger (Christopher Walken), Charles (Morgan Freeman) and George (William H. Macy) are appalled to learn that the management of the Boston Museum where they work has decided to sell a renowned work. These three guards realize that they are particularly attached to most of the works they are responsible for supervising. Irritated, they then imagine a crazy plan: to steal certain pieces to replace them with copies. They immediately began to work. But it's all complicated when Roger's wife gets involved.
