programme.title: Verdun's forts
programme.desc: Built and rebuilt on the heights of Verdun and its surroundings between 1873 and 1914, the city's fortifications constituted a strategic issue of World War I during the battle of the same name. About 40 works were defended, lost before being taken over by the enemy. In addition, more than 160,000 French soldiers reportedly lost their lives in the area during the 300 days of the confrontation, which is one of the bloodiest in history.

programme.title: The war of all French
programme.desc: This documentary contains a choral account of the Great War, which was fed by archives. Far from the front, he revives the daily life of the French "back". For the victory of November 1918 was that of an entire country that had been able to mobilize its resources and arms to the end. France at war is the innumerable crowd of the homeless, anonymous... With the testimony, among others, of Abel Ferry, MP-soldier, and his wife Hélène, nurse, Emile Joly, Mayor of Mende, Félicie and Hyppolyte Bougaud, a couple of Jurassian peasants, and Louise Weill, a young Lyon girl.

programme.title: Medieval cities
programme.sub-title: Provins : fortress of the Counts of Champagne
programme.desc: In the 13th century, while King Louis VIII strengthened his authority over the kingdom, Thibaut IV, Count of Champagne, dared to stand up to him. Forced to retreat to his fief, he made Provins a strong place as prosperous as it was impossible to take it. Walls, halls, underground: everything is designed ...
programme.desc-more: In the heart of Champagne, 80 kilometres from Paris, stands Provins, one of the best preserved medieval cities in Europe. Between architectural genius and economic audacity, this documentary recaptures its exciting history, marked by the way a rebel count made this place one of the most influential centers of power and commerce of his time.

At the same time, Jack began an affair with Anne Cassidy (Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio), the widow of one of her mentors, adding a personal touch to her professional commitment. This season is marked by unusual investigations, including the one aimed at discovering the identity of an amnesia, thus breaking with the usual routine of disappearances.
programme.desc-more: The team of Jack Malone (Anthony LaPaglia), an experienced FBI agent, finds herself facing a delicate investigation when she receives a call about the disappearance of Barry Rosen, a man who recently won a chili eater contest with a $5,000 prize. While Barry seemed to be in good shape, his doctor had advised him to avoid this type of risk activity, fearing for his health. Far from being a mere case of disappearance, this case raises questions about the reasons and circumstances surrounding Barry's victory. Poppy Montgomery, in the role of Samantha Spade, and Enrique Murciano, incarnation of Danny Taylor, join Jack in this investigation that led them to explore the world of food competitions. As the investigation progresses, the team will discover hidden secrets and unexpected rivalries, while sailing through the stress and pressure of a race against the clock to find Barry before it is too late.

programme.title: The great restaurant
programme.desc: Mr. Septime brilliantly runs his "grand restaurant", a Parisian temple of gastronomy where personalities are rushing in view. But one day, a South American head of state was taken there when a splendid room was fired...
programme.desc-more: Monsieur Septime (Louis de Funès), an ambitious restaurant owner, runs the Grand Restaurant with one hand of iron, a renowned gourmet establishment located on the famous Champs-Élysées in Paris. His reputation rests on his impeccable service and refined cuisine. Everything changes when a major event is scheduled: Novalès (Folco Lulli), the president of a South American state, has reserved a table for a dinner he hopes will be unforgettable. The restaurant teams put the double bites to prepare a living-size room in his honour. However, at the time of the dessert, Novalès mysteriously disappears from the restaurant, leaving all guests panicked. The situation is rapidly deteriorating and the press is taking over the case, propelling Septime under the media spotlight. But this sudden notoriety turns to its disadvantage when the police begin to suspect him of complicity in the kidnapping of the president. Aggravated, Septime finds itself at the heart of an investigation that threatens not only its establishment but also its reputation.

programme.title: Live my life
programme.desc: In a Norman abbey, Byron, a young Parisian comedian and great chatter, shares for three days the daily life of Brother Simon-Marie. Prayers, manual work and awakening at dawn are the rhythm of this parenthesis out of the time when silence could be the worst difficulty to overcome. Along with Fiona and her Dalmatian Boogie, Ludovic, father of two children and not comfortable with dogs, discovers a universe where the animal is at the center of all attentions. Between care, activities and rituals of everyday life, he will gradually have to tame the one he does not yet consider the best friend of man.

programme.title: Live my life
programme.desc: In Saintes-Maries-de-la-Mer, Jonathan, a solitary funeral agent who was not used to the crowd, joined Lony and the 200 members of his family on the occasion of the famous gypsy pilgrimage. Between party, music, fervor and traditions, he discovers from within a community with specific codes, and even more...

programme.title: France of Mysteries
programme.desc: In the middle of the Middle Ages, the Vikings have been a constant strike on the kingdom of the Franks. Pillows, brutality and relentless strategy: they imposed their law and forged their legend on board their drakkars, until they besieged Paris several times. But who are they really? The last trace...
programme.desc-more: In the middle of the Middle Ages, the Vikings have been a constant strike on the kingdom of the Franks. Pillows, brutality, formidable audacity and relentless strategy: they imposed their law and forged their legend on board their drakkars, until they besieged Paris several times. But who are they really? The last traces reveal a people far more complex than mere barbarians. From Brittany to Normandy, head on the Vikings track, discovering a still alive heritage, between myths and reality.

programme.title: France of Mysteries
programme.desc: From Carnac and Gavrinis, in Brittany, to Filitosa, on the island of Beauty, and through Rochemaure, in the department of Ardèche, France is full of mysterious sites that have fed legends. Thus, some archaeological elements such as carved menhirs, a pyramid or an enigmatic amphitheater have still not delivered all their secrets, defying the knowledge of researchers and sometimes throwing trouble on the foundations of humanity. This documentary reveals these places as fascinating as they are mysterious.

programme.title: FBI: Missing Persons
programme.desc: In this intense season of "FBI: missing", the team of the Missing Persons Brigade is confronted with the tragic consequences of a hunt that has left deep scars. Danny (Enrique Murciano), haunted by post-traumatic stress, struggles to regain his balance, while Martin (Eric Close), seriously shot wounded, has to fight against a painkillers addiction that threatens his career. To strengthen the team, Jack (Anthony LaPaglia) welcomes Elena Delgado (Roselyn Sanchez), a former New York policeman with methods often considered aggressive, which brings a new dynamic but also tensions within the group. At the same time, Jack began an affair with Anne Cassidy (Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio), the widow of one of her mentors, adding a personal touch to her professional commitment. This season is marked by unusual investigations, including the one aimed at discovering the identity of an amnesia, thus breaking with the usual routine of disappearances.
programme.desc-more: The team of Jack Malone (Anthony LaPaglia), an experienced FBI agent, finds herself facing a delicate investigation when she receives a call about the disappearance of Barry Rosen, a man who recently won a chili eater contest with a $5,000 prize. While Barry seemed to be in good shape, his doctor had advised him to avoid this type of risk activity, fearing for his health. Far from being a mere case of disappearance, this case raises questions about the reasons and circumstances surrounding Barry's victory. Poppy Montgomery, in the role of Samantha Spade, and Enrique Murciano, incarnation of Danny Taylor, join Jack in this investigation that led them to explore the world of food competitions. As the investigation progresses, the team will discover hidden secrets and unexpected rivalries, while sailing through the stress and pressure of a race against the clock to find Barry before it is too late.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible 2
programme.desc: Former secret agent Ethan Hunt now leads a peaceful life alongside her fiancée Julia. He was no longer in permanent danger and was content with training for future agents of the American government. Despite this new life he appreciates, Hunt is forced to return to service. One of his former students, Lindsey Farris, was the victim of a gun dealer named Owen Davian. Without telling Julia, he agreed to hunt Davian and formed a team of experienced agents. programme.desc-more: Agent Ethan Hunt (Tom Cruise) is to recover and destroy a deadly virus, called "The Chimera," which was stolen by his former colleague Sean Ambrose (Dougray Scott). The latter holds the antidote and is buried in a laboratory in Sydney. Hunt and his assistant Luther Stickell (Ving Rhames) are trying to get close to Nyah Hall (Thandiwe Newton), Sean's former girlfriend, to infiltrate his highly secure headquarters.

programme.title: Maritime transport, a global revolution
programme.desc: At any time, more than 50,000 merchant ships cross the high seas. The ocean is a dangerous environment, with ships risking damage or loss of equipment and cargo on rough seas. About 1500 vessels are lost each year. Canals and passageways are created at a high human cost to reduce transit times, avoid dangerous sections or protect special marine environments.

programme.title: Maritime transport, a global revolution
programme.sub-title: In the ports of the world
programme.desc: At the end of each voyage, the goods are transferred from the ship to the ground transport on the port. These transshipment platforms operate 24 hours a day and use specialized equipment to load and unload cargo from cargo ships as quickly and efficiently as possible. The largest vessels in the current commercial fleet can take several hours to dock. Modern giants are directed to shore by experienced local pilots and tug crews.

programme.title: Maritime transport, a global revolution
programme.desc: Looking at the evolution of small, propulsion-powered boats to powerful cargo ships, the technology of ships excelled and the result is faster and more reliable freight transport. Today's cargo ships are wonders of engineering, with the ability to carry enough grain on a ship to feed four million people for a month. Over the past two to three years, the title of the largest container carrier has lasted only a month or two, with each successive record pushing the limits of engineering and human ingenuity.

programme.title: Maritime transport, a global revolution
programme.desc: This old industry, which is the transport of goods by boat, has undergone many technological revolutions. With each new development, the efficiency of trade is increasing, allowing the industry to develop. Simple innovations, such as Malcolm McLean's revolutionary standard freight container, to the expansion of commercial routes along the Silk Seaway. The constant need to improve logistics and supply chain has made global imports cheaper than local manufacturing.

programme.title: Basile Bourgnon: the heir of the offshore
programme.desc: As the 13th edition of the Route du Rhum approaches, Basile Bourgnon is about to start for the first time. Navigator in the midst of ascent, it appears today ready, determined, turned towards performance. But behind this assurance is a more intimate story. Son of the navigator Laurent Bourgnon, disappeared at sea, and nephew of Yvan Bourgnon, emblematic figure of the ocean sailing, Basile grew up in a universe where the sea is both a space of life, a heritage and a memory. The film is built in a back and forth between present and past: the last preparations, training, the rise in tension before departure interlace with personal archives and intimate testimonies.

programme.title: France of Mysteries
programme.desc: From all time, castles, palaces and cabarets have been home to scandalous extravagances. The walls of the power stations were silent witnesses of forbidden embraces and of all kinds of drifts. The opportunity to return to the frascs of kings and queens but also nobles whose reputation has been through the centuries. Among them, the Marquis de Sade, the sulphurous owner of the Château de Lacoste, in Luberon.

programme.title: France of Mysteries
programme.desc: In Brittany, the mysterious forest of Broceliande is the kingdom of a mythical character of the legend of King Arthur: Merlin. The famous enchanter with exceptional powers would be the master of this place. In the Upper Rhine, Bollenberg Hill is at the heart of many witchcraft stories. In Provence, a certain Nostradamus published in 1555 his "Prophecies", a book whose poetic verses predicted the future until 3797. Other less well-known places also have their share of secrets, as in the Basque Country, in the castle of Saint-Pée-sur-Nivelle, next to Bayonne, where Judge Pierre de Lancre led 400 witches to death. In the Béarn, a cursed people, the Cagots, were accused of witchcraft and condemned to live in unthinkable conditions.

programme.title: France of Mysteries
programme.desc: In the South of France, in the 13th century, Catharism was born, a religious challenge that advocated the return to the early Church model of early Christianity and condemned hierarchy in the Roman Church. The director went to the departments of Aude and Ariège, in the footsteps of the Cathars, who were particularly victims of the Inquisition and then lived clandestinely. Thus the castle of Montségur, a fortress long remained unobstructed, would have sheltered the fortune of these men and women with a course still full of mysteries as well as... Holy Grail.

programme.title: The faces of crime in the region
programme.sub-title: Special photographers of stars in the torment
programme.desc: In summary, "A murder without a body." In January 2014, Josiane, a 57-year-old mother of a city-level employee, disappeared after having dropped her son off at the station. - "Rixe fatale au waulon." While he spent the evening of New Year's Eve with friends in Tignes, a teenager, Yohan, was the victim of a violent assault and died a few days later. - "Love Tragedy." Jean-Luc, carpenter, lives in Haute-Savoie. On 8 June 2014, his ex-wife, accompanied by his son Vincent, reported his disappearance.

programme.title: The faces of crime in the region
programme.desc: In the summary: "Toxic relationship to Aosta". November 2007, in Isère, Alain's lifeless body is found burned in his car 30 kilometers from his home. - "The barbaric trio of Echirolles." A couple of thirty-year-olds were violently assaulted near Grenoble. They claim to have been the victims of kidnapping at home, among others.

programme.title: Flynn Carson's Adventures
programme.desc: In the felted enclosure of a library where every book contains forgotten secrets, Flynn Carson (Noah Wyle), a meticulous and adventurous curator despite himself, spends his days restoring artifacts from all over the globe. His expertise in ancient history and his keen sense of observation make him a discreet but passionate guardian of the treasures of the past. Yet his routine changes the day he receives a mysterious package: an Egyptian manuscript, jaunished by centuries, adorned with an enigmatic symbol that seems to defy time. He has barely begun to decipher the secrets that a masked commando is breaking in, determined to seize the precious document. The attack, as brutal as it is unexpected, leaves Flynn with more questions than answers. Why does this parchment arouse such lust? His research soon led him to the trail of a long-standing legend: this manuscript would be nothing other than the map leading to the mines of King Solomon, a mythical treasure, source of unheard of riches and unsuspected powers.

programme.title: Flynn Carson's Adventures: The Secret of the Cursed Cup
programme.desc: In the felted enclosure of a library where every book contains forgotten secrets, Flynn Carson (Noah Wyle), a meticulous and adventurous curator despite himself, spends his days restoring artifacts from all over the globe. His expertise in ancient history and his keen sense of observation make him a discreet but passionate guardian of the treasures of the past. Yet his routine changes the day he receives a mysterious package: an Egyptian manuscript, jaunished by centuries, adorned with an enigmatic symbol that seems to defy time.
programme.desc-more: Dive into the enchanting atmosphere of New Orleans, where voodoo legends still murmur between the cobbled alleys and the smoky jazz clubs, Flynn Carson (Noah Wyle), an adventurous librarian with a past already filled with solved puzzles, is going through a dark period. Freshly abandoned by his companion, he struggles to regain the taste of the mysteries that have always rhythmed his life. Then his faithful friends, Charlene (Jane Curtin) and Judson (Bob Newhart), offered him a breakaway into the Creole city, hoping that the vibrant energy of the Bayous and the magic of the Old Square would give him a smile. But fate has other plans for Flynn. In a bar that is enthralled by the notes of a languorous blues, he meets the gaze of Simone Renoir (Stana Katic), a French singer as mysterious as he is captivating. Between two melodies, she confides in her secret that smells sulfur and forbids: she would have an ancient key, opening the way to a cursed relic, the Judas Cup. According to rumours, this artifact, imbued with a curse of centuries old, would have the power to resurrect the most feared creatures of the night... vampires.

programme.title: The faces of crime in the region
programme.sub-title: Jeffrey Epstein, Jean-Luc Brunel: suicides, sex and prostitution
programme.desc: On 19 February 2022, Jean-Luc Brunel was found hanged in his cell at the prison of Health in Paris. He was charged with rape of two minors and sexual harassment. But he was also accused of recruiting for his friend, US billionaire Jeffrey Epstein, who was also found dead in prison in August 2019. The investigation, containing exclusive testimonies of alleged victims of Jean-Luc Brunel, seeks to understand who this man really was and the role he played in what became the Epstein case.

programme.title: Woodwood: a high-risk trade
programme.desc: Unforeseeables seem to be going on and falling on the loggers. Lionel Sabatier and his teams, who are accustomed to risk areas, will be put in great difficulty on an rugged volcanic land of the Cantal. A record number of machines are on the ground, which further increases the risk of accidents.. In the East, in the Ardèche, Enzo Pettavino, a young forest boss, must form a new recruit: Paoline. The young woman who is not cold in her eyes will have to convince Enzo that she deserves her place in the company.

programme.title: Woodwood: a high-risk trade
programme.desc: In the Basque country, Arian, a languor, will be performing high-voltigation exercises, under the worried eye of Guillaume, his boss. Direction le Finistère, where Jean-Baptiste Le Floch presents a machine for extracting trees that only 20 loggers control throughout France: a technique that is fearlessly effective but also excessively dangerous. In Alsace, the European Women's Lumbering Championships are held, a discovery of this exceptional event with Julia Meyer, an 18-year-old young bucheronne.

programme.title: Woodwood: a high-risk trade
programme.desc: Operation Super Puma is named after the highly efficient military helicopter, reconverted for civilian operations. For two long weeks, about 15 people will cut down and extract nearly 1200 tons of sick wood from the Maurienne valley. The loggers will work under difficult conditions. All the sick wood is destined for a pulp mill. Discovers the various stages of the complex process of wood processing in a unique French plant that uses various technological processes.

programme.title: Woodwood: a high-risk trade
programme.sub-title: Building risks in the face of the crisis
programme.desc: Adrien Recorbet and his teams are involved in a zoo in the region. For this unprecedented mission, they will have to look after 14 cedars from Lebanon and cut the top of these trees over 30 meters high while retaining their branches that will serve as perch for chimpanzees. Nicolas will be put in trouble for the first time in his career and have to push his limits. Near Saumur, Joël Coutant, a wooden transporter, tries to carry his cargo of wood in good port despite the numerous misadventures crossed along the way.

programme.title: France of Mysteries
programme.sub-title: The truth about Joan of Arc
programme.desc: A sacred and enigmatic icon, Joan of Arc has long marked the history of France. Heroin of war, divine messenger, political figure: who was this 17-year-old girl really capable of upsetting the destiny of the kingdom? From Domrémy to Rouen, through Chinon and Orléans, his journey is gleaming with shadows, and his story continues to question.

programme.title: France of Mysteries
programme.desc: In the middle of the Middle Ages, the Vikings have been a constant strike on the kingdom of the Franks. Pillows, brutality, formidable audacity and relentless strategy: they imposed their law and forged their legend on board their drakkars, until they besieged Paris several times. But who are they really? The last traces reveal a people far more complex than mere barbarians. From Brittany to Normandy, head on the Vikings track, discovering a still alive heritage, between myths and reality.

programme.title: France of Mysteries
programme.sub-title: The legend of the Knights of the Round Table
programme.desc: King Arthur, Merlin, Perceval, Lancelot du Lac, Guinevere: these legendary medieval figures reached the contemporary era under the pen of various authors, including Chrétien de Troyes in the 12th century. Today, the legend of the Knights of the Round Table and their quest for the Grail continue to fascinate. From the forest of Broceliande to the castle of Kerduel, exploration of Brittany through one of the most mythical stories of medieval literature.

programme.title: Secrets swallowed up
programme.sub-title: The mysteries of the China Sea
programme.desc: Using the technology of a state-of-the-art probe and recent synthetic images, experts are able to find hidden treasures under the China Sea. Their tools allow them to virtually remove the waters to discover what their funds are. They thus reveal one of the largest warships in history and the evidence of the existence of an ancient weapon.
programme.desc-more: With the help of the latest technologies and synthetic images, it is now possible to uncover the secrets and mysteries of the greatest civilizations. The researchers found that a volcanic eruption caused the decline of the Minoan society, which had developed in the Aegean Sea in the 15th century B.C.E. Marine archaeologists have also proved the existence of a decisive battle between Carthage and Rome.

programme.sub-title: Be careful, Sahib the rhino is falling asleep!
programme.desc: At Beauval Zoo, Sahib, an Indian rhinoceros, must be anesthetized to treat an abscess to the eye. Sleeping an animal over two tons is complicated. On the other side of the zoopark, Boomer, the sea baby, injured himself with a fin. Amélie, the intern, discovers a very turbulent little patient who does not want to be tested at all. In Paris, Break, ferret, suffers from a pancreatic tumor. Minh, a veterinarian specializing in new pets, decides to operate it. In Lille, Lalou, a young bitch is paralyzed on one side. His mistress doesn't understand what happened to her animal.

programme.title: Veterinarians, their Live Live Life
programme.desc: A young koala arrives at the Beauval Zoo, while in Paris, the masters of the dog Fenrir worry about his condition. In Lille, Marion tries to save Neo, a cat.

programme.title: Veterinarians, their Live Live Life
programme.desc: This issue features news from several animals that marked the documentary series this season. Thus, a few months after her birth, Gaia, daughter of the female rhinoceros Mafu, is out of her box for the first time. It is also an opportunity to discover, in Lille, how Neo, a cat who had had a heart attack, is doing. The feline was just rescued by Marion. Finally, in Arcueil, Val-de-Marne, Claire goes back to the story of Filou, a young Bernese bounty who had had a difficult recovery after suffering from a twist of the stomach.

programme.title: The faces of crime in the region
programme.desc: In the summary: "Out-track to Rezé". Pauline, a former motocross champion, goes to the Rezé gendarmerie to file a complaint. The young woman accuses her former coach of sexual touching and rape. - "The terrible lie." A look at the murder of Céline Sablé-Marchand, heiress of the Sorinières mansion, near Nantes. - "Fatal Alliance." In June 2015, at Le Mans, Frédéric's lifeless body was found at his home.

programme.title: The faces of crime in the region
programme.sub-title: Special to those families who want the truth
programme.desc: In summary, "A murder without a body." In January 2014, Josiane, a 57-year-old mother of a city-level employee, disappeared after having dropped her son off at the station. - "Rixe fatale au waulon." While he spent the evening of New Year's Eve with friends in Tignes, a teenager, Yohan, was the victim of a violent assault and died a few days later. - "Love Tragedy." Jean-Luc, carpenter, lives in Haute-Savoie. On 8 June 2014, his ex-wife, accompanied by his son Vincent, reported his disappearance.

programme.title: The faces of crime in the region
programme.desc: In the summary: "Satanist death at Kingersheim". On 20 December 1996, Father Jeana was found dead in his presbytery. - "The mystery of Galfingue." On October 23, 2003, Marc discovered, near a tree strain, human remains in three garbage bags. - "Execution in Gundolsheim." On 22 May 2001, Mohammed, a home-based carpet seller, made his tour. He's found in a pool of blood. The 46-year-old man was shot in the head in the street. But by chance, he's still alive.

programme.title: The faces of crime in the region
programme.desc: In the summary, "The Essonne Killer." Between 2011 and 2012, the Essonne department lived in terror. A series of murders spread panic among the locals. - "The jogger's ordeal." When Marie-Christine, 42, left that day to jogging in Milly the forest. She knew she was going to cross death on her way. Her attacker kidnapped her, sequestered her in her trunk and raped her before she killed her. - "The monster of the city." On 16 February 2010, Tanja, then only 25 years old, was killed by several stab wounds sustained by his former companion, Mahamadou Doucouré.

programme.title: The faces of crime in the region
programme.desc: In 2017, in the city of Charenton-le-pont, a 12-year-old boy confesses to his mother that he was the victim of a sexual assault. His attacker would be a man he met on social media. His mother decides to go to the police station to file a complaint, and discovers that her son is not the only victim. In 2018 in Avignon, a friend of Cassandre told the police to report the assault she had suffered in the city centre. The attacker is on the run, trying to blackmail her with social media.

programme.title: FBI: Missing Persons
programme.desc: In this intense season of "FBI: missing", the team of the Missing Persons Brigade is confronted with the tragic consequences of a hunt that has left deep scars. Danny (Enrique Murciano), haunted by post-traumatic stress, struggles to regain his balance, while Martin (Eric Close), seriously shot wounded, has to fight against a painkillers addiction that threatens his career. To strengthen the team, Jack (Anthony LaPaglia) welcomes Elena Delgado (Roselyn Sanchez), a former New York policeman with methods often considered aggressive, which brings a new dynamic but also tensions within the group. At the same time, Jack began an affair with Anne Cassidy (Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio), the widow of one of her mentors, adding a personal touch to her professional commitment. This season is marked by unusual investigations, including the one aimed at discovering the identity of an amnesia, thus breaking with the usual routine of disappearances.
programme.desc-more: The team of Jack Malone (Anthony LaPaglia), an experienced FBI agent, finds herself facing a delicate investigation when she receives a call about the disappearance of Barry Rosen, a man who recently won a chili eater contest with a $5,000 prize. While Barry seemed to be in good shape, his doctor had advised him to avoid this type of risk activity, fearing for his health. Far from being a mere case of disappearance, this case raises questions about the reasons and circumstances surrounding Barry's victory. Poppy Montgomery, in the role of Samantha Spade, and Enrique Murciano, incarnation of Danny Taylor, join Jack in this investigation that led them to explore the world of food competitions. As the investigation progresses, the team will discover hidden secrets and unexpected rivalries, while sailing through the stress and pressure of a race against the clock to find Barry before it is too late.

programme.title: Verdun's forts
programme.desc: Built and rebuilt on the heights of Verdun and its surroundings between 1873 and 1914, the city's fortifications constituted a strategic issue of World War I during the battle of the same name. About 40 works were defended, lost before being taken over by the enemy. In addition, more than 160,000 French soldiers reportedly lost their lives in the area during the 300 days of the confrontation, which is one of the bloodiest in history.

programme.title: The war of all French
programme.desc: This documentary contains a choral account of the Great War, which was fed by archives. Far from the front, he revives the daily life of the French "back". For the victory of November 1918 was that of an entire country that had been able to mobilize its resources and arms to the end. France at war is the innumerable crowd of the homeless, anonymous... With the testimony, among others, of Abel Ferry, MP-soldier, and his wife Hélène, nurse, Emile Joly, Mayor of Mende, Félicie and Hyppolyte Bougaud, a couple of Jurassian peasants, and Louise Weill, a young Lyon girl.

programme.title: Medieval cities
programme.sub-title: Provins : fortress of the Counts of Champagne
programme.desc: In the heart of Champagne, 80 kilometres from Paris, stands Provins, one of the best preserved medieval cities in Europe. Between architectural genius and economic audacity, this documentary recaptures its exciting history, marked by the way a rebel count made this place one of the most influential centers of power and commerce of his time.

programme.title: Your objects are worth gold
programme.desc: Dominique, 62, a grandmother filled with seven grandchildren, lives in Brittany with her husband Laurent. Originally from Belgium, she fell in love with the region years ago and now feels at home. Former brocantist, passionate about creation and recovery, Dominique has accumulated many objects over time. By his side, his daughter Melissa follows his footsteps and shares the same love of the brocante. Together, they open the doors of their home filled with treasures in Adeline, accompanied by Pierre-Guillaume Klein, the regional auctioneer, who came to help them to get the most out of these objects. For today Dominique wants to make room, it is for a beautiful reason: to go to Montreal to celebrate the 50th anniversary of his little brother.

programme.title: Your objects are worth gold
programme.sub-title: Troyes: the holiday cottage with a thousand treasures
programme.desc: In Verrières, a few kilometers from Troyes, in the Aube, Laure and Rémi, who are passionate about food and brocante, opened a cottage two years ago. Today, they want to sort out some of the objects they have accumulated. The goal: to purchase new ones to renew their decor and satisfy their ever more demanding clientele. Between the Jacuzzi and the games room, Adeline and the auctioneer Léonard Pommez may find it difficult to stay focused in this environment dedicated to relaxation.

programme.title: Your objects are worth gold
programme.desc: Meet you a few kilometers from Troyes, in a totally atypical family farm. In the midst of donkeys and cows, Thierry, Audrey, his brother Charles and little Leonard have lived here for several generations. They are passionate farmers, and they admit that they have accumulated many objects of all kinds for decades. It is urgent to sort out and make room. Adeline and Leonard will not be at the end of their surprises by discovering, among other things, an incredible collection of tractors, and many other unusual objects such as old self-tamp machines.

programme.title: The faces of crime in the region
programme.desc: In the summary, "A night of horror." In Toulouse, 23-year-old Eva is a beautiful and charismatic student. His life is changing when a corpse is found in a box filled with acid in his apartment. - "Eoux's double homicide." At 54, Brigitte, an auxiliary of life passionate about her job, lives at her mother's house after a complicated breakup. But on March 22, 2015, mother and daughter eclipsed into nature. A few hours later, they were found murdered in a farm in the commune of Eoux.

programme.title: The faces of crime in the region
programme.sub-title: Pays de la Loire: on the crime trail
programme.desc: In the summary: "The young mother's ordeal". Elodie lives with Raphael and their daughters. On 9 June 2014, Léa, aged 3, was found in the street by a neighbour who contacted the gendarmerie. - "Sail at sea in Saint-Nazaire". In 2017, Carl came to the gendarmerie to file a complaint. He says he was raped for several years. - "Murder disguised in Ecommoy." Gilbert is a retired farmer. On 21 January 2014, his neighbour was panicked. He finds Gilbert's house on fire.

programme.title: The faces of crime in the region
programme.desc: In the summary: "Scandale in college". - At 22, Camille returned to Moulins and accused Jean-Philippe, 36, of repeated rapes while she was a minor. - "The terrible machination." In 2014, Jerome reported the disappearance of her partner Magali, a mother. - "A strange suicide." In 2016, Christian discovered his wife Fabienne's lifeless body in their apartment.

programme.title: The faces of crime in the region
programme.desc: In summary, "Purpose Viol." On November 29, 2014, Alice went to the gendarmerie of Aubigny-sur-Nère, in the Cher department. She accuses her doctor of having raped her. - "Removal to Vierzon." Mathieu, 22, works in a fast food store. His life is going on without a shadow. Yet in July 1999, he was found dead in a sluggish neighbourhood of the city. - "A evil duo." Yvonne, retired without history, devotes her days to her garden. On December 5, 2008, the seven-year-old was discovered without life.

programme.title: The faces of crime in the region
programme.desc: In summary, "Terrible ballad." In 2015, a 40-year-old mother was brutally attacked in the Haguenau forest, north of Strasbourg. - "The cursed castle." On 18 September 2011, in Sedan, a man and a woman were shot and executed near a castle for sale. - "A taxi for death." On August 15, 2013, Fadila's lifeless body, a quadrennial, was found on the street near the building where she resides in Nancy.

programme.title: The great restaurant
programme.desc: Monsieur Septime (Louis de Funès), an ambitious restaurant owner, runs the Grand Restaurant with one hand of iron, a renowned gourmet establishment located on the famous Champs-Élysées in Paris. His reputation rests on his impeccable service and refined cuisine. Everything changes when a major event is scheduled: Novalès (Folco Lulli), the president of a South American state, has reserved a table for a dinner he hopes will be unforgettable. The restaurant teams put the double bites to prepare a living-size room in his honour. However, at the time of the dessert, Novalès mysteriously disappears from the restaurant, leaving all guests panicked. The situation is rapidly deteriorating and the press is taking over the case, propelling Septime under the media spotlight. But this sudden notoriety turns to its disadvantage when the police begin to suspect him of complicity in the kidnapping of the president. Aggravated, Septime finds itself at the heart of an investigation that threatens not only its establishment but also its reputation.

programme.title: The spirit is having fun
programme.desc: A successful writer, Charles Condomine (Dan Stevens) is hosting a dinner with his new wife Ruth (Isla Fisher) accompanied by an eccentric psychic. At the end of the meal, guests gather for a spiritualism session that everyone thinks is missed. But that night Charles was haunted by the ghost of his first wife, Elvira (Leslie Mann), which aroused the greatest jealousy in Ruth's life.

programme.title: New York, Criminal Section
programme.desc: The agents are investigating the death of the son of a powerful businessman: the wife of the Chinese-born magnate may be involved in the tragedy.
programme.desc-more: In this fifth season of "New York, Criminal Section", Inspectors Robert Goren (Vincent D'Onofrio) and Alexandra Eames (Kathryn Erbe) welcome two new officers, Veteran Mike Logan (Chris Not) and Inspector Carolyn Barek (Annabella Sciorra). Although the two investigators' duos never cross, each one is confronted with complex and intriguing cases. Goren and Eames find themselves facing a grieving patriarch (Malcolm McDowell), whose grief hides dark secrets, while Logan and Barek have to navigate the tumults of a charismatic adoptive mother (Whoopi Goldberg), whose protégés seem to have drifted to crime. This season is distinguished by its innovative formula, where each pair of actors devotes themselves to only half a season, with one episode in two. Fred Dalton Thompson also made a striking appearance, adding a familiar touch to this new dynamic within the "Law & Order" universe.

programme.title: New York Special Unit
programme.desc: Benson and Stabler are trying to find Annika Bergeron, an eight-month-old pregnant woman, who has mysteriously evaporated into nature.
programme.desc-more: Benson and Stabler investigate both an Islamophobic hate crime, a high school shooting, slave trafficking and a violent husband, and the multitude of sexual maniacs running the streets of New York. Their already trying investigations become almost impossible when victims themselves hesitate to testify. When two parents refuse to report a child to a paedophile in exchange for a large sum of money, Stabler's blood is only a turn. An episode inspired, like many others, by real facts. At the end of the season, Alexandra Cabot's character left his post and would only appear sporadically.

programme.title: New York Special Unit
programme.desc: Young Tommy, the only witness to his mother-in-law's murder, refuses to talk to the police. His father became the main suspect in the case.
programme.desc-more: Can we leave two sexual predators at liberty on the grounds that they must testify soon against a mafia godfather? Is it permissible to take cells from a woman in a coma, even in the interests of medicine? Should we excuse the transgender victim of rape if she kills her assailant? Several cases of conscience torment the team of the special unit. The hearings did not end for this fourth season, in which Sherilyn Fenn, Pam Grier, Rob Estes and Fred Savage participated, impressive in the role of a rapist who himself defended and stood up to prosecutor Cabot.

programme.title: Friends
programme.sub-title: The one who was too positive
programme.desc: The 35th anniversary celebration of Ross and Monica's parents is an opportunity for Phoebe to introduce her new boyfriend to the whole band.
programme.desc-more: While the candles of Monica Geller's (Courteney Cox) and Chandler Bing (Matthew Perry) wedding are barely out, news of Rachel Green's (Jennifer Aniston) pregnancy is beginning to spread, creating a palpable tension within the group of friends. Ross Geller (David Schwimmer) and Rachel are trying to navigate this delicate situation, seeking to establish a stable friendship while managing their complex feelings. Rachel, seeking to get closer to Ross, moved home, which made it even more difficult, especially when Ross's new girlfriend, Mona, proposed to write common greeting cards, adding an extra layer of confusion to their dynamics. Meanwhile, Joey Tribbiani (Matt LeBlanc) made an unexpected revelation that could upset the fragile balance of the band. This season, acclaimed by critics, highlights Jennifer Aniston's actress talents, hailed by nominations for the Emmy Awards.

programme.title: Josephine, guardian angel
programme.desc: Josephine arrives with Louise, a young Egyptologist, who is responsible for studying the mummy of Neferet, a relic that is just revealed, and which is called evil.
programme.desc-more: In this captivating episode of "Josophine, guardian angel", Josephine (Mimie Mathy) is called to the rescue to help Louise, a promising young Egyptian, who finds herself immersed in a series of disturbing events related to the recent discovery of the mummy of Neféret. While Louise is dedicated to the study of this mummy, known for her malice, mysterious incidents occur, including the presence of a cobra in the sarcophagus, sowing panic among the research team. Mathis (Stéphane Metzger), the archaeologist behind the discovery, was under Louise's spell, but he struggled to make him forget a recent disappointment in love that forced him to take refuge in his work. Josephine must navigate through the mysteries surrounding Neferet and help Louise regain confidence in her, while facing the dark forces that seem to haunt the archaeological site.

programme.title: Sarah Bernhardt, the Divine
programme.desc: In 1916, after a brilliant performance of theatrical performances alongside his accomplice Lucien Guitry, Sarah Bernhardt (Sandrine Kiberlain) found himself confronted with a difficult personal event: amputation of one of her legs. She was hospitalized and visited Sacha Guitry, a young man seeking his own way away from her father. In this moment of vulnerability, Sarah is back on track, plunging us in 1896 during the preparations for the "Sarah Bernhardt Day", an event celebrating her immense talent. This time, marked by his passion for theatre, revealed promises and disillusionments. As Sarah prepares to shine on stage, she discovers that Lucien, the man she is caught with, has crossed the path of a young woman, sowing the seeds of a grief that will mark her life. programme.title: Twilight, Chapter 2: Temptation
programme.desc: Bella understands that Victoria has not given up her revenge plans. She's actually raising an army of vampires. The Cullen and Quileutes agreed to join forces, despite the hatred that was against them. But shortly before the battle, Bella had to choose between Jacob and Edward...
programme.desc-more: Bella Swan (Kristen Stewart), now linked to Edward Cullen (Robert Pattinson) by a passion as intense as forbidden, celebrates his 18th birthday surrounded by the adoptive vampire family of his beloved. The Cullen, led by the charismatic and protective Carlisle (Peter Facinelli), try to lead a discreet existence, fighting every day against their thirst for blood. Yet, at this evening, which was to be joyful, an incident upsets everything: Jasper (Jackson Rathbone), whose control over his vampiric nature remains fragile, is submerged by instinct in front of a mere drop of blood. The precarious balance on which the Cullen co-existence with humans is based is suddenly threatened. Stunned that his family would not pose a mortal danger to Bella, Edward made a radical decision: leaving Forks to protect her, despite the unbearable pain that this separation inflicted on her. Abandoned and heartbroken, Bella sinks into a deep depression, haunted by memories of her lost love and hallucinations that constantly bring her back to him. It is in this moment of extreme vulnerability that she approaches Jacob Black (Taylor Lautner), her childhood friend with a comforting smile. Their bond is strengthened, offering Bella a semblance of comfort in her suffering. But Jacob hides a heavy secret, linked to an ancestral curse that turns him into a werewolf, a member of a pack that has been at war for generations against vampires.

programme.title: New York, Criminal Section
programme.desc: "The flamber" Goren and Eames investigate the murder of a respectable man, found dead in a river. His death is apparently related to a gambling debt.
programme.desc-more: In this fifth season of "New York, Criminal Section", Inspectors Robert Goren (Vincent D'Onofrio) and Alexandra Eames (Kathryn Erbe) welcome two new officers, Veteran Mike Logan (Chris Not) and Inspector Carolyn Barek (Annabella Sciorra). Although the two investigators' duos never cross, each one is confronted with complex and intriguing cases. Goren and Eames find themselves facing a grieving patriarch (Malcolm McDowell), whose grief hides dark secrets, while Logan and Barek have to navigate the tumults of a charismatic adoptive mother (Whoopi Goldberg), whose protégés seem to have drifted to crime. This season is distinguished by its innovative formula, where each pair of actors devotes themselves to only half a season, with one episode in two. Fred Dalton Thompson also made a striking appearance, adding a familiar touch to this new dynamic within the "Law & Order" universe.

This season is distinguished by its innovative formula, where each pair of actors devotes themselves to only half a season, with one episode in two. Fred Dalton Thompson also made a striking appearance, adding a familiar touch to this new dynamic within the "Law & Order" universe.

programme.title: Love, glory and beauty
programme.desc: The Forresters rule the fashion world in Los Angeles but they're not the only ones. Over the years, other families, the Spectra, the Logan, the Marone and the Spencers, have been making them dark. Each clan is full of dark secrets often poorly hidden. Love intrigues are so effervescent that the two main young women in the Forrester family, Brooke and Taylor, do not count or distinguish their marriages, lovers and children. A soap-opera almost legendaire, mixing its intrigues since its creation in 1987.

Schooled in a new high school, they have to integrate into this very different environment from the one in which they used to be. While Brenda meets Kelly and Donna, Brandon meets Dylan, a young rebel man who does not leave the girls indifferent. Steve, Andrea and David are also quickly part of their knowledge.

programme.title: New York Special Unit
programme.desc: Benson and Stabler investigate both an Islamophobic hate crime, a high school shooting, slave trafficking and a violent husband, and the multitude of sexual maniacs running the streets of New York. Their already trying investigations become almost impossible when victims themselves hesitate to testify. When two parents refuse to report a child to a paedophile in exchange for a large sum of money, Stabler's blood is only a turn. An episode inspired, like many others, by real facts. At the end of the season, Alexandra Cabot's character left his post and would only appear sporadically.
programme.desc-more: In the hectic New York City, the Special Police Unit is dedicated to the fight against sexual crimes and cases involving vulnerable victims, orchestrated by the determined detective Olivia Benson (Mariska Hargitay). Each episode plunges investigators into often sordid and complex situations where the discovery of a revolting crime requires their sensitivity and professionalism. The members of this unit, composed of experienced detectives, are engaged in thorough investigations, gathering evidence and interviewing suspects with the aim of bringing the culprits to justice. Cases, including rape, abuse of minors and sexual trafficking, are not only sensitive but also emotionally stressful. The Special Unit would not only act as investigators, but also as support for victims, highlighting their trauma and the challenges they face in rebuilding themselves.

programme.title: New York Special Unit
programme.desc: Can we leave two sexual predators at liberty on the grounds that they must testify soon against a mafia godfather? Is it permissible to take cells from a woman in a coma, even in the interests of medicine? Should we excuse the transgender victim of rape if she kills her assailant? Several cases of conscience torment the team of the special unit. The hearings did not end for this fourth season, in which Sherilyn Fenn, Pam Grier, Rob Estes and Fred Savage participated, impressive in the role of a rapist who himself defended and stood up to prosecutor Cabot.

programme.title: Friends
programme.sub-title: The one who was doing a job interview
programme.desc: "He who was in a job interview"After having been subjected to a disastrous gastronomic criticism, Monica decides to take cooking classes. Rachel suffers from jealousy.
programme.desc-more: While the candles of Monica Geller's (Courteney Cox) and Chandler Bing (Matthew Perry) wedding are barely out, news of Rachel Green's (Jennifer Aniston) pregnancy is beginning to spread, creating a palpable tension within the group of friends. Ross Geller (David Schwimmer) and Rachel are trying to navigate this delicate situation, seeking to establish a stable friendship while managing their complex feelings. Rachel, seeking to get closer to Ross, moved home, which made it even more difficult, especially when Ross's new girlfriend, Mona, proposed to write common greeting cards, adding an extra layer of confusion to their dynamics. Meanwhile, Joey Tribbiani (Matt LeBlanc) made an unexpected revelation that could upset the fragile balance of the band. This season, acclaimed by critics, highlights Jennifer Aniston's actress talents, hailed by nominations for the Emmy Awards.

programme.sub-title: The one who didn't ask anyone to marry

programme.desc-more: In this memorable season of the iconic series, friendship and relationships continue to become complex for the inseparable group. While Chandler Bing (Matthew Perry) and Monica Geller (Courteney Cox) are embarking on an unexpected adventure trying to design a child in a maternity closet, the dynamics between other friends are changing. Joey Tribbiani (Matt LeBlanc), in a misunderstanding, finds himself improvising a meeting between Phoebe Buffay (Lisa Kudrow) and a mysterious stranger, Mike (Paul Rudd), who might well upset her life. Meanwhile, Rachel Green (Jennifer Aniston) is back on the job, and her feelings towards Ross Geller (David Schwimmer) are getting complicated, especially with the arrival of Charlie, a seductive colleague. Tensions rise and laughter is coming as each navigates through the joys and challenges of love, friendship and careers, all with unforgettable humour.

Meanwhile, Rachel Green (Jennifer Aniston) is back on the job, and her feelings towards Ross Geller (David Schwimmer) are getting complicated, especially with the arrival of Charlie, a seductive colleague. Tensions rise and laughter is coming as each navigates through the joys and challenges of love, friendship and careers, all with unforgettable humour.

programme.title: Christmas in Notting Hill
programme.desc: Georgia, a special educator for children in difficulty, travels to London to spend Christmas with her little sister, Lizzie, and meet her boyfriend. At Notting Hill Market, she accidentally stumbles upon the beautiful and mysterious Graham, who immediately seduces her. But she doesn't know Graham is none other than Henry's brother, sister's fiancé and... a national football star.

programme.title: Christmas at the fire
programme.desc: As Christmas approaches, Rose, an American woman who lives on real estate speculation, buys a small cottage in Dunclare, on the Irish coast, where her mother lived briefly in the 1980s. When she arrived there, Rose had an appointment with Sean, the real estate agent who sold her the house. What she doesn't know is that she's going to have to negotiate with him to be able to carry out the renovation work of the cottage, much more delabrant than she thought. Decided to sell, she embarked on some beautification work, and took advantage of the local Christmas traditions during her stay. But his relationship with Sean gradually takes on another turn and this trip to Ireland becomes an opportunity for a great challenge.

programme.title: On the way to Christmas
programme.desc: Following a flight cancellation, a group of 9 unknown people wishing to go to Denver for Christmas decides to rent a van and go together. Despite their differences, they will learn to know each other and unexpected bonds will form, which will change their lives forever.

programme.title: Twilight, chapter 4: Revelation, part 1
programme.desc: In Forks, the small town wrapped in haze and mysteries, the announcement of the marriage between Bella Swan (Kristen Stewart), a young man as determined as he is vulnerable, and Edward Cullen (Robert Pattinson), a vampire with a dark and tormented past, divides their loved ones. Between hopes and fears, reactions are blurred between sincere joy and deepest concerns, including those of Charlie (Billy Burke), Bella's father, who struggles to accept this extraordinary union. On the eve of the ceremony, Edward, gnawed by guilt, confides in Bella a heavy secret: in his youth as a rebel vampire, he hunted and killed humans, a confession that could have broken their relationship. Yet Bella, whose love for Edward transcends the boundaries of morality and reason, chooses to accept him unreservedly. The wedding day finally arrives, surrounded by a magical atmosphere and full of tension. Even Jacob Black (Taylor Lautner), the heart-torn werewolf whose feelings for Bella have never weakened, made a discreet appearance, unable to stay away from her despite the pain that this union inflicts on her. As the newlyweds fly to an idyllic honeymoon in Brazil, their happiness seems at last to be within reach. But fate, ruthless, reserves to Bella a revelation as unexpected as alarming: she carries in her the child of Edward, a pregnancy that defies the laws of nature and endangers her life. Between the ecstasy of absolute love and the anguish of an uncertain future, Bella and Edward find themselves faced with a heartbreaking choice, where every decision could have irreversible consequences for them... And for those who are dear to them. Alliances will be tested, loyalty questioned, and best-kept secrets threaten to burst out.

programme.title: The Addams family values
programme.desc: In his sinister mansion, Morticia Addams (Anjelica Huston) just gave birth to a boy. The mustache newborn is named after Puberté. While this birth filled with joy her husband, Gomez (Raúl Juliá), she hardly rejoiced Wednesday (Christina Ricci) and Pugsley (Jimmy Workman), the couple's two elders. While the latter use all the schemes to get rid of the bambin, Morticia and Gomez decide to hire Debbie Jellinsky (Joan Cusack) to take care of them. Still single, Uncle Fétide (Christopher Lloyd) falls under the charm of the new arrival, unaware that she has rid herself of her rich husbands in the past.

programme.title: Beverly Hills
programme.desc: Clare, Kelly, Donna and Valérie go together on weekends in the mountains. On the way, each one reveals his secrets and his passions. Valerie reveals her story with Ray.
programme.desc-more: Jim and Cindy Walsh moved from Minnesota to a home in Beverly Hills, a cossuous town in Los Angeles County, California. Their twins, Brandon and Brenda, followed them. Schooled in a new high school, they have to integrate into this very different environment from the one in which they used to be. While Brenda meets Kelly and Donna, Brandon meets Dylan, a young rebel man who does not leave the girls indifferent. Steve, Andrea and David are also quickly part of their knowledge.

programme.title: Camping Paradis
programme.sub-title: It's a bit of a break at the campsite.
programme.desc: Discover the summary of the episodes of season 3 of the Camping Paradis series
programme.desc-more: Tom Delormes (Laurent Ournac) is the passionate manager of a family campsite located on the beautiful Mediterranean coast. Its mission: to ensure a constant flow of campers to various and often eccentric personalities, while resolving unforeseen events that disturb the holidays of its clients. With his faithful friend Philippe (Eric Geynes) at his side, Tom works every day to create a welcoming and friendly atmosphere, transforming logistical challenges into opportunities for laughter and solidarity. In this picturesque setting, each episode features crazy situations, unexpected quiproquos and humorous resolutions where mutual aid and camaraderie are essential. Whether they are unconformative couples seeking to revive their flames, or families struggling to regain the sense of harmony, Tom and his team are committed to making each stay memorable.

programme.title: Team explores
programme.desc: In professional football, sex remains a subject surrounded by taboos, between received ideas and performance discourse.
programme.desc-more: In recent years, multiple gender-related cases have splashed the world of football, some even finishing in court to condemn the violence committed by players. The sex relationship of the latter questions: are they all addicted? Have they turned into a world where temptations are too great, and where money and glory provide a sense of impunity? Are others more victims of their success? And is there still room for love? Diving in the backstage of a world often opaque to try to break a taboo.

programme.title: 36 Goldsmith's Pier
programme.desc: Two PJ officers are seeking to stop the actions of a group of robbers. This situation exacerbates the rivalry between the two men.
programme.desc-more: For several months now, in Paris, a gang of robbers has been operating with impunity with rare violence. The director of the judicial police, Robert Mancini (André Dussollier), was perfectly clear with the 2 lieutenants Léo Vrinks (Daniel Auteuil) and Denis Klein (Gérard Depardieu): the one who will bring down this gang will replace him at his position of "great boss" of 36, quai des Orfèvres. The struggle is open between these two great cops, once friends, who today separate everything: their lives, their methods, their teams and a woman, Camille Vrinks (Valeria Golino).

programme.desc: Charles would like to have an alcoholic father who has been ill-treated by his child since his wife died, but Dr. Baker has another idea.
programme.desc-more: In the peaceful community of Walnut Grove, an invisible threat is emerging: an epidemic of typhus, triggered by an invasion of rats. As the first cases begin to appear, fear and uncertainty take hold of the inhabitants. Charles Ingalls (Michael Landon) and his family are facing this unprecedented health crisis, while Caroline Ingalls (Karen Grassle) is concerned about the health of their children, Laura (Melissa Gilbert) and Mary (Melissa Sue Anderson). The church, usually a place of gathering and joy, is transformed into a quarantine centre, where the sick are isolated to avoid the spread of the disease. Tensions are rising as villagers show solidarity and courage in the face of this dramatic situation. Children, including Carrie (Lindsay Greenbush) and Grace (Sidney Greenbush), are discovering the realities of community life, learning the importance of helping each other in difficult times.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: Charles Ingalls persuaded his neighbours to entrust their money to a young agronomist, so that he could buy wheat seeds. The engineer is the victim of an accident.
programme.desc-more: Graham Stewart, a young boy, goes to school every day with marks of beatings visible on his body, testifying to the violence he is experiencing at home. His comrades, though concerned, dare not intervene in the tragic situation of their friend. The situation reached a point of no return when his father, drunk and in a state of destructive anger, put Graham's life in danger. Caroline Ingalls (Karen Grassle), the mother of a caring family, cannot stand by and takes the initiative to encourage the community to act to protect the unhappy child. In parallel, Charles Ingalls (Michael Landon) decided to settle with Graham's father John Stewart to help him detoxify himself and deal with his demons. Meanwhile, Graham was welcomed to the Ingalls, where he hoped to find comfort and security, far from the violence that had marked his daily life.

Buck discovers new cognitive abilities after being struck by lightning. Eddie tests his talent in a poker game with firefighters.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant city of Los Angeles, the 118 relief team, led by Bobby Nash (Peter Krause), are facing increasingly unpredictable and dramatic emergencies. Whether it is a burning airship threatening a crowded stage or the collapse of a conference-hosting structure, each intervention tests not only their professional expertise, but also their personal ties. Meanwhile, Maya (Michelle Hurd) and Bobby have to deal with their new reality at home, while their son Harry is in Miami with Michael (Rockmond Dunbar) and David (Kenneth Choi). The challenges of daily life intertwine with the adrenaline of interventions, revealing the depth of the characters and the sacrifices they make. Over the course of the sixth season, rescuers discover that the real heroism lies as much in the action as in the management of the emotional crises that affect them outside of their work.

programme.title: The Rookie: Los Angeles Cop
programme.desc: After the Armstrong case broke, John Nolan was blamed and his training period extended for a month. This sanction is accompanied by a visit to a disciplinary commission and may well ruin his chances of becoming an inspector or joining a specialized unit. Promote investigator, Lopez prefers to keep her pregnancy quiet, fearing that she will be treated differently if she knows. Shortened by the pandemic, this third season is the shortest of the series with only 14 episodes.
programme.desc-more: Recently divorced and faced with a major turning point in his life, John Nolan (Nathan Fillion), a man aged 40 years, finds himself somewhat lost after his son left for university. On an ordinary day, he became a witness to a bank robbery where he barely escaped death. This traumatic event leads him to a profound introspection on his life choices and the path he wishes to take. Driven by a strong desire to change his life, John decided to leave his old life behind and settle in Los Angeles to fulfill his dream of becoming a policeman. As a new LAPD member, he must navigate in a complex environment where danger and stress are pervasive. At the earliest age of recruits, he found himself under the wing of Talia Bishop (Alyssa Diaz), his educational determination, who would have to help him overcome the specific challenges associated with his unique situation. Between training events, police intrigues and the need to prove its worth to younger colleagues, John Nolan will have to show courage and resilience while finding his place in a constantly changing world.

On an ordinary day, he became a witness to a bank robbery where he barely escaped death. This traumatic event leads him to a profound introspection on his life choices and the path he wishes to take. Driven by a strong desire to change his life, John decided to leave his old life behind and settle in Los Angeles to fulfill his dream of becoming a policeman. As a new LAPD member, he must navigate in a complex environment where danger and stress are pervasive. At the earliest age of recruits, he found himself under the wing of Talia Bishop (Alyssa Diaz), his educational determination, who would have to help him overcome the specific challenges associated with his unique situation. Between training events, police intrigues and the need to prove its worth to younger colleagues, John Nolan will have to show courage and resilience while finding his place in a constantly changing world.

programme.title: Hawaii 5-0
programme.desc: A young man, suffering from post-traumatic stress and receiving hypnosis therapy, has just realized that he may have witnessed a murder.
programme.desc-more: After leaving the hospital, Steve McGarrett (Alex O'Loughlin) and Danny Williams (Scott Caan) quickly returned to duty in Special Unit 5-0, where a murder investigation was awaiting them. The case takes an intriguing turn when the victim's body is discovered in the 5-0's premises, raising questions about the team's safety. As they try to solve this mystery, the agents must also work with an MI-6 agent to track down a formidable terrorist, responsible for an attack on the British embassy in Madrid. Barely the case closed, McGarrett and Alicia, a key figure on his team, became targets of a serial killer, who did not hesitate to remove them. Meanwhile, the rest of the team, including members like Chin Ho Kelly (Daniel Kim) and Kono Kalakaua (Grace Park), is mobilizing to save them, leading to unexpected twists in this season full of action and suspense.

programme.title: A treasure in your home
programme.desc: What if a treasure hides in your attic? In each episode, a private individual opens his or her doors, convinced to own a nugget: rare stamps, family jewels, old vase or forgotten old instrument. programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: A typhu epidemic has several victims in Walnut Grove. Charles is trying to determine the origin of the disease. It seems that it's being propagated by rats.
programme.desc-more: In the peaceful community of Walnut Grove, an invisible threat is emerging: an epidemic of typhus, triggered by an invasion of rats. As the first cases begin to appear, fear and uncertainty take hold of the inhabitants. Charles Ingalls (Michael Landon) and his family are facing this unprecedented health crisis, while Caroline Ingalls (Karen Grassle) is concerned about the health of their children, Laura (Melissa Gilbert) and Mary (Melissa Sue Anderson). The church, usually a place of gathering and joy, is transformed into a quarantine centre, where the sick are isolated to avoid the spread of the disease. Tensions are rising as villagers show solidarity and courage in the face of this dramatic situation. Children, including Carrie (Lindsay Greenbush) and Grace (Sidney Greenbush), are discovering the realities of community life, learning the importance of helping each other in difficult times.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: Charles would like to have an alcoholic father who has been ill-treated by his child since his wife died, but Dr. Baker has another idea.
programme.desc-more: Graham Stewart, a young boy, goes to school every day with marks of beatings visible on his body, testifying to the violence he is experiencing at home. His comrades, though concerned, dare not intervene in the tragic situation of their friend. The situation reached a point of no return when his father, drunk and in a state of destructive anger, put Graham's life in danger. Caroline Ingalls (Karen Grassle), the mother of a caring family, cannot stand by and takes the initiative to encourage the community to act to protect the unhappy child. In parallel, Charles Ingalls (Michael Landon) decided to settle with Graham's father John Stewart to help him detoxify himself and deal with his demons. Meanwhile, Graham was welcomed to the Ingalls, where he hoped to find comfort and security, far from the violence that had marked his daily life.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: Charles Ingalls persuaded his neighbours to entrust their money to a young agronomist, so that he could buy wheat seeds. The engineer is the victim of an accident.
programme.desc-more: In a small rural community, Charles Ingalls (Michael Landon) plays the leadership role in convincing his neighbours to entrust their money to a promising young agronomist. The latter, determined to transform the land of the region, is entrusted with the task of purchasing quality wheat seeds to ensure a successful harvest. However, as he embarks on this crucial mission, the young agronomist is suffering an unfortunate accident that complicates things. Unfortunately, that's not all: he is also the victim of a robbery orchestrated by ill-intentioned individuals, threatening not only his project, but also the economies of his investors. In the face of this alarming situation, Charles and the members of the community must unite to overcome this crisis, rediscover their solidarity and face the consequences of their blind trust, while seeking to save their agricultural future.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: When the Ingalls come back from town, they learn that a Sioux is wanted by the sheriff. Later, Charles met the Indian...
programme.desc-more: As the Ingalls family prepares for a family outing, Charles Ingalls (Michael Landon) decides to take Caroline (Karen Grassle) and their children, Laura (Melissa Gilbert), Mary (Melissa Sue Anderson), and the twins Carrie (Lindsay Greenbush and Sidney Greenbush) on a promenade in Mankato. This getaway takes an unexpected turn when, on the way back, a violent storm rises. Looking for a refuge, the family finds an abandoned cabin, where they hope to wait for bad weather to pass. However, the situation became more complicated when Charles, in search of food, ventured into the woods to hunt. In his determination to support his family, he finds himself confronted with unforeseen dangers, endangering his life. This moment of tension reveals not only the dangers of nature, but also the strength of family ties, while Caroline and the children are worried about their father.

118 went to the scene of a fire that had occurred in an accounting firm. The team also supports the injured in a car accident.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant city of Los Angeles, the 118 relief team, led by Bobby Nash (Peter Krause), are facing increasingly unpredictable and dramatic emergencies. Whether it is a burning airship threatening a crowded stage or the collapse of a conference-hosting structure, each intervention tests not only their professional expertise, but also their personal ties. Meanwhile, Maya (Michelle Hurd) and Bobby have to deal with their new reality at home, while their son Harry is in Miami with Michael (Rockmond Dunbar) and David (Kenneth Choi). The challenges of daily life intertwine with the adrenaline of interventions, revealing the depth of the characters and the sacrifices they make. Over the course of the sixth season, rescuers discover that the real heroism lies as much in the action as in the management of the emotional crises that affect them outside of their work.

Athena and Bobby board their honeymoon cruise, but when duty calls them, their vacations are put on hold.
programme.desc-more: The long-awaited honeymoon of Athena Grant (Angela Bassett) and Bobby Nash (Peter Krause) takes an unexpected turn when they find themselves trapped in a catastrophic situation on their cruise. Meanwhile, Buck (Oliver Stark) is entering a new relationship that allows him to better understand his own emotions and rediscover himself, while navigating the complexities of love and commitment. Maddie (Jennifer Love Hewitt) and Chimney (Kenneth Choi) are preparing to celebrate their union, surrounded by their loved ones and colleagues, highlighting the joys and challenges of wedding preparations. At the same time, Harry (Gavin McHugh), Athena's son, returns to Los Angeles, crossing the path of people with varied stories, bringing their share of surprises and twists. This final season, as intense as the first, celebrates the 100th episode, mixing action, emotion and humour.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: Since the death of his mother, a child has been abused by his father, who became an alcoholic. Charles would like this violent parent to be sent to prison, but Dr. Baker suggests that he should take a detoxification cure...
programme.desc-more: Graham Stewart, a young boy, goes to school every day with marks of beatings visible on his body, testifying to the violence he is experiencing at home. His comrades, though concerned, dare not intervene in the tragic situation of their friend. The situation reached a point of no return when his father, drunk and in a state of destructive anger, put Graham's life in danger. Caroline Ingalls (Karen Grassle), the mother of a caring family, cannot stand by and takes the initiative to encourage the community to act to protect the unhappy child. In parallel, Charles Ingalls (Michael Landon) decided to settle with Graham's father John Stewart to help him detoxify himself and deal with his demons. Meanwhile, Graham was welcomed to the Ingalls, where he hoped to find comfort and security, far from the violence that had marked his daily life.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: Charles Ingalls persuaded his neighbors to entrust their money to a young agronomist, so that he could buy wheat seeds. The engineer is the victim of an accident, in which he is robbed...
programme.desc-more: In a small rural community, Charles Ingalls (Michael Landon) plays the leadership role in convincing his neighbours to entrust their money to a promising young agronomist. The latter, determined to transform the land of the region, is entrusted with the task of purchasing quality wheat seeds to ensure a successful harvest. However, as he embarks on this crucial mission, the young agronomist is suffering an unfortunate accident that complicates things. Unfortunately, that's not all: he is also the victim of a robbery orchestrated by ill-intentioned individuals, threatening not only his project, but also the economies of his investors. In the face of this alarming situation, Charles and the members of the community must unite to overcome this crisis, rediscover their solidarity and face the consequences of their blind trust, while seeking to save their agricultural future.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: When the Ingalls come back from town, they learn that a Sioux is wanted by the sheriff. Later, Charles met the Indian...
programme.desc-more: As the Ingalls family prepares for a family outing, Charles Ingalls (Michael Landon) decides to take Caroline (Karen Grassle) and their children, Laura (Melissa Gilbert), Mary (Melissa Sue Anderson), and the twins Carrie (Lindsay Greenbush and Sidney Greenbush) on a promenade in Mankato. This getaway takes an unexpected turn when, on the way back, a violent storm rises. Looking for a refuge, the family finds an abandoned cabin, where they hope to wait for bad weather to pass. However, the situation became more complicated when Charles, in search of food, ventured into the woods to hunt. In his determination to support his family, he finds himself confronted with unforeseen dangers, endangering his life. This moment of tension reveals not only the dangers of nature, but also the strength of family ties, while Caroline and the children are worried about their father.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: Johnny Johnson, the farm boy, decides to go live in town. Mr Edwards accompanies him and promises to protect him from the temptations of the city...
programme.desc-more: In the episode "Discovering the World" of the iconic series "The Little House in the Prairie," Johnny Johnson, a young dreamer, feels a deep need for escape and decides to leave the family farm to explore the world around him. Despite the efforts of Isaiah Edwards (Victor French), a family friend who tries to deter him from this urban adventure, Johnny remains determined. Isaiah, concerned about the safety of the adolescent, finally chose to accompany him, hoping to protect him from the dangers and temptations of urban life. Once in town, Johnny meets Mimi Monroe, a young woman who immediately captures her heart. As he immerse himself in this new environment, Isaiah is developing a bold plan: he promises Mimi a financial reward if she manages to convince Johnny to return home. This episode explores the themes of innocence, life choices and the realities of adulthood, while highlighting the challenges of friendship and love.
