In the vibrant city of Los Angeles, the 118 relief team, led by Bobby Nash (Peter Krause), are facing increasingly unpredictable and dramatic emergencies. Whether it is a burning airship threatening a crowded stage or the collapse of a conference-hosting structure, each intervention tests not only their professional expertise, but also their personal ties. Meanwhile, Maya (Michelle Hurd) and Bobby have to deal with their new reality at home, while their son Harry is in Miami with Michael (Rockmond Dunbar) and David (Kenneth Choi). The challenges of daily life intertwine with the adrenaline of interventions, revealing the depth of the characters and the sacrifices they make. Over the course of the sixth season, rescuers discover that the real heroism lies as much in the action as in the management of the emotional crises that affect them outside of their work.
programme.desc-more: 9-1-1 is a dramatic series that plunges into the heart of the crises that hit American citizens and highlights the heroic work of first responders. Through stories from police, firefighters and ambulances, the series offers us a perspective on the challenges they face on a daily basis. Each episode reminds us of the crucial importance of the 9-1-1 emergency number, which is a true link between those in distress and those who work for their safety. The heroes of this series are embodied in a casting composed of Angela Bassett in the role of Athena Grant, a determined and competent police officer, and Peter Krause in the role of Bobby Nash, the fire chief. Together, they lead a diverse team of stakeholders, each bringing their unique skills and personal stories. Jennifer Love Hewitt also joins the casting as a 9-1-1 operator, who has to navigate in stressful situations while facing her own emotional struggles. At each episode, viewers witness moments of extreme tension, whether in dangerous interventions, tragic accidents or personal crises. The series deals with real social issues, such as domestic violence, natural disasters and even unlikely catastrophic situations, while exploring how these events affect not only victims but also the actors themselves. Between moments of bravery and vulnerability, 9 -1-1 reminds us that behind every call to 9-1-1 is a human history, full of courage, sacrifice and hope. Thus, this series invites the public to reflect on the essential role these heroes play in our lives. 9-1-1 is not only a series of emergency interventions, but also an exploration of human ties in times of crisis, while paying tribute to those who risk their lives to save others' lives.

The long-awaited honeymoon of Athena Grant (Angela Bassett) and Bobby Nash (Peter Krause) takes an unexpected turn when they find themselves trapped in a catastrophic situation on their cruise. Meanwhile, Buck (Oliver Stark) is entering a new relationship that allows him to better understand his own emotions and rediscover himself, while navigating the complexities of love and commitment. Maddie (Jennifer Love Hewitt) and Chimney (Kenneth Choi) are preparing to celebrate their union, surrounded by their loved ones and colleagues, highlighting the joys and challenges of wedding preparations. At the same time, Harry (Gavin McHugh), Athena's son, returns to Los Angeles, crossing the path of people with varied stories, bringing their share of surprises and twists. This final season, as intense as the first, celebrates the 100th episode, mixing action, emotion and humour.

programme.title: Bear
programme.desc: Youk bear runs happy days with her mother. But a stone that detachs itself from a rock wall makes it orphan. Disembodied, he wanders in the wild in search of some comfort, which he believes he finds with Kodiak Kaar, an adult bear. He agrees to take it under his protection...

programme.title: Gaston Lagaffe
programme.desc: As a member of Peticoin, Prunelle saw a large sachata landing in the village named Gaston. The intern does not start until noon and is a siesta-like student. Which has the gift of deeply annoying Prunelle. Especially since he is the cost of the young man's wild inventions. He's gonna do everything he can to get Gaston to work...
programme.desc-more: At the heart of this adventure is Gaston Lagaffe (Theo Fernandez), a young man as generous as he is clumsy, whose arrival at the Peticoin newspaper will upset the already precarious balance of the editorial staff. Armed with a boundless imagination and a keen sense of innovation, Gaston keeps inventing farfelus gadgets, which are supposed to simplify the lives of his colleagues. Yet his creations, often as unpredictable as they are uncontrollable, transform each day into a succession of more baffled disasters. Gaston is driven by a sincere desire to do good around him, but his initiatives are especially exasperated by his boss, Prunelle. The latter, already overwhelmed by the challenges of running a newspaper in difficulty, sees with a very bad eye the eccentricities of his intern. But Gaston is not the only one who is sowing the peticoin mess: the threatening shadow of Monsieur de Mesmaeker hovering over the editorial staff. This dreadful businessman, ready to do anything to get hold of the newspaper, represents a real threat to the future of the Peticoin and its employees. Between Gaston's catastrophic inventions, Prunelle's nerve attacks and Mr de Mesmaeker's devious maneuvers, the newspaper's survival seems more uncertain than ever.

programme.title: A dream life
programme.desc: Istanbul. Sanem Aydın dreams of becoming a novelist, but is forced to work in the family grocery store. To escape an arranged marriage, she accepted a position in an advertising agency, where she met the boss Can Divit, a barouder photographer who had recently returned to the city. Alchemy is immediate, but the obstacles are numerous.

programme.desc-more: In the peaceful community of Walnut Grove, an invisible threat is emerging: an epidemic of typhus, triggered by an invasion of rats. As the first cases begin to appear, fear and uncertainty take hold of the inhabitants. Charles Ingalls (Michael Landon) and his family are facing this unprecedented health crisis, while Caroline Ingalls (Karen Grassle) is concerned about the health of their children, Laura (Melissa Gilbert) and Mary (Melissa Sue Anderson). The church, usually a place of gathering and joy, is transformed into a quarantine centre, where the sick are isolated to avoid the spread of the disease. Tensions are rising as villagers show solidarity and courage in the face of this dramatic situation. Children, including Carrie (Lindsay Greenbush) and Grace (Sidney Greenbush), are discovering the realities of community life, learning the importance of helping each other in difficult times.

In the vibrant city of Los Angeles, the 118 relief team, led by Bobby Nash (Peter Krause), are facing increasingly unpredictable and dramatic emergencies. Whether it is a burning airship threatening a crowded stage or the collapse of a conference-hosting structure, each intervention tests not only their professional expertise, but also their personal ties. Meanwhile, Maya (Michelle Hurd) and Bobby have to deal with their new reality at home, while their son Harry is in Miami with Michael (Rockmond Dunbar) and David (Kenneth Choi). The challenges of daily life intertwine with the adrenaline of interventions, revealing the depth of the characters and the sacrifices they make. Over the course of the sixth season, rescuers discover that the real heroism lies as much in the action as in the management of the emotional crises that affect them outside of their work.
programme.desc-more: 9-1-1 is a dramatic series that plunges into the heart of the crises that hit American citizens and highlights the heroic work of first responders. Through stories from police, firefighters and ambulances, the series offers us a perspective on the challenges they face on a daily basis. Each episode reminds us of the crucial importance of the 9-1-1 emergency number, which is a true link between those in distress and those who work for their safety. The heroes of this series are embodied in a casting composed of Angela Bassett in the role of Athena Grant, a determined and competent police officer, and Peter Krause in the role of Bobby Nash, the fire chief. Together, they lead a diverse team of stakeholders, each bringing their unique skills and personal stories. Jennifer Love Hewitt also joins the casting as a 9-1-1 operator, who has to navigate in stressful situations while facing her own emotional struggles. At each episode, viewers witness moments of extreme tension, whether in dangerous interventions, tragic accidents or personal crises. The series deals with real social issues, such as domestic violence, natural disasters and even unlikely catastrophic situations, while exploring how these events affect not only victims but also the actors themselves. Between moments of bravery and vulnerability, 9 -1-1 reminds us that behind every call to 9-1-1 is a human history, full of courage, sacrifice and hope. Thus, this series invites the public to reflect on the essential role these heroes play in our lives. 9-1-1 is not only a series of emergency interventions, but also an exploration of human ties in times of crisis, while paying tribute to those who risk their lives to save others' lives.

programme.title: Kaamelott
programme.desc: In the fifth century, King Arthur and his prious knights tried to raise up the divine mission entrusted to them: to go in search of the Holy Grail.
programme.desc-more: The island of Brittany, in the fifth century. His legends, battles, the fantastic and respectable adventures of the Knights of the Round Table, gathered around their powerful and magnanimous King Arthur. But looking closer, Arthur is not always as wise as he would like to think, and his dear wife Guinevere is not the erudite nymph related by history, but rather a naive woman who keeps exasperating her husband. Guinevere's father, Leodagan, king of Carmellia, is a warmaniac who only thinks of fighting the other peoples, while his mother, Séli, is an ambitious acariquist always quick to share her bad mood with the kingdom. As for the famous Knights of the Round Table, they are not so brave and philanthropic that we are told that they want to believe it. Perceval and Karadoc are poltrons who are better at making the tavern of the village go bad than in fulfilling the missions entrusted to them by King Arthur. Yvain and Gauvain are two teenagers seeking glory but unable to prove their courage. Bohort is more interested in fashion than in fighting, and Merlin is an enchanter whose spells usually turn against him. King Arthur is embodied by talented Alexandre Astier, who is one of the three creators of the series with Alain Kappauf (Camera Café) and Jean-Yves Robin. He knows how to work with the family, since he shares the screen with Lionnel Astier (Leodagan of Carmelide) and Simon Astier (Yvain), who is the main hero of Hero Corp.

programme.title: A treasure in your home
programme.desc: What if a treasure hides in your attic? In each episode, a private individual opens his or her doors, convinced to own a nugget: rare stamps, family jewels, old vase or forgotten old instrument. He entrusts us with the estimate he makes and what he dreams of accomplishing with that sum. Then visit a auctioneer, whose expert verdict sometimes contains cruel disillusionments... or beautiful surprises !!

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: As the Ingalls family prepares for a family outing, Charles Ingalls (Michael Landon) decides to take Caroline (Karen Grassle) and their children, Laura (Melissa Gilbert), Mary (Melissa Sue Anderson), and the twins Carrie (Lindsay Greenbush and Sidney Greenbush) on a promenade in Mankato. This getaway takes an unexpected turn when, on the way back, a violent storm rises. Looking for a refuge, the family finds an abandoned cabin, where they hope to wait for bad weather to pass. However, the situation became more complicated when Charles, in search of food, ventured into the woods to hunt. In his determination to support his family, he finds himself confronted with unforeseen dangers, endangering his life. This moment of tension reveals not only the dangers of nature, but also the strength of family ties, while Caroline and the children are worried about their father.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: In the episode "Discovering the World" of the iconic series "The Little House in the Prairie," Johnny Johnson, a young dreamer, feels a deep need for escape and decides to leave the family farm to explore the world around him. Despite the efforts of Isaiah Edwards (Victor French), a family friend who tries to deter him from this urban adventure, Johnny remains determined. Isaiah, concerned about the safety of the adolescent, finally chose to accompany him, hoping to protect him from the dangers and temptations of urban life. Once in town, Johnny meets Mimi Monroe, a young woman who immediately captures her heart. As he immerse himself in this new environment, Isaiah is developing a bold plan: he promises Mimi a financial reward if she manages to convince Johnny to return home. This episode explores the themes of innocence, life choices and the realities of adulthood, while highlighting the challenges of friendship and love.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: In Walnut Grove, the effervescence is at its peak as the annual celebration approaches, promising laughter and friendly competitions. Laura Ingalls (Melissa Gilbert) and her sister Mary (Melissa Sue Anderson) are enthusiastically preparing for the three-legged race, an event that will test their coordination. Meanwhile, Laura is looking forward to the hula hoop fight, where she hopes to compete with the formidable Nellie Oleson (Sidney Greenbush). Caroline Ingalls (Karen Grassle) is now in the pie competition, determined to prove her culinary talents against her competitors. In another corner of the party, Charles Ingalls (Michael Landon) faces Jim Tyler (Richard Bull) in a woodcut competition, a challenge that fuels rivalry between the two men. As preparations are in full swing, the spirit of community and competition intersects, promising a memorable day for all the inhabitants.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.sub-title: The richest man in the village
programme.desc: In the peaceful Walnut Grove community, Charles Ingalls (Michael Landon) is faced with major financial difficulties that push him to seek additional employment. Debts are accumulating, and to support his family, he accepts various small jobs, testing his endurance and his spirit. Meanwhile, her daughter Mary (Melissa Sue Anderson), who wanted to contribute to the home, made the difficult decision to leave school to work. This choice distances her from her academic aspirations, but she is determined to help her loved ones. As Charles and Mary struggle to maintain the balance of their families, tensions rise and sacrifices become inevitable. The series highlights the values of solidarity and perseverance, while exploring the economic challenges facing the Ingalls family. Family relations and community spirit are essential to overcoming these challenges.

The long-awaited honeymoon of Athena Grant (Angela Bassett) and Bobby Nash (Peter Krause) takes an unexpected turn when they find themselves trapped in a catastrophic situation on their cruise. Meanwhile, Buck (Oliver Stark) is entering a new relationship that allows him to better understand his own emotions and rediscover himself, while navigating the complexities of love and commitment. Maddie (Jennifer Love Hewitt) and Chimney (Kenneth Choi) are preparing to celebrate their union, surrounded by their loved ones and colleagues, highlighting the joys and challenges of wedding preparations. At the same time, Harry (Gavin McHugh), Athena's son, returns to Los Angeles, crossing the path of people with varied stories, bringing their share of surprises and twists. This final season, as intense as the first, celebrates the 100th episode, mixing action, emotion and humour.
programme.desc-more: 9-1-1 is a dramatic series that plunges into the heart of the crises that hit American citizens and highlights the heroic work of first responders. Through stories from police, firefighters and ambulances, the series offers us a perspective on the challenges they face on a daily basis. Each episode reminds us of the crucial importance of the 9-1-1 emergency number, which is a true link between those in distress and those who work for their safety. The heroes of this series are embodied in a casting composed of Angela Bassett in the role of Athena Grant, a determined and competent police officer, and Peter Krause in the role of Bobby Nash, the fire chief. Together, they lead a diverse team of stakeholders, each bringing their unique skills and personal stories. Jennifer Love Hewitt also joins the casting as a 9-1-1 operator, who has to navigate in stressful situations while facing her own emotional struggles. At each episode, viewers witness moments of extreme tension, whether in dangerous interventions, tragic accidents or personal crises. The series deals with real social issues, such as domestic violence, natural disasters and even unlikely catastrophic situations, while exploring how these events affect not only victims but also the actors themselves. Between moments of bravery and vulnerability, 9 -1-1 reminds us that behind every call to 9-1-1 is a human history, full of courage, sacrifice and hope. Thus, this series invites the public to reflect on the essential role these heroes play in our lives. 9-1-1 is not only a series of emergency interventions, but also an exploration of human ties in times of crisis, while paying tribute to those who risk their lives to save others' lives.

programme.title: The Rookie: Los Angeles Cop
programme.desc: After the Armstrong case broke, John Nolan was blamed and his training period extended for a month. This sanction is accompanied by a visit to a disciplinary commission and may well ruin his chances of becoming an inspector or joining a specialized unit. Promote investigator, Lopez prefers to keep her pregnancy quiet, fearing that she will be treated differently if she knows. Shortened by the pandemic, this third season is the shortest of the series with only 14 episodes.
programme.desc-more: Recently divorced and faced with a major turning point in his life, John Nolan (Nathan Fillion), a man aged 40 years, finds himself somewhat lost after his son left for university. On an ordinary day, he became a witness to a bank robbery where he barely escaped death. This traumatic event leads him to a profound introspection on his life choices and the path he wishes to take. Driven by a strong desire to change his life, John decided to leave his old life behind and settle in Los Angeles to fulfill his dream of becoming a policeman. As a new LAPD member, he must navigate in a complex environment where danger and stress are pervasive. At the earliest age of recruits, he found himself under the wing of Talia Bishop (Alyssa Diaz), his educational determination, who would have to help him overcome the specific challenges associated with his unique situation. Between training events, police intrigues and the need to prove its worth to younger colleagues, John Nolan will have to show courage and resilience while finding his place in a constantly changing world.

programme.desc-more: Recently divorced and faced with a major turning point in his life, John Nolan (Nathan Fillion), a man aged 40 years, finds himself somewhat lost after his son left for university. On an ordinary day, he became a witness to a bank robbery where he barely escaped death. This traumatic event leads him to a profound introspection on his life choices and the path he wishes to take. Driven by a strong desire to change his life, John decided to leave his old life behind and settle in Los Angeles to fulfill his dream of becoming a policeman. As a new LAPD member, he must navigate in a complex environment where danger and stress are pervasive. At the earliest age of recruits, he found himself under the wing of Talia Bishop (Alyssa Diaz), his educational determination, who would have to help him overcome the specific challenges associated with his unique situation. Between training events, police intrigues and the need to prove its worth to younger colleagues, John Nolan will have to show courage and resilience while finding his place in a constantly changing world.

programme.title: A private case
programme.desc: In Spain, in 1949, Marina Quiroga (Aura Garrido), a young woman from a prestigious line of police officers, aspired to prove herself in a world dominated by men. When rumors of a mysterious murder begin to circulate, she sees this as an opportunity to assert herself and prove her worth. Accompanied by her faithful butler, Héctor (Gorka Otxoa), she is immersed in a thrilling investigation that leads her through the elegant streets of Vigo, where secrets and dangers are hidden at every corner of the street. While sailing between the enigmatic mist of Sacred Ribbon and the dark lows of the harbour, Marina must show courage and ingenuity to expose the murderer. The series, mixing suspense, action and humour, highlights the charism of Aura Garrido, supported by the captivating presence of Jean Reno, who embodies a mysterious and phlegmatic character.
programme.desc-more: Marina (Aura Garrido), a determined woman, finds herself at the heart of an intriguing investigation when she discovers a killer's mask in Pablo's car (Gorka Otxoa), a police officer with whom she has tensions. The confrontation between Marina and Pablo is rapidly degenerating, and following a desperate struggle, they lose control of the vehicle, eventually hitting a tree. When she woke up two days later, Marina found Pablo by her side, who claimed her innocence while trying to convince her that another might be behind this dangerous ploy. Accepting the idea that this could be a setup, Marina requires to explore Pablo's garage to check for the presence of the mask. What they discover plunges them into a race against the clock: the mask is there, but they realize that the escape is none other than the one nicknamed the Artisan, a mysterious and elusive individual. Together, Marina and Pablo must decipher the clues that will lead them to the Artisan, while sailing in a maze of puzzles, dangers and betrayals. With their lives at stake, their talents and determination will be tested as they attempt to expose a killer who always seems a step ahead of them.

programme.title: The dress of my life
programme.desc: Two women, accompanied by their relatives, go to a shop to buy their wedding dress. This quest for the perfect dress for D-Day is particularly strong in emotions for the future wife and her attendants, whether they are witnesses, parents or friends. Joy, but also tension, fear, jealousy... are coming. programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: In the episode "Discovering the World" of the iconic series "The Little House in the Prairie," Johnny Johnson, a young dreamer, feels a deep need for escape and decides to leave the family farm to explore the world around him. Despite the efforts of Isaiah Edwards (Victor French), a family friend who tries to deter him from this urban adventure, Johnny remains determined. Isaiah, concerned about the safety of the adolescent, finally chose to accompany him, hoping to protect him from the dangers and temptations of urban life. Once in town, Johnny meets Mimi Monroe, a young woman who immediately captures her heart. As he immerse himself in this new environment, Isaiah is developing a bold plan: he promises Mimi a financial reward if she manages to convince Johnny to return home. This episode explores the themes of innocence, life choices and the realities of adulthood, while highlighting the challenges of friendship and love.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: In Walnut Grove, the effervescence is at its peak as the annual celebration approaches, promising laughter and friendly competitions. Laura Ingalls (Melissa Gilbert) and her sister Mary (Melissa Sue Anderson) are enthusiastically preparing for the three-legged race, an event that will test their coordination. Meanwhile, Laura is looking forward to the hula hoop fight, where she hopes to compete with the formidable Nellie Oleson (Sidney Greenbush). Caroline Ingalls (Karen Grassle) is now in the pie competition, determined to prove her culinary talents against her competitors. In another corner of the party, Charles Ingalls (Michael Landon) faces Jim Tyler (Richard Bull) in a woodcut competition, a challenge that fuels rivalry between the two men. As preparations are in full swing, the spirit of community and competition intersects, promising a memorable day for all the inhabitants.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.sub-title: The richest man in the village
programme.desc: In the peaceful Walnut Grove community, Charles Ingalls (Michael Landon) is faced with major financial difficulties that push him to seek additional employment. Debts are accumulating, and to support his family, he accepts various small jobs, testing his endurance and his spirit. Meanwhile, her daughter Mary (Melissa Sue Anderson), who wanted to contribute to the home, made the difficult decision to leave school to work. This choice distances her from her academic aspirations, but she is determined to help her loved ones. As Charles and Mary struggle to maintain the balance of their families, tensions rise and sacrifices become inevitable. The series highlights the values of solidarity and perseverance, while exploring the economic challenges facing the Ingalls family. Family relations and community spirit are essential to overcoming these challenges.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: Mary Ingalls (Melissa Sue Anderson), an exemplary student of the small prairie house, is going through a difficult period, marked by an unexpected fall on the stairs. His father, Charles Ingalls (Scottie McCreery), concerned about his recent school failures, decided to consult a doctor. During this visit, the doctor discovers that Mary's problems with concentration and academic performance are related to visual impairment. To help her overcome this challenge, he prescribed a pair of glasses, an accessory that, although common to some, represented Mary as a symbol of change and challenge. In parallel, her mother, Caroline Ingalls (Karen Grassle), and her sister, Laura (Melissa Gilbert), are fighting to support her in this transition, exploring the themes of family, support and resilience. This new obstacle leads Mary to rediscover her inner strength and fight for her academic future, while learning to accept her new equipment.

The long-awaited honeymoon of Athena Grant (Angela Bassett) and Bobby Nash (Peter Krause) takes an unexpected turn when they find themselves trapped in a catastrophic situation on their cruise. Meanwhile, Buck (Oliver Stark) is entering a new relationship that allows him to better understand his own emotions and rediscover himself, while navigating the complexities of love and commitment. Maddie (Jennifer Love Hewitt) and Chimney (Kenneth Choi) are preparing to celebrate their union, surrounded by their loved ones and colleagues, highlighting the joys and challenges of wedding preparations. At the same time, Harry (Gavin McHugh), Athena's son, returns to Los Angeles, crossing the path of people with varied stories, bringing their share of surprises and twists. This final season, as intense as the first, celebrates the 100th episode, mixing action, emotion and humour.
programme.desc-more: 9-1-1 is a dramatic series that plunges into the heart of the crises that hit American citizens and highlights the heroic work of first responders. Through stories from police, firefighters and ambulances, the series offers us a perspective on the challenges they face on a daily basis. Each episode reminds us of the crucial importance of the 9-1-1 emergency number, which is a true link between those in distress and those who work for their safety. The heroes of this series are embodied in a casting composed of Angela Bassett in the role of Athena Grant, a determined and competent police officer, and Peter Krause in the role of Bobby Nash, the fire chief. Together, they lead a diverse team of stakeholders, each bringing their unique skills and personal stories. Jennifer Love Hewitt also joins the casting as a 9-1-1 operator, who has to navigate in stressful situations while facing her own emotional struggles. At each episode, viewers witness moments of extreme tension, whether in dangerous interventions, tragic accidents or personal crises. The series deals with real social issues, such as domestic violence, natural disasters and even unlikely catastrophic situations, while exploring how these events affect not only victims but also the actors themselves. Between moments of bravery and vulnerability, 9 -1-1 reminds us that behind every call to 9-1-1 is a human history, full of courage, sacrifice and hope. Thus, this series invites the public to reflect on the essential role these heroes play in our lives. 9-1-1 is not only a series of emergency interventions, but also an exploration of human ties in times of crisis, while paying tribute to those who risk their lives to save others' lives.

Each episode reminds us of the crucial importance of the 9-1-1 emergency number, which is a true link between those in distress and those who work for their safety. The heroes of this series are embodied in a casting composed of Angela Bassett in the role of Athena Grant, a determined and competent police officer, and Peter Krause in the role of Bobby Nash, the fire chief. Together, they lead a diverse team of stakeholders, each bringing their unique skills and personal stories. Jennifer Love Hewitt also joins the casting as a 9-1-1 operator, who has to navigate in stressful situations while facing her own emotional struggles. At each episode, viewers witness moments of extreme tension, whether in dangerous interventions, tragic accidents or personal crises. The series deals with real social issues, such as domestic violence, natural disasters and even unlikely catastrophic situations, while exploring how these events affect not only victims but also the actors themselves. Between moments of bravery and vulnerability, 9 -1-1 reminds us that behind every call to 9-1-1 is a human history, full of courage, sacrifice and hope. Thus, this series invites the public to reflect on the essential role these heroes play in our lives. 9-1-1 is not only a series of emergency interventions, but also an exploration of human ties in times of crisis, while paying tribute to those who risk their lives to save others' lives.

programme.title: Hawaii 5-0
programme.desc: After leaving the hospital, Steve McGarrett (Alex O'Loughlin) and Danny Williams (Scott Caan) quickly returned to duty in Special Unit 5-0, where a murder investigation was awaiting them. The case takes an intriguing turn when the victim's body is discovered in the 5-0's premises, raising questions about the team's safety. As they try to solve this mystery, the agents must also work with an MI-6 agent to track down a formidable terrorist, responsible for an attack on the British embassy in Madrid. Barely the case closed, McGarrett and Alicia, a key figure on his team, became targets of a serial killer, who did not hesitate to remove them. Meanwhile, the rest of the team, including members like Chin Ho Kelly (Daniel Kim) and Kono Kalakaua (Grace Park), is mobilizing to save them, leading to unexpected twists in this season full of action and suspense.
programme.desc-more: Hawaii, famous for its white sand beaches and turquoise waters, also hides dark realities in its sunny climate. The island of paradise has become a playground for criminals, requiring urgent intervention. Lieutenant-Commander Steve McGarrett (Alex O'Loughlin), a SEAL of the U.S. Navy Special Forces, is on his way to Hawaii for a personal mission: to investigate the death of his father. However, the Governor of the State sees his presence as a strategic opportunity. McGarrett was convinced to create a special police unit with extensive powers, enabling this team to act unhindered to restore order on the island. McGarrett recruited Daniel Williams (Scott Caan), a former New Jersey policeman, and Chin Ho Kelly (Daniel Dae Kim), a veteran of Honolulu police. Next to them is Kono Kalakaua (Grace Park), a young recruit who has a fresh degree and an expert in martial arts. Together, they form an elite unit determined to track down and neutralize the criminals who threaten Hawaii's security. Throughout their dangerous missions, McGarrett also received support from Catherine Rollins (Michelle Borth), his girlfriend and lieutenant, adding a personal dimension to his fight against crime.

programme.title: Hawaii 5-0
programme.sub-title: E ho'i na keiki oki uaua o na pali
programme.desc: In this season's iconic series, Steve McGarrett (Alex O'Loughlin) and Danny Williams (Scott Caan) are called upon to investigate a troubling case involving military veterans engaged to eliminate mafia leaders. In parallel, they meet with Quinn Liu, a sergeant of the military police, whose methodical approach and efficiency quickly impress the team. Recognizing his talent, Steve invited him to join the famous 5-0 group of investigators, thereby strengthening their ability to solve increasingly complex cases, ranging from kidnappings to murders to drug trafficking networks. This tenth season is marked by the return of iconic characters and captivating intrigues, not to mention a long-awaited crossover with "Magnum". Tensions are rising as the team faces ever more dangerous threats while navigating the personal and professional challenges ahead.

programme.title: Night programmes
programme.desc: To follow, rebroadcasts of the channel's programs, as well as documentaries and other reports intended to entertain the diapers like early-rises.

programme.title: A season at the zoo
programme.desc: Sabrina and Maggy are taking care of the elephants while Margaux and Jeanne are taking care of a female suricate injured in a fight. His reintegration into the group proved to be delicate because of the aggressive behaviour of his congeners. Meanwhile, Geoffrey and Paul are trying to set up new enrichments for the fearful giraffes, a complex mission.

programme.title: A season at the zoo
programme.desc: Margaux, the veterinarian, collects goat's milk urgently to save an alpaca baby whose mother does not produce enough milk. At the aquatic complex, two caretakers adapt their methods to the sea lions with unpredictable and demanding temperament. In parallel, Margaux also immunizes a giraffe for imminent transfer to a foreign zoo, while training his intern in the dart.

programme.title: E=M6
programme.sub-title: Microwave, lighter, ballpoint pen: the hidden secrets of these 3 inventions that conquered the world!
programme.desc: Every Sunday, this family science magazine answers in a didactic and fun way to the questions that everyone asks themselves, thanks to visual experiences, testimonies but also decryptions of specialists.

programme.title: E=M6
programme.sub-title: Cough, mites, mould: come to the end of parasites thanks to science!
programme.desc: Every Sunday, this family science magazine answers in a didactic and fun way to the questions that everyone asks themselves, thanks to visual experiences, testimonies but also decryptions of specialists.

programme.title: Home lens: one year to change everything
Home lens: one year to change everything
Lauren's strange Christmas
programme.desc: In his home, Lauren Brunell was looking for a surgeon position in a prestigious Boston hospital, the capital of Massachusetts. But his candidacy was rejected. The doctor then has no choice but to go to a remote town in Alaska, where residents have only rarely seen a doctor for a year now. Lauren soon falls under the charm of Andy Holliday, one of the inhabitants of this warm little town. With her reindeer, her elves in the garden and her transport company, Frank, father d'Andy, is surprisingly like Santa Claus...

programme.title: A sweeter Christmas
programme.desc: As they prepare their wedding, Sophie and Sam are so surprised to see their love story adapted to Christmas film! Their small town of Waynesbridge is turning into a filming set, thus upsetting their daily lives. In the spotlight, everyone's expectations and unforeseen events are accumulating, putting their couple seriously to the test. Will they succeed in preserving their love and finally organizing the marriage they dream of?

programme.title: Dr. Cath: Mission Adoption
programme.desc: An owner contacted the Liège PRRS to recover Stella, the previously lost dog Dr. Cath visited a veterinarian. Sophie tells Leon's past, a 20-year-old horse.

programme.title: Dr. Cath: Mission Adoption
programme.desc: Tino finally meets her new adoptive family. Sophie tells Rodney's story, a young goat recovered from the shelter, and Fabrice goes to Stella's owner to make sure the conditions are right before returning the dog.

programme.title: Dr. Cath: Mission Adoption
programme.desc: The teams are waiting for a landlord to be able to seize animals. A family goes to the shelter to meet Vanille, a labrador, for adoption, and we discover the story of Winston, a pony collected at the shelter.

programme.title: Dr. Cath: Mission Adoption
programme.desc: At the shelter, we learn the story of Tyson Bull. Dr. Cath finds the recovered kitten from the old lady and the recently seized sheep are adopted. Fabrice and Dr.Cath visit Naya, previously adopted. The kitten who lost an eye will find her mistress.

programme.title: Dr. Cath: Mission Adoption
programme.desc: The kitten owner didn't come to get it. Dr. Cath finds a pony collected by the teams of "Pets at Risk". It's Tika's adoption day.

programme.title: A treasure in your home
programme.desc: What if a treasure hides in your attic? In each episode, a private individual opens his or her doors, convinced to own a nugget: rare stamps, family jewels, old vase or forgotten old instrument. He entrusts us with the estimate he makes and what he dreams of accomplishing with that sum. Then visit a auctioneer, whose expert verdict sometimes contains cruel disillusionments... or beautiful surprises !!
The lives and careers of relief team members, risking their lives to save others' lives.
programme.desc-more: 9-1-1 is a dramatic series that plunges into the heart of the crises that hit American citizens and highlights the heroic work of first responders. Through stories from police, firefighters and ambulances, the series offers us a perspective on the challenges they face on a daily basis. Each episode reminds us of the crucial importance of the 9-1-1 emergency number, which is a true link between those in distress and those who work for their safety. The heroes of this series are embodied in a casting composed of Angela Bassett in the role of Athena Grant, a determined and competent police officer, and Peter Krause in the role of Bobby Nash, the fire chief. Together, they lead a diverse team of stakeholders, each bringing their unique skills and personal stories. Jennifer Love Hewitt also joins the casting as a 9-1-1 operator, who has to navigate in stressful situations while facing her own emotional struggles. At each episode, viewers witness moments of extreme tension, whether in dangerous interventions, tragic accidents or personal crises. The series deals with real social issues, such as domestic violence, natural disasters and even unlikely catastrophic situations, while exploring how these events affect not only victims but also the actors themselves. Between moments of bravery and vulnerability, 9 -1-1 reminds us that behind every call to 9-1-1 is a human history, full of courage, sacrifice and hope. Thus, this series invites the public to reflect on the essential role these heroes play in our lives. 9-1-1 is not only a series of emergency interventions, but also an exploration of human ties in times of crisis, while paying tribute to those who risk their lives to save others' lives.

programme.title: Kaamelott
programme.desc: The island of Brittany, in the fifth century. His legends, battles, the fantastic and respectable adventures of the Knights of the Round Table, gathered around their powerful and magnanimous King Arthur. But looking closer, Arthur is not always as wise as he would like to think, and his dear wife Guinevere is not the erudite nymph related by history, but rather a naive woman who keeps exasperating her husband. Guinevere's father, Leodagan, king of Carmellia, is a warmaniac who only thinks of fighting the other peoples, while his mother, Séli, is an ambitious acariquist always quick to share her bad mood with the kingdom. As for the famous Knights of the Round Table, they are not so brave and philanthropic that we are told that they want to believe it. Perceval and Karadoc are poltrons who are better at making the tavern of the village go bad than in fulfilling the missions entrusted to them by King Arthur. Yvain and Gauvain are two teenagers seeking glory but unable to prove their courage. Bohort is more interested in fashion than in fighting, and Merlin is an enchanter whose spells usually turn against him. King Arthur is embodied by talented Alexandre Astier, who is one of the three creators of the series with Alain Kappauf (Camera Café) and Jean-Yves Robin. He knows how to work with the family, since he shares the screen with Lionnel Astier (Leodagan of Carmelide) and Simon Astier (Yvain), who is the main hero of Hero Corp.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: Graham Stewart, a young boy, goes to school every day with marks of beatings visible on his body, testifying to the violence he is experiencing at home. His comrades, though concerned, dare not intervene in the tragic situation of their friend. The situation reached a point of no return when his father, drunk and in a state of destructive anger, put Graham's life in danger. Caroline Ingalls (Karen Grassle), the mother of a caring family, cannot stand by and takes the initiative to encourage the community to act to protect the unhappy child. In parallel, Charles Ingalls (Michael Landon) decided to settle with Graham's father John Stewart to help him detoxify himself and deal with his demons. Meanwhile, Graham was welcomed to the Ingalls, where he hoped to find comfort and security, far from the violence that had marked his daily life.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: In a small rural community, Charles Ingalls (Michael Landon) plays the leadership role in convincing his neighbours to entrust their money to a promising young agronomist. The latter, determined to transform the land of the region, is entrusted with the task of purchasing quality wheat seeds to ensure a successful harvest. However, as he embarks on this crucial mission, the young agronomist is suffering an unfortunate accident that complicates things. Unfortunately, that's not all: he is also the victim of a robbery orchestrated by ill-intentioned individuals, threatening not only his project, but also the economies of his investors. In the face of this alarming situation, Charles and the members of the community must unite to overcome this crisis, rediscover their solidarity and face the consequences of their blind trust, while seeking to save their agricultural future.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: As the Ingalls family prepares for a family outing, Charles Ingalls (Michael Landon) decides to take Caroline (Karen Grassle) and their children, Laura (Melissa Gilbert), Mary (Melissa Sue Anderson), and the twins Carrie (Lindsay Greenbush and Sidney Greenbush) on a promenade in Mankato. This getaway takes an unexpected turn when, on the way back, a violent storm rises. Looking for a refuge, the family finds an abandoned cabin, where they hope to wait for bad weather to pass. However, the situation became more complicated when Charles, in search of food, ventured into the woods to hunt. In his determination to support his family, he finds himself confronted with unforeseen dangers, endangering his life. This moment of tension reveals not only the dangers of nature, but also the strength of family ties, while Caroline and the children are worried about their father.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: In the episode "Discovering the World" of the iconic series "The Little House in the Prairie," Johnny Johnson, a young dreamer, feels a deep need for escape and decides to leave the family farm to explore the world around him. Despite the efforts of Isaiah Edwards (Victor French), a family friend who tries to deter him from this urban adventure, Johnny remains determined. Isaiah, concerned about the safety of the adolescent, finally chose to accompany him, hoping to protect him from the dangers and temptations of urban life. Once in town, Johnny meets Mimi Monroe, a young woman who immediately captures her heart. As he immerse himself in this new environment, Isaiah is developing a bold plan: he promises Mimi a financial reward if she manages to convince Johnny to return home. This episode explores the themes of innocence, life choices and the realities of adulthood, while highlighting the challenges of friendship and love.

In the vibrant city of Los Angeles, the 118 relief team, led by Bobby Nash (Peter Krause), are facing increasingly unpredictable and dramatic emergencies. Whether it is a burning airship threatening a crowded stage or the collapse of a conference-hosting structure, each intervention tests not only their professional expertise, but also their personal ties. Meanwhile, Maya (Michelle Hurd) and Bobby have to deal with their new reality at home, while their son Harry is in Miami with Michael (Rockmond Dunbar) and David (Kenneth Choi). The challenges of daily life intertwine with the adrenaline of interventions, revealing the depth of the characters and the sacrifices they make. Over the course of the sixth season, rescuers discover that the real heroism lies as much in the action as in the management of the emotional crises that affect them outside of their work.

The long-awaited honeymoon of Athena Grant (Angela Bassett) and Bobby Nash (Peter Krause) takes an unexpected turn when they find themselves trapped in a catastrophic situation on their cruise. Meanwhile, Buck (Oliver Stark) is entering a new relationship that allows him to better understand his own emotions and rediscover himself, while navigating the complexities of love and commitment. Maddie (Jennifer Love Hewitt) and Chimney (Kenneth Choi) are preparing to celebrate their union, surrounded by their loved ones and colleagues, highlighting the joys and challenges of wedding preparations. At the same time, Harry (Gavin McHugh), Athena's son, returns to Los Angeles, crossing the path of people with varied stories, bringing their share of surprises and twists. This final season, as intense as the first, celebrates the 100th episode, mixing action, emotion and humour.

Jennifer Love Hewitt also joins the casting as a 9-1-1 operator, who has to navigate in stressful situations while facing her own emotional struggles. At each episode, viewers witness moments of extreme tension, whether in dangerous interventions, tragic accidents or personal crises. The series deals with real social issues, such as domestic violence, natural disasters and even unlikely catastrophic situations, while exploring how these events affect not only victims but also the actors themselves. Between moments of bravery and vulnerability, 9 -1-1 reminds us that behind every call to 9-1-1 is a human history, full of courage, sacrifice and hope. Thus, this series invites the public to reflect on the essential role these heroes play in our lives. 9-1-1 is not only a series of emergency interventions, but also an exploration of human ties in times of crisis, while paying tribute to those who risk their lives to save others' lives.

The long-awaited honeymoon of Athena Grant (Angela Bassett) and Bobby Nash (Peter Krause) takes an unexpected turn when they find themselves trapped in a catastrophic situation on their cruise. Meanwhile, Buck (Oliver Stark) is entering a new relationship that allows him to better understand his own emotions and rediscover himself, while navigating the complexities of love and commitment. Maddie (Jennifer Love Hewitt) and Chimney (Kenneth Choi) are preparing to celebrate their union, surrounded by their loved ones and colleagues, highlighting the joys and challenges of wedding preparations. At the same time, Harry (Gavin McHugh), Athena's son, returns to Los Angeles, crossing the path of people with varied stories, bringing their share of surprises and twists. This final season, as intense as the first, celebrates the 100th episode, mixing action, emotion and humour.

programme.title: Gaston Lagaffe
programme.desc: At the heart of this adventure is Gaston Lagaffe (Theo Fernandez), a young man as generous as he is clumsy, whose arrival at the Peticoin newspaper will upset the already precarious balance of the editorial staff. Armed with a boundless imagination and a keen sense of innovation, Gaston keeps inventing farfelus gadgets, which are supposed to simplify the lives of his colleagues. Yet his creations, often as unpredictable as they are uncontrollable, transform each day into a succession of more baffled disasters. Gaston is driven by a sincere desire to do good around him, but his initiatives are especially exasperated by his boss, Prunelle. The latter, already overwhelmed by the challenges of running a newspaper in difficulty, sees with a very bad eye the eccentricities of his intern. But Gaston is not the only one who is sowing the peticoin mess: the threatening shadow of Monsieur de Mesmaeker hovering over the editorial staff. This dreadful businessman, ready to do anything to get hold of the newspaper, represents a real threat to the future of the Peticoin and its employees. Between Gaston's catastrophic inventions, Prunelle's nerve attacks and Mr de Mesmaeker's devious maneuvers, the newspaper's survival seems more uncertain than ever.

programme.title: Legos: the 30 most incredible constructions - Volume 3
programme.desc: Since their creation, the Legos have been a tremendous success. This toy has succeeded in investing all the universes, from space to architecture, from mechanics to real-scale constructions, including iconic brands such as Batman and Star Wars. The Lego brings together manufacturers who have decided, out of passion, to go beyond the simple box to invent ever more incredible models. In an attempt to break through the unsuspectable secrets of this toy that unleashes the passions of young and old, this documentary looks back on the thirty craziest constructions made to date: the first brick motocross, Bilbo's home, the human-sized Hobbit, but also a castle with XXL dimensions.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Penny's having a gallant meeting between Raj and one of her deaf friends. She doesn't know that she's interested in money...
programme.desc-more: The tumultuous relationship between Leonard (Johnny Galecki) and Penny (Kaley Cuoco) is reaching a new turning point when their breakup forces them to re-evaluate their respective feelings. As Penny entered a new romance with Zack, a man whose contempt for Leonard's geek friends was palpable, he turned to Priya, Raj's sister (Kunal Nayyar). However, Priya's jealousy of Leonard's persistent friendship with Penny complicates their emerging relationship. At the same time, Sheldon (Jim Parsons) continues to explore her platonic relationship with Amy (Mayim Bialik), whose interactions provide memorable comic moments throughout the season. The relationship challenges and social dynamics between these staggered characters highlight the struggles of friendship and love in an academic setting. In January 2011, the series received its first Golden Globe, rewarding Jim Parsons' outstanding performance in Sheldon's iconic role.

programme.title: The crazy story of Barbie
programme.desc: For over sixty-five years, Barbie has been passing through generations. Its size, however, has been constantly causing criticism and controversy, which has long been denounced by feminist movements. Pop culture has not spared it either: mocked like a doll in Aqua's "Barbie Girl" in 1997, she has a new consecration with the blockbuster of 2023 worn by Margot Robbie. Meanwhile, it has been a world-wide success, adopted by the leading fashion designers since the 1980s. She also inspired artists, starting with Andy Warhol, who painted her in 1986. So what were the ingredients of this success, and how did his designer Ruth Handler find them? Most importantly, how did Barbie go through decades without disappearing?

programme.title: The magic of Disney, all the secrets finally revealed!
programme.desc: A focus on the ten most innovative technologies of the Puy du Fou Park, which attracts ever more visitors each year thanks to these prowess.
programme.desc-more: After Élodie Frégé, it is the turn of Lorie Pester, French voice of the fairy bell, to enter the backstage of Christmas at Disneyland Paris, in the heart of the world's greatest dream machine, to reveal the secrets of this magical world. The singer discovers why the castle of the beautiful with sleeping wood is the most visited monument in France, but also that the snow queen has almost never seen the light and that the Winnie bear is forbidden in China. She also wonders if some of the Disney princesses really existed.

programme.title: XXL works : swimming pools and lagoons
programme.sub-title: Architect's pool one hour from Paris
programme.desc: The teams are going to Cape Ferret to build an infinity pool. There are many constraints. Indeed, the house must be built at the same time.
programme.desc-more: The DiffAzur team intervenes at an hour from Paris, in a sumptuous property, to meet the demands of the architect of the house. The customer wishes a swimming pool with a mobile background; Once it has been raised, the bottom becomes a terrace and hides the existence of the basin. So it's about creating a pool in trompe l'oeil, something out of the norm imagined by an architect who can't be anticipated the technical challenges that will arise. The main question is whether all the gears will work once the moving bottom is in place.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Sheldon and Amy are conducting a secret experiment that aims to spread rumours within the group. Howard's relationship with Bernadette is on a new course...
programme.desc-more: As the group dynamics evolve within the group of friends, the female presence is increasing around Leonard (Johnny Galecki), Sheldon (Jim Parsons), Howard (Simon Helberg) and Raj (Kunal Nayyar). The relationship between Penny (Kaley Cuoco) and Leonard gets more complicated after Penny shared one night with Raj, while Leonard is going through a difficult breakup with Priya. This tumultuous emotional context raises questions about the possibility of a reconciliation between Leonard and Penny. Amy (Mayim Bialik) is eager to advance her platonic relationship with Sheldon, seeking to push him to explore a more intimate connection, which exacerbates Sheldon's associative traits. At the same time, Howard is preparing for a major turning point in his life, with the wedding on the horizon and expedition projects to the international space station. This fifth season promises many twists and hilarious tensions within this iconic group.

programme.title: The madness of the motorhome: a holiday not like the others
programme.desc: Tony and Virginia chose to go on a motorhome to discover Portugal, looking for local specialities. A tetralegic, Samuel has developed and fully adapted his van. Accompanied by a friend of Marine, he spent a few days in Spain discovering Catalonia before going to conquer the African continent. In the Vaucluse, a strange vehicle does not go unnoticed. Hervé and Marion have built a truck to make it a real duplex with two terraces and an outdoor kitchen. In Sanary-sur-Mer, Chloe and Gianni opted for more discretion. The couple just finished the layout of their van to make it a small cozy studio. Every weekend, they set off on the roads to discover the most beautiful landscapes

programme.title: The madness of the motorhome: a holiday not like the others
programme.desc: Andrea, Manusch and their two children did not hesitate to transport their camper to the other side of the world. Originally from Italy and settled in Guadeloupe for three years, they travel the island every weekend to discover the most beautiful spots. Every year, the number of campers increases and there are many for all tastes. Marion and her two children are novices. The mother opted for a smaller and more economical model, a van. This summer, she rented this model for ten days with the program discovering the Atlantic coast. Simon and Marie, on their side, turned a school bus into a real little country house. This year again, they offer their children a dream holiday: a month on the roads of Europe.

programme.title: Flic story
programme.sub-title: Police force in the Lyon region
programme.desc: The department of Ain, located half an hour north of Lyon, hides a dark reality with 64 crimes and offences recorded every day. Law enforcement agencies are constantly being called upon to deal with drivers, shoplifting, abuse and alcohol abuse. The PSIG, which specializes in night interventions, is always ready to manage dangerous situations. In addition, the Ain has a large 13 000-kilometre road network to monitor carefully.

programme.title: Flic story
programme.desc: It is good to live in Aix-en-Provence, in the Bouches-du-Rhône. Yet behind these postcard landscapes is a daily life that is not always of all rest.

programme.title: Flic story
programme.desc: Every summer, the population of Royan is multiplied by six, attracting hundreds of thousands of holidaymakers who come to enjoy the beaches. But behind this postcard, the city's fifty-five policemen face a reality under high tension. For two months, focus on the moving daily life of Sandra and Olivier, faced with refusals to comply, accidents and runaway drivers.

programme.title: Flic story
programme.desc: Refusal to comply, provocations, assaults: the police officers of the Saint-Quentin police station are fighting crime relentlessly. The Emergency Police units are facing all the abuses of society. Violent altercations, fighting, police officers regularly intervene to bring about civil peace. At night, interventions are often more muscular: alcohol abuse, drug abuse, and arrests are more aggressive. On the roads, many people drive after festive evenings, unaware of the danger. Neighborhood conflicts, teenage runaways, urban rodeos: immersion in the heart of the daily life of the police officers of Saint-Quentin.

programme.title: XXL works : swimming pools and lagoons
programme.sub-title: Architect's pool one hour from Paris
programme.desc: The last guest wants a swimming pool with a mobile background; Once it has been raised, the bottom becomes a terrace and hides the existence of the basin.
programme.desc-more: The DiffAzur team intervenes at an hour from Paris, in a sumptuous property, to meet the demands of the architect of the house. The customer wishes a swimming pool with a mobile background; Once it has been raised, the bottom becomes a terrace and hides the existence of the basin. So it's about creating a pool in trompe l'oeil, something out of the norm imagined by an architect who can't be anticipated the technical challenges that will arise. The main question is whether all the gears will work once the moving bottom is in place.

programme.title: XXL works : swimming pools and lagoons
programme.desc: The teams have an appointment in the Pyrenees to build a lagoon-shaped swimming pool. Will this exceptional lagoon meet the client's expectations?
programme.desc-more: The Diffazur family-owned company has revolutionized the pool market in France for nearly 50 years and is now the European leader in the creation of reinforced concrete pools. His team of experts is ingenuity-based to realize the most incredible and unexpected wishes of their clients everywhere in France. A new XXL challenge awaits the team in the Pyrenees where the customer wants a real lagoon to appear on his property. The project is expected to be a titanic project, everything must be done perfectly to ensure the success of this project.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Raj and Penny spent a night together and everyone agrees that this act is not without consequences for the life of the small group of friends.
programme.desc-more: As the group dynamics evolve within the group of friends, the female presence is increasing around Leonard (Johnny Galecki), Sheldon (Jim Parsons), Howard (Simon Helberg) and Raj (Kunal Nayyar). The relationship between Penny (Kaley Cuoco) and Leonard gets more complicated after Penny shared one night with Raj, while Leonard is going through a difficult breakup with Priya. This tumultuous emotional context raises questions about the possibility of a reconciliation between Leonard and Penny. Amy (Mayim Bialik) is eager to advance her platonic relationship with Sheldon, seeking to push him to explore a more intimate connection, which exacerbates Sheldon's associative traits. At the same time, Howard is preparing for a major turning point in his life, with the wedding on the horizon and expedition projects to the international space station. This fifth season promises many twists and hilarious tensions within this iconic group.

programme.title: The madness of the motorhome: a holiday not like the others
programme.desc: Tony and Virginia chose to travel by camper, Samuel by equipped van, Hervé and Marion by converted truck, and Chloe and Gianni by van.
programme.desc-more: Tony and Virginia chose to go on a motorhome to discover Portugal, looking for local specialities. A tetralegic, Samuel has developed and fully adapted his van. Accompanied by a friend of Marine, he spent a few days in Spain discovering Catalonia before going to conquer the African continent. In the Vaucluse, a strange vehicle does not go unnoticed. Hervé and Marion have built a truck to make it a real duplex with two terraces and an outdoor kitchen. In Sanary-sur-Mer, Chloe and Gianni opted for more discretion. The couple just finished the layout of their van to make it a small cozy studio. Every weekend, they set off on the roads to discover the most beautiful landscapes

programme.title: The madness of the motorhome: a holiday not like the others
programme.desc: Andréa and Manusch travel through Guadeloupe by motorhome, Marion rented a van, and Simon and Marie turned a school bus into a small country house.
programme.desc-more: Andrea, Manusch and their two children did not hesitate to transport their camper to the other side of the world. Originally from Italy and settled in Guadeloupe for three years, they travel the island every weekend to discover the most beautiful spots. Every year, the number of campers increases and there are many for all tastes. Marion and her two children are novices. The mother opted for a smaller and more economical model, a van. This summer, she rented this model for ten days with the program discovering the Atlantic coast. Simon and Marie, on their side, turned a school bus into a real little country house. This year again, they offer their children a dream holiday: a month on the roads of Europe.

programme.title: Flic story
programme.sub-title: Police force in the Lyon region
programme.desc: In the department of Ain, law enforcement officers identify more than 60 crimes and offences every day. The gendarmes of the company of Trévoux have no minute of respite.
programme.desc-more: The department of Ain, located half an hour north of Lyon, hides a dark reality with 64 crimes and offences recorded every day. Law enforcement agencies are constantly being called upon to deal with drivers, shoplifting, abuse and alcohol abuse. The PSIG, which specializes in night interventions, is always ready to manage dangerous situations. In addition, the Ain has a large 13 000-kilometre road network to monitor carefully.

programme.title: Flic story
programme.desc: Near La Rochelle, Royan, a popular seaside resort in Charente-Maritime, is stormed every summer. For the city's 55 policemen, the season is not a rest.
programme.desc-more: Every summer, the population of Royan is multiplied by six, attracting hundreds of thousands of holidaymakers who come to enjoy the beaches. But behind this postcard, the city's fifty-five policemen face a reality under high tension. For two months, focus on the moving daily life of Sandra and Olivier, faced with refusals to comply, accidents and runaway drivers.

programme.title: Flic story
programme.desc: Refusal to comply, provocations, assaults: the police officers of the Saint-Quentin police station struggle tirelessly. At night, interventions are often more muscular.
programme.desc-more: Refusal to comply, provocations, assaults: the police officers of the Saint-Quentin police station are fighting crime relentlessly. The Emergency Police units are facing all the abuses of society. Violent altercations, fighting, police officers regularly intervene to bring about civil peace. At night, interventions are often more muscular: alcohol abuse, drug abuse, and arrests are more aggressive. On the roads, many people drive after festive evenings, unaware of the danger. Neighborhood conflicts, teenage runaways, urban rodeos: immersion in the heart of the daily life of the police officers of Saint-Quentin.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Sheldon learns that his mother will spend a few days at his house. Once she has settled in, she announces that she does not intend to prepare her meals.
programme.desc-more: The tumultuous relationship between Leonard (Johnny Galecki) and Penny (Kaley Cuoco) is reaching a new turning point when their breakup forces them to re-evaluate their respective feelings. As Penny entered a new romance with Zack, a man whose contempt for Leonard's geek friends was palpable, he turned to Priya, Raj's sister (Kunal Nayyar). At the same time, Sheldon (Jim Parsons) continues to explore her platonic relationship with Amy (Mayim Bialik), whose interactions provide memorable comic moments throughout the season. The relationship challenges and social dynamics between these staggered characters highlight the struggles of friendship and love in an academic setting. programme.title: The Mona Lisa Mystery: The Mona Lisa Mystery
programme.desc: The Mona Lisa. The Louvre welcomed nine million visitors last year, and many come only for it, painted by one of the greatest artists in history: Leonardo da Vinci. A face that seems almost alive, a enigmatic smile, a look that we swear he's following you. The painting has become a legend, and it keeps its shadows. For decades, Leonardo da Vinci's specialists have been looking for answers. Who was Mona Lisa really? By whom was the painting ordered? What did the very first portrait look like, and how many times did the painter take it back in his life? Thanks to the reconstructions, the unpublished archive images and the expert competition, this documentary traces the life of the painter and the way in which he is painting.

programme.title: Star Trek
programme.desc: At the edge of the galaxy, George Kirk, who became captain of the USS Kelvin, sacrificed himself to save his crew and his newly born son, when his ship was attacked by Nero, a Romulan. Twenty years later, James T. Kirk was a promising but unpredictable Starfleet cadet. He met doctor Leonard McCoy and was waiting to get an officer position. But, for cheating on an exam, Kirk is laid off. That's when the planet Vulcan calls the fleet for help. In defiance of orders, Kirk, assisted by McCoy, boarded the USS Enterprise, the second of which is Spock, which led to Kirk's sanction...

programme.desc: Very efficient robbers, both ingenious and brutal, attack jewellers and banks located in the heart of the capital. Serge Buren, a legendary cop, is pursuing them with his young colleagues. His hierarchy, which hardly appreciates his speedy methods, the sum of success...

programme.title: Puy du Fou: the genius of the shows revealed
programme.desc: The Puy du Fou, a salesman's leisure park, has been growing remarkably for nearly half a century, and is the best park in the world in 2012 and 2014. Its outreach now extends internationally. The park's success depends on the combination of captivating narrative and technical achievements. The teams, in collaboration with industrial experts, create innovative stage design. This synergy between creativity and technology generates immersive shows, offering a unique experience for visitors. The ingenuity deployed to arouse emotion makes Puy du Fou a reference in the field of entertainment.

programme.title: Puy du Fou: the 10 most innovative technos in the park
programme.desc: The Puy du Fou attracts an ever-increasing audience every year. While visitors come for historical stories and epic frescoes, the park's success is also based on a particularly elaborate technical mechanics. Behind the stage, teams of engineers and technicians design complex devices, designed to make illusion possible. Each element must combine safety, reliability and fluidity, while remaining invisible to the public. With images shot behind the scenes, in the basement and in the technical corridors, complemented by 3D models, this unpublished documentary reveals, for the first time, the ten most innovative technologies in the park.

programme.title: Walibi: the techno of attractions
programme.desc: In Belgium, which is called the country dish, there are certain summits that can be seen from a very far distance. These are the famous roller coasters of Walibi Park. Located 30 kilometres south-east of Brussels, the park has been in existence for 50 years and has a population of 1 700 000 people each year, of which 20% are French. All are looking for strong sensations and adrenaline. To do so, they can trust ten roller coasters, some of which are genuine national institutions. Like "La Turbine": an attraction that is experienced in the complete darkness but which was originally open and which was called "Le Sirocco". For five decades, to attract an ever-increasing audience, the park has been continuously innovating to provide visitors with ever-changing emotions.

programme.title: Flic story
programme.desc: L'Hérault, in the south of France. A department near the Spanish border that smells good on holiday but not for everyone. Brackets, assaults, or insanity. For the 1200 gendarmes in the department, the interventions are ongoing. Last year, 30,000, more than 80 per day. A team followed the women and men of Béziers' company. Their daily lives include robbery, shoplifting or marriage wars. But there is also a vast road network to be monitored closely. This is the mission of the Poussan motorway platoon. Speeding, driving under the influence of narcotics.

programme.title: Night programmes
programme.desc: Every week, David Chaignon and his team go on the ground to meet passionate people, both in France and abroad. It offers a travelling program that sheds light on the latest cynégetic and fisheries, is interested in techniques in vogue, the regulations in force, new materials...

programme.title: Lagoon Master
programme.desc: A caregiver sees her dream of having her own pool fulfilled. Lucas is under pressure to build a dream pool in a small garden.
programme.desc-more: The designer of extraordinary pools and pools Lucas Congdon and his entire team are in Florida to build a pond that will house koi carps: but rather than stay there, they transform the old family pool into a paradisiac lagoon that communicates with the pond. They even find time to install an aquaponie system that combines plant and fish farming.

programme.title: XXL works : swimming pools and lagoons
programme.desc: The Diffazur family-owned company has revolutionized the pool market in France for nearly 50 years and is now the European leader in the creation of reinforced concrete pools. His team of experts is ingenuity-based to realize the most incredible and unexpected wishes of their clients everywhere in France. A new XXL challenge awaits the team in the Pyrenees where the customer wants a real lagoon to appear on his property. The project is expected to be a titanic project, everything must be done perfectly to ensure the success of this project.

programme.title: XXL works : swimming pools and lagoons
programme.sub-title: Submerged beach sea view on the French Riviera
programme.desc: The Diffazur family-owned company has been revolutionizing the pool market in France for nearly 50 years. The team is back in the south of France, with a project that will require a lot of work and ingenuity. The customer of the day wishes a swimming pool that gives the appearance of having a beach immersed in his garden. The constraints are numerous in order to be able to make a quality trompe l'oeil, especially since the pool must be positioned so as to have a view of the sea and therefore create a perfect illusion.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The tumultuous relationship between Leonard (Johnny Galecki) and Penny (Kaley Cuoco) is reaching a new turning point when their breakup forces them to re-evaluate their respective feelings. As Penny entered a new romance with Zack, a man whose contempt for Leonard's geek friends was palpable, he turned to Priya, Raj's sister (Kunal Nayyar). However, Priya's jealousy of Leonard's persistent friendship with Penny complicates their emerging relationship. At the same time, Sheldon (Jim Parsons) continues to explore her platonic relationship with Amy (Mayim Bialik), whose interactions provide memorable comic moments throughout the season. The relationship challenges and social dynamics between these staggered characters highlight the struggles of friendship and love in an academic setting. In January 2011, the series received its first Golden Globe, rewarding Jim Parsons' outstanding performance in Sheldon's iconic role.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant city of Pasadena, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) and Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons), two roommates passionate about quantum physics, lead an existence marked by their intellectual genius, but their social malfeasance. Their days are rhythmic by discussions on complex scientific theories and video game marathons, but their love life is far from fulfilling. The arrival of Penny (Kaley Cuoco), a charming and life-filled young woman, in the nearby apartment is a turning point in their daily lives. Leonard quickly develops feelings for her, creating both excitement and confusion in the group of friends. At the same time, their comrades Howard Wolowitz (Simon Helberg) and Rajesh Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar) are trying to navigate through the tumults of encounters and relationships in love, enriching the group dynamics. Over the seasons, their friendship is growing and evolving, as they face the challenges of modern life, mixing humour, science and the sometimes chaotic daily life of human relations.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: As the group dynamics evolve within the group of friends, the female presence is increasing around Leonard (Johnny Galecki), Sheldon (Jim Parsons), Howard (Simon Helberg) and Raj (Kunal Nayyar). The relationship between Penny (Kaley Cuoco) and Leonard gets more complicated after Penny shared one night with Raj, while Leonard is going through a difficult breakup with Priya. This tumultuous emotional context raises questions about the possibility of a reconciliation between Leonard and Penny. Amy (Mayim Bialik) is eager to advance her platonic relationship with Sheldon, seeking to push him to explore a more intimate connection, which exacerbates Sheldon's associative traits. At the same time, Howard is preparing for a major turning point in his life, with the wedding on the horizon and expedition projects to the international space station. This fifth season promises many twists and hilarious tensions within this iconic group.

programme.title: Full eyes
programme.desc: After more than twenty years of absence, "Full eyes" makes its great return. Carole Rousseau and Jacques Legros take over the show in an atmosphere that is both complicit and nibbling. On the agenda of this return, stories are absolutely crazy and strong in emotions: a ride that breaks in half, a truck suspended over the void, a woman stuck in her cabin or a paratrooper who is the victim of an epilepsy attack and who faints in the middle of the flight. Specialists are taking part in answering questions raised by these images. The program also evolves with time thanks to a new section: "False or Real?". In this sequence, the team decrypts impressive videos that circulate on social networks to determine whether they are genuine or the fruit of artificial intelligence.

programme.title: Apolline morning
programme.desc: Apolline de Malherbe gives an appointment to RMC listeners and RMC viewers Discovered for a new morning news: "Apolline morning". Explanations, debates and good mood to know everything, understand everything and make one's own opinion. Every day, from 6am, those who are current answer Apolline de Malherbe's questions and listeners/students.
