The relationship between Penny (Kaley Cuoco) and Leonard gets more complicated after Penny shared one night with Raj, while Leonard is going through a difficult breakup with Priya. This tumultuous emotional context raises questions about the possibility of a reconciliation between Leonard and Penny. Amy (Mayim Bialik) is eager to advance her platonic relationship with Sheldon, seeking to push him to explore a more intimate connection, which exacerbates Sheldon's associative traits. At the same time, Howard is preparing for a major turning point in his life, with the wedding on the horizon and expedition projects to the international space station. This fifth season promises many twists and hilarious tensions within this iconic group.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant city of Pasadena, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) and Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons), two roommates passionate about quantum physics, lead an existence marked by their intellectual genius, but their social malfeasance. Their days are rhythmic by discussions on complex scientific theories and video game marathons, but their love life is far from fulfilling. The arrival of Penny (Kaley Cuoco), a charming and life-filled young woman, in the nearby apartment is a turning point in their daily lives. Leonard quickly develops feelings for her, creating both excitement and confusion in the group of friends. At the same time, their comrades Howard Wolowitz (Simon Helberg) and Rajesh Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar) are trying to navigate through the tumults of encounters and relationships in love, enriching the group dynamics. Over the seasons, their friendship is growing and evolving, as they face the challenges of modern life, mixing humour, science and the sometimes chaotic daily life of human relations.

programme.title: Backtrace
programme.desc: After a bank robbery, MacDonald and his accomplices meet in the middle of the forest to share... $20 million! But the five men don't get along. The argument ends with exchanges of gunfire. Injured in the head, MacDonald is found by the police. He's become amnesia. Doctors decide to give him an experimental serum to help him recover his memory.

programme.title: Flic story
programme.desc: The gendarmes of the Normandy region are not short of work. They survey the roads considered dangerous and accidental. Adrenaline and emotion punctuate the various missions entrusted to these extraordinary women and men, who very often find themselves confronted with violence in the performance of their duties. They track down the drivers, often willing to do anything to escape the controls, fight insecurity and hunt off the crime.

programme.title: Flic story
programme.desc: In New Aquitaine, the summer season attracts tourists, an influx of people that is not without consequences for the 150 gendarmes of the Lesparre-Médoc company.

programme.title: Flic story
programme.desc: Every day millions of French people travel through the highways that cross the hexagon. The cameras followed the gendarmes who guarded the main axes of the South.
programme.desc-more: To avoid the drama, all over France, law enforcement forces are fighting against drivers: the 18/24 age group is the most affected. Speeding, neglect, fatigue driving, excessive alcohol use or under the influence of drugs: throughout the country, officers are on the alert to enforce the traffic code. Police patrol day and night to break the deal points. For weeks, close-up on the work of these police officers in their daily missions. Between prevention and repression, gendarmerie and police are on all fronts.

programme.title: Revelation: The Day a Virus Will Decimate Humanity
programme.desc: In Mexico City, in the near future, a respiratory virus called X disease, far more deadly and contagious than Covid-19, turns megapoly into a ghost city. This documentary traces the disaster scenario that could cause fifty million deaths worldwide. It analyses the pandemics of the past and highlights current scientific solutions to avoid the worst.

programme.title: The 10 disasters that threaten the planet
programme.desc: Since the beginning of its long history, the blue planet has experienced a number of cataclysms. Indeed, the Earth is fragile, and it will eventually disappear. But no one knows the date or the circumstances. There are many threats, including the risk of mega-saesisms or d-asteroids that could destroy all life on the planet. Unfortunately, man could also be responsible for its decline. Discovered, with unpublished archive and synthesis images, a ranking of the ten greatest disasters that threaten the Earth.

programme.title: Alert on the planet!
programme.desc: The Sun, the source of all life, also represents a major threat to the Earth. His violent explosions are throwing billions of tons of matter into space. These solar storms, reaching the Earth, can paralyze the most critical human infrastructure: satellites, electrical networks and communications, a hyper-connected world extremely vulnerable to this phenomenon.

programme.title: I'll go sleep at the Gauls' house.
programme.desc: Antoine travels France in convertibles, meeting alternative communities, school-goers and a lady in a naturist camp.
programme.desc-more: Antoine began his trip to France in the Maurienne valley and met Jean-Paul, a retired breeder. Then he went to Aveyron where people lived in huts in the middle of a 75-hectare forest. Those who live there tell him why they chose this way of life. Later, as he crossed Drôme, he discovered the association Ecoravie, a clustered intergenerational habitat. Finally, Antoine went to Montalivet's naturist camp in Gironde where he met Coco, 94, who lived there during the year.

programme.desc: 200 kilometres east of Paris, the gendarmes of Epernay face violent individuals, who do not hesitate to provoke them.
programme.desc-more: La Marne is a rural area known for its champagne vineyards. But in this quiet environment, the gendarmes of Épernay are increasingly confronted with violent individuals. To ensure security, the motorized brigade is tracking the area for offences. Exceeding speed, narcotics, driving without a licence and altercation on a background of alcohol, the gendarmes sometimes encounter energists who exceed the law without any remorse. A look back at the busy daily life of these gendarmes who are trying to enforce the order.

programme.desc: The Raneys arrived in Hartford, Tennessee, and found the Robinson family in desperate conditions, without roofs or water on their property. The mother, Keesa, and the father, Christian, live on a transformed and cramped school bus, and their three teenage children live hard on the property. Marty is trying to build a 30 foot yurt for the family. Meanwhile, Matt helps the two youngest boys realize their dream of becoming professional blacksmiths by expanding their small workshop and installing a propane-powered forge. And Misty revives a delabrated pond at the foot of the Robinson property.

programme.desc-more: On August 8, 2003, Jean-François André, head of the MC Drôme bike club, was found dead a few metres from his home, lying alongside his motorcycle, in a cornfield. Nicknamed La Pie by his relatives, he founded the first "Outlaws" biker club in France. The gendarmes, who are in charge of the investigation, quickly come up against the code of honor of the bikers, men who are not very talkative and prefer to fight with their leader's murderer. An anonymous call provides them with a single lead: Michel Di Bacco. He allegedly ordered the murder of Gérald Crouzet, an ex-biker and weapons collector.

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.desc: On 18 July 2011, the inanimate body of 23-year-old Charlène Bello was found in an apartment in La Rochelle. The young mother was raped, strangled and beaten. The room is smeared with blood. This crime recalls another homicide committed twenty years earlier, on August 12, 1991. Valérie Bechtel's naked body was found in a wood not far from Thaon-les-Vosges. Valérie's murderer is arrested and condemned, but doubts reappear. Raphaël Maillant has always denied the crime and has been fighting for twenty years to get his trial reviewed.

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.sub-title: Jacqueline Sauvage, from crime to grace
programme.desc: On September 10, 2012, in La Selle-sur-le-Bied in the Loiret, Jacqueline Sauvage killed her husband Norbert Marot with three shots. The Marot couple were united in society. But behind the walls of their pavilion, the atmosphere seemed very different: a violent husband, a woman under control and frightened children. On two occasions, on sittings and then on appeal, the popular jury and the magistrates discovered another facet of the defendant's personality, condemning her to ten years in prison. Finally, a partial and then total presidential pardon was granted Jacqueline Sauvage in 2016.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Lucy Knight, a third year medical student, is in the ER. His unsightlyness and doubts remind Carter of many memories. To continue working in Cook County, Elizabeth Corday was forced to re-institut. Benton discovers his son's deafness. Finally, the position of Chief of Emergency Operations escapes Weaver for Amanda Lee. Actress Laura Innes made her weapons behind the camera with the episode "Toute-puissance", the first of a beautiful career as a series director.
programme.desc-more: Back at Cook County Hospital, Dr.John Carter (Noah Wyle) discovered an environment radically transformed by technological innovation that upset the emergency department during his absence. In the face of his colleagues, he must navigate between his traditional methods, which some consider to be outdated, and the integration of new practices. Meanwhile, Dr. Banfield (Laura Innes) and her husband make the choice to adopt, a process that plunges them into intense reflections on parenting and the challenges that accompany it. At the same time, Sam's situation (Eriq La Salle) becomes more complicated when his mother, with a tumultuous past, arrives in the emergency room, generating strong tensions and emotions. Through these intertwined narratives, "Emergences" explores not only the medical challenges, but also the human dynamics and personal struggles that take place in the background of a hospital service always under pressure.

programme.desc-more: Ink Master features a competition of American professional tattoo artists, judged through various artistic challenges. Ink Master is the first show to make tattoo art a competition! The principle is simple: 10 candidates compete through events to win the prestigious title of "best tattooer" and the $100,000 award. For eight weeks, candidates will have to prove themselves and face a series of challenges that are more complicated than each other. Their works will then be judged by a ruthless jury composed of Dave Navarro (the guitarist of Jane's Addiction), Chris Nunez (Miami Ink) and Oliver Peck. Our tattoo apprentices will not have the right to make mistakes, because they have sharp eyes and for them every detail counts!

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.sub-title: Béranger Bruns, the charcutier at the Saint-Martin market
programme.desc: Béranger Bruns was an Italian caterer at the Saint-Martin market in Paris. In 2005, he cut his mistress into pieces, who was also her employee, her son and her little dog. Although his lawyer pleaded the crime of passion, Béranger Bruns was sentenced in 2007 to thirty years in prison.
programme.desc-more: Paris, February 23, 2005, the disappearance of Christelle Leroy, 26, Lucas, her 4-year-old son, and their dog, is reported to the police by the young woman's family. Investigators are interested in Béranger Bruns, the merchant-carcutier, employer and lover of the latter, married and father of two children. But at first, they are convinced that Christelle, of an unstable nature, has voluntarily disappeared. A few months later, they made a sordid discovery that would lead to the conviction of thirty years of imprisonment of the charcutier.

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.desc: In March 2012, Mohammed Merah awakened a fear that France had forgotten since the last GIA attacks in 1995. He was wearing black, riding a scooter, and he killed seven times in Toulouse and Montauban. Three soldiers, three children and one Jewish father died under his bullets.
programme.desc-more: Between 11 March and 19 March 2012, in Toulouse and Montauban, Mohamed Merah committed a series of attacks killing seven people: three military personnel, as well as three children and one adult in a Jewish school. He will be identified after a flash investigation by the judicial police. His arrest will be entrusted to RAID. Return to a 10 day track and 30 hours of siege of his home before the assault. Families of victims, lawyers, police and judicial authorities testify.

programme.title: Bring In The Accused

programme.title: The crazy Disney story
programme.desc: Disney is a giant entertainment giant that dominates the box office like no other studio. Close-up on the crazy story of a company not like the others.
programme.desc-more: Marked by the contempt of the great studios of the time, Walt Disney, determined to exploit his creations by creating his own studio, managed to concoct a magical recipe that would make his first success. After surviving the difficult years that followed the death of its creator, Disney managed to populate the adult imaginations by getting hold of multiple franchises in the 2000s. Today, he is a giant of entertainment that dominates the box office like no other studio in the history of cinema. How did he manage to distance his competitors so much? How does he manage to renew himself without giving up his DNA? Close-up on the crazy story of a company not like the others.

programme.title: Nutella's crazy story
programme.desc: Everyone knows Nutella. In France, the brand represents more than half of the market for spread pasta and is one of the country's top food products. Yet, few know that this success was born in the back of a small Italian pastry shop. Just after World War II, in Piedmont, Pietro Ferrero sought to create a gourmet and accessible product. In 1949, his son Michele Ferrero, then 24 years old, turned this craft idea into an industrial adventure.

programme.title: Inside McDo : a year in the #1 restaurant in France
programme.desc: It is one of the most well-known companies in the world and is present on all continents. With more than 2 million meals served a day, France is now the second largest global market for "McDonald's", just after the United States. This conquest of the country champion of gastronomy is not without intrigue the implantation of what is emblematic of junk food. Besides, competitors like "Burger King" or the "KFC" fried chicken king are also present alongside the American giant.

programme.title: The crazy story of Coca-Cola
programme.desc: Close-up on the crazy epic of Coca-Cola, which has become a global symbol of user-friendliness and shared moments thanks to a visionary marketing.
programme.desc-more: More than a drink, Coca-Cola has become a global symbol of conviviality and shared moments. His fulgurant rise is based on a visionary marketing: the secret of the recipe locked in a safe in Atlanta, the red and jovial Santa Claus popularized in his pubs, cult campaigns and a pioneer product placement in the cinema, notably in Spielberg's E.T. Even today, Coca-Cola must defend its image against criticisms of sugar and the environment. How does the giant manage to remain a leader despite the controversy? Close-up on the crazy epic of Coca-Cola, from cocaine to the most iconic soda on the planet.

programme.title: A guy, a girl
programme.desc: John and Alex are in bad faith, they're fighting, they're getting provoked. They're arrogant, selfish, greedy and jealous. But first, they love each other!
programme.desc-more: In a Parisian apartment where the disputes are as fast as the bursts of laughter, vibrate a thirty-year-old couple as fond as it is exasperating: Jean (Jean Dujardin), nicknamed Loulou by the one who shares her daily life, and Alexandra (Alexandra Lamy), affectionately called Chouchou. He, a seducer clumsy with the great principles but with the little cowardice, she, an independent woman with a well-drained character, forms an explosive duo where love is measured in existential crises and improvised reconciliations. Between the walls of their housing – a battlefield of battle and tenderness at the same time – is a human comedy where the daily hassles become mountains to climb... or to bypass with a pirouette. Chouchou and Loulou, it's the story of two egos who fight, seek and find each other, tirelessly. He dreams of greatness but drowns in details (how to fold a road map without tearing it apart?), she manages their lives with a pragmatism that friezes despotism (the socks that drag are a crime against humanity). Between forgotten races, romantic dinners that turn to the rules of accounts, and friends who always arrive at the wrong time, their relationship is a constant balance between the desire to break everything and the desire to repair everything with a hug. Yet behind the arguments for a poorly closed pot lid or a lost remote control, there is an unwavering complicity. Whether it is in the face of the intrusive mother-in-law, the insufferable office colleagues, or the temptations of infidelity that point their noses, Chouchou and Loulou navigate between nerve attacks and crazy laughs, proving that love is also a laugh of his own faults. For in the background, despite the low blows and the unsaid, one question persists: how can we stay together when we are both the best and the worst that can happen to each other?

programme.title: The Christmas parade
programme.desc: A young boy and his mother are trying to revive an old local train party. The teacher who helps them hides the truth about his mysterious interruption.
programme.desc-more: Charlotte, a single mother who is busy between her work and her son's education, Benny, a ten-year-old boy as dreaming as she is determined, tries to make ends meet. Since her husband's disappearance, the end-of-year celebrations have lost their shine, and Christmas is more than a succession of mechanical gestures, without this spark that once made the eyes of the inhabitants shine. Everything changes when Benny discovers, in an old dusty grimoire found in the attic, the existence of a forgotten tradition: the Christmas train, an enchanted railway parade that, decades earlier, brought together the families of Pine Ridge and neighbouring villages. The ancient accounts describe a luminous procession, where the decorated cars ran to the sound of the songs, distributing gifts and spreading joy throughout the county. Fascinated, Benny persuades her mother to revive this magic that disappeared. Despite her reluctance – and a budget more than limited – Charlotte is convinced, touched by her son's enthusiasm and hope to reconnect with the spirit of the holidays. To carry out this ambitious project, they turn to Benny's professor Zack, a charismatic and mysterious man who seems to share their passion for the d Under his leadership, the project takes shape: the inhabitants are mobilizing, the scenery is coming out of the boxes, and the old train, abandoned for years, is being rehabilitated. Charlotte, who begins to fall under Zack's charm, sees him as an unexpected ally, perhaps even a chance to rebuild his sentimental life. But as the preparations are in full swing, she discovers that Zack is hiding a secret.

programme.title: A Christmas in Scotland
programme.desc: A decorator helps a Scottish village to participate in the "Most Beautiful Christmas Village" contest. First hostile, a rich heir eventually joins the project.
programme.desc-more: Emma McKenzie, a young designer of popular event facilities in New York City, built her career on her ability to create fairy-tale atmospheres for parties. Yet, despite her talent, she feels a growing vacuum in the face of the constant agitation of the big city. As Christmas approaches, she decides to give herself a break and goes to a small rural village in Scotland where time seems to have stopped. There, she hopes to find a little more simplicity and authenticity that she so much misses. But his stay takes an unexpected turn when the inhabitants, charmed by his expertise, ask him to help them decorate the village for the holidays. Emma, touched by their enthusiasm, accepts with pleasure, seeing there an opportunity to give a little magic back to this endearing community. However, his project quickly met with opposition from Liam, the influential heir to the local domain. Unlike other villagers, Liam does not share the general enthusiasm for Christmas celebrations. For him, these feasts are only a painful reminder of the past, and he prefers to preserve the tranquillity and austere traditions of his family. Despite their disagreements, Emma and Liam find themselves forced to collaborate when unforeseen circumstances force them to join forces to save the preparations. Between the garlands to hang, the tree to decorate and the Christmas markets to organize, their exchanges, initially tense, gradually leave room for unexpected complicity.

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.desc: In the early 1970s, a series of murders bloodshed the city of Nogent-sur-Oise. The victims are women. The modus operandi is always the same: they are spotted in advance, tracked as they return home after work. They are then abused and killed. After a seven-year investigation, the police finally arrested a man, Marcel Barbeault.
programme.desc-more: In the early 1970s, Nogent-sur-Oise lived in terror: several murders were committed at night. The victims, who were raped before being killed, were mostly women who returned home after work. In September 1974, the investigation was entrusted to Divisional Inspector Daniel Neveu, a young policeman who had no fault in his journey. He became passionate about the case and eventually arrested Marcel Barbeault, a husband and father of a family, in 1976.

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.desc: In 2006, in the small village of Ladoix-Serrigny, in Côte-d'Or, Marcelle Bouvard, a 79-year-old wealthy old lady, widow of the former mayor, was murdered. The couple had no children, but Marcelle was very close to her grand-neveux. The investigation is a surprising culprit.
programme.desc-more: On April 16, 2006, on Easter Sunday, gendarmes went to Marcelle Bouvard, an old lady who lived in the small village of Ladoix-Serrigny, Burgundy, to bring her wallet back. Finding the door closed, the patrol is about to leave when she notices that the garage is closed. Inside, the seven-year-old lies on the ground. His head is bloody. The autopsy revealed that the victim was violently beaten with a blunt object.

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.sub-title: Jean-Pierre Deulin: for a few centimetres more
programme.desc: June 21, 1987, in Maroilles. Jean-Pierre Deulin, a farmer, calls the gendarmerie: his wife, Janine, has just killed herself. When the gendarmes arrive at the scene, everything has already been cleaned. A few days later, Deulin was the victim of a car accident. In his pocket, the investigators find a word in which he claims to have killed his wife.
programme.desc-more: June 21, 1987, at Maroilles, in the North. Jean-Pierre Deulin, a 37-year-old farmer, calls the gendarmerie: Janine, his wife, killed herself with a long-rifle rifle. When the gendarmes arrived, everything was cleaned up. A reconstitution will later reveal that Janine was too small to reach the weapon release, effectively excluding suicide. However, after a demonstration by his lawyer to prove the contrary, the jurors of his trial, which opened in March 1990, acquit Jean-Pierre Deulin definitively.

programme.sub-title: Florence Federlé, the mystery of the burnt trunk

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.sub-title: Jean-Michel Bissonnet, the husband, the count and the gardener
programme.desc: Who killed Bernadette Bissonnet in her beautiful villa in Castelnau-le-Lez? Mezzane Belkacem, the gardener? Amaury d'Harcourt, the noble and old friend of the family? Or Jean-Michel Bissonnet, the husband? The three men appeared before the Assises de Montpellier.
programme.desc-more: On March 11, 2008, Jean-Michel Bissonnet, a retired, discovered his wife's body in their luxurious villa in Castelnau-le-Lez. Bernadette was killed with two shots. Confondu, Mezzane Belkacem, the couple's gardener, confesses but accuses the husband of being the sponsor. Amaury d'Harcourt, an old friend of the husband, joined the accusations with the gardener. Jean-Michel Bissonnet, who was sentenced to 20 years in prison on appeal, still claims his innocence.

programme.title: Cold Case
programme.desc: A truck containing human bones came out of the Delaware River. On this occasion, Lilly and Scotty reopen an investigation dating from the Prohibition.
programme.desc-more: In the Cold Case series, Inspector Lilly Rush (Kathryn Morris) is the head of a special unit of the Philadelphia police, dedicated to reopening unresolved cases. Lilly and his team are confronted with complex mysteries and long-sought secrets by immerse themselves in investigations that sometimes go back to the Prohibition. Each episode plunges them into the past, revealing poignant stories of forgotten victims, while Lilly uses his intuition and empathy to dig up the truth. The discovery of whitened bone skeletons and the testimony of people with new elements fuel his determination to do justice. With the support of his teammates, including Detective Scotty Valens (Danny Pino) and Sergeant John Stillman (John Finn), Lilly sailed between the ages, seeking to solve crimes that still haunted families. The series, with its exciting rhythm and captivating soundtrack, offers a touching exploration of the consequences of criminal acts on human lives.

programme.title: Cold Case
programme.desc: A young girl is contacted by a stranger who says she is her father. Lilly Rush reopens the case of a young man killed the night the teenage girl was born in 1988.
programme.desc-more: Lilly Rush (Kathryn Morris), a detective in a special police unit, is dedicated to reopening unsolved old investigations, called "cold cases". His commitment led him to reopen the affair of the mysterious death of his great-grandmother, which occurred in 1929. In parallel, Lilly discovered new evidence in a case of underage violence dating back to 1965, as well as the apparently inexplicable suicide of a teenager in 1994. Through these investigations, Lilly navigates a complex world of family emotions and secrets, while encircling a diverse team, including Kat Miller (Tracie Thoms), a novice but full of potential. This team dynamic is reinforced when Kat helped solve the murder of a Vietnam veteran in 1973. Each episode reveals buried truths, while exploring the lasting impact of unresolved crimes on victims and their loved ones, capturing the essence of the need for justice.

programme.title: A guy, a girl
programme.desc: John and Alex are in bad faith, they're fighting, they're getting provoked. They're arrogant, selfish, greedy and jealous. But first, they love each other!
programme.desc-more: In a Parisian apartment where the disputes are as fast as the bursts of laughter, vibrate a thirty-year-old couple as fond as it is exasperating: Jean (Jean Dujardin), nicknamed Loulou by the one who shares her daily life, and Alexandra (Alexandra Lamy), affectionately called Chouchou. He, a seducer clumsy with the great principles but with the little cowardice, she, an independent woman with a well-drained character, forms an explosive duo where love is measured in existential crises and improvised reconciliations. Between the walls of their housing – a battlefield of battle and tenderness at the same time – is a human comedy where the daily hassles become mountains to climb... or to bypass with a pirouette. Chouchou and Loulou, it's the story of two egos who fight, seek and find each other, tirelessly. He dreams of greatness but drowns in details (how to fold a road map without tearing it apart?), she manages their lives with a pragmatism that friezes despotism (the socks that drag are a crime against humanity). Between forgotten races, romantic dinners that turn to the rules of accounts, and friends who always arrive at the wrong time, their relationship is a constant balance between the desire to break everything and the desire to repair everything with a hug. Yet behind the arguments for a poorly closed pot lid or a lost remote control, there is an unwavering complicity. Whether it is in the face of the intrusive mother-in-law, the insufferable office colleagues, or the temptations of infidelity that point their noses, Chouchou and Loulou navigate between nerve attacks and crazy laughs, proving that love is also a laugh of his own faults. For in the background, despite the low blows and the unsaid, one question persists: how can we stay together when we are both the best and the worst that can happen to each other?

programme.title: The Gentlemen
programme.desc: Supported by his beloved wife and his right arm, a drug baron wants to sell his belongings, coveted by three unscrupulous gangsters.
programme.desc-more: In the complex world of London crime, Mickey Pearson (Matthew McConaughey), a respected gangster, finds himself in the heart of a dangerous imbroglio after being shot in his favourite bar by a mysterious shooter. Prior to this tragedy, Fletcher (Hugh Grant), a private detective with unorthodox methods, was hired by Big Dave, a newspaper director with questionable intentions, to extort a colossal sum from Mickey's band. By infiltrating Mickey's circle, Fletcher visits Ray (Charlie Hunnam), one of Mickey's accomplices, in order to offer him a deal: he holds compromising information about the gang's criminal activities and is ready to exchange it for twenty million pounds. This game of power and manipulation leads to a treason, rivalry and revenge in a world where loyalty is put to the test and where every movement can have fatal consequences.

programme.title: Alone in the world
programme.desc: Failed after a crash on a deserted island, an employee of an express transport company gradually learns the art of survival and debugging.
programme.desc-more: Chuck Noland (Tom Hanks) plays the archetype of the overbooked frame. A logistics expert for FedEx, he travels the planet with surgical precision, optimizing delivery chains and boosting the productivity of his teams. Its existence, regulated as a Swiss clock, leaves little room for the unexpected – or emotions. Only respite in this whirlwind: the rare moments spent with Kelly Frears (Helen Hunt), his companion, whose patient love and tender contrast with his own pragmatism. Yet, on Christmas Eve, as Chuck finally prepares to enjoy a well-deserved respite alongside him, an urgent appeal is upsetting everything. A priority package must be delivered to Malaysia without delay, and its presence on the ground is essential. Despite Kelly's reluctance, he boarded reluctantly, once again sacrificing his personal life on the altar of professional efficiency. But this routine journey will sink into the nightmare when his plane, caught in a storm of unheard of violence, crashes in the Pacific Ocean.

programme.desc: Each year, more than one hundred Samus across France respond to more than 20 million calls and nearly 400 mobile emergency and resuscitation facilities (SMUR) perform more than 750,000 interventions. Collisions, serious falls, malaise or domestic accidents: the missions of emergency doctors never look alike. The gravity of the situation is also compounded by the difficulties on the ground. Direction Périgueux, in the Dordogne department, where a team followed the rhythmic daily life of these professionals for several months.

programme.title: 100 days with rescue
programme.desc: The SAMU du Var, based in Brignoles Le Luc, between Marseille and Saint-Tropez, is under high voltage. In the heart of a vast territory of more than 30 communes, often very far from each other, medical teams take turns day and night to serve 200,000 inhabitants. They manage a multitude of interventions, ranging from road accidents and paediatric emergencies to the rarest and most spectacular cases such as psychiatric emergencies or ventrations, which require their full attention.

programme.sub-title: John Szablewski, from lying to murder
programme.desc: On Wednesday, November 28, 2007, in Farbus, Pas-de-Calais, John Szablewski contacted the gendarmerie. Her companion Laurence Maille, 36, is missing. Only out walking the dog, she didn't return to the marital home. The search begins immediately. John Szablewski, along with the investigators, traces the time of the missing woman, prepares and distributes search notices. In front of the cameras, the 29-year-old man continues the interviews and returns to the scene of the disappearance. On December 5, Laurence Maille's body was found buried in a wood in the vicinity.

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.desc: Despite the years in prison, Albert Millet was never able to contain his deadly impulses. In Hyères, in 1954, when he was 25, he sifted his girlfriend's aunt with bullets. In 1979, he killed his wife with a knife. In 2002, he was wounded by his new companion and in 2007 he killed a man who was frequented by his concubine. As always, Millet disappeared into the landscape, followed closely by the police. But this time, he's not going to jail. At 78, he no longer wants to flee and commit suicide.

programme.sub-title: The Blue Beard of the Essonne
programme.desc: As a child, Adeline Piet was fond of dolls and bathers. Her dream came true at 34 when she became a mother of seven. When Adeline disappeared on 2 July 2006, the incomprehension and the shock quickly gained his entourage. This devoted mother could never have given up her little ones without a word. The accident, the runaway, a sect, suicide, investigators have considered all the leads.
programme.desc-more: A professor in a professional high school, now a businessman, Jamel Leulmi crossed the road of several women who had taken out insurances for his benefit. Like his wife, Katthlyn, who died in front of his eyes in a bicycle accident at night on a small road. And, later, his girlfriend Julie who almost died, the vertebrae broken, in a road accident followed by an attack, in Morocco. Back to the investigation that led in 2016 to his conviction to thirty years in prison for murder, attempted murder and fraud.

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.desc: Patrick Constantien was knocked down and slit on his couch on November 18, 2008. The investigators soon suspected his wife, Christine. programme.desc-more: On February 11, 1997, Peggy, Amélie, Isabelle and Audrey, aged 17 to 20, went to a carnival party in Pas-de-Calais. We never saw them again. The culprits: Jean-Michel and Jean-Louis Jourdain, two men already convicted, one for rape, the other for murder. Christophe Hondelatte returns to the first days of the research with Gérald Lesigne, prosecutor of the Republic of Boulogne-sur-Mer. At that point, the police are thinking of a runaway. But ten days later, the Jordan brothers were arrested. Jean-Louis cracked during his custody and led the police to the martyred bodies of Peggy, Amélie, Isabelle and Audrey, buried on the beach of Sainte-Cécile, near the Touquet. After their appeal, the two brothers received life imprisonment.

programme.desc: Anne-Laure Urvoy, 27, was found dead at her home on Wednesday, November 21, 2007. Very soon, suspicions were made of Anne-Laure's former companion, Abderrazzak Zibha, a violent man with multiple faces. When the gendarmes discover that the suspect is trying to reach Algeria on a ferry, the Public Prosecutor's Office diverts the boat.

programme.title: The witches of Salem: the true story

programme.title: Cold Case
programme.desc: Lilly and her team are reopening an unresolved 30-year-old case: the disappearance in 1975 of an 8-year-old girl. At the time, his relatives had concluded that he had been murdered. In a predominantly white and racist city, she had the courage to be friends with a black child...
programme.desc-more: In Philadelphia, the team of the Unsolved Business Section, led by Lilly Rush (Kathryn Morris), is committed to reopening long forgotten investigations, confronting the ghosts of the past. The season opens with a tragic case: a massacre in a large area in 1995, where a possible third accomplice emerges, questioning the version of events. In another episode, the death of a policeman, suspected of corruption in 1968, revives investigations into a troubled past. The discovery of a teenager's remains in a garbage dumpster raises questions about the young man's identity and the circumstances of his disappearance. Each case is intertwined with poignant cultural references, such as the Columbine shooting and controversial doctor Jack Kevorkian. With a rich soundtrack, mixing artists like Bob Dylan and Coldplay, this Cold Case season plunges the spectator into an emotional exploration of the consequences of unsolved crimes.

programme.title: Cold Case
programme.desc: 1995. Two teenagers commit suicide after being involved in a murderous shooting in a mall. In 2006, the police found a video of the shooting. Lilly discovers that a third shooter managed to escape from the crime scene by pretending to be a survivor...
programme.desc-more: Lilly Rush (Kathryn Morris), a detective in a special police unit, is dedicated to reopening unsolved old investigations, called "cold cases". His commitment led him to reopen the affair of the mysterious death of his great-grandmother, which occurred in 1929. In parallel, Lilly discovered new evidence in a case of underage violence dating back to 1965, as well as the apparently inexplicable suicide of a teenager in 1994. Through these investigations, Lilly navigates a complex world of family emotions and secrets, while encircling a diverse team, including Kat Miller (Tracie Thoms), a novice but full of potential. This team dynamic is reinforced when Kat helped solve the murder of a Vietnam veteran in 1973. Each episode reveals buried truths, while exploring the lasting impact of unresolved crimes on victims and their loved ones, capturing the essence of the need for justice.

At the port of Ghent, Anaïs and Myriam encounter difficulties in parking and delaying unloading. Estelle delivers her cargo before returning to search for concrete walls. Lexie, for his part, continues to learn mechanics from Jennifer, with the ambition to become a race driver. In Nogaro, Amélie, Anaïs, Myriam, Clotilde and Sabine, they have an exceptional experience: they board race trucks.

programme.title: XXL trucks: the queens of the wheel
programme.desc: In general, the female gender is not associated with the trucking profession. But the "Trucker Babes" are here to hurt this prejudice. They are robust, bright in spirit and with many horses under their seats, they do not let themselves be counted.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Luka Kovac, a Croatian doctor, took his first steps in the emergency room, as did Abby Lockhart, a young obstetric nurse who had become a medical student. Elizabeth Corday and Mark Greene started an affair while his father gave the soul back. The actor Anthony Edwards, who was behind the camera for the film "Charlie et le Phantom" in 1994, directed the episode "Family affairs", after two first essays in seasons 2 and 4.
programme.desc-more: Back at Cook County Hospital, Dr.John Carter (Noah Wyle) discovered an environment radically transformed by technological innovation that upset the emergency department during his absence. In the face of his colleagues, he must navigate between his traditional methods, which some consider to be outdated, and the integration of new practices. Meanwhile, Dr. Banfield (Laura Innes) and her husband make the choice to adopt, a process that plunges them into intense reflections on parenting and the challenges that accompany it. At the same time, Sam's situation (Eriq La Salle) becomes more complicated when his mother, with a tumultuous past, arrives in the emergency room, generating strong tensions and emotions. Through these intertwined narratives, "Emergences" explores not only the medical challenges, but also the human dynamics and personal struggles that take place in the background of a hospital service always under pressure.

programme.title: Ink Master: the best tattooer
programme.desc: Ink Master is a competition of American professional tattoo artists, judged through various artistic challenges. Ink Master is the first show to make tattoo art a competition! The principle is simple: ten candidates compete through events to win the prestigious title of "best tattoo artist" and the $100,000 award. programme.title: The 100 most cult pubs: special 1990s
programme.desc: Repeated slogans in the playground, jingles impossible to forget, characters become famous and replicas that, thirty years later, remain in all memories: zooming in on unforgettable ads from the 1990s. Memories of a car that was not "cost enough" for the son of an emir, the ambassador's evenings and their pyramids of a famous chocolate, the Australian of a underwear brand, or the "itching pub" for a scratch game. Not to mention the stars of the time: Johnny, Maity, Ophelia Winter, Clémentine Célarié or the heroes of the 1998 World Cup. Funny, inventive, sometimes absurd, these advertisements have marked collective memory.

programme.title: The 100 most cult pubs
programme.desc: The pubs are an integral part of the landscape of the small screen. And for the first time, a ranking reveals the 100 most cult ads. These advertisements have become real must-sees such as the madeleines of Proust, Maurice the goldfish that "pushs the cork", the unforgettable slogans of the Lotto or the crazy sagas of Orangina signed Alain Chabat. There are also the faces of the stars: Zidane, Adriana Karembeu, Claudia Schiffer... And how to forget the campaigns of Evian, Peugeot or Free, Ikea and Oasis that changed the advertising in their own way.

programme.title: A guy, a girl
programme.desc: In a Parisian apartment where the disputes are as fast as the bursts of laughter, vibrate a thirty-year-old couple as fond as it is exasperating: Jean (Jean Dujardin), nicknamed Loulou by the one who shares her daily life, and Alexandra (Alexandra Lamy), affectionately called Chouchou. He, a seducer clumsy with the great principles but with the little cowardice, she, an independent woman with a well-drained character, forms an explosive duo where love is measured in existential crises and improvised reconciliations. Between the walls of their housing – a battlefield of battle and tenderness at the same time – is a human comedy where the daily hassles become mountains to climb... or to bypass with a pirouette. Chouchou and Loulou, it's the story of two egos who fight, seek and find each other, tirelessly. He dreams of greatness but drowns in details (how to fold a road map without tearing it apart?), she manages their lives with a pragmatism that friezes despotism (the socks that drag are a crime against humanity). Between forgotten races, romantic dinners that turn to the settlement of accounts, and friends who always arrive at the wrong time, their relationship is a constant balance between the desire to break everything and the desire to repair everything with a hug.However, behind the arguments for a poorly closed pot lid or a lost remote control, is a constant complicity. Whether it is in the face of the intrusive mother-in-law, the insufferable office colleagues, or the temptations of infidelity that point their noses, Chouchou and Loulou navigate between nerve attacks and crazy laughs, proving that love is also a laugh of his own faults. For in the background, despite the low blows and the unsaid, one question persists: how can we stay together when we are both the best and the worst that can happen to each other?

programme.title: Castle
programme.desc: Castle and Beckett finally decided to get married. At the same time, the young woman joined the FBI, and she's starting to work in Washington. During this sixth season, when we follow the wedding preparations, Castle is poisoned by a mysterious toxin. He's trying to get back on the team while Beckett's fired from the FBI. Meanwhile, Alexis has a new boyfriend, Pi, a boy who doesn't like Castle. In the twelfth episode, Castle found his father, whose news he had had since Alexis was abducted in Paris (season 5).

programme.title: Castle
programme.desc: Beckett's relationship with Castle is taking on a new twist: they spent one night together. As a first step, they obviously try to hide their relationship from their colleagues as well as Matha and Alexis. In the first episode of this fifth season, Beckett and Castle finally discover the name of the man who commissioned Beckett's mother's murder. This is William Bracken (Jack Coleman), a senator. This character becomes recurring in the series, creating a conflict with Beckett. Finally, in a double episode, Alexis was kidnapped and then Castle met his father, a former spy. The season ends with Castle's marriage proposal, and the FBI's offer to Beckett.

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.sub-title: Roland Bondonny, the mystery of blue meatballs
programme.desc: On 25 August 2004, Marius Lac, a retired police officer, was murdered at his home in Corrèze. The man had witnessed the prosecution in the trial of Roland Bondonny, a notable sentenced to one year in prison for poisoning more than a hundred dogs and cats. This murder occurred shortly before Bondonny's appeal trial was opened. In Fourmies, in the North, the gendarmes discover that Alain Bodchon knows Roland Bondonny. On 19 October 2004, Bodchon and Bondonny were arrested. Bodchon confesses to killing Marius Lake at Bondonny's request.

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.sub-title: On the road to mass killers
programme.desc: Check out the summary of season 24 episodes in the series Bring the Accused

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.desc: On 19 April 2008, Susanna Zetterberg, a 19-year-old Swedish student, went to a nightclub in the 1st arrondissement of Paris, La Scala, with friends. At about 4:30, the girl left the discotheque. Nobody ever saw him again. His calcined body was discovered shortly after in Chantilly Forest, in the Oise. Shot by video surveillance cameras, a few kilometres from the crime scene, a man is being arrested by the police. Bruno Cholet, 51, a illegal taxi driver, already known to the police.

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.sub-title: Ponce Gaudissard, the mysteries of Meyrargues
programme.desc: On 31 March 2003, in Meyragues, not far from Aix-en-Provence, Chantal d'Amato and his daughter Audrey, 24, were both absent from their work. Alerted, the gendarmes found their house closed, the shutters lowered. But smoke comes out of a window. Inside, the two women are discovered bent and tied. They were slit, and Audrey, who seemed to be the pincipal target, received 29 stab wounds. Despite traces of DNA discovered on site, the investigation is trampling until the name of Ponce Gaudissard appears.

programme.title: Inside Center Parks: holidays all year round
programme.desc: More than thirty years after the opening of the first Parks Center in France, this concept halfway between the holiday village and the leisure park continues to seduce as much. With hundreds of identical houses scattered under the trees, its supermarket, swimming pool and restaurants, the ensemble gives the visitor the strange feeling of diving in a fictional setting, a "bulle" that would simulate an ideal city, where children travel freely, in a reassuring and domesticated nature. Discover the secrets of the brand's success.

programme.title: Futuroscope: the techno of attractions
programme.desc: Futuroscope is the fourth most visited amusement park in France. In 1987 he opened in Vienna with the aim of becoming the showcase of the future. With 25 avant-garde buildings, it offers highly innovative, image-based attractions that succeed in transmitting scientific concepts in an educational and fun way. In recent years, the Futuroscope has taken a new turn, investing in creating new and revolutionary attractions, including an aquatic park. Discover behind the scenes of this huge futuristic machine.

programme.title: Puy du Fou: the genius of the shows revealed
programme.desc: For 45 years, Le Puy du Fou conquered the hearts of the French. The world's best-known park in 2012 and 2014 in the United States, this amusement park sees its visitors grow every year. With a new park in Spain, shows in Holland and soon in the United States, it becomes international. Behind these stories developed by the Puy du Fou, which seduce thanks to the emotions they convey, are a whole team of the best talents of the industries concerned to perform the shows.

programme.title: Puy du Fou : the 10 most innovative technos in the park
programme.desc: The Puy du Fou attracts an ever-increasing audience every year. While visitors come for historical stories and epic frescoes, the park's success is also based on a particularly elaborate technical mechanics. Behind the stage, teams of engineers and technicians design complex devices, designed to make illusion possible. Each element must combine safety, reliability and fluidity, while remaining invisible to the public. With images shot behind the scenes, in the basement and in the technical corridors, complemented by 3D models, this unpublished documentary reveals, for the first time, the ten most innovative technologies in the park.

programme.title: A candlelit Christmas
programme.desc: As the end of the year approaches, Juliet, an ambitious wellness expert, finally sees the opportunity to make her talent recognized. His idea? Launch an exclusive range of Christmas souvenir candles, olfactory creations supposed to capture the magic of festive moments and move the most hardened hearts. For her, this project is not only a question of creativity, but a chance to get the much-awaited promotion in her company. Yet his enthusiasm is quickly met with a major obstacle: Tom, the owner of a small craft candle shop, as talented as he is skeptical. For him, the welfare industry is just an illusion machine, and he categorically refuses to collaborate on what he considers to be a marketing operation that is devoid of sincerity. But Tom is hiding a secret that could make things go wrong. Behind his apparent coldness is a father ready to do anything to fulfill his daughter's Christmas vow. When he realizes that the income generated by this project could offer him this opportunity, he reluctantly accepts to associate with Juliet.

programme.title: The Christmas parade
programme.desc: Charlotte, a single mother who is busy between her work and her son's education, Benny, a ten-year-old boy as dreaming as she is determined, tries to make ends meet. Since her husband's disappearance, the end-of-year celebrations have lost their shine, and Christmas is more than a succession of mechanical gestures, without this spark that once made the eyes of the inhabitants shine. Everything changes when Benny discovers, in an old dusty grimoire found in the attic, the existence of a forgotten tradition: the Christmas train, an enchanted railway parade that, decades earlier, brought together the families of Pine Ridge and neighbouring villages. The ancient accounts describe a luminous procession, where the decorated cars ran to the sound of the songs, distributing gifts and spreading joy throughout the county. Fascinated, Benny persuades her mother to revive this magic that disappeared. Despite her reluctance – and a budget more than limited – Charlotte is convinced, touched by her son's enthusiasm and hope to reconnect with the spirit of the holidays. To carry out this ambitious project, they turn to Benny's professor Zack, a charismatic and mysterious man who seems to share their passion for the d Under his leadership, the project takes shape: the inhabitants are mobilizing, the scenery is coming out of the boxes, and the old train, abandoned for years, is being rehabilitated. Charlotte, who begins to fall under Zack's charm, sees him as an unexpected ally, perhaps even a chance to rebuild his sentimental life. But as the preparations are in full swing, she discovers that Zack is hiding a secret.

programme.title: Bring nature in
programme.desc: A lawyer is preparing a petition against the French state for the slaughter of sharks in Réunion. Its objective: to make the ocean recognized as a subject of law.
programme.desc-more: The lawyer Marine Calmet is preparing a new remedy against the French state following the slaughter of hundreds of sharks in La Réunion. With oceanographer François Sarano and students, she organizes a simulated trial to develop her arguments. Its aim is to have a legal personality recognized in the ocean in order to condemn this slaughter and to make the oceans new subjects of law.

programme.title: The bottom of the maps
programme.desc: Drugs: a global market The world drug industry has long been dominated by the United States and Europe. Today, manufacturing is largely carried out by emerging countries such as India and China. Faced with the risks of shortages and the challenges of health sovereignty, several European countries are seeking to relocate manufacturing. Presentation: Émilie Aubry
programme.desc-more: An opportunity to understand how this large global market for drugs is organized, from production sites to research laboratories. programme.title: The fabulous history of birds, dinosaurs among us
programme.desc: A review of the history of birds that, after surviving the last great extinction, have become one of the most diverse species on the planet.
programme.desc-more: Daniel Field, a specialist in paleo-ornithology at Cambridge University, is working on the reconstruction of the major stages of bird evolution, the last survivors of the disaster that led to the extinction of their cousins dinosaurs. In 2019, he found in a fossil the crane of the oldest modern bird ever discovered. Now, research focuses on the reasons for their survival for millions of years and on their colonization of our planet. However, many of the 11,000 species of birds that inhabit the Earth today are threatened with extinction.

programme.title: The mystery of the yellow chamber
programme.desc: Assisted by a photographer friend, a young reporter investigates to find the one who tried to find the life of a famous teacher's daughter.
programme.desc-more: In the 1930s, the Glandier estate, isolated in the heart of a green countryside, became the scene of a troubling mystery. Miss Mathilde (Sabine Azema), the daughter of the famous scientist Stangerson, finds herself victim of an inexplicable assault in her yellow room, a room whose door was locked from the inside and whose window is carefully wired. Strangely, Mathilde cannot remember the events that preceded this attack, leaving the investigators puzzled by a riddle that seems to defy logic. The young and daring Joseph Rouletabille (Denis Podalydès), reporter of the newspaper 'L'Epoque' and aspirant detective, embarks on a quest to discover this mystery. With the help of his friend Sainclair (Olivier Gourmet), he is involved in a complex investigation, while Commissioner Larsan (Michael Lonsdale) and Marquet (Claude Rich) are also trying to resolve this intriguing case. Each clue reveals new layers of secrets, and tensions rise as the characters find themselves trapped in a game of manipulation and mystery. Rouletabille will have to be sagacious and perceptive in order to overcome the obstacles on its way, while discovering the truth hidden behind this yellow room, where danger seems to be waiting at every corner.

programme.desc: Three elderly people died a few months apart after a spider bite. The little world of arachnophiles is panicking, Adamsberg is investigating.
programme.desc-more: In an atmosphere of mystery, the tranquillity of a small village is disturbed by the death of three old men, all of whom died a few months apart after being snatched by a dreaded spider, the rufescens loxosceles. While the arachnophile community is concerned about a possible mutation of this creature due to pesticides, Commissioner Jean-Baptiste Adamsberg (Jean-Hugues Anglade) refuses to give in to the panic. For him, the truth seems darker and more sinister: what if behind these shots were a series of carefully orchestrated murders? With his faithful assistant, Adrien Danglard (Thierry Hancisse), who remains skeptical of this theory, Adamsberg is embarking on a complex investigation. As he investigates, he will discover buried secrets and underlying tensions, testing his instincts as a detective against an elusive opponent, while navigating a world where nature and human life are unexpectedly intertwined.

programme.title: Die to love
programme.desc: In May 68, a 17-year-old high school student took a turn at her teacher, a French teacher, a thirty-year-old protestor: their love caused a scandal.
programme.desc-more: In the tumultuous context of May 1968, Danièle Guénot (Annie Girardot), a recently divorced thirty-year-old mother of two, began a new life as a teacher of letters in a high school in Rouen. His modern and committed teaching method contrasts strongly with that of his colleagues, which arouses admiration but also mistrust. In this atmosphere of revolt and desire for freedom, one of his students, Gérard Leguen (Bruno Pradal), aged 17, develops deep feelings for her. Despite his initial reluctance, Danièle gradually gave way to this unexpected love, shared between passion and guilt. However, their relationship soon attracted attention, and Gérard's parents, desperate to see their son move away, decided to intervene. They try to separate the two lovers by all means, going so far as to file a complaint against Danièle for misappropriation of minors. This explosive situation highlights intergenerational tensions and raises questions about freedom, love and morality. In a changing world, Danièle finds herself facing heartbreaking choices that could upset her life and Gérard's. This poignant drama explores the limits of love and the consequences of the choices we make, while portraying a striking portrait of an era in full swing. (Final verification: the text makes 213 words, without spoilers, and follows the instructions.)

programme.title: The point
programme.sub-title: Noise greenhouse gases / Milk residue based fuel
programme.desc:
To the summary:
Nose greenhouse gases In Nova Scotia, a project is under development to clean up the atmosphere. The latter is attracting the interest of scientists all over the world. It plans to drown CO2 in oceans and rivers, to absorb greenhouse gases! Trials are already underway...
A milk residue fuel, a crazy idea? In Michigan and perhaps soon Ontario, the dairy industry has found an original way to add value to one of its by-products. A fuel based on milk residue is in production and is already attracting the aviation sector.
Transforming a church into a vegetable complex To combat food insecurity and waste, a major project was set up in Beauce. The organization Cultiver pour partage has transformed a church into a gardening complex. The goal? Produce, process, store and distribute fresh vegetables and fruit year round.
Circular economy: close the loop at the farm In the past, when farms were smaller and different types of animals were raised, cooking waste was given to chickens and pigs. A practice that has been lost. A young family is inspired by this approach and makes the circular economy.

In "L'Arabe", the director freely adapts the text of Kamel Daoud "Meursault, contra-inquiries" and gives the name and face of the Arab murdered in Albert Camus's "L'Etranger". In this novel, the writer embarks us on an intimate and apocalyptic roadtrip, with Joseph and Maryam. It's nighttime, two strangers drive north to join their loved ones. Around them, villages in ruins, the sea that absorbs, mysterious encounters, the star of the North...
As early as 2011, Rafael Yaghobzadeh documented the Arab Spring and has been covering since Ukraine's conflicts in Lebanon. His long-term work questions memory, exile, identity, inheritance, in disaster-stricken territories or post-conflict situations. The photographer participates in the "Kyiv Impact 2026" forum, with the French Institute in Ukraine, and was the winner of the 2026 Gold Visa Online for "Lebanon - Perpetual War(s)", directed for "Le Monde".
#Atmosphere with the guests' favourites.

programme.title: My mom, the crab and I
programme.desc: In a world full of emotion and complexity, "My mother, the crab and I" explores the fragile links between a mother and her daughter. Tania (Lorette Nyssen), a young woman with an assertive character, begins to feel a disturbing distance with her mother, Cathy (Emilie Dequenne). While she suspects her mother to have a lover, Tania is far from imagining Cathy's real concern. In a state of internal turmoil, Cathy hides a devastating secret: she has just learned that she has breast cancer. This upsetting news obliges him to face his fears, including that of having to tell his daughter about his illness, whose carelessness and frequent conflicts seem to make the situation even more difficult. Over the days, Tania will discover the unsuspecting force that is hidden in her. By revealing herself to her mother, she becomes her unexpected support, accompanying her in this battle against illness. Both women, through their poignant exchanges and moments of vulnerability, learn to rediscover themselves and strengthen their ties. However, the path to acceptance and healing will be stumbling blocks, testing their love and resilience to adversity.

Europe is looking for reliable solutions and suppliers. In this equation, Norway is a key player. How far can it meet the needs? And above all, at what cost? Guests: Alexandre Paré, journalist at France Télévisions; Michael Aklin, Professor, Chair in Public Policy and Sustainability at the École Polytechnique fédérale de Lausanne Presentation: Dominique Laresche

programme.title: Fred Vargas Collection
programme.desc: Commissioner Adamsberg (Jean-Hugues Anglade) went to the Camargue, where he was confronted with a disturbing investigation that plunged him into a world of uncertainty. Lost in his reflections, he feels that he escapes something essential. The question that haunts him is that of reclusion: is it a woman, a beast, or a combination of both? As he went through his investigations, he discovered that Irene, a key figure in his investigation, shared her living space with Louise (Sylvie Testud), a woman marked by a deep fear of spiders and men. Intrigued, Adamsberg asked his lieutenant Froissy (Thierry Hancisse) to investigate Louise and meet her. In doing so, Froissy is digging up a terrible secret that unites Irene and Louise, revealing complex and obscure bonds that could well change the course of the investigation and highlight hidden truths.
programme.desc-more: In the Fred Vargas Collection, an intriguing universe is emerging through a series of adaptations of the successful novelist Fred Vargas. Dive into the world of criminal investigations and mysteries, the protagonist, Commissioner Adamsberg (Jean-Hugues Anglade), is an atypical policeman with unconventional methods, endowed with an exceptional instinct to solve the most complex cases. Each episode highlights a unique investigation, where legends, superstitions and absurdity mix together, while revealing the depths of the human soul. Accompanied by his faithful collaborators, such as Captain Danglard (Jacques Spiesser), a historian with remarkable analytical skills, and the sparkling Irene (Sylvie Testud), Adamsberg is walking the streets of Paris looking for mysterious clues and unsuspecting culprits.

programme.title: Death on beaten ground
programme.desc: As the spotlights light up on the prestigious International de tennis feminin de Paris, the effervescence of qualifications turns into a drama. In the early morning, as the players were about to tread the court in the mud, Vincent Beti (Yannick Noah), the technical director of the tournament, discovered Manon Picard's inanimate body, the young French prodigy whose brilliant career made it one of the public's favourites. His assassination plunges the event into chaos and reveals the ruthless behind the scenes of an environment where sporting rivalries and disproportionate ambitions mix with the shadows of a troubled past. In charge of the investigation, Captain Romain Fabiot (Florent Peyre), a seasoned and passionate tennis cop, finds himself confronted with a puzzle as complex as the strategies of a five-set match. With Camille Lauristan (Roxanne Roux), a young lieutenant determined to prove that she is worth more than her family heritage, he must unravel the sons of a case where every suspect – players, coaches, organizers – seems to hide something. Among them, Vincent Beti, whose silences and contradictions fuel Roman suspicions. If the hypothesis of a murder linked to competition is first imposed – tensions between competitors, jealousies, media pressure – the captain quickly press that the truth is much deeper. Who really wanted Manon dead? A sports rival? A close betrayer? Or someone whose motives date back to a long time before this damn tournament? To break the mystery, Romain will have to dive into the shadows of professional tennis, where glamour looks conceal much darker stakes.

programme.title: The fabulous history of birds, dinosaurs among us
programme.desc: Daniel Field, a specialist in paleo-ornithology at Cambridge University, is working on the reconstruction of the major stages of bird evolution, the last survivors of the disaster that led to the extinction of their cousins dinosaurs. In 2019, he found in a fossil the crane of the oldest modern bird ever discovered. Now, research focuses on the reasons for their survival for millions of years and on their colonization of our planet. However, many of the 11,000 species of birds that inhabit the Earth today are threatened with extinction.

programme.title: The point
programme.desc: The Agricultural Dream Further to the report \" La rendition agricole \" and dedicated to five young and passionate Quebec farmers who start their journey. A path that is often strewn with pitfalls where they face financial, administrative and climatic challenges. The man who planted wheat: the geneticist André Comeau To arrive at the varieties of wheat that we are growing today, it took a long selection work done first by farmers and then by scientists. Geneticist André Comeau, 80, continues to work tirelessly on improving this cereal. Its objective is to develop wheat adapted to climate change: the wheats of tomorrow! *The Agricultural Dream* 1 *The man who planted wheats: the geneticist André Comeau* 2

programme.title: The mystery of the yellow chamber
programme.desc: In the 1930s, the Glandier estate, isolated in the heart of a green countryside, became the scene of a troubling mystery. Miss Mathilde (Sabine Azema), the daughter of the famous scientist Stangerson, finds herself victim of an inexplicable assault in her yellow room, a room whose door was locked from the inside and whose window is carefully wired. Strangely, Mathilde cannot remember the events that preceded this attack, leaving the investigators puzzled by a riddle that seems to defy logic. The young and daring Joseph Rouletabille (Denis Podalydès), reporter of the newspaper 'L'Epoque' and aspirant detective, embarks on a quest to discover this mystery. With the help of his friend Sainclair (Olivier Gourmet), he is involved in a complex investigation, while Commissioner Larsan (Michael Lonsdale) and Marquet (Claude Rich) are also trying to resolve this intriguing case. Each clue reveals new layers of secrets, and tensions rise as the characters find themselves trapped in a game of manipulation and mystery. Rouletabille will have to be sagacious and perceptive in order to overcome the obstacles on its way, while discovering the truth hidden behind this yellow room, where danger seems to be waiting at every corner.
